papers.title: Percolation of Zero-Weight Paths and the Shape of the Phase Boundary in the Two-Dimensional Random-Bond Ising Model
papers.abstract: We explore the connection between the low-temperature boundary of the ferromagnetic phase in the two-dimensional $\pm J$ random-bond Ising model, where antiferromagnetic bonds occur with probability $p$ and a geometric transition dubbed ``zero-weight percolation''. We argue that the onset of this percolation characterized by the emergence of a percolating path containing an equal number of $+J$ and $-J$ bonds is incompatible with ferromagnetic ordering. Due to its purely geometrical nature, this percolation criterion is a property of a disorder realization and is independent of the temperature, which in turn suggests that the ferromagnetic phase boundary is vertical below the Nishimori point in the $(p,T)$ plane. Using a dynamic-programming algorithm combined with finite-size scaling, we identify the critical disorder at which zero-weight paths first percolate as $p_c = 0.1000(2)$, and we extract the associated critical exponents $ν= 1.26(1)$, $β/ν= 0.85(1)$, $γ/ν= 0.264(5)$, and fractal dimension $d_f \approx 1.11$. The value of $p_c$ is below the previously reported values of the critical disorder strength corresponding to the loss of the ferromagnetic order, both at zero temperature and the Nishimori point. Nevertheless, we argue that the percolation transition studied in this paper is behind the loss of ferromagnetism and thus provides a new, purely geometrical perspective on the stability of ferromagnetic order in disordered spin systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用动态规划算法结合有限尺寸标度分析，属于计算与理论结合的研究。；研究对象：二维±J随机键伊辛模型（random-bond Ising model）中的铁磁相边界形状，以及一种称为“零权重逾渗”（zero-weight percolation）的几何相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零权重逾渗（即存在一条包含等量+J和-J键的逾渗路径）的出现与铁磁有序不相容；该逾渗转变的临界无序强度p_c = 0.1000(2)低于此前报道的铁磁序消失的临界值，表明该几何逾渗是铁磁序丧失的根本原因，从而在(p,T)相图中，Nishimori点以下的铁磁相边界是垂直的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零权重逾渗（即存在一条包含等量+J和-J键的逾渗路径）的出现与铁磁有序不相容；该逾渗转变的临界无序强度p_c = 0.1000(2)低于此前报道的铁磁序消失的临界值，表明该几何逾渗是铁磁序丧失的根本原因，从而在(p,T)相图中，Nishimori点以下的铁磁相边界是垂直的。；创新点：提出了一种纯几何的逾渗判据（零权重路径逾渗）来理解无序自旋系统中铁磁序的稳定性，该判据与温度无关，从而为铁磁相边界的垂直形状提供了新的几何视角。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态规划算法（dynamic-programming algorithm）识别零权重路径的逾渗，并结合有限尺寸标度（finite-size scaling）提取临界点p_c及临界指数ν、β/ν、γ/ν和分形维数d_f。

papers.title: Insights of Ammonia Decomposition on W--B Nanoclusters by Computational Simulations
papers.abstract: Tungsten-boride nanoclusters represent a promising class of materials for catalytic applications, yet their structural stability and reactivity remain poorly understood. The evolutionary algorithm combined with density functional theory (DFT) are used to systematically explore the ground-state structures and stability landscape of W$_m$B$_n$ nanoclusters with up to 43 atoms. The resulting stability maps reveal a highly non-monotonic landscape characterized by isolated "magic" compositions, including WB$_{16}$, W$_2$B$_8$, W$_7$B$_{24}$, and W$_{11}$B$_{22}$, which exhibit pronounced local stability maxima. We further investigate the adsorption and initial decomposition step of ammonia on these clusters as a probe of their catalytic potential. Molecular NH$_3$ adsorption occurs exclusively on tungsten sites with energies ranging from -0.54 to -1.78 eV (average -1.43 eV), comparable to Pt$_n$ and Fe$_n$ clusters. Atomic hydrogen adsorption spans a broader range from +0.49 to -1.46 eV, reflecting high site sensitivity. Nudged elastic band calculations for the first N--H bond cleavage reveal forward barriers of 1.1-1.4 eV, with the dissociated NH$_2^*$ + H$^*$ state lying below the molecular adsorption state for most compositions. Notably, the activation barrier depends critically on the local environment available for stabilizing the detached hydrogen atom. These findings establish W--B nanoclusters as tunable catalysts for ammonia decomposition and provide a structural foundation for their rational design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：evolutionary algorithm combined with density functional theory (DFT)、nudged elastic band calculations。；研究对象：W-B（钨-硼）纳米团簇，具体为W_mB_n（原子数最多43个）的结构稳定性及其催化氨分解反应的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了W-B纳米团簇中一系列“魔幻”稳定组分（如WB₁₆、W₂B₈、W₇B₂₄、W₁₁B₂₂），并证明其氨分解催化活性与局部环境对氢原子的稳定能力密切相关，活化势垒在1.1-1.4 eV范围内。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了W-B纳米团簇中一系列“魔幻”稳定组分（如WB₁₆、W₂B₈、W₇B₂₄、W₁₁B₂₂），并证明其氨分解催化活性与局部环境对氢原子的稳定能力密切相关，活化势垒在1.1-1.4 eV范围内。；创新点：首次系统揭示了W-B纳米团簇的稳定性非单调图谱，并识别出多个“魔幻”组分；阐明了氨分解中氢原子稳定化环境对活化势垒的关键影响，为理性设计W-B基催化剂提供了结构基础。
papers.method_zh: 采用进化算法结合密度泛函理论（DFT）搜索基态结构并绘制稳定性图谱；通过DFT计算氨分子和氢原子的吸附能；使用微动弹性带（NEB）方法计算第一个N-H键断裂的反应势垒。

papers.title: Second-order dc conductivity in the velocity-gauge Keldysh formalism: gauge-invariant decomposition into nonlinear Drude, Berry-curvature-dipole, and quantum-metric responses
papers.abstract: We derive a gauge-invariant clean-limit decomposition of the second-order dc nonlinear conductivity in multiband tight-binding systems within the velocity-gauge Keldysh Green's function formalism. In the constant-relaxation-time approximation, the dc response separates into four contributions with distinct lifetime $τ$ scalings and physical origins: the nonlinear Drude term $σ^{\mathrm{ND}}_{ijk}\proptoτ^{2}$, the Berry-curvature-dipole term $σ^{\mathrm{BCD}}_{ijk}\proptoτ$, the intraband quantum-metric-dipole term $σ^{\mathrm{intra\text{-}QMD}}_{ijk}\proptoτ^{0}$, and the interband quantum-metric-dipole term $σ^{\mathrm{inter\text{-}QMD}}_{ijk}\proptoτ^{0}$. The intraband term is a Fermi-surface dipole of the ordinary band quantum metric, while the interband term is written, in the present representation, as a Fermi-sea-type response involving a band-normalized quantum metric. Working entirely within the velocity-gauge Keldysh--Kubo framework, we show that all connection-dependent commutator terms generated in the band-basis expansion cancel exactly between the covariant-quantum-connection sector $σ^{\mathcal{C}}_{ijk}$ and the three-Berry-connection sector $σ^{\mathcal{T}}_{ijk}$, making the role of the Peierls contact velocity vertices $V_{ij}$ and $V_{ijk}$ explicit; a complementary projector-based derivation appears in Ulrich et al., Phys. Rev. B 113, L201107 (2026), and our Fermi-surface dc-limit expression agrees with that reference after accounting for index and convention differences. As a diagnostic illustration, we introduce a real two-band model in which the Berry curvature and hence the BCD response vanish identically while the intraband quantum-metric dipole remains finite, establishing a practical route to quantum-metric dc responses not reducible to the Berry-curvature-dipole mechanism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive”（推导）、“Keldysh Green's function formalism”（Keldysh格林函数形式）、“gauge-invariant decomposition”（规范不变分解）。；研究对象：多带紧束缚系统中的二阶直流非线性电导率，具体涉及非线性Drude项、贝里曲率偶极子响应和量子度量响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在速度规范Keldysh形式下，二阶直流非线性电导率可规范不变地分解为四个具有不同寿命τ标度律的贡献：非线性Drude项（∝τ²）、贝里曲率偶极子项（∝τ）、带内量子度量偶极子项（∝τ⁰）和带间量子度量偶极子项（∝τ⁰）。其中带内项是普通能带量子度量的费米面偶极子，带间项涉及带归一化量子度量的费米海型响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在速度规范Keldysh形式下，二阶直流非线性电导率可规范不变地分解为四个具有不同寿命τ标度律的贡献：非线性Drude项（∝τ²）、贝里曲率偶极子项（∝τ）、带内量子度量偶极子项（∝τ⁰）和带间量子度量偶极子项（∝τ⁰）。其中带内项是普通能带量子度量的费米面偶极子，带间项涉及带归一化量子度量的费米海型响应。；创新点：首次在速度规范Keldysh形式中严格证明了所有规范依赖的联络项在协变量子联络扇区和三贝里联络扇区之间精确抵消，明确了Peierls接触速度顶点V_ij和V_ijk的作用。通过构造贝里曲率恒为零而带内量子度量偶极子有限的两带模型，建立了不可归约为贝里曲率偶极子机制的量子度量直流响应实现路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用速度规范下的Keldysh-Kubo理论框架，在恒定弛豫时间近似下，通过能带基展开并处理规范依赖的联络项，实现了对二阶直流电导率的规范不变分解。同时引入了一个实两带模型作为诊断示例。

papers.title: Lattice-mediated Geometric Frustration Drives Fast Ionic Transport
papers.abstract: Fast ionic conductors are commonly described from two perspectives: soft lattices that facilitate ion migration, and geometrically frustrated ionic sublattices that host multiple nearly degenerate configurations. Here we demonstrate that these two pictures are intrinsically linked within a single lattice-renormalized free-energy landscape. Eliminating the adiabatic lattice response from a coupled ion-lattice Hamiltonian, we derive a lattice-mediated free-energy correction governed by the projection of ionic configurational forces onto the inverse stiffness of the host lattice. In a coarse-grained representation, this correction decomposes into local self-trapping and non-local interference between lattice-response fields. These intertwined effects reshape the frustrated free-energy landscape, redistribute mobile ions, and promote correlated ionic transport. Large-scale atomistic simulations of cubic Li$_7$La$_3$Zr$_2$O$_{12}$ and AgCrSe$_2$ show these effects across scales, from barrier reduction to collective ionic reorganization. The resulting picture recasts fast ionic transport as a lattice-renormalized geometric frustration problem, in which lattice softness, frustration and collective diffusion emerge as different expressions of the same free-energy landscape.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：推导了晶格重正化自由能景观的理论框架，并辅以大规模原子模拟验证。；研究对象：快离子导体中的离子输运现象，具体材料为立方相Li₇La₃Zr₂O₁₂（LLZO）和AgCrSe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 快离子输运并非单纯由软晶格或几何阻挫单独驱动，而是两者通过晶格介导的自由能修正内在耦合的结果：晶格软度、几何阻挫与集体扩散是同一重正化自由能景观的不同表现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：快离子输运并非单纯由软晶格或几何阻挫单独驱动，而是两者通过晶格介导的自由能修正内在耦合的结果：晶格软度、几何阻挫与集体扩散是同一重正化自由能景观的不同表现。；创新点：将传统上被视为独立机制的“软晶格”与“几何阻挫”统一到同一个晶格重正化自由能景观中，揭示了二者之间的内在联系，并指出阻挫、软度和集体扩散是该景观的不同侧面。
papers.method_zh: 从离子-晶格耦合哈密顿量出发，通过绝热消除晶格响应，推导出由离子构型力在晶格逆刚度上的投影所控制的晶格介导自由能修正；采用粗粒化表示分解为局域自陷与非局域晶格响应场干涉项；并利用大规模原子模拟对LLZO和AgCrSe₂进行验证。

papers.title: Pairing-induced Bloch oscillations in an interacting Kitaev chain
papers.abstract: We study the peculiar dynamics of the Kitaev chain induced by nearest-neighbor (NN) interaction. We show that a strong NN interaction suppresses single-particle hopping but enhances pairing, resulting in a Wannier-Stark ladder. Based on the spin-fermion correspondence at the symmetry point, the model maps to a transverse field Ising model on a zigzag lattice, providing a clear physical picture and guiding experimental verification. The Wannier-Stark state corresponds to a localized domain wall between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic phases. It exhibits Bloch oscillation even in the absence of a longitudinal field, in contrast to previous works. Numerical simulations of time-dependent observables verify these conclusions. Our findings provide an example demonstrating emergent Stark many-body localization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：We study、model maps、Numerical simulations）；研究对象：Kitaev链中由最近邻相互作用诱导的配对动力学，具体为Wannier-Stark梯级与布洛赫振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强最近邻相互作用抑制单粒子跳跃但增强配对，从而产生Wannier-Stark梯级；该梯级态对应铁磁与反铁磁相之间的局域畴壁，并在无纵向场条件下仍表现出布洛赫振荡，为涌现的斯塔克多体局域化提供了范例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强最近邻相互作用抑制单粒子跳跃但增强配对，从而产生Wannier-Stark梯级；该梯级态对应铁磁与反铁磁相之间的局域畴壁，并在无纵向场条件下仍表现出布洛赫振荡，为涌现的斯塔克多体局域化提供了范例。；创新点：首次在无纵向场条件下观察到由配对诱导的布洛赫振荡，并揭示了其与铁磁/反铁磁畴壁局域化的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 基于自旋-费米子对应将模型映射到锯齿格点上的横场伊辛模型，结合数值模拟时间依赖可观测量进行验证。

papers.title: Evolution of anisotropic magnetostriction in LaMn1-xCoxO3 (x= 0.1-0.9)
papers.abstract: Polycrystalline samples of LaMn1-xCoxO3 series over a wide compositional range (x = 0.1 - 0.9) were synthesized by microwave irradiation of oxide precursors and their magnetic and magnetostrictive properties were investigated. Magnetostrictions parallel (l_par) and perpendicular (l_per) to the applied magnetic field were measured to estimate anisotropic(l_anis) and volume magnetostrictions(l_vol). In all the compositions, l-par (l_per) is negative (positive) and (l_anis) >> (l_vol), suggesting dominance of anisotropic lattice distortion under a magnetic field. The value of l_anis at 10 K for H = 50 kOe initially increases with x from 178 ppm for x = 0.1 to a maximum of 1221 ppm at x = 0.5 before decreasing for higher x. The composition dependence of magnetostriction is asymmetric about x = 0.5, the decrease for x > 0.5 is more steeper than for x < 0.5 whereas saturation magnetization decreases monotonically with increasing x except for an abrupt change at x = 0.6. The largest anisotropic magnetostriction observed for x = 0.5 is attributed to the presence of high-spin Co2+ ions with a non-zero orbital moment in the maximum fraction whereas Mn3+/4+ or Co3+ ions play minor roles. The composition dependence of magnetostriction is suggested to arise from changes in the structure, valence states of Mn and Co ions and magnetic interactions among them.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“synthesized”、“measured”、“investigated”表明为实验合成与测量。；研究对象：LaMn1-xCoxO3（x = 0.1-0.9）系列多晶样品，具体研究其磁致伸缩性质（包括平行、垂直、各向异性和体积磁致伸缩）及磁性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在所有组分中，各向异性磁致伸缩远大于体积磁致伸缩，表明磁场下主要发生各向异性晶格畸变；在x=0.5时各向异性磁致伸缩达到最大值（1221 ppm），归因于具有非零轨道角动量的高自旋Co2+离子占比最大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在所有组分中，各向异性磁致伸缩远大于体积磁致伸缩，表明磁场下主要发生各向异性晶格畸变；在x=0.5时各向异性磁致伸缩达到最大值（1221 ppm），归因于具有非零轨道角动量的高自旋Co2+离子占比最大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用微波辐照氧化物前驱体方法合成多晶样品；测量平行和垂直于外加磁场的磁致伸缩（l_par和l_per），进而估算各向异性磁致伸缩（l_anis）和体积磁致伸缩（l_vol）；同时测量饱和磁化强度。

papers.title: Magnetovolume effect in SrRu1-xCoxO3 (x = 0.0, 0.05)
papers.abstract: Polycrystalline SrRu1-xCoxO3 (x = 0.0, 0.05) and CaRuO3 were rapidly synthesized (< 1 hour) by microwave irradiation of oxide powders, and their magnetic, magnetoresistance, thermal expansion, and magnetostriction properties were investigated. The microwave-synthesised SrRuO3 exhibits a ferromagnetic transition at TC = 160 K, metallic-type resistivity, and negative magnetoresistance, with magnitudes comparable to those of a sample synthesized by conventional heating over 24 hours. Upon lowering the temperature from 300 K, the linear thermal expansion shows a transition from the usual contraction in the paramagnetic state to spontaneous expansion in the ferromagnetic state (invar-like effect). The application of an external magnetic field at a fixed temperature results in isotropic expansion of the length, implying a positive magnetovolume effect. The volume magnetostriction is 40 ppm at 10 K in a magnetic field of 50 kOe, and it reaches a maximum value of 60 ppm close to TC. The spontaneous thermal expansion is diminished in SrRu0.95Co0.05O3. While the magnetostriction is anisotropic at 10 K, the isotropic behaviour is recovered above 80 K, and the maximum value of the positive magnetovolume is comparable to that of the parent compound. Our results suggest that the magnetovolume effect in SrRu1-xCoxO3 is related to competition between robust tilting/rotation of RuO6 octahedra and spin-orbit interaction of the doped Co2+ ions
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“rapidly synthesized”、“investigated their magnetic, magnetoresistance, thermal expansion, and magnetostriction properties”等实验合成与测量手段。；研究对象：多晶 SrRu₁₋ₓCoₓO₃（x = 0.0, 0.05）和 CaRuO₃ 的磁体积效应（magnetovolume effect），包括磁性、磁电阻、热膨胀和磁致伸缩行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SrRuO₃ 在铁磁态表现出自发膨胀（类因瓦效应），外加磁场导致各向同性正磁体积效应；Co 掺杂（x=0.05）削弱了自发热膨胀，并在低温下引入磁致伸缩各向异性，但高温下恢复各向同性行为。磁体积效应与 RuO₆ 八面体刚性倾斜/旋转及掺杂 Co²⁺ 的自旋-轨道相互作用之间的竞争有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SrRuO₃ 在铁磁态表现出自发膨胀（类因瓦效应），外加磁场导致各向同性正磁体积效应；Co 掺杂（x=0.05）削弱了自发热膨胀，并在低温下引入磁致伸缩各向异性，但高温下恢复各向同性行为。磁体积效应与 RuO₆ 八面体刚性倾斜/旋转及掺杂 Co²⁺ 的自旋-轨道相互作用之间的竞争有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 微波辐照快速合成（<1小时）多晶样品；测量磁化率、电阻率、磁电阻、线性热膨胀（300 K 至低温）和磁致伸缩（固定温度下加磁场）。

papers.title: Van Hove Singularity and Phase Instability: Exploring the Role of Electron Correlation in the Magnetic Behavior of $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$
papers.abstract: The ordered iron nitride phase $α''-\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ is a promising candidate for environment-friendly, rare-earth-free permanent magnets due to its demonstrated giant saturation magnetization ($M_s$). However, first-principles electronic-structure calculations have struggled to consistently reproduce experimentally-observed high $M_s$, and have yielded highly variable magneto-crystalline anisotropy (MCA) values. In this work, we employ Density Functional Theory under the GGA+$U$ framework to study the effect of the Hubbard parameters $U$ and $J$ on the magnetic properties of $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$. We demonstrate that the electronic structure exhibits high sensitivity to these parameters, specifically uncovering a van Hove singularity near the Fermi level ($E_F$), inherently tied to the material's structural and thermal phase instability. By linking this topological anomaly to the calculated magnetic properties, we demonstrate that the selection of $U$ not only tunes $M_s$ and MCA energy towards experimental values but also reveals an underlying electronic mechanism potentially responsible for the phase's metastability. This provides a framework for understanding the correlation-driven magnetic behavior of $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ and offers a pathway for optimizing its stability and performance in practical applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles electronic-structure calculations、Density Functional Theory、GGA+$U$。；研究对象：有序氮化铁相 $\alpha''-\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ 的磁性能，特别是其饱和磁化强度（$M_s$）和磁晶各向异性（MCA），以及电子关联效应对其磁行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ 的费米能级附近发现了一个范霍夫奇点，该奇点与材料的结构和热相不稳定性内在相关；通过调节 Hubbard 参数 $U$，可以同时使计算得到的 $M_s$ 和 MCA 能量接近实验值，并揭示出导致该相亚稳态的潜在电子机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ 的费米能级附近发现了一个范霍夫奇点，该奇点与材料的结构和热相不稳定性内在相关；通过调节 Hubbard 参数 $U$，可以同时使计算得到的 $M_s$ 和 MCA 能量接近实验值，并揭示出导致该相亚稳态的潜在电子机制。；创新点：首次将 $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ 费米能级附近的范霍夫奇点与材料的相不稳定性联系起来，并展示了通过选择 $U$ 值来同时调控 $M_s$ 和 MCA 的可行性，为理解该材料的关联驱动磁行为提供了新框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用 GGA+$U$ 框架下的密度泛函理论（DFT），系统研究了 Hubbard 参数 $U$ 和 $J$ 对 $\mathrm{Fe}_{16}\mathrm{N}_2$ 磁性能的影响。

papers.title: Quasi-two-dimensional dispersions of Brownian particles with competitive interactions: Dynamical clustering, non-Gaussianity and hydrodynamic correlations
papers.abstract: We conduct a comprehensive dynamical analysis of quasi-two-dimensional (Q2D) dispersions of Brownian particles with competing short-range attractive (SA) and long-range repulsive (LR) interactions using Langevin dynamics (LD) and multiparticle collision dynamics (MPC). As the attractive interaction is strengthened, self-diffusion is significantly suppressed, and clustering gives rise to pronounced subdiffusive behavior. We find that cluster lifetimes are influenced more strongly by attraction strength than by particle concentration. Two dynamical criteria for the transition from non-clustered to clustered phases are identified in terms of the mean cluster lifetime and the relaxation time of local hexagonal order, respectively. Moreover, clustered Q2D-SALR systems exhibit pronounced non-Gaussian dynamics. In particular, the self-van Hove function in the equilibrium-cluster phase displays an approximately exponential form, consistent with an underlying diffusing-diffusivity mechanism. Importantly, MPC simulations reveal the critical role of hydrodynamic interactions (HIs) in collective dynamics. We observe that the anomalously enhanced large-scale collective diffusion characteristic of hydrodynamically interacting Q2D systems is qualitatively preserved in Q2D-SALR dispersions. However, this enhancement suppresses the intermediate-range-order peak in the hydrodynamic function compared to its three-dimensional counterpart. Furthermore, by analyzing the time-dependent evolution of hydrodynamic function and the sound mode in hydrodynamic correlations, we find that clustering in Q2D-SALR systems leads to an earlier onset of HIs than in Q2D hard-sphere reference systems, implying HIs become relevant already on inertial timescales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics (LD), multiparticle collision dynamics (MPC)。；研究对象：准二维（Q2D）布朗粒子分散体系，粒子间具有竞争性相互作用：短程吸引（SA）和长程排斥（LR），即Q2D-SALR体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着吸引作用增强，粒子自扩散显著抑制并出现亚扩散行为；团簇相中自范霍夫函数呈近似指数形式，符合扩散-扩散率机制；流体动力学相互作用（HIs）在集体动力学中起关键作用，且团簇化导致HIs在惯性时间尺度上更早出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着吸引作用增强，粒子自扩散显著抑制并出现亚扩散行为；团簇相中自范霍夫函数呈近似指数形式，符合扩散-扩散率机制；流体动力学相互作用（HIs）在集体动力学中起关键作用，且团簇化导致HIs在惯性时间尺度上更早出现。；创新点：首次在准二维SALR体系中系统揭示团簇化对非高斯动力学和流体动力学相互作用的影响，发现团簇化使HIs在惯性时间尺度上即变得显著，并抑制了流体动力学函数的中程有序峰。
papers.method_zh: 采用朗之万动力学（LD）和多粒子碰撞动力学（MPC）进行大规模模拟，分析自扩散、团簇寿命、局域六角序弛豫时间、自范霍夫函数、流体动力学函数及声学模式等。

papers.title: Delafossites as an unexpected competing phase to infinite-layer oxides
papers.abstract: Motivated by the discovery of superconductivity in Sr-doped infinite-layer nickelate films on SrTiO$_3$(001), we explore the broader landscape of $AB$O$_2$ oxides through comprehensive high-throughput first-principles simulations. Specifically, delafossites and their ordered rock-salt (111) variants stand out as intriguing layered oxides that share the infinite-layer $AB$O$_2$ stoichiometry and simultaneously retain a perovskite-like octahedral motif. This positions them as a unique structural bridge between these two phases and as promising candidates for novel correlated electronic states. We compile a phase diagram that compares the relative stability of these four distinct oxides across the periodic table. Surprisingly, we find that the delafossite structure rivals the infinite-layer phase in thermodynamic stability for the nickelates, and even more for the recently suggested palladate and platinate analogs. Comparison of the respective electronic structures reveals that the delafossite compounds, which we find to be characterized by reversed cation order, exhibit a strongly $d_{z^2}$-dominated Fermi surface, in stark contrast to the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ character observed in the infinite-layer phases. Among all candidates, the La-Ni combination stands out as a thermodynamic optimum for stabilizing the infinite-layer motif. Furthermore, we show that hole doping via Ca, Sr, and Ba systematically enhances the stability of the infinite-layer phase in all three transition-metal families. These results reveal fundamental challenges in realizing bulk substrate-free infinite-layer oxides, and simultaneously offer guidance for future experimental synthesis efforts targeting novel superconducting compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：high-throughput first-principles simulations（高通量第一性原理模拟）。；研究对象：ABO₂型氧化物中的delafossite相（铜铁矿相）及其有序岩盐（111）变体，与无限层氧化物（infinite-layer oxides）的结构竞争关系，具体涵盖镍酸盐、钯酸盐和铂酸盐体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Delafossite结构在热力学稳定性上与无限层结构相竞争，尤其在镍酸盐中两者相当，在钯酸盐和铂酸盐中甚至更稳定；且delafossite相具有反转的阳离子顺序和以d_{z^2}轨道为主的费米面，与无限层相的d_{x^2-y^2}特征截然不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Delafossite结构在热力学稳定性上与无限层结构相竞争，尤其在镍酸盐中两者相当，在钯酸盐和铂酸盐中甚至更稳定；且delafossite相具有反转的阳离子顺序和以d_{z^2}轨道为主的费米面，与无限层相的d_{x^2-y^2}特征截然不同。；创新点：揭示了delafossite相作为无限层氧化物意想不到的竞争相，并指出La-Ni组合是稳定无限层结构的热力学最优选择；同时发现Ca、Sr、Ba空穴掺杂可系统增强无限层相的稳定性。这些结果为理解无衬底体相无限层氧化物的合成挑战提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 高通量第一性原理模拟（high-throughput first-principles simulations），通过计算比较四种不同氧化物结构（无限层、delafossite及其有序岩盐变体）在元素周期表中的相对稳定性，并分析电子结构。

papers.title: Keldysh field theory of spin- and valley-distinguished polariton nonlinearities in transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers
papers.abstract: Electrons in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) possess valley and spin degrees of freedom, which leads to rich exciton and exciton-polariton physics with nontrivial scattering dynamics and enhanced nonlinearities, presenting a key mechanism for photonic devices. Yet, existing descriptions of bosonization and polariton interactions in TMD-based systems overlook the valley degree of freedom as well as the various particles' spins combinations. In this work, we derive a nonequilibrium field-theory approach in the path integral formalism that allows to track all the polariton nonlinearities in the strong coupling regime. We demonstrate that, when all the bright and dark exciton species are considered, the TMD monolayer-based polariton systems feature sixteen different nonlinear contributions due to interactions and even more saturation-related terms. Strikingly, while the interactions of excitons within one valley are overall dominant, we show that the contribution to the blueshift from spin-dark excitons is much higher than that from bright intravalley excitons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“derive a nonequilibrium field-theory approach”、“path integral formalism”、“theoretical framework”。；研究对象：过渡金属硫族化合物（TMD）单层中的激子-极化激元系统，特别关注其自旋和谷自由度导致的非线性相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当考虑所有亮激子和暗激子种类时，TMD单层基极化激元系统存在16种不同的相互作用非线性贡献以及更多饱和相关项；其中，自旋暗激子对蓝移的贡献远高于谷内亮激子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当考虑所有亮激子和暗激子种类时，TMD单层基极化激元系统存在16种不同的相互作用非线性贡献以及更多饱和相关项；其中，自旋暗激子对蓝移的贡献远高于谷内亮激子。；创新点：首次在理论描述中系统纳入谷自由度以及不同粒子自旋组合，揭示了以往被忽视的自旋暗激子对非线性响应的主导贡献。
papers.method_zh: 采用路径积分形式下的非平衡场论方法（Keldysh场论），在强耦合区域中追踪所有极化激元非线性效应。

papers.title: Non-equilibrium angular momentum selectivity and filtering in chiral carbon nanotubes
papers.abstract: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) constitute a highly tunable platform for probing the interplay between structural chirality and quantum transport in quasi-one-dimensional systems. Here, we perform a systematic study of the non-equilibrium orbital response across a broad set of metallic and semiconducting chiral CNTs. We find that the orbital Edelstein susceptibility depends strongly on both chirality and nanotube diameter, revealing that the orbital response cannot be captured by a universal scaling law. Instead, distinct families of CNTs emerge, forming characteristic orbital-response branches uniquely determined by the chiral wrapping vector. We further investigate the role of metallic contacts on orbital-current generation and orbital selectivity. While metallic CNTs rapidly recover their intrinsic orbital response away from the contact region, semiconducting CNTs display pronounced oscillatory behavior arising from interference between transport channels carrying different angular momenta injected by wide-band metallic contacts. Finally, by incorporating angular correlations into the contact self-energy, we demonstrate that chiral CNTs can operate as efficient orbital-angular-momentum filters, selectively transmitting orbitally textured electronic states in accordance with the crystal angular momentum of the propagating bands.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“systematic study”“orbital response”“susceptibility”等理论分析术语，未提及实验手段，且涉及自能修正和输运通道干涉分析。；研究对象：手性碳纳米管（chiral CNTs）中的非平衡轨道角动量选择性及滤波效应，具体研究金属性和半导体性手性碳纳米管在非平衡条件下的轨道响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 手性碳纳米管的轨道Edelstein响应强烈依赖于手性和管径，无法用普适标度律描述，而是形成由手性包裹矢量唯一确定的特征轨道响应分支；半导体性碳纳米管在接触区域附近表现出由不同角动量输运通道干涉引起的振荡行为，且通过引入接触自能中的角关联，手性碳纳米管可作为高效的轨道角动量滤波器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：手性碳纳米管的轨道Edelstein响应强烈依赖于手性和管径，无法用普适标度律描述，而是形成由手性包裹矢量唯一确定的特征轨道响应分支；半导体性碳纳米管在接触区域附近表现出由不同角动量输运通道干涉引起的振荡行为，且通过引入接触自能中的角关联，手性碳纳米管可作为高效的轨道角动量滤波器。；创新点：揭示了手性碳纳米管中轨道响应无法用单一标度律描述，而是由手性包裹矢量决定的分支结构；首次提出通过接触自能中的角关联实现手性碳纳米管作为轨道角动量滤波器的机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算与模型分析。具体包括：计算轨道Edelstein磁化率随手性和管径的变化；分析金属接触对轨道电流产生和轨道选择性的影响；通过接触自能引入角关联，模拟轨道角动量滤波效应。

papers.title: Fine-Tuned Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials for Structural and Vibrational Properties of Twisted 2D Materials
papers.abstract: Twisted van der Waals bilayers form moiré superlattices whose structural and vibrational properties are highly sensitive to variations in local stacking registry and the degree of atomic reconstruction, yet accurate atomistic modeling of these systems at the DFT level remains computationally prohibitive at small twist angles. We investigate machine-learned interatomic potentials for moiré systems, using twisted bilayer graphene, \textit{h}-BN, and MoS$_2$ as representative materials spanning a broad spectrum of mechanical compliance and atomic reconstruction behavior. We show that fine-tuning universal atomistic foundation models is essential to achieve DFT accuracy for layered materials, as broadly trained foundation models prove insufficient for resolving the subtle interlayer energetics that govern atomic reconstruction. Through local strain tensor analysis and the phonon band unfolding technique, our fine-tuned MACE model reveals a consistent reconstruction-induced strain landscape in all three materials, with extended low-energy stacking domains separated by narrow soliton lines where deformation concentrates. The system progressively optimizes the local stacking registry within each domain, giving rise to a spatially structured deformation field whose amplitude scales with the mechanical compliance of the material and can be further tuned by external perturbation. The obtained results of both atomic reconstructed structures and moiré phonon spectra present a good agreement with the reported experiments, thereby demonstrating the accuracy and efficiency of our methodology in modeling of these large scale nanomaterials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learned interatomic potentials、DFT、phonon band unfolding technique。；研究对象：扭曲二维材料（twisted bilayer graphene、h-BN、MoS₂）形成的莫尔超晶格，重点关注其结构重构和振动性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微调通用原子基础模型（如MACE）获得的机器学习原子间势能，能够达到DFT精度，揭示出三种材料中一致的、由重构诱导的应变景观：低能堆叠畴区被狭窄的孤子线分隔，变形集中在孤子线上，且变形幅度随材料机械柔顺性增大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微调通用原子基础模型（如MACE）获得的机器学习原子间势能，能够达到DFT精度，揭示出三种材料中一致的、由重构诱导的应变景观：低能堆叠畴区被狭窄的孤子线分隔，变形集中在孤子线上，且变形幅度随材料机械柔顺性增大。；创新点：证明了对于层状材料，微调通用原子基础模型（而非直接使用广泛训练的模型）是达到DFT精度的关键，因为广泛训练的模型无法分辨控制原子重构的微妙层间能量。
papers.method_zh: 使用微调后的MACE机器学习原子间势能进行原子尺度模拟，结合局部应变张量分析和声子能带展开技术（phonon band unfolding technique）研究莫尔超晶格的结构与振动性质。

papers.title: Open-quantum-system theory of non-Markovian electron-phonon dynamics
papers.abstract: We present a non-Markovian open quantum dynamics formalism for the study of nonequilibrium electron-phonon interactions, based on a closed set of four coupled equations of motion for the electronic one-body reduced density matrix, the phonon density matrix, the coherent phonon, and the electron-phonon correlations. Memory effects in the electronic dynamics emerge naturally from the coupling between the electronic density matrix and the electron-phonon correlation equations, beyond the Markovian approximation. The formalism treats coherent-phonon dynamics and dissipative broadening on an equal footing, making it particularly suited to polaron formation and the finite lifetimes of driven electronic excitations. In appropriate limits it recovers the Fan-Migdal, polarization in random-phase-approximation, and Ehrenfest self-energies of nonequilibrium Green's function theory, as well as the Lindblad and Boltzmann equations, while avoiding the storage of two-time correlators. To drive the system out of equilibrium, we study its interaction with an external time-dependent field. As an illustrative application, we benchmark our theory against the exact solution of the Holstein dimer under a strong external perturbation, where the non-Markovian dynamics correctly captures dissipative spectral broadening and energy conservation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：open quantum dynamics formalism、coupled equations of motion、non-Markovian。；研究对象：非平衡电子-声子相互作用系统，具体以Holstein二聚体在强外场下的动力学作为示例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一套非马尔可夫开放量子动力学形式，能够自然捕捉电子动力学中的记忆效应，并同等处理相干声子动力学与耗散展宽，在强外场下正确描述了耗散谱展宽和能量守恒。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一套非马尔可夫开放量子动力学形式，能够自然捕捉电子动力学中的记忆效应，并同等处理相干声子动力学与耗散展宽，在强外场下正确描述了耗散谱展宽和能量守恒。；创新点：该形式避免了存储双时间关联函数，在适当极限下可恢复非平衡格林函数理论中的Fan-Migdal、随机相位近似极化以及Ehrenfest自能，同时涵盖Lindblad方程和Boltzmann方程，实现了对马尔可夫近似的超越。
papers.method_zh: 基于电子单粒子约化密度矩阵、声子密度矩阵、相干声子以及电子-声子关联的四组耦合运动方程，构建了非马尔可夫开放量子动力学理论框架，并与Holstein二聚体的精确解进行对比验证。

papers.title: A correlation of structural changes with nanomechanical properties in TiN-AlN multilayer films
papers.abstract: The present work investigates the changes in overall nanomechanical properties of reactively sputtered TiN-AlN multilayer films arising due to phase transformation in the AlN layers. Multilayered TiN-AlN films were sputter deposited with constant TiN layer thickness of 5 nm while the AlN layer thickness varied between 1-5 nm. The AlN underwent a phase transition from cubic rock salt to hexagonal wurtzite above 3 nm thickness due to the lattice strains. The hardness and indentation modulus of the multilayers decreased with increasing AlN film thickness, up to 3 nm, due to increased volume fraction of softer AlN layer and then stabilized for 4 nm and 5 nm thickness films. Micropillar compression of these multilayers showed a transition from columnar brittle to partially ductile failure associated with crack deflection with increasing AlN film thickness. Interestingly, nanoindentation scratch resistance of 3 nm AlN multilayer was observed to be superior compared to all other films. The crack propagation behavior in scratching showed increased microcracking tendency towards higher AlN film thickness. This shows that cubic to hexagonal transformation in AlN is beneficial for improving the damage tolerance of the multilayer system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词为“investigates”、“sputter deposited”、“nanoindentation”、“micropillar compression”。；研究对象：反应溅射制备的TiN-AlN多层薄膜，重点研究AlN层厚度变化引起的相变（立方岩盐结构到六方纤锌矿结构）及其对薄膜整体纳米力学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AlN层厚度超过3 nm时发生从立方岩盐到六方纤锌矿的相变，该相变有利于提高多层薄膜体系的损伤容限；3 nm AlN厚度的多层膜具有最优异的纳米压痕抗划伤性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AlN层厚度超过3 nm时发生从立方岩盐到六方纤锌矿的相变，该相变有利于提高多层薄膜体系的损伤容限；3 nm AlN厚度的多层膜具有最优异的纳米压痕抗划伤性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 反应磁控溅射沉积制备多层膜；纳米压痕测试（硬度、压痕模量）；微柱压缩实验（观察脆性到部分延性断裂转变）；纳米压痕划痕实验（评估抗划伤性和裂纹扩展行为）。

papers.title: Giant Fluctuations in Self-Propelled Particles with Age-Dependent Switching
papers.abstract: We investigate the transport and fluctuation properties of self-propelled particles whose motion is governed by an age-dependent phase-switching mechanism. The dynamics alternate between a Markovian downstream phase with a constant switching probability $r$ and a semi-Markovian upstream phase in which the age-dependent hazard probability $a/(b+c)$ decays with the internal clock $c$, representing persistent orientation. The time-averaged velocity, as an order parameter, shows a continuous transition at $a=1$ which separates an upstream-dominated ballistic regime ($a<1$) from an ergodic diffusive regime ($a>1$). Through generating-function methods and discrete-time moment recurrences, we derive exact expressions for the propagator and determine the long-time asymptotics of the mean displacement and variance. At the critical point $a=1$, the system exhibits giant fluctuations, with the variance scaling ballistically up to a logarithmic correction, $\mathrm{Var}(x_T) \propto T^2 / \log T$. These results demonstrate how slowly decaying reorientation probabilities lead to a marginal breakdown of the Central Limit Theorem, enabling unusually high-variance exploratory dynamics in biased environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：generating-function methods, discrete-time moment recurrences, exact expressions。；研究对象：具有年龄依赖切换机制的自驱动粒子的输运与涨落特性，具体研究其在上游和下游相位之间的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界点 \(a=1\) 处，系统表现出巨涨落，方差呈弹道标度并带有对数修正 \(\mathrm{Var}(x_T) \propto T^2 / \log T\)，表明缓慢衰减的重新定向概率导致中心极限定理的边际失效。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界点 \(a=1\) 处，系统表现出巨涨落，方差呈弹道标度并带有对数修正 \(\mathrm{Var}(x_T) \propto T^2 / \log T\)，表明缓慢衰减的重新定向概率导致中心极限定理的边际失效。；创新点：揭示了年龄依赖的切换机制如何导致系统在临界点出现非标准涨落行为，即巨涨落，并展示了这种机制如何使系统在偏置环境中实现高方差的探索动力学。
papers.method_zh: 采用生成函数方法和离散时间矩递推关系，推导了传播子的精确表达式，并确定了平均位移和方差的长时间渐近行为。

papers.title: Deterministic control of the probabilistic phase dynamics in injection-locked spin-torque nano-oscillators
papers.abstract: Spin-torque nano-oscillators (STNOs) inherently exhibit thermally driven phase fluctuations that render their dynamics truly stochastic. Here, we demonstrate that, despite this intrinsic randomness, the probability of occupying each phase state can be deterministically and continuously programmed. We experimentally investigate a vortex-based STNO operating under second-harmonic injection-locking, where the oscillator phase settles into two degenerate attractors separated by $π$ and undergoes thermally activated phase jumps. By applying a weak radio-frequency perturbation at the free-running frequency, we tune the phase-jump rates between the two attractors without suppressing the fluctuations, achieving continuous probability control from the unbiased limit to values approaching 0 or 1. The bias phase selects which attractor is favored while the bias amplitude sets the strength of the imbalance, providing two complementary control knobs within a single nanoscale device. A phase-reduced description based on an effective quasipotential quantitatively accounts for the observations. These results establish injection-locked STNOs as programmable stochastic elements and provide a hardware primitive for probabilistic computing, Ising machines, and brain-inspired computing architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experimentally investigate、experimental、observations）；研究对象：注入锁定自旋扭矩纳米振荡器（STNOs）中基于涡旋振荡器的概率相位动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 尽管STNOs存在热驱动的随机相位涨落，但通过施加弱射频扰动，可以确定性且连续地调控两个简并吸引子之间的相位占据概率，实现从无偏极限到接近0或1的概率控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：尽管STNOs存在热驱动的随机相位涨落，但通过施加弱射频扰动，可以确定性且连续地调控两个简并吸引子之间的相位占据概率，实现从无偏极限到接近0或1的概率控制。；创新点：在单个纳米尺度器件中，利用偏置相位和偏置幅度两个互补控制旋钮，实现了对随机相位动力学的确定性概率编程，为概率计算、伊辛机和类脑计算架构提供了硬件原语。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用二次谐波注入锁定下的涡旋基STNO，通过施加自由振荡频率附近的弱射频扰动来调节相位跳变速率；理论上使用基于有效准势的相位约化描述进行定量解释。

papers.title: Cladding Layer Enhanced GHz Bulk Acoustic Wave Resonance in Sodium Niobate Thin Films on Silicon
papers.abstract: Bulk acoustic wave resonators (BAWR) and bandpass filters operating at GHz frequency are the workhorse of (Vo-)LTE telecommunication and broadband internet. In line with the Singapore Green Plan 2030 for innovating environmentally friendly products, we fabricated lead-free BAWR with sodium niobate (NaNbO3) piezoelectric on silicon with a high electromechanical coupling factor up to 31.3% operating at ~4 GHz. We disclose our crucial strategy where the NaNbO3 layer is cladded between two thin layers of high band gap insulators, which satisfies two primary objectives, i.e. leakage current mitigation and crack avoidance. In addition, we also verified the efficacy of reducing lattice parameters of the cladding layers in promoting vertically distorted tetragonal phase NaNbO3 and producing stronger BAWR signals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabricated（制备）、measured（测量）、disclose strategy（披露策略）、verified（验证）。；研究对象：基于硅衬底的铌酸钠（NaNbO₃）压电薄膜体声波谐振器（BAWR），工作频率约4 GHz。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过在铌酸钠薄膜上下两侧包覆高带隙绝缘体薄层，成功制备出无铅体声波谐振器，实现了高达31.3%的机电耦合系数，同时有效抑制漏电流并避免裂纹产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过在铌酸钠薄膜上下两侧包覆高带隙绝缘体薄层，成功制备出无铅体声波谐振器，实现了高达31.3%的机电耦合系数，同时有效抑制漏电流并避免裂纹产生。；创新点：提出并验证了将NaNbO₃压电层包覆于两层高带隙绝缘体之间的关键策略，同时实现漏电流抑制与裂纹避免，并通过减小包覆层晶格参数增强体声波谐振信号。
papers.method_zh: 采用薄膜沉积技术制备NaNbO₃/包覆层/硅多层结构；通过包覆层晶格参数的调控促进垂直畸变四方相NaNbO₃的生长；利用电学测量表征谐振频率、机电耦合系数及漏电流特性。

papers.title: Reversible nonrelativistic magnon spin transport in ferroelastic altermagnets
papers.abstract: Magnons in antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulators facilitate low-dissipation, stray-field-free spin transport. However, achieving nonvolatile, field-free control over magnon spin currents remains elusive. Here, based on symmetry analysis, we propose a universal mechanism for the active manipulation of magnon spin transport via ferroelastic transitions in two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets (AMs)-a class of unconventional AFMs simultaneously exhibiting compensated magnetization and nonrelativistic spin splitting. We show that these transitions effectively reorient principal crystal axes and modulate the underlying magnetic exchange anisotropy. Consequently, this magnetoelastic coupling drives nonrelativistic anisotropic spin transport that is ferroelastically switchable without the need for external magnetic fields or Berry curvature, leading to sign reversals in the spin Seebeck and spin Nernst conductivities. We validate this mechanism using first-principles calculations and spin-model analyses of an AM CoTe2 monolayer. Our findings establish a symmetry-based magnetoelastic paradigm for the nonvolatile control of magnon spin transport in 2D AMs, opening new avenues toward energy-efficient, reconfigurable AFM magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算和自旋模型分析）。判断依据：symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, spin-model analyses。；研究对象：二维铁弹性交变磁体（altermagnet, AM）中的非相对论性磁振子自旋输运，具体以CoTe₂单层为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过铁弹性相变可主动调控二维交变磁体中的磁振子自旋输运，实现无需外磁场或贝里曲率的非易失性、可逆自旋塞贝克和自旋能斯特电导率符号反转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过铁弹性相变可主动调控二维交变磁体中的磁振子自旋输运，实现无需外磁场或贝里曲率的非易失性、可逆自旋塞贝克和自旋能斯特电导率符号反转。；创新点：提出基于铁弹性相变的通用机制，利用磁弹耦合驱动非相对论性各向异性自旋输运，实现交变磁体中磁振子自旋流的主动、非易失性操控，无需外磁场或贝里曲率。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析、第一性原理计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明）、自旋模型分析（spin-model analyses）。

papers.title: Bridging Phase-Field Model and Deep Learning for Predicting 2D and 3D Microstructure Evolution in Ternary Alloys
papers.abstract: We develop a hybrid framework that integrates a phase-field model (PFM) with an attention-enhanced deep learning (DL) architecture to study ternary spinodal dealloying, a sophisticated self-organization approach used to fabricate three-dimensional bicontinuous, hierarchical nanoporous materials. The study captures three distinct phase-separation mechanisms that emerge during the early stages of spinodal decomposition in both two and three dimensions. The DL workflow consists of three key components: (i) a dimensionality-reducing autoencoder that provides compact representations of high-resolution microstructure images (256x256x3), (ii) an attention-augmented convolutional long short-term memory (ConvLSTM) network that learns complex spatiotemporal correlations governing microstructure evolution, and (iii) a novel slice-by-slice strategy that enables extension of the model to three-dimensional systems (128x128x128x3). We further demonstrate a hybrid simulation strategy in which PFM accurately captures rapid early-stage microstructure evolution, while the DL model efficiently predicts late-stage coarsening dynamics. The trained DL model achieves remarkable predictive accuracy, maintaining fidelity up to 400 timesteps ahead and generalizing to compositions outside the training distribution. By bridging the physical fidelity of PFM with the computational efficiency of DL, this framework establishes a robust platform for predictive modeling of microstructure evolution in complex multicomponent systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（混合类型）。关键词：phase-field model (PFM)、deep learning (DL)、hybrid framework。；研究对象：三元合金中旋节线脱合金（spinodal dealloying）过程中的微观结构演化，特别是二维和三维双连续、分级纳米多孔材料的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现并捕捉了早期旋节分解中出现的三种不同相分离机制，并证明深度学习模型可准确预测长达400时间步的微观结构演化，且能泛化到训练集之外的合金成分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现并捕捉了早期旋节分解中出现的三种不同相分离机制，并证明深度学习模型可准确预测长达400时间步的微观结构演化，且能泛化到训练集之外的合金成分。；创新点：提出了一种混合模拟策略：用PFM精确捕捉早期快速演化，用深度学习模型高效预测后期粗化动力学，从而在物理保真度与计算效率之间建立桥梁。摘要未突出说明与纯PFM或纯DL方法相比的具体加速比或计算成本降低幅度。
papers.method_zh: 采用相场模型（PFM）与注意力增强的深度学习架构相结合的混合框架。深度学习部分包括：（i）降维自编码器，（ii）注意力增强的卷积长短期记忆网络（ConvLSTM），（iii）用于三维系统（128x128x128x3）的逐片扩展策略。

papers.title: Superconducting cavity probes sliding ferroelectricity in small-angle twisted WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Ferroelectricity is a property of materials that exhibit spontaneous charge polarization. Ferroelectricity in 2D materials is interesting because of their applications in memory devices and field-effect transistors. Recently, a new type of ferroelectricity, known as sliding ferroelectricity, has been discovered, in which parallel-stacked bilayers of hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) or transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) develop an out-of-plane electric polarization. In this work, we probe the polarization of small-angle parallel stacked WSe$_2$ by measuring its high-frequency AC response, achieved by embedding it into a half-wave superconducting coplanar waveguide cavity. We observe a hysteretic response in the capacitance of the stack and quality factor of the cavity, confirming ferroelectric switching in the system. Our results further reveal relaxation effects associated with ferroelectric domain-wall motion. This cavity-based technique has potential applications in probing domain-wall dynamics in a ferroelectric system at high frequencies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：probe、measuring、embedding、observe、results reveal。；研究对象：小角度平行堆叠的WSe₂双层中的滑动铁电性（sliding ferroelectricity）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将小角度平行堆叠WSe₂嵌入超导共面波导腔，测量其高频交流响应，观察到电容和腔品质因数的滞回行为，证实了系统中的铁电开关效应，并揭示了与铁电畴壁运动相关的弛豫效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将小角度平行堆叠WSe₂嵌入超导共面波导腔，测量其高频交流响应，观察到电容和腔品质因数的滞回行为，证实了系统中的铁电开关效应，并揭示了与铁电畴壁运动相关的弛豫效应。；创新点：利用超导腔高频探测技术研究滑动铁电体的极化行为，并首次在该体系中观察到与畴壁运动相关的弛豫效应，为高频下探测铁电畴壁动力学提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 将样品嵌入半波超导共面波导腔中，测量其高频交流响应（电容和腔品质因数），通过滞回行为判断铁电开关。

papers.title: Field-tunable quadruple-$Q$ states driven by momentum-space frustration
papers.abstract: Multiple-$Q$ magnetism in itinerant electron systems enables complex spin crystals and noncoplanar textures even in centrosymmetric settings. We study a minimal momentum-space spin model on a square lattice with four symmetry-related ordering wave vectors, including bilinear and biquadratic interactions under an out-of-plane magnetic field. Using simulated annealing, we obtain the field-dependent phase diagram and identify successive transitions among single-$Q$, double-$Q$, and multiple inequivalent quadruple-$Q$ states. The quadruple-$Q$ manifold exhibits rich internal structures: the states sharing the same wave vectors differ in phase locking, amplitude distribution, and noncoplanarity, leading to distinct real-space textures and scalar spin chirality patterns. Our results demonstrate that momentum-space frustration and biquadratic coupling provide an efficient route to stabilizing diverse quadruple-$Q$ spin crystals, offering a general framework for higher-order spin textures in centrosymmetric itinerant magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“momentum-space spin model”、“simulated annealing”、“phase diagram”等理论建模与数值模拟关键词。；研究对象：在中心对称的巡游电子系统中，由动量空间阻挫驱动的多-Q 自旋晶体，具体为正方晶格上具有四个对称性关联的序波矢的模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过模拟退火，发现了随外磁场变化的相图，包含单-Q、双-Q 以及多种不等价的四重-Q 态，这些四重-Q 态在相位锁定、振幅分布和非共面性上存在丰富内部结构，导致不同的实空间纹理和标量自旋手性图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过模拟退火，发现了随外磁场变化的相图，包含单-Q、双-Q 以及多种不等价的四重-Q 态，这些四重-Q 态在相位锁定、振幅分布和非共面性上存在丰富内部结构，导致不同的实空间纹理和标量自旋手性图案。；创新点：证明了动量空间阻挫与双二次耦合是稳定多种四重-Q 自旋晶体的有效途径，为中心对称巡游磁体中高阶自旋纹理的调控提供了通用框架。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比或材料预测。
papers.method_zh: 构建了包含双线性与双二次相互作用的动量空间自旋模型，采用模拟退火方法进行数值计算，获得磁场依赖的相图并分析不同多-Q 态的结构。

papers.title: Thermodynamic stability and structural transitions in virus-host networks
papers.abstract: Understanding virus-host interactions is crucial for predicting the stability of networks under various perturbations. In this study, we present an analysis of virus-related networks for several organisms (Homo sapiens, Mus musculus, Gallus gallus), encompassing directed and weighted connections. We compute a range of network parameters, including topological characteristics and thermodynamic quantities derived from adjacency spectra, to gain insights into the structural robustness and dynamic behavior of the networks. To assess stability, we model two distinct node removal scenarios: targeted elimination of the most influential nodes and random removal. Our findings reveal transition-like behavior in spectral thermodynamic functions and characteristic changes in structural measures, contributing to evaluating the potential of a thermodynamic framework for studying virus-host networks and advancing a deeper understanding of their dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“计算网络参数”、“谱热力学量”、“建模节点移除场景”等关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：病毒-宿主网络，具体针对三种生物（人类、小鼠、鸡）的病毒相关网络，研究其有向加权连接、结构鲁棒性与动态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在病毒-宿主网络中，谱热力学函数表现出类似相变的行为，结构度量也出现特征性变化，表明热力学框架可用于评估网络稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在病毒-宿主网络中，谱热力学函数表现出类似相变的行为，结构度量也出现特征性变化，表明热力学框架可用于评估网络稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于邻接矩阵谱计算热力学量，分析网络拓扑参数；通过两种节点移除场景（定向移除最具影响力节点与随机移除）模拟网络扰动，评估结构鲁棒性。

papers.title: Effect of weak positional disorder on the miniband structure of spherical quantum dot chains
papers.abstract: A theoretical framework is developed for the electron miniband structure in one-dimensional chains of spherical quantum dots subjected to weak positional disorder. Within the tight-binding approximation combined with the effective-medium approach, the stochastic fluctuations of the inter-dot spacing are mapped onto the renormalization of the key Hamiltonian parameters: the hopping integral $ B $, the overlap integral $ Q $, and the on-site energy shift $ M $. Analytical expressions for these disorder-renormalized parameters are derived by performing an ensemble average over a narrow Gaussian distribution of positional deviations ($ σ\ll a $). The resulting generalized dispersion relation shows that weak positional disorder causes a broadening of the minibands. Specifically, for typical fabrication fluctuations $σ= 0.1\,a $, the miniband width increases by 8-12\% (depending on the mean inter-dot distance $a$). At the same time, the sensitivity of the miniband width to disorder decreases rapidly with increasing lattice period due to the exponential decay of the electron wave functions. In the considered weak-disorder regime, the Anderson localization length significantly exceeds the lattice constant, so the miniband states remain delocalized.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、tight-binding approximation、effective-medium approach、analytical expressions。；研究对象：一维球形量子点链中的电子微带结构，以及弱位置无序对其的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 弱位置无序会导致微带展宽，例如在典型制造涨落σ=0.1a下，微带宽度增加8-12%；但微带宽度对无序的敏感性随晶格周期增大而迅速降低，且在弱无序区，安德森局域化长度远大于晶格常数，微带态仍保持退局域化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：弱位置无序会导致微带展宽，例如在典型制造涨落σ=0.1a下，微带宽度增加8-12%；但微带宽度对无序的敏感性随晶格周期增大而迅速降低，且在弱无序区，安德森局域化长度远大于晶格常数，微带态仍保持退局域化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用紧束缚近似结合有效介质方法，将量子点间距的随机涨落映射为哈密顿量关键参数（跳跃积分B、重叠积分Q、在位能偏移M）的重整化，并对窄高斯分布的位置偏差进行系综平均，推导出无序重整化参数的解析表达式。

papers.title: Enhanced approach to calculation of cluster integrals for lattice models of matter
papers.abstract: The study is devoted to enhancing the existing techniques of calculating Mayer's expansion cluster integrals for lattice models of matter. Two important optimizations are proposed: simplifying the calculation of the integrand at each integration point and reducing the number of such integration points due to eliminating physically identical configurations. Based on those optimizations, new data on high-order cluster integrals are obtained for a number of 2D and 3D lattice models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Mayer's expansion cluster integrals、lattice models、optimizations、new data。；研究对象：晶格物质模型（lattice models of matter），具体包括二维和三维晶格模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过两项优化（简化被积函数计算、消除物理相同构型以减少积分点），获得了若干二维和三维晶格模型的高阶簇积分新数据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过两项优化（简化被积函数计算、消除物理相同构型以减少积分点），获得了若干二维和三维晶格模型的高阶簇积分新数据。；创新点：提出了两种针对晶格模型簇积分计算的具体优化方案，并基于这些优化获得了高阶簇积分的新数据（摘要未突出说明与已有数据的具体差异或精度提升）。
papers.method_zh: 基于Mayer展开的簇积分计算方法，提出了两项优化策略：1）简化每个积分点处被积函数的计算；2）通过排除物理相同构型来减少积分点数量。

papers.title: First-principles study of the impact of As doping on the structural and electronic properties of MoS$_2$ monolayer
papers.abstract: This study is aimed at exploring the structural and electronic properties of doped MoS$_2$ monolayers, including Mo and S vacancies and As doped systems, employing DFT calculations. The electronic properties were analyzed to understand how these modifications affect the behavior of the material. Introduction of defects generates new defect states in the midgap. In the S-vacancy (V$_\text{S}$), Mo-vacancy (V$_{\text{Mo}}$), As-Mo (As substituting Mo), and As-S (As substituting S) doped systems, the downward shift of the Fermi level to the valence band indicates a $p$-type behavior. In the As interstitial system the Fermi level shifts to the conduction band, suggesting an $n$-type semiconductor. The results highlight that doping MoS$_2$ with As, particularly at the Mo site, can be used in photocatalysis and high-efficiency photovoltaics. Additionally, the As interstitial system demonstrates an enhanced performance in field-effect transistors (FETs).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“DFT calculations”（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：As掺杂的MoS₂单层，包括Mo空位、S空位、As替代Mo、As替代S以及As间隙掺杂体系的结构与电子性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: As掺杂在MoS₂中引入缺陷态，其中As替代Mo和As替代S体系表现为p型半导体，而As间隙体系表现为n型半导体，且后者在场效应晶体管中性能增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：As掺杂在MoS₂中引入缺陷态，其中As替代Mo和As替代S体系表现为p型半导体，而As间隙体系表现为n型半导体，且后者在场效应晶体管中性能增强。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析掺杂体系的几何结构与电子性质。

papers.title: An elastic model of confined hydrogel particles with competing entropic and energetic networks
papers.abstract: This work presents an elastic model to study the interplay between entropic and energetic networks in confined hydrogel particles. We consider a quasi-two-dimensional system composed of spherical hydrogel beads confined in a circular container, where particle growth occurs through hydration. Based on experimental observations, an elastic potential is introduced to model interactions between particles and between particles and the confining wall. Computational simulations based on energy minimization identify the lowest-energy configurations adopted during growth. Analysis of the resulting energy landscapes reveals emergent self-organization, adaptability, and cooperativity arising from the competition between entropic and energetic networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出弹性模型”、“基于能量最小化的计算模拟”、“分析能量景观”。；研究对象：受限水凝胶颗粒体系，具体为在圆形容器中通过水合作用生长的准二维球形水凝胶珠，研究其熵网络与能量网络之间的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在受限水凝胶颗粒生长过程中，熵网络与能量网络的竞争导致了自组织、自适应性和协同性等涌现行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在受限水凝胶颗粒生长过程中，熵网络与能量网络的竞争导致了自组织、自适应性和协同性等涌现行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 构建弹性势能模型描述颗粒间及颗粒与容器壁的相互作用，采用基于能量最小化的计算模拟，通过分析能量景观确定生长过程中的最低能量构型。

papers.title: On the statistical theory of strong electrolytes and high-temperature plasmas: new applications of the work of Yukhnovskii and Kelbg
papers.abstract: Remembering here the work of two pioneers of the statistical physics of Coulomb systems, Günter Kelbg, and Ihor Yukhnovskii, we analyze their methods and give some new applications to ionic solutions and quantum plasmas. In particular, we develop applications of the theory to strong electrolytes and to thermal high-temperature plasmas at $T > 0^5$ K using the exponential interaction model. We show the strong structural similarity of these two classes of Coulomb systems, which physics is determined mostly by contributions proportional to $e^4$ and $e^6$. We predict at higher densities a structural transition to oscillating correlations. The thermodynamic functions show a smooth transition from a quadratic root increase to a slower increase like $n_i^{1/4}$ which observes the Onsager bound. Effects of asymmetries in charges and masses are studied with applications to ionic systems with multiple charges and to high-temperature plasmas, in particular, to plasmas with He$^{2+}$-ions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“统计理论”“分析他们的方法”“发展应用”，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：强电解质溶液与高温等离子体（T > 10^5 K），特别是含He²⁺离子的等离子体及多电荷离子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 强电解质与高温等离子体在结构上高度相似，其物理主要由e⁴和e⁶贡献项决定；在高密度下预测出现向振荡关联的结构转变，热力学函数从平方根增长平滑过渡到n_i^{1/4}的较慢增长，符合Onsager界限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：强电解质与高温等离子体在结构上高度相似，其物理主要由e⁴和e⁶贡献项决定；在高密度下预测出现向振荡关联的结构转变，热力学函数从平方根增长平滑过渡到n_i^{1/4}的较慢增长，符合Onsager界限。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Yukhnovskii和Kelbg的库仑系统统计物理方法，采用指数相互作用模型进行理论分析，研究不对称电荷与质量效应。

papers.title: Internal-state criticality in Bayesian-inverse-Bayesian inference
papers.abstract: We propose Bayesian-inverse-Bayesian (BIB) inference in repeated games as a minimal generative model linking Bayesian inference, statistical mechanics, and heavy-tailed statistics. As a concrete instantiation we simulate repeated $N$-hand cyclic-dominance rock-paper-scissors, a discrete setting in which Nash-targeting algorithms collapse to uniform random play, so that any non-trivial dynamics must originate internally. Across a multi-axis sweep of design, window, and opponent conditions, the BIB dynamics remain in the same internal critical state, the argmax-persistence distribution staying a heavy-tailed power law with exponent $α\approx 1.43$ at the canonical window. Along the window and alphabet axes the exponent is not constant but drifts toward the universal $3/2$ as the finite-sample residual $(N-1)/(2m)$ vanishes. Bayes-only inference, which lacks the inverse step, shows no analogous universality and no power law. Because the argmax and laminar observables are first-passage reads of one driftless log-posterior walk, what is robust across conditions is the critical, zero-drift state itself, evidenced by the cross-design data collapse rather than by any particular exponent value. The state is also invariant across the hypothesis count $N_h$, with the cutoff time and posterior spread obeying finite-size scaling. Adding an inverse-Bayesian relaxation step (hypothesis renewal) to ordinary Bayesian inference is by itself enough to render the dynamics critical, with no external parameter adjustment. Rather than self-organizing toward an absorbing state, BIB reaches criticality by continually reconstructing the hypothesis-space boundary, a mechanism complementary to self-organized criticality that makes the criticality robust across a natural parameter range.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a minimal generative model、simulate、dynamics。；研究对象：贝叶斯-逆贝叶斯（BIB）推理在重复博弈中的动力学，具体以重复N手循环支配石头-剪刀-布博弈为实例，研究其内部临界态行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需外部参数调节的情况下，仅通过向普通贝叶斯推理中添加逆贝叶斯松弛步骤（假设更新），即可使动力学进入临界态，其argmax持久性分布呈现重尾幂律，且该临界态在多种设计、窗口和对手条件下保持稳健。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需外部参数调节的情况下，仅通过向普通贝叶斯推理中添加逆贝叶斯松弛步骤（假设更新），即可使动力学进入临界态，其argmax持久性分布呈现重尾幂律，且该临界态在多种设计、窗口和对手条件下保持稳健。；创新点：提出BIB推理作为连接贝叶斯推理、统计力学和重尾统计的最小生成模型；发现临界态是通过持续重构假设空间边界达到的，而非自组织到吸收态，这是一种与自组织临界性互补的机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用贝叶斯-逆贝叶斯（BIB）推理作为生成模型，通过数值模拟重复N手循环支配石头-剪刀-布博弈，分析argmax持久性分布、有限尺寸标度等统计力学量。

papers.title: Halide substitution effects on the photovoltaic properties of Ca$_3$PX$_3$ (X = F, Cl, Br, I) perovskites: advancing solar cell efficiency
papers.abstract: Herein, the fundamental physical characteristics like structural, electronic, optical parameters of the Ca$_3$PX$_3$ (X = F, Cl, Br, I) materials have been investigated for their potential optoelectronic applications, particularly for solar cells and related devices. To the crystallographic investigations, Ca$_3$PI$_3$ has the most stable configuration among all investigated materials. From the band structure analyses of these materials indicate that all materials have a direct bandgap in the range of 2.0 eV to 3.788 eV, which makes them ideal for light absorption. For the photovoltaic applications, we have analysed first-principles spectroscopic screening limited maximum efficiency (SLME) which confirms that the Ca$_3$PI$_3$ material exhibits the highest solar cell efficiency 29.6% and Ca$_3$PF$_3$ and shows lower efficiency for solar cell suitability 0.6%. Thus, these results demonstrate the real potential and abilities of halide substitution to tune the materials for particular optoelectronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“first-principles spectroscopic screening limited maximum efficiency (SLME)”，表明采用第一性原理计算。；研究对象：Ca₃PX₃（X = F, Cl, Br, I）系列钙钛矿材料，研究其结构、电子和光学性质，以及作为太阳能电池材料的潜力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ca₃PI₃在所有研究材料中结构最稳定，且具有最高的太阳能电池效率（29.6%），而Ca₃PF₃效率最低（0.6%），表明卤素替代可有效调控材料的光伏性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ca₃PI₃在所有研究材料中结构最稳定，且具有最高的太阳能电池效率（29.6%），而Ca₃PF₃效率最低（0.6%），表明卤素替代可有效调控材料的光伏性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles），具体包括能带结构分析、光谱限制最大效率（SLME）计算。

papers.title: Exact Accumulated-Field Determined Steady States with Boundary-Controlled Relaxation in Dissipative Quantum Link Chains
papers.abstract: In open quantum lattice systems, changing the boundary condition would appear to alter both the steady state and the nonzero Liouvillian spectrum. Here we show that these two boundary-induced changes do not necessarily occur together in a globally reciprocal dissipative quantum link chain. The steady state is determined by an accumulated field defined by link-resolved dissipative asymmetries, and a gauge-generated transformation built from this field gives exact symmetry-resolved steady states with nonuniform, accumulated-field-dependent reduced matter occupations. We then construct a reciprocal cyclic boundary condition that preserves these matter occupations while changing the nonzero Liouvillian spectrum. Consequently, open and cyclic chains relax to the same reduced matter steady-occupation profile with different Liouvillian gaps, with the cyclic closure accelerating relaxation. In the strong-dissipation limit, this relaxation difference can be reduced to a spectral comparison of effective exclusion processes with open and cyclic boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：open quantum lattice systems, Liouvillian spectrum, exact symmetry-resolved steady states, gauge-generated transformation。；研究对象：耗散量子链接链（dissipative quantum link chains），一种开放量子晶格系统，重点研究边界条件对稳态和弛豫动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在全局互易的耗散量子链接链中，稳态由链接分辨的耗散不对称性定义的累积场唯一确定，而边界条件可以独立改变非零Liouvillian谱而不改变稳态物质占据分布；循环边界条件可加速弛豫，且强耗散极限下弛豫差异可简化为有效排斥过程在开边界与循环边界下的谱比较。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在全局互易的耗散量子链接链中，稳态由链接分辨的耗散不对称性定义的累积场唯一确定，而边界条件可以独立改变非零Liouvillian谱而不改变稳态物质占据分布；循环边界条件可加速弛豫，且强耗散极限下弛豫差异可简化为有效排斥过程在开边界与循环边界下的谱比较。；创新点：揭示了边界条件对稳态与弛豫动力学的解耦效应：稳态由内部耗散不对称性（累积场）决定，而边界条件仅改变非零Liouvillian谱，从而可独立调控弛豫速率而不影响稳态物质占据。摘要未突出说明与已有具体工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过规范生成变换（gauge-generated transformation）从累积场构建精确的对称分辨稳态；对比开边界与循环边界条件下的Liouvillian谱和弛豫间隙；在强耗散极限下将问题映射为有效排斥过程（effective exclusion processes）的谱比较。

papers.title: Spin-orbit-enabled Fermi-surface splitting in noncollinear antiferromagnetic SmBi
papers.abstract: Spin-split electronic structures in compensated antiferromagnets are commonly sought in the nonrelativistic limit, where magnetic order lifts spin degeneracy without spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Whether SOC can instead be the indispensable symmetry-breaking ingredient remains largely unexplored. Here we combine quantum oscillations detected by ultrahigh-sensitivity ac magnetostriction, magnetic-symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations to resolve the bulk Fermi-surface evolution of SmBi across two successive antiferromagnetic (AFM) transitions. New oscillation branches emerge below TN and undergo a further reconstruction below T*, whereas isostructural SmSb shows no comparable change. For the candidate noncollinear orders of SmBi, breaking global parity-time symmetry is insufficient in the nonrelativistic limit because residual spin-space symmetries protect twofold band degeneracy; conversely, SOC alone cannot lift the degeneracy of the centrosymmetric paramagnetic (PM) phase. Only the coexistence of noncollinear order and SOC locks spin to the lattice and removes the residual protection. SmBi therefore realizes a cooperative, relativistic route to spin-split Fermi surfaces, broadening unconventional magnetism beyond systems whose splitting is already present in the nonrelativistic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算+理论）。判断依据：结合了“量子振荡探测”（实验）、“磁对称性分析”（理论）和“第一性原理计算”（计算）。；研究对象：非共线反铁磁材料SmBi，具体研究其在外磁场下两次连续反铁磁相变过程中体费米面的演化，并与同构材料SmSb进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非共线反铁磁体SmBi中，自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）与磁有序的协同作用是实现费米面自旋劈裂的关键。仅靠非相对论极限下的磁有序或仅靠SOC都无法实现这种劈裂，这与通常在非相对论极限下寻找自旋劈裂的补偿反铁磁体不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非共线反铁磁体SmBi中，自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）与磁有序的协同作用是实现费米面自旋劈裂的关键。仅靠非相对论极限下的磁有序或仅靠SOC都无法实现这种劈裂，这与通常在非相对论极限下寻找自旋劈裂的补偿反铁磁体不同。；创新点：该工作揭示了一种实现自旋劈裂费米面的“合作性、相对论性”新路径。它证明了在非共线反铁磁体中，自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）可以成为打破能带简并的不可或缺的对称性破缺要素，而非仅仅在非相对论极限下依赖磁有序。这拓宽了对非常规磁性的理解，超越了那些在非相对论极限下就已存在自旋劈裂的系统。
papers.method_zh: 1.  **实验手段**：超高灵敏度交流磁致伸缩技术，用于探测量子振荡。

papers.title: The Market Crystal: A Spin-Lattice Model for Collective Cryptocurrency States
papers.abstract: Collective dynamics in financial markets can emerge through synchronized movements of large groups of assets. Motivated by analogies with interacting many-body systems, we introduce a spin-lattice representation for analyzing collective states in cryptocurrency markets. In this framework, assets are encoded as binary spin variables according to the sign of their returns, while correlations between assets determine effective interaction strengths. A correlation-based breadth-first search (CBFS) procedure embeds 169 cryptocurrencies into a $13 \times 13$ lattice, enabling the construction of an Ising-like Hamiltonian describing the market configuration, which we call the \emph{Market Crystal}. Macroscopic observables such as magnetization and energy provide a statistical-mechanical characterization of collective market states. The resulting phase-space structure highlights regimes of strong alignment and fragmentation among assets, with an energy--magnetization pattern suggestive of predominantly ferromagnetic interactions. This framework offers a statistical-mechanical viewpoint for studying collective behavior in financial systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spin-lattice representation、Ising-like Hamiltonian、statistical-mechanical characterization。；研究对象：加密货币市场的集体动力学行为，具体为169种加密货币的收益率同步涨跌模式，类比于自旋晶格系统中的集体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构建“市场晶体”（Market Crystal）模型，发现加密货币市场的相空间结构呈现出强对齐与碎片化两种状态，且能量-磁化强度模式暗示以铁磁相互作用为主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构建“市场晶体”（Market Crystal）模型，发现加密货币市场的相空间结构呈现出强对齐与碎片化两种状态，且能量-磁化强度模式暗示以铁磁相互作用为主导。；创新点：将凝聚态物理中的自旋晶格模型与伊辛哈密顿量框架首次系统性地应用于加密货币市场的集体态分析，提出了“市场晶体”这一统计力学视角的金融系统研究方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋晶格表示法，将资产收益率符号编码为二元自旋变量，基于相关性广度优先搜索（CBFS）将169种加密货币嵌入13×13晶格，并构建类伊辛哈密顿量描述市场构型。

papers.title: Sliding ferroelectricity tunable conventional and anomalous spin Hall effects in bilayer 1T'-WTe2
papers.abstract: The spin Hall effect, recognized for its high-speed, low-power, and highly controllable characteristics, is a key enabler for next-generation memory and logic devices. However, a primary challenge lies in achieving 180$^{\circ}$ magnetization switching without an external magnetic field in spin-orbit torque devices. Here, we propose a method to tune the conventional and anomalous spin Hall effects by the intrinsic sliding ferroelectricity. Importantly, the anomalous spin Hall effect can enable the field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization. We find a substantial anomalous spin Hall conductivity of $σ_{xy}^{y}$ = 45.62 ($\hbar$/e)S/cm and $σ_{yx}^{y}$ = 56.84 ($\hbar$/e)S/cm in monolayer 1T'-WTe$_2$. These values are significantly enhanced to $σ_{xy}^{y}$ = -96.77 ($\hbar$/e)S/cm and $σ_{yx}^{y}$ = 104.03 ($\hbar$/e)S/cm in the bilayer 1T'-WTe$_2$. More interestingly, the sliding ferroelectricity enables reversible switching of the signs and magnitudes for both the conventional and anomalous spin Hall conductivities. This originates from the fact that the sliding ferroelectric markedly shifts the relative spin Berry curvature contributions from the valence and conduction bands around the $Γ$-X path. Our findings not only reveal a strong coupling between sliding ferroelectricity and spin transport, but also propose a strategy for the nonvolatile electrical control of spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“提出方法”“发现”“源自于”等理论分析表述，以及“自旋Berry曲率”等理论概念，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：双层1T’-WTe₂材料中的滑移铁电性与自旋霍尔效应（包括常规和反常自旋霍尔效应）之间的耦合关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过滑移铁电性可实现对常规和反常自旋霍尔电导率的符号和幅度的可逆调控，且反常自旋霍尔效应能够实现无外磁场的垂直磁化翻转。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过滑移铁电性可实现对常规和反常自旋霍尔电导率的符号和幅度的可逆调控，且反常自旋霍尔效应能够实现无外磁场的垂直磁化翻转。；创新点：首次提出利用材料本征的滑移铁电性来调控自旋霍尔效应，特别是实现无外磁场下的垂直磁化翻转，揭示了滑移铁电性与自旋输运之间的强耦合机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理计算（DFT）分析自旋Berry曲率，计算自旋霍尔电导率，并研究滑移铁电位移对能带结构及自旋输运性质的影响。

papers.title: Stacking-Directed Polarization and Excitonic Engineering in MoS$_2$/MoSe$_2$ van der Waals Heterostructures
papers.abstract: The stacking-dependent polarization and excitonic response of MoS$_2$/MoSe$_2$ heterostructures were investigated using GW+BSE many-body perturbation theory. While homobilayer MoS$_2$ exhibited a switchable interlayer dipole driven by registry-induced symmetry breaking, the MoS$_2$/MoSe$_2$ hetero-interface remained pinned by the intrinsic chemical potential mismatch between sulfur and selenium. In 2L-MoS$_2$/MoSe$_2$ trilayers, the stacking sequence enabled a deterministic control of photogenerated electrons between the central and bottom MoS$_2$ layers, governed by internal electric fields and quasiparticle band-edge shifts of 60--70~meV. Our calculations predicted a 36~meV interlayer excitonic shift, in remarkable agreement with recent experiments. These results elucidate the microscopic link between atomic registry and many-body interactions, establishing transition metal dichalcogenide trilayers as a potential platform for sliding ferroelectricity and programmable optoelectronic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：关键词“GW+BSE many-body perturbation theory”（多体微扰理论计算）。；研究对象：MoS₂/MoSe₂ 范德华异质结（包括双层及三层结构）中的堆叠依赖极化与激子响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂/MoSe₂ 异质界面因硫和硒的化学势失配而极化方向固定，但在2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂三层结构中，通过堆叠顺序可确定性控制光生电子在中间与底层MoS₂层间的分布，并预测了36 meV的层间激子位移，与实验吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂/MoSe₂ 异质界面因硫和硒的化学势失配而极化方向固定，但在2L-MoS₂/MoSe₂三层结构中，通过堆叠顺序可确定性控制光生电子在中间与底层MoS₂层间的分布，并预测了36 meV的层间激子位移，与实验吻合。；创新点：揭示了原子堆叠序与多体相互作用之间的微观联系，提出过渡金属硫族化物三层结构可作为滑动铁电性和可编程光电子功能性的平台。摘要未突出说明与已有计算工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用GW+BSE（多体微扰理论）方法进行第一性原理计算，分析准粒子能带边偏移（60–70 meV）和内建电场效应。

papers.title: Generation of two-dimensional pulses in lipid monolayers by rapid photoswitching
papers.abstract: We study pressure pulse generation and propagation in lipid monolayers by an experimental approach employing rapid photoisomerization of photoswitchable lipids (azoPC). This allows us to generate longitudinal surface pressure pulses by optical flash excitation in both free and constrained layer geometries. We compare the observed pulse shapes with a theoretical approach based on a nonlinear fractional wave equation for a surface displacement field, where a fractional time derivative term captures the hydrodynamics of the monolayer subphase. We explore channel geometries of different lengths and widths and find quantitative agreement between theory and experiment regarding pulse speed and pulse shapes. For narrow channels, we employ a one-dimensional version of the fractional wave equation to study pulse propagation without any fit parameters by using the pressure signal at a close pressure sensor as boundary condition to predict the pressure signal at a second far sensor. A full two-dimensional description can capture all effects arising from the channel geometry for wider channels using one common set of fit parameters for the pulse excitation that can be applied to all geometries. The nonlinearity in the fractional wave equation plays no role in explaining the observed pulse shapes because pulse amplitudes generated by azoPC photoswitching remain very small.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以理论建模）。判断依据：摘要明确描述“experimental approach employing rapid photoisomerization”，并“compare the observed pulse shapes with a theoretical approach”。；研究对象：脂质单分子层（lipid monolayers）中由光开关脂质（azoPC）快速光异构化产生的二维压力脉冲（two-dimensional pressure pulses）及其传播行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过快速光开关在脂质单分子层中可产生纵向表面压力脉冲，实验观测到的脉冲形状与基于非线性分数阶波动方程的理论预测在脉冲速度和形状上定量吻合；但非线性项对解释观测结果不起作用，因为脉冲振幅非常小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过快速光开关在脂质单分子层中可产生纵向表面压力脉冲，实验观测到的脉冲形状与基于非线性分数阶波动方程的理论预测在脉冲速度和形状上定量吻合；但非线性项对解释观测结果不起作用，因为脉冲振幅非常小。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光开关脂质（azoPC）的快速光异构化产生压力脉冲，在自由和受限几何构型中测量；理论上使用描述表面位移场的非线性分数阶波动方程，其中分数阶时间导数项捕捉单分子层亚相（subphase）的流体动力学效应。对于窄通道采用一维版本（无拟合参数），宽通道采用二维版本（使用一组公共拟合参数）。

papers.title: Magneto-ionic control of topological transport in SrRuO3 via band topology engineering
papers.abstract: The interplay between spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and nontrivial band topology in ferromagnets gives rise to a rich landscape of topological transport phenomena such as anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and topological Hall effect (THE). One central goal in modern spintronics lies in the realization of the active control over topological transport phenomena in a reversible fashion, while unambiguously disentangling respective contributions of THE and AHE to the net Hall effect remains a formidable challenge. Here we establish magneto ionic control as a powerful paradigm for dynamically engineering topological transports in a 4d-orbital SrRuO3 system with sizable SOC and itinerant ferromagnetism. Harnessing controllable protonation or oxygen vacancy incorporation, the Fermi-level upshift relative to avoided band crossings are realized through band filling control, giving rise to tunable reversal temperature of AHE polarity. Of particular note is the emergence of hump like Hall anomalies through extensive ionic doping that can be reversibly switched, irrespective of AHE polarity, providing evidence for a THE signal driven by broken inversion symmetry rather than a two channel AHE. Our findings provide a viable tuning knob for Berry curvature engineering, enabling on demand control of topological transports in strong SOC ferromagnets for low power, reconfigurable all oxide spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了通过可控质子化或氧空位掺入等实验手段，实现了对拓扑输运的调控，并观察到了特定的霍尔效应特征。；研究对象：4d轨道氧化物 SrRuO₃ 体系中的拓扑输运现象，特别是反常霍尔效应（AHE）和拓扑霍尔效应（THE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过磁离子学方法（可控质子化或氧空位掺入）动态调控 SrRuO₃ 的能带填充，实现了对能带拓扑结构的工程化，从而可逆地控制反常霍尔效应的极性反转温度，并观测到与AHE极性无关、可逆切换的驼峰状霍尔异常，证实了由反演对称性破缺驱动的拓扑霍尔效应信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过磁离子学方法（可控质子化或氧空位掺入）动态调控 SrRuO₃ 的能带填充，实现了对能带拓扑结构的工程化，从而可逆地控制反常霍尔效应的极性反转温度，并观测到与AHE极性无关、可逆切换的驼峰状霍尔异常，证实了由反演对称性破缺驱动的拓扑霍尔效应信号。；创新点：建立了磁离子学控制作为动态调控强自旋-轨道耦合铁磁体中拓扑输运的新范式，并成功区分了拓扑霍尔效应与双通道反常霍尔效应对净霍尔效应的贡献，为Berry曲率工程提供了可行的调控手段。
papers.method_zh: 磁离子学控制（可控质子化或氧空位掺入），通过能带填充控制实现费米能级相对于能带交叉点的移动，并结合霍尔效应测量来表征AHE和THE。

papers.title: Nonlocal fractional Kardar-Parisi-Zhang dynamics of grain boundaries
papers.abstract: The kinetic roughening of driven grain boundaries (GBs) is fundamentally mediated by the collective behavior of disconnections, whose long-range $1/r$ elastic interactions distinguish them from conventional growing surfaces. Through large-scale molecular dynamics simulations and a nonlocal fractional Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (fKPZ) theory, we demonstrate that driven GBs undergo a sharp transition of morphology at the yield point, from the quenched Edwards-Wilkinson universality class ($H \approx 0.33$) to an anomalous fKPZ regime ($H \approx 0.8$), while the 1/r nonlocal elasticity manifests as the fractional relaxation of GB morphology. The results show that the avalanche noise arrests the gradient catastrophe induced by the KPZ nonlinearity. Governed by the nonlocal elastic kernels, the resulting morphology breaks the Gaussian self-affinity and parallels the universality class of dynamic fracture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：molecular dynamics simulations（分子动力学模拟）、nonlocal fractional Kardar-Parisi-Zhang theory（非局域分数阶KPZ理论）。；研究对象：受驱动晶界（grain boundaries, GBs）的动力学粗糙化行为，特别是由位错（disconnections）集体行为介导的形态演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 受驱动晶界在屈服点处发生形态的尖锐转变：从淬火Edwards-Wilkinson普适类（粗糙度指数H≈0.33）转变为反常fKPZ区（H≈0.8）；1/r非局域弹性作用表现为晶界形态的分数阶弛豫，雪崩噪声抑制了KPZ非线性引起的梯度灾变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：受驱动晶界在屈服点处发生形态的尖锐转变：从淬火Edwards-Wilkinson普适类（粗糙度指数H≈0.33）转变为反常fKPZ区（H≈0.8）；1/r非局域弹性作用表现为晶界形态的分数阶弛豫，雪崩噪声抑制了KPZ非线性引起的梯度灾变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟（large-scale molecular dynamics simulations）结合非局域分数阶Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（fKPZ）理论。

papers.title: Spectroscopic fingerprints of a ferroaxial charge density wave
papers.abstract: Unconventional charge density waves (CDWs) with complex order parameters can host exotic collective modes and non-trivial topologies. They have emerged as a new frontier in the study of quantum matter. Recent experiments on rare-earth tritellurides have reported evidence for a ferroaxial CDW through the detection of characteristic Raman modes. This phase, often regarded as a hidden order, has been recognized to arise from the coupling between charge and orbital degrees of freedom in these materials. Yet, spectroscopic insight into its underlying electronic structure and the explicit form of its order parameter symmetry has remained elusive. Here, we present results from linearly polarized angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) measurements of the CDW phase in LaTe$_3$. Our ARPES measurements reveal a complex landscape of spectral gaps across the reconstructed Fermi surface, while our STM-based quasiparticle interference (QPI) mapping, enhanced through the selective deposition of atomic scattering centers, directly reveals an inter-orbital CDW with mixed $p_x$-$p_z$ orbital character. The detailed analysis of the QPI characteristics in terms of the order parameter symmetry within the orbital subspace of the Fermi surface suggests a mixed CDW phase with substantial ferroaxial component, which breaks all vertical mirror symmetries. More broadly, our work establishes a powerful spectroscopic pathway, based on scattering off individual atoms, for identifying and characterizing hidden, multi-component electronic orders in quantum materials using STM and ARPES measurements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“linearly polarized angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) measurements”，以及“selective deposition of atomic scattering centers”等实验手段。；研究对象：稀土三碲化物LaTe₃中的铁轴电荷密度波（ferroaxial charge density wave, CDW）相，及其电子结构和序参量对称性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过线偏振角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合原子散射中心的准粒子干涉（QPI）测量，直接揭示了LaTe₃中具有混合pₓ-p_z轨道特征的轨道间电荷密度波，并发现该CDW相具有显著的铁轴分量，破坏了所有垂直镜面对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过线偏振角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合原子散射中心的准粒子干涉（QPI）测量，直接揭示了LaTe₃中具有混合pₓ-p_z轨道特征的轨道间电荷密度波，并发现该CDW相具有显著的铁轴分量，破坏了所有垂直镜面对称性。；创新点：首次通过基于单个原子散射的STM-QPI与ARPES联合光谱方法，直接识别并表征了隐藏的多分量电子序（铁轴CDW），并明确了其混合轨道（pₓ-p_z）特征和对称性破缺性质。
papers.method_zh: 线偏振角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量重构费米面上的谱隙；扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合选择性沉积原子散射中心进行准粒子干涉（QPI）成像，并通过QPI特征分析轨道子空间内的序参量对称性。

papers.title: Antiferromagnetic pseudospintronics without spin splitting
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFMs) are promising for high-density spintronics due to their zero net magnetization, yet conventional AFM spintronics relies on spin splitting-a requirement that excludes many collinear AFMs with compensated spin sublattices. Here we exploit the sublattice degree of freedom in a honeycomb AFM with zero spin splitting. We uncover a coupling between spin and sublattice: the out-of-plane pseudospin polarization is spin-dependent, a mechanism we term partial pseudospin-spin coupling. This allows switching of the pseudospin polarization by reversing the Néel vector. Introducing an impurity into a specific sublattice induces Friedel oscillations with a sublattice-resolved amplitude ratio dictated solely by the pseudospin polarization, which is directly measurable by spin-polarized scanning tunneling microscopy. Furthermore, we demonstrate Néel-vector-controlled transmission and a large nonvolatile tunneling magnetoresistance in an all-in-one AFM junction, with pronounced resonant enhancement in gate-tunable two-dimensional devices. Our work establishes a new paradigm-AFM pseudospintronics-that utilizes the sublattice pseudospin in zero-spin-splitting AFMs, extending spintronics beyond the conventional spin-splitting paradigm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we uncover”“we demonstrate”等理论推导与机制描述，未提及具体实验或计算手段，核心为提出新物理机制与器件概念。；研究对象：零自旋分裂的蜂窝状反铁磁体中的赝自旋自由度，以及基于该自由度的反铁磁赝自旋电子学器件（如全反铁磁结、栅可调二维器件）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零自旋分裂的蜂窝状反铁磁体中，发现了自旋与子晶格自由度之间的耦合（部分赝自旋-自旋耦合），使得通过翻转奈尔矢量可切换赝自旋极化，并实现奈尔矢量控制的隧穿磁电阻效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零自旋分裂的蜂窝状反铁磁体中，发现了自旋与子晶格自由度之间的耦合（部分赝自旋-自旋耦合），使得通过翻转奈尔矢量可切换赝自旋极化，并实现奈尔矢量控制的隧穿磁电阻效应。；创新点：提出了“反铁磁赝自旋电子学”这一新范式，将自旋电子学从传统的自旋分裂依赖拓展到零自旋分裂反铁磁体中的子晶格赝自旋利用，为无净磁化、无自旋分裂的反铁磁材料提供了新的信息存储与操控自由度。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型构建：利用子晶格自由度与自旋的耦合机制，推导了Friedel振荡的子晶格分辨振幅比与赝自旋极化的关系，并设计了全反铁磁结的输运模型，预测了栅可调二维器件中的共振增强隧穿磁电阻。

papers.title: Saturation Coverage in Binary Mixtures of Oriented Regular Polygons via Random Sequential Adsorption
papers.abstract: We study saturation in two-dimensional binary mixtures of fixed-orientation regular polygons deposited by random sequential adsorption (RSA). Polygons with (n\in{3,\dots,23}) are considered under an equal-area constraint, isolating shape effects from size effects.
