Saturated configurations are generated using an adaptive split-voxel RSA algorithm with exact overlap detection based on the Separating Axis Theorem, allowing a systematic exploration of all distinct binary shape combinations. Jamming coverage depends strongly on polygon geometry despite identical particle area. Triangle-containing mixtures yield the lowest coverages, whereas axis-aligned squares achieve the maximum observed value, (φ_{\rm sat}\approx0.5646). Even-sided polygons consistently outperform neighboring odd-sided polygons, revealing a parity effect associated with centrosymmetry. For odd (n), the pure-species saturation approaches the disk RSA limit (φ_{\rm disk}\approx0.547) from below according to (φ_{\rm sat}(n)=φ_{\rm disk}-c/n^α), with (α\approx2.41\pm0.06), close to the (1/n^2) scaling expected from isoperimetric arguments. Even-sided polygons instead converge from above, indicating a symmetry-driven packing advantage that disappears only in the circular limit. These trends are explained through the excluded area (E_{AB}=\mathrm{Area}(P_A\oplus(-P_B))), computed analytically via Minkowski sums. Centrosymmetry fixes (E_{AA}=4A_0) for even (n), whereas odd polygons have a larger excluded area that decreases monotonically toward the same limit as (n\to\infty). Saturation coverage is negatively correlated with excluded area, consistent with a mean-field RSA description and directly linking geometric symmetry to jamming efficiency.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：random sequential adsorption (RSA)、数值模拟、Minkowski和解析计算。；研究对象：二维二元混合物中固定取向正多边形（边数n=3至23）的随机顺序吸附饱和覆盖问题，重点研究形状效应（等面积约束下）对堵塞覆盖率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在等面积条件下，三角形含量高的混合物覆盖率最低，而轴对齐正方形混合物达到最大饱和覆盖率（约0.5646）。偶数边多边形始终优于相邻奇数边多边形，揭示了与中心对称性相关的奇偶效应；奇数边纯物种的饱和覆盖率从下方趋近圆盘RSA极限（约0.547），而偶数边则从上方趋近，表明对称性驱动的堆积优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在等面积条件下，三角形含量高的混合物覆盖率最低，而轴对齐正方形混合物达到最大饱和覆盖率（约0.5646）。偶数边多边形始终优于相邻奇数边多边形，揭示了与中心对称性相关的奇偶效应；奇数边纯物种的饱和覆盖率从下方趋近圆盘RSA极限（约0.547），而偶数边则从上方趋近，表明对称性驱动的堆积优势。；创新点：系统探索了所有不同二元正多边形形状组合（n=3至23）的饱和覆盖率，定量揭示了中心对称性（奇偶性）对堵塞效率的影响，并发现奇数边多边形饱和覆盖率随1/n^α（α≈2.41）趋近圆盘极限，接近等周论证预期的1/n^2标度。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于分离轴定理（Separating Axis Theorem）精确重叠检测的自适应分割体素RSA算法，生成饱和构型；通过Minkowski和解析计算排除面积E_AB，并利用平均场RSA描述建立排除面积与饱和覆盖率的负相关关系。

papers.title: The FAST Framework: Developing a Data-Efficient Machine Learning Potential to Decode Superionic Transition-Induced Thermophysical and Kinetic Anomalies in UO2 under Extreme Conditions
papers.abstract: Uranium dioxide ($UO_2$) serves as the predominant nuclear fuel globally. Despite its widespread application, evaluating its mechanical, thermophysical, and species transport behaviors under extreme accident scenarios remains a formidable challenge for conventional experimental and computational methods. To address this, we develop a versatile machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) for $UO_2$ by proposing an efficient training strategy, termed the "FAST" (Fine-tuning via Active-learning and Superionic-Targeting) framework. Our "FAST" framework integrates superionic transition-targeted sampling with active learning-enhanced exploration to efficiently construct a highly compact dataset comprising only 500 configurations for fine-tuning a foundation model. By rigorously accounting for the strong correlation of uranium 5f electrons and antiferromagnetic (AFM) ground state during DFT labeling, we train a robust DFT-level neuroevolution potential (NEP) for $UO_2$. We demonstrate that this NEP exhibits superior predictive capability for various physical properties, encompassing mechanical, defect, thermophysical, and ionic diffusion over an extensive temperature range. Moreover, this NEP accurately captures the anomalous thermophysical and kinetic behaviors triggered by superionic transition. Specifically, it reproduces both the $λ$-peak in linear thermal expansion coefficient (LTEC) and "non-Arrhenius" anionic diffusion. Crucially, NEP-based simulations elucidate the microscopic origins underlying these anomalies: the pre-melting of oxygen sublattice and resultant kinetic decoupling between U and O ions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP)、DFT labeling、neuroevolution potential (NEP)、simulations。；研究对象：二氧化铀（UO₂）在极端条件下的超离子转变引发的热物理与动力学反常行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该机器学习势能（NEP）准确复现了超离子转变导致的线性热膨胀系数λ峰和“非阿伦尼乌斯”阴离子扩散行为，并揭示其微观起源为氧亚晶格的预熔化以及U与O离子之间的动力学解耦。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该机器学习势能（NEP）准确复现了超离子转变导致的线性热膨胀系数λ峰和“非阿伦尼乌斯”阴离子扩散行为，并揭示其微观起源为氧亚晶格的预熔化以及U与O离子之间的动力学解耦。；创新点：提出一种数据高效的机器学习势能训练策略（FAST框架），以极小数据集（500构型）实现对UO₂在极端条件下多种物性（力学、缺陷、热物理、离子扩散）的精确预测，并成功捕捉超离子转变引发的反常热物理与动力学行为。
papers.method_zh: 提出“FAST”（Fine-tuning via Active-learning and Superionic-Targeting）训练框架，结合超离子转变靶向采样与主动学习增强探索，仅用500个构型微调基础模型；采用DFT标记（考虑铀5f电子的强关联和反铁磁基态）训练神经演化势能（NEP）。

papers.title: Solid-state transcapacitor, a new gain element for logic, memory and interconnects
papers.abstract: Today's transistors dictate the voltage and charge scales for both logic and memory. While AI systems are recognized to be limited by memory energy, the dominant share of the energy is expended in the intrachip interconnects whose voltage and charge scales are set by transistors. The energy scaling challenges of transistors can be attributed to simultaneously meeting high current density, high current/impedance modulation, and the inability to lower voltages. Hence, a new logic element that lowers the voltage and charge needs is a priority, not only for lowering logic power but also memory access power. Here, we propose a novel 3-terminal logic element for low energy computing, a solid-state transcapacitor (TCAP). A TCAP is a solid state displacement current modulator realized by a gate which controls the charge-voltage relationship of the channel. Unlike transistors, TCAPs eliminate the dissipative transport current, are not bound by the Boltzmann current modulation limit, and operate with displacement currents limited only by the polarization response and contact resistance. Hence, TCAP circuits may simultaneously overcome the voltage, current density, and current modulation limits of CMOS. We describe a solid state TCAP using a piezoelectric transcapacitor in which a gate-controlled stressor modulates the capacitance of a polar channel via electromechanical coupling. This device achieves inversion and gain, essential for logic, and is functionally equivalent to a 1T-1C memory cell, enabling dense memory. Using voltage scaling, capacitive energy recovery, and high polarization densities of polar materials, the logic based on TCAP offers a pathway to 100 fold lower energy consumption with a delay comparable to ultimately scaled CMOS devices. This approach provides a new potential pathway for low-energy computing beyond the limits of transistors using electro-mechanics and multiferroics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/概念提出文章。关键词：propose、concept、pathway。；研究对象：一种新型三端逻辑元件——固态跨电容器（solid-state transcapacitor, TCAP），基于压电-电介质耦合的位移电流调制机制，用于低能耗计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于压电跨电容器的固态TCAP，通过栅极控制应力调制极性沟道的电容，实现逻辑所需的反相和增益，同时规避了晶体管的玻尔兹曼电流调制极限和耗散输运电流，有望实现比最终尺度CMOS器件低100倍的能耗。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于压电跨电容器的固态TCAP，通过栅极控制应力调制极性沟道的电容，实现逻辑所需的反相和增益，同时规避了晶体管的玻尔兹曼电流调制极限和耗散输运电流，有望实现比最终尺度CMOS器件低100倍的能耗。；创新点：首次提出用固态跨电容器（TCAP）替代晶体管作为逻辑/存储/互连的基本增益元件，利用位移电流和机电耦合突破CMOS在电压、电流密度和电流调制方面的根本限制。摘要未突出说明与已有铁电或负电容器件的具体对比。

papers.title: Interaction between point defects and vertical inversion domain walls in wurtzite AlN
papers.abstract: Alloyed aluminium nitride compounds constitute a promising class of ferroelectric materials due to their high remanent electric polarizations, large band gaps and structural compatibility with a growth on Si substrates. Such materials nonetheless possess large coercive fields and polarization-switching mechanisms are still debated. We performed first-principles calculations to investigate the stability of isolated point defects in the vicinity of a vertical inversion domain wall (DW). We found that all studied defects are energetically more stable at or near the DW. Depending on their nature, they can have the opposite effect on the displacement of the DW, which occurs during polarization switching. Finally, we discuss how likely the different defects may be responsible for leaking currents and degraded ferroelectric properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：纤锌矿结构氮化铝（wurtzite AlN）中的点缺陷与垂直反演畴壁（inversion domain wall, DW）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有研究的点缺陷在能量上更倾向于稳定在垂直反演畴壁附近；不同种类的缺陷对极化翻转过程中畴壁的位移可能产生相反的影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有研究的点缺陷在能量上更倾向于稳定在垂直反演畴壁附近；不同种类的缺陷对极化翻转过程中畴壁的位移可能产生相反的影响。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），用于研究孤立点缺陷在垂直反演畴壁附近的稳定性。

papers.title: Non-BCS Pairing by a Singular Dynamical Interaction
papers.abstract: This review examines the theory of superconductivity in systems with {\em singular dynamical} electron-electron interaction and contrasts it with a conventional BCS superconductivity. Examples include metals near a Quantum Critical Point, quantum dots and system near a localization (Mott) transition. We show, that the singular interaction destroys the traditional separation of energy scales, invalidating the significance of Cooper logarithm, and, as the consequence, the whole BCS framework. We explore the universal model with dynamical interaction $Γ(Ω) \propto 1/|Ω|^γ$ (the $γ$-model) and analyze the competition/interplay between the tendency towards pairing and towards non-Fermi liquid behavior. We show that superconductivity still develops once the pairing interaction exceeds a certain threshold, but the origin of the pairing is qualitatively different from that in BCS theory. We show that the gap equation at $T=0$ has an infinite set of topologically distinct solutions. These solution disappear one by one once the pairing interaction becomes non-singular (massive). We review the physics underlying these phenomena and outline future directions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（综述）。判断依据：摘要明确说明“This review examines...”，并主要基于理论模型（γ-model）和解析分析（gap equation）。；研究对象：具有奇异动态电子-电子相互作用的超导系统。具体体系包括：量子临界点附近的金属、量子点、以及临近局域化（Mott）转变的系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 奇异动态相互作用会破坏传统BCS理论中能量尺度的分离，使“Cooper对数”失效，从而颠覆整个BCS框架。超导仍可在相互作用超过某一阈值时发生，但其起源与BCS理论有本质不同，且零温能隙方程存在无穷多拓扑不同的解。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：奇异动态相互作用会破坏传统BCS理论中能量尺度的分离，使“Cooper对数”失效，从而颠覆整个BCS框架。超导仍可在相互作用超过某一阈值时发生，但其起源与BCS理论有本质不同，且零温能隙方程存在无穷多拓扑不同的解。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新在于系统性地揭示了奇异动态相互作用如何从根本上改变超导配对的机制，并发现了能隙方程具有无穷多拓扑不同解这一非BCS特征。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架为：建立具有动态相互作用 Γ(Ω) ∝ 1/|Ω|^γ 的通用模型（γ-model），通过求解零温能隙方程（gap equation）分析配对与非费米液体行为之间的竞争与相互作用。

papers.title: A Topology-Preserving Python Framework for Reliable Initialization of Star and Cyclic Polymer Architectures in Molecular Dynamics (LAMMPS) Simulations
papers.abstract: Accurate initialization of polymer architectures remains a critical yet underappreciated determinant of reliability in molecular dynamics simulations of soft matter systems. Errors in coordinate generation and connectivity assignment frequently introduce artificial stresses, topological inconsistencies, and numerical instabilities that propagate throughout simulation trajectories. Here, we present a topology-preserving Python framework for generating star and cyclic polymer architectures with deterministic bond connectivity, exact ring closure, excluded volume enforcement, and spatial-hashing-based overlap detection. The algorithm produces LAMMPS-compatible data files under atom style full without reliance on third-party libraries. We demonstrate that the generated structures exhibit mechanical stability at initialization, suppressed artificial energy spikes, and consistent thermodynamic behavior during equilibration. Benchmark comparisons against naive random placement schemes reveal significant reductions in overlap-induced instabilities and improved reproducibility of structural and dynamical observables. The presented framework establishes initialization as a controlled physical boundary condition rather than a stochastic preprocessing step, thereby enhancing the reliability and reproducibility of polymer molecular dynamics simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Python framework、Molecular Dynamics (LAMMPS) Simulations、algorithm、benchmark comparisons。；研究对象：星形和环形聚合物（star and cyclic polymer architectures）的分子动力学模拟初始化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种拓扑保持的Python框架，能够生成具有确定性键连接、精确闭环、排除体积效应和空间哈希重叠检测的聚合物初始构型，显著抑制了初始化过程中的人为能量尖峰和拓扑不一致性，提高了模拟的可靠性和可重复性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种拓扑保持的Python框架，能够生成具有确定性键连接、精确闭环、排除体积效应和空间哈希重叠检测的聚合物初始构型，显著抑制了初始化过程中的人为能量尖峰和拓扑不一致性，提高了模拟的可靠性和可重复性。；创新点：将聚合物分子动力学模拟的初始化从随机预处理步骤转变为可控的物理边界条件，通过拓扑保持算法确保键连接和环闭合的确定性，从而消除因初始化错误导致的数值不稳定性和人工应力。摘要未突出说明与已有拓扑生成工具（如Polyply、Moltemplate等）的具体性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于Python开发的拓扑保持算法，结合空间哈希（spatial-hashing）重叠检测技术，生成LAMMPS兼容的atom style full数据文件。通过对比随机放置方案，对初始化结构的力学稳定性、能量行为和热力学平衡行为进行基准测试。

papers.title: Symmetry-Enforced Pair-Density Wave and Chiral Interband Superconductivity in Strongly Correlated Kagome Systems
papers.abstract: The pair-density wave (PDW) state, characterized by Cooper pairing at finite momentum, is a long-sought superconducting phase whose possible realization in Kagome metals is particularly intriguing in the strongly correlated regime. We investigate superconductivity in the extended $t$-$J$ model on the Kagome lattice and show that the symmetry-enforced sublattice structure of the Bloch wavefunctions gives rise to a rich landscape of unconventional pairing states. When the chemical potential is tuned to a sublattice-pure ($p$-type) van Hove singularity (vHS), a PDW state inevitably emerges. Near the $m'$-type vHS, which features opposite mirror eigenvalues to the conventional $m$-type vHS, intraband chiral, uniform, and nematic pairing states compete. When further-neighbor hoppings drive the $p$- and $m'$-type vHSs towards near degeneracy, phase frustration in the interband pairing channel stabilizes a chiral interband state. Our results reveal the previously overlooked $m'$-type vHS as a distinct route to unconventional superconductivity rooted in electronic correlations and mirror-symmetry-constrained Bloch wavefunctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We investigate”“Our results reveal”等表述，且未提及实验手段或计算模拟，属于基于模型的理论分析。；研究对象：Kagome晶格上的扩展t-J模型中的超导态，特别是由对称性约束的布洛赫波函数导致的非常规配对态，如配对密度波（PDW）和手性带间超导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当化学势调谐至子格纯（p型）范霍夫奇点时，必然出现配对密度波（PDW）态；当p型和m'型范霍夫奇点接近简并时，带间配对通道中的相位竞争会稳定一种手性带间超导态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当化学势调谐至子格纯（p型）范霍夫奇点时，必然出现配对密度波（PDW）态；当p型和m'型范霍夫奇点接近简并时，带间配对通道中的相位竞争会稳定一种手性带间超导态。；创新点：揭示了此前被忽视的m'型范霍夫奇点作为通向非常规超导的新路径，该路径根植于电子关联和镜面对称性约束的布洛赫波函数。
papers.method_zh: 基于扩展t-J模型的理论分析，利用Kagome晶格布洛赫波函数的对称性（特别是镜面对称性）约束，分析不同范霍夫奇点（p型、m型、m'型）附近的超导配对态竞争。

papers.title: Quantum oscillations and Dirac dispersion in tunable kagome lattice Lu$_{1-y}$Y$_y$(Nb$_{1-x}$Ta$_x$)$_6$Sn$_6$
papers.abstract: Kagome lattice crystal systems present interesting symmetry-protected band structure features such as flat bands, van Hove singularities, and linearly dispersing Dirac/Weyl points that provide a rich playground for strongly correlated electron physics. Motivated by the rich properties and charge density wave evolution through the 1-6-6 series of compounds, we present our results in single crystal growth and characterization of the of Lu$_{1-y}$Y$_y$(Nb$_{1-x}$Ta$_x$)$_6$Sn$_6$ double-alloy system, including evolution of the charge density wave transition, electrical transport behavior and resultant phase diagrams. Using a novel growth technique, the synthesis of high quality crystals with extended length along the crystallographic $c$-axis allows us to follow the gradual suppression of charge density wave (CDW) order with Y substitution, and observe quantum oscillations in both magnetoresistance and magnetization throughout the series. We review the evolution of Fermi surfaces, effective masses and quasiparticle dispersion through the alloy series, revealing a decrease in size of Fermi surfaces that trends with both substitutions, and a scaling between effective mass and Fermi wavevector that suggests a regime with Dirac-like dispersion. The ability to fine-tune crystallographic, ground state and electronic dispersion properties of the \lit\ system with minimal impact of disorder opens a path torward further understanding the nature of the kagome lattice and its novel states and interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词包括“single crystal growth”、“characterization”、“electrical transport behavior”、“magnetoresistance”、“magnetization”等实验手段。；研究对象：Lu₁₋ᵧYᵧ(Nb₁₋ₓTaₓ)₆Sn₆双合金体系中的可调谐kagome晶格，具体研究其电荷密度波（CDW）演化、费米面、有效质量及准粒子色散。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过Y和Ta的双重替代，可逐步抑制电荷密度波序，并观察到整个合金系列中磁阻和磁化强度的量子振荡；费米面尺寸随替代减小，有效质量与费米波矢之间存在标度关系，暗示狄拉克型色散的存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过Y和Ta的双重替代，可逐步抑制电荷密度波序，并观察到整个合金系列中磁阻和磁化强度的量子振荡；费米面尺寸随替代减小，有效质量与费米波矢之间存在标度关系，暗示狄拉克型色散的存在。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用新型晶体生长技术制备沿c轴方向延长的单晶；通过电输运测量、磁阻和磁化强度中的量子振荡分析，研究费米面、有效质量和准粒子色散的演化，并构建相图。

papers.title: Heavy-Tailed Dispersal Kernels from Stopped Subdiffusive Fractional Brownian Motion
papers.abstract: Subdiffusive fractional Brownian motions produce localized aggregation when particles are stopped at exponentially distributed times. In applications where clumping and long-distance dispersal events are observed simultaneously, such as in some instances of seed dispersal, this model fails to describe the tails of the data. The resulting redistribution kernel has only an exponentially decaying tail, whereas a heavier tail is needed for modeling the long-distance dispersal observed. Here we propose a model in which subdiffusive particles stop at exponentially distributed times, but with a rate parameter that is Gamma distributed. This heterogeneity in stopping rates causes the density of final radial positions to have a heavy-tailed distribution. Our model retains the strong localized clumping characteristic of subdiffusive fractional Brownian motion while simultaneously generating the heavy tails required for realistic long-distance dispersal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a model、model retains、generating heavy tails。；研究对象：亚扩散分数布朗运动（subdiffusive fractional Brownian motion）中粒子停止过程产生的重尾扩散核（heavy-tailed dispersal kernel），具体应用于种子扩散等同时出现聚集与长距离扩散的现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入服从Gamma分布的停止速率参数，使原本仅具有指数衰减尾部的扩散核变为重尾分布，从而同时保留亚扩散分数布朗运动的强局部聚集特性并实现长距离扩散建模。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入服从Gamma分布的停止速率参数，使原本仅具有指数衰减尾部的扩散核变为重尾分布，从而同时保留亚扩散分数布朗运动的强局部聚集特性并实现长距离扩散建模。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：在亚扩散分数布朗运动框架下，将粒子停止时间从指数分布推广为速率参数服从Gamma分布的混合指数分布，推导最终径向位置密度的尾部行为。

papers.title: Multifractality at the Integer Quantum Hall Transition: Acquittal of the Parabolic Law
papers.abstract: Stationary wave functions at the integer quantum Hall transition are known to be multifractal, but the exact form of the multifractality spectrum has remained a subject of debate. While conformal field theory arguments predict a parabolic law, numerical simulations show deviations from parabolicity. We resolve this discrepancy by pointing out that powers of the local wave intensity fail to obey the Gaussian Free Field and Abelian Fusion Hypothesis assumed in earlier analysis. Rather, due to the non-Abelian nature of the underlying effective field theory, wave intensity correlators are dressed by insertions of background charge distributed uniformly in space. An exact expression for the $q$-moments of point-contact generated eigenstates is presented. Numerical tests are performed for the critical Chalker-Coddington network model on a rectangular torus. Our results are in precise agreement with the predictions of conformal symmetry realized as a level-4 current algebra.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值计算验证）。判断依据：摘要中提及“conformal field theory arguments”、“non-Abelian nature of the underlying effective field theory”、“exact expression”等理论推导，以及“numerical simulations”、“numerical tests”等计算验证。；研究对象：整数量子霍尔相变中的多分形行为，具体为临界点处波函数的多分形谱形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 整数量子霍尔相变中波函数的多分形谱并非抛物线形式，而是由非阿贝尔有效场论中背景电荷插入所修正，与共形对称性（level-4 电流代数）的预言精确吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：整数量子霍尔相变中波函数的多分形谱并非抛物线形式，而是由非阿贝尔有效场论中背景电荷插入所修正，与共形对称性（level-4 电流代数）的预言精确吻合。；创新点：指出此前分析中假设的“高斯自由场与阿贝尔融合假设”不成立，揭示了波函数强度关联函数因非阿贝尔背景电荷插入而修正，从而解决了抛物线律与数值模拟之间的长期矛盾。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析基于共形场论和有效场论中的非阿贝尔结构；数值计算采用临界Chalker-Coddington网络模型在矩形环面上的模拟。

papers.title: Trial wavefunction for fractional quantum spin Hall insulators
papers.abstract: Fermions with opposite spins occupying half-filled conjugate Chern bands exhibit interaction physics distinct from their multi-component Landau-level counterparts with the same chirality. This is largely due to unavoidable inter-species collisions that preclude the Halperin-type wavefunctions available in multi-component Landau levels. In this work, we propose and evaluate a variational wavefunction for a fractional quantum spin Hall state with Z_4 topological order in a pair of conjugate Landau levels. This Z_4 topological order has previously been shown to be the minimal topological order compatible with charge conservation, $S_z$ conservation, time-reversal symmetry, and the fractional spin Hall conductance 1/2 suggested by previous twisted MoTe$_2$ experiments. Our construction is based on the condensation of an anyonic exciton formed by the neutral fermionic excitations in a decoupled pair of Moore-Read Pfaffian state and its conjugate. By coupling the chiral and anti-chiral Ising conformal field theories associated with the two spin species, we introduce a variational mass parameter in the Z_4 trial wavefunction that captures the inter-spin-species s-wave pairing of composite fermions alongside the intra-spin-species p-wave pairing. We assess the energetics of this trial state using Monte Carlo sampling on a spherical geometry. Because the coupled state intrinsically involves Landau-level mixing, we explicitly evaluate the resulting kinetic energy penalty. Our phase diagram reveals that the proposed Z_4 state becomes energetically favorable in a sizable region of parameter space, over both the decoupled pair of conjugate Pfaffian states and an alternative exciton condensate state. These results provide a concrete microscopic wavefunction realization of this Z_4 fractional quantum spin Hall phase, and propose a route to constructing additional families of such states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出变分波函数、蒙特卡洛采样、相图分析，属于理论计算与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：分数量子自旋霍尔绝缘体，具体为具有Z₄拓扑序的分数量子自旋霍尔态，在共轭朗道能级对中的费米子体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并验证了一种具有Z₄拓扑序的变分波函数，该态在参数空间的一个可观区域内能量上优于解耦的共轭Pfaffian态和替代的激子凝聚态，为分数量子自旋霍尔相提供了具体的微观波函数实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并验证了一种具有Z₄拓扑序的变分波函数，该态在参数空间的一个可观区域内能量上优于解耦的共轭Pfaffian态和替代的激子凝聚态，为分数量子自旋霍尔相提供了具体的微观波函数实现。；创新点：通过凝聚由中性费米子激发形成的任意子激子（来自解耦的Moore-Read Pfaffian态及其共轭态对），首次构造了满足电荷守恒、Sz守恒、时间反演对称性和分数自旋霍尔电导1/2的Z₄拓扑序的微观变分波函数，并系统评估了其能量优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于共形场论构造变分波函数（耦合手性和反手性Ising共形场论），引入变分质量参数描述复合费米子的自旋间s波配对与自旋内p波配对；在球面几何上进行蒙特卡洛采样评估能量；明确计算了由朗道能级混合引起的动能惩罚，并绘制相图。

papers.title: Many-body quantum geometric effects and entanglement at the 3D metal-insulator quantum phase transition
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a unifying concept across condensed matter physics, underlying phenomena from nonlinear topological response to flat-band superconductivity. While usually formulated within band theory, quantum geometry remains meaningful in disordered interacting systems~\cite{resta1999electron}. Here we show that the first negative moment of the optical conductivity -- proportional to the zero temperature quantum Fisher information as a bound on the multipartite entanglement -- provides an experimental probe of quantum geometry across the three-dimensional metal-insulator quantum phase transition in phosphorus-doped silicon. We extract a quantum geometric length $\ell$ that characterizes the local wavefunctions. Far from the transition, this length is almost coincident with the Bohr radius of the hydrogenic phosphorus donors, reflecting their atomic-scale quantum geometry. Approaching the transition, $\ell$ is enhanced, but does not diverge continuously like a correlation length; it jumps discontinuously to infinity at the critical point. This reflects the UV domination of the sum rule in three dimensions that renders it insensitive to the critical fluctuations driving the diverging dielectric constant and correlation length. Its enhancement demonstrates a ``puffing" of the donor polarizability volume of quantum geometric origin, which yields a quantum geometric corrected Clausius-Mossotti description in closer agreement with the diverging dielectric response and provides a quantum mechanical foundation for the century-old Herzfeld metallization criterion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：quantum geometry、sum rule、quantum Fisher information、理论分析）；研究对象：三维金属-绝缘体量子相变，具体体系为磷掺杂硅（phosphorus-doped silicon）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 光学电导的第一负矩（与零温量子Fisher信息成正比）可作为探测三维金属-绝缘体量子相变中量子几何的实验探针；量子几何长度ℓ在临界点处不连续地跳变为无穷大，而非像关联长度那样连续发散，表明该求和规则在三维中由紫外贡献主导，对临界涨落不敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：光学电导的第一负矩（与零温量子Fisher信息成正比）可作为探测三维金属-绝缘体量子相变中量子几何的实验探针；量子几何长度ℓ在临界点处不连续地跳变为无穷大，而非像关联长度那样连续发散，表明该求和规则在三维中由紫外贡献主导，对临界涨落不敏感。；创新点：首次将量子几何概念（通常用于能带理论）应用于无序相互作用体系的三维金属-绝缘体相变，揭示了量子几何长度在临界点的不连续跳变行为，并提供了对Herzfeld金属化判据的量子力学基础。
papers.method_zh: 基于量子几何理论框架，分析光学电导求和规则与量子Fisher信息的关系，提取量子几何长度ℓ，并与Clausius-Mossotti模型及Herzfeld金属化判据进行量子力学修正对比。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning a Universal Machine-Learned Interatomic Potential for Oxygen Plasma Interactions with WS$_2$
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics simulation of plasma-surface interactions requires an interatomic potential that is simultaneously accurate, computationally efficient, and able to describe many elements and bonding types in reactive systems. In principle, a foundation model for machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) can meet these demands. We explore the use of the Universal Models for Atoms (UMA) model, developed by Meta FAIR, for the interactions of oxygen plasma species on a multilayer of WS$_2$, a promising 2D material. Starting from the pretrained uma-s-1p1 model under the Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20) task, we apply an iterative fine-tuning loop with maximally diverse configuration sampling using Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) and Farthest Point Sampling (FPS); DFT labeling at the PBE+D3+$U$+spin level; and fine-tuning on energy, force, and stress labels. Even in the absence of fine-tuning, the pretrained model reproduces the production-scale observables of interest, namely, chemisorbed S and O coverage under 15eV O$^+$ and O$_2^+$ bombardment. These results were obtained without spin polarization and Hubbard $U$ correction. Nonetheless, fine-tuning reduces the energy and force mean absolute error (MAE) to $4.5\times10^{-3}$eV/atom and $0.076$eV/angstrom, respectively.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：分子动力学模拟、机器学习原子间势、DFT标记、微调。；研究对象：氧等离子体物种（O⁺和O₂⁺）与多层WS₂（一种有前景的二维材料）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 即使未经微调，预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（UMA模型）也能准确再现氧等离子体轰击WS₂时化学吸附的S和O覆盖度；微调后能量和力的平均绝对误差分别降至4.5×10⁻³ eV/原子和0.076 eV/埃。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：即使未经微调，预训练的通用机器学习原子间势（UMA模型）也能准确再现氧等离子体轰击WS₂时化学吸附的S和O覆盖度；微调后能量和力的平均绝对误差分别降至4.5×10⁻³ eV/原子和0.076 eV/埃。；创新点：探索了通用机器学习原子间势（UMA模型）在等离子体-二维材料相互作用这一具体反应体系中的应用，并展示了通过微调进一步提升精度的可行性。
papers.method_zh: 使用Meta FAIR开发的UMA（Universal Models for Atoms）基础模型，基于预训练的uma-s-1p1模型（来自Open Catalyst 2020任务），通过迭代微调循环进行优化：采用基于平滑重叠原子位置（SOAP）和最远点采样（FPS）的最大多样性构型采样；在PBE+D3+U+自旋水平上进行DFT标记；对能量、力和应力标签进行微调。

papers.title: Subgap Linear Thermoelectricity in Superconducting Quantum Hall Systems
papers.abstract: We show that an integer quantum Hall setup proximized by superconductors can exhibit subgap thermoelectric effects in the linear-response regime when triplet superconducting correlations are present. We devise a minimal setup that enables a nonzero Seebeck effect mediated by Andreev processes and predict that the corresponding Seebeck coefficient can reach values on the order of $k_B/e$ in the middle of the quantum Hall plateau. We analytically show that both triplet correlations and spin polarization are essential for the emergence of the thermoelectric effect, which arises despite the linear band dispersion of the edge states. We characterize the dependence of the thermoelectric response on the Hamiltonian parameters and the system's temperature regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, devise, analytically show, characterize（理论推导与分析）。；研究对象：超导近邻化量子霍尔体系中的亚能隙热电效应，具体为整数量子霍尔态与超导体近邻耦合的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超导近邻化的整数量子霍尔体系中，当存在三重态超导关联时，线性响应区可出现亚能隙热电效应；其塞贝克系数在量子霍尔平台中部可达 $k_B/e$ 量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超导近邻化的整数量子霍尔体系中，当存在三重态超导关联时，线性响应区可出现亚能隙热电效应；其塞贝克系数在量子霍尔平台中部可达 $k_B/e$ 量级。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：构建最小模型，通过解析推导证明三重态关联和自旋极化对热电效应的必要性，并分析热电响应对哈密顿量参数和温度区间的依赖关系。

papers.title: Nonreciprocal Disorder Prevents Zero-Temperature Freezing in a Ferromagnet
papers.abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions underpin diverse nonequilibrium phenomena, yet the effects of quenched nonreciprocity in extended systems remain largely unexplored. We study a $2d$ Ising model with randomly distributed nonreciprocal bonds at density $p$, finding a continuous nonequilibrium transition down to $T=0$ with finite $p_c$. A gauge-invariance argument yields $p_c(T)\leq1/2$, and mean-field theory predicts a qualitatively correct phase diagram. Unlike equilibrium disordered models, the zero-temperature dynamics remains active, with athermal rare-region reversals and logarithmic "activated" coarsening.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：研究、论证、平均场理论、模型）；研究对象：二维伊辛模型中随机分布的非互易键（nonreciprocal bonds）导致的非平衡相变，以及零温下的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非互易无序（nonreciprocal disorder）阻止了铁磁体在零温下的冻结，系统在零温下仍保持动力学活性，出现非热稀有区域翻转和对数“激活”粗化行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非互易无序（nonreciprocal disorder）阻止了铁磁体在零温下的冻结，系统在零温下仍保持动力学活性，出现非热稀有区域翻转和对数“激活”粗化行为。；创新点：揭示了淬火非互易性（quenched nonreciprocity）在扩展系统中的独特效应，与平衡态无序模型不同，零温下系统不会冻结，而是持续演化。
papers.method_zh: 通过二维伊辛模型引入密度为p的随机非互易键，利用规范不变性论证推导出临界密度p_c(T) ≤ 1/2，并采用平均场理论预测相图。

papers.title: Assessing Majorana states and qubits through quantum capacitance
papers.abstract: Quantum capacitance (QC) has recently emerged as a promising tool for parity readout in topological qubits based on Majorana bound states (MBSs). Here, we show that this capability can be extended further: by employing an auxiliary quantum dot (QD) as a sensor, we demonstrate that QC measurements simultaneously resolve two fundamental figures of merit of the device, the ground-state energy splitting and the MBS overlap, thus providing direct access to the underlying internal degrees of freedom. Using a low-energy effective model, we provide analytic expressions for these two figures of merit that can be determined from the relative position and magnitude of the QC maxima in the even and odd parity sectors as functions of the auxiliary-QD energy. We further validate these results with a microscopic model of QD-based Kitaev chains and qubits, demonstrating their applicability in a wide range of MBS-based devices. Our results establish QC as a probe of MBS quality and a tool for topological-device optimization that preserves fermion parity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“低能有效模型”、“解析表达式”、“微观模型”等关键词，未提及具体实验操作或数据。；研究对象：基于马约拉纳束缚态（MBSs）的拓扑量子比特，特别是通过量子电容（QC）测量来评估其性能。具体体系包括基于量子点（QD）的Kitaev链和量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过使用辅助量子点作为传感器，量子电容测量可以同时解析出马约拉纳束缚态器件的两个关键品质因数：基态能级分裂和MBS波函数重叠，从而直接探测其内部自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过使用辅助量子点作为传感器，量子电容测量可以同时解析出马约拉纳束缚态器件的两个关键品质因数：基态能级分裂和MBS波函数重叠，从而直接探测其内部自由度。；创新点：将量子电容的应用从单纯的宇称读取扩展到对马约拉纳束缚态质量（MBS quality）的直接评估，并建立了一种不破坏费米子宇称的拓扑器件优化工具。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。首先使用低能有效模型推导出两个品质因数（基态能级分裂和MBS重叠）与量子电容峰值位置和大小之间的解析关系；然后通过基于量子点的Kitaev链和量子比特的微观模型对解析结果进行验证。

papers.title: The moving Fermi polaron
papers.abstract: The Fermi polaron, formed by an impurity interacting with a surrounding Fermi sea, exemplifies the canonical quasiparticle concept as a cornerstone in our description of quantum many-body systems across a wide range of energy scales. Experiments on atomic quantum gases have provided profound insights into the universal nature of the Fermi polaron. While most previous studies have focused on the case of zero impurity momentum, finite-momentum properties have remained largely uncharted. Here, we investigate the moving Fermi polaron by combining a novel Raman acceleration scheme with high-precision radio-frequency spectroscopy, exploring the quasiparticle dispersion relation over a wide range of momenta. We compare our measurements of energy shifts and spectral linewidths with a microscopic theory and reach quantitative agreement for all momenta. For low momenta, we find the energy of the moving polaron to be fully consistent with the Fermi liquid picture of a dressed particle with a constant effective mass. At high momenta, the polaron approaches the behavior of a weakly interacting bare particle, featuring small energy shifts and weak broadening. For intermediate momenta, broadening is generally larger and, most strikingly, the behavior differs for attractive and repulsive polarons. While the repulsive polaron exhibits a smooth connection between both regimes along with a monotonic change of the energy shift, the attractive case shows a peculiar non-monotonic behavior. With increasing momentum, the attractive polaron enters a regime where its energy deviates from the constant effective mass expression and broadening suddenly increases. By comparing this observation with theory, we show that this abrupt behavior coincides with the attractive polaron entering a molecule-hole continuum, where it is no longer the ground state. We interpret this as a motion-induced polaron-molecule transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论分析）。判断依据：关键词“combining a novel Raman acceleration scheme with high-precision radio-frequency spectroscopy”、“measurements of energy shifts and spectral linewidths”、“compare with a microscopic theory”。；研究对象：移动的费米极化子（moving Fermi polaron），即一个杂质与周围费米海相互作用形成的准粒子，研究其在不同动量下的色散关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低动量下移动极化子的能量与恒定有效质量的费米液体图像完全一致；高动量下趋近于弱相互作用的裸粒子行为；中间动量下，吸引极化子表现出非单调的能量变化和突然增宽的“运动诱导极化子-分子转变”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低动量下移动极化子的能量与恒定有效质量的费米液体图像完全一致；高动量下趋近于弱相互作用的裸粒子行为；中间动量下，吸引极化子表现出非单调的能量变化和突然增宽的“运动诱导极化子-分子转变”。；创新点：首次系统实验研究了有限动量下费米极化子的准粒子色散关系，揭示了吸引极化子在中间动量区间的非单调行为及其与分子-空穴连续体的关联，发现了运动诱导的极化子-分子转变。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用新型拉曼加速方案结合高精度射频光谱技术，测量不同动量下极化子的能量移动和谱线宽度；理论上与微观理论进行定量比较。

papers.title: A thermodynamic uncertainty relation for (hybrid) N--S coherent conductors
papers.abstract: Thermodynamic uncertainty relations establish fundamental bounds between current fluctuations and entropy production in nonequilibrium systems. In hybrid normal superconducting conductors, transport is governed by the coexistence of quasiparticle transmission and Andreev reflection, where electron hole conversion transfers charge through the superconducting condensate. Using the Anantram Datta scattering formalism, we decompose the charge current and zero-frequency noise into Andreev, quasiparticle, and interference contributions. Although the interference term prevents a simple additive bound at the level of individual noise components, we show that the nonequilibrium excess noise admits a positive representation. This allows us to prove a hybrid quantum thermodynamic uncertainty relation valid for an arbitrary real superconducting gap. Our result extends the pure Andreev quantum TUR to regimes where quasiparticle and Andreev processes coexist, clarifying how superconducting coherence reshapes current fluctuations while preserving a universal dissipation precision constraint in hybrid quantum conductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：scattering formalism、prove、thermodynamic uncertainty relation。；研究对象：混合正常金属-超导（N-S）相干导体中的电荷输运现象，特别是准粒子传输与Andreev反射共存时的电流涨落与熵产生关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在准粒子与Andreev过程共存的混合N-S导体中，非平衡过剩噪声具有正定表示，从而证明了一个适用于任意超导能隙的混合量子热力学不确定关系，揭示了超导相干性如何重塑电流涨落并保持普适的耗散-精度约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在准粒子与Andreev过程共存的混合N-S导体中，非平衡过剩噪声具有正定表示，从而证明了一个适用于任意超导能隙的混合量子热力学不确定关系，揭示了超导相干性如何重塑电流涨落并保持普适的耗散-精度约束。；创新点：将纯Andreev量子热力学不确定关系扩展到准粒子与Andreev过程共存的混合体系，澄清了超导相干性对电流涨落的影响，并证明了在混合量子导体中仍存在普适的耗散-精度约束。
papers.method_zh: 采用Anantram-Datta散射形式论，将电荷电流和零频噪声分解为Andreev、准粒子和干涉贡献，并基于非平衡过剩噪声的正定表示推导热力学不确定关系。

papers.title: Perspective: Highly stable vapor-deposited glasses
papers.abstract: This article describes recent progress in understanding highly stable glasses prepared by physical vapor deposition and provides perspective on further research directions for the field. For a given molecule, vapor-deposited glasses can have higher density and lower enthalpy than any glass that can be prepared by the more traditional route of cooling a liquid, and such glasses also exhibit greatly enhanced kinetic stability. Because vapor-deposited glasses can approach the bottom of the amorphous part of the potential energy landscape, they provide insights into the properties expected for the ideal glass. Connections between vapor-deposited glasses, liquid-cooled glasses, and deeply supercooled liquids are explored. The generality of stable glass formation for organic molecules is discussed along with the prospects for stable glasses of other types of materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/综述文章。判断依据：关键词“perspective”（观点）、“describes recent progress”（描述近期进展）、“provides perspective on further research directions”（提供未来研究方向的观点）。；研究对象：通过物理气相沉积制备的高稳定性玻璃（vapor-deposited glasses），以及其与液冷玻璃、深度过冷液体之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 物理气相沉积制备的玻璃比传统液冷玻璃具有更高的密度、更低的焓和显著增强的动力学稳定性，其性质接近理想玻璃在势能面非晶部分底部的预期行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：物理气相沉积制备的玻璃比传统液冷玻璃具有更高的密度、更低的焓和显著增强的动力学稳定性，其性质接近理想玻璃在势能面非晶部分底部的预期行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该文总结了物理气相沉积制备高稳定玻璃的最新进展，并探讨了其与理想玻璃、深度过冷液体之间的物理联系，以及向其他材料类型拓展的前景。
papers.method_zh: 该文为综述性观点文章，主要基于对已有实验和理论结果的综合分析，未具体描述单一实验或计算方法。摘要中提及“物理气相沉积”作为制备手段，并探讨了有机分子稳定玻璃形成的普适性。

papers.title: Nontrivial Boundary-Mediated Superconducting Transport in a TRSB Topological Iron-Based Superconductor
papers.abstract: The interplay of superconductivity, band topology, and spontaneous time-reversal-symmetry breaking (TRSB) is expected to enable topological superconducting boundary states. FeTe0.55Se0.45 provides a promising single-material platform because it combines superconductivity, nontrivial band topology, and spontaneous magnetization in the superconducting state. Here we report evidence for a boundary-mediated superconducting transport response in exfoliated Fe(Te,Se) devices. Polar Kerr measurements show that TRSB emerges below TKerr < Tc and coexists with superconductivity across multiple compositions, providing an independent symmetry-breaking scale for transport. Using crystallographically sharp, continuous edges and side-surface-dominant contacts, we find that topological FeTe0.55Se0.45 exhibits an anomalous conductance plateau absent in topologically trivial FeTe0.40Se0.60 and Fe1.02Te0.55Se0.45 under comparable measurements. This plateau requires uninterrupted sharp edges connecting source and drain, persists over micrometer-scale separations far exceeding the bulk coherence length, shows strongly suppressed thermal broadening, and collapses when the drain is moved to the top surface. Its temperature evolution follows the TRSB scale: the plateau remains weakly broadened below T*Kerr and disappears near TKerr rather than Tc. These doping-selective, edge-geometry-dependent, TRSB-correlated, and long-range nonlocal signatures establish experimental criteria for identifying boundary-mediated superconducting transport in FeTe0.55Se0.45 and motivate phase-sensitive and theoretical studies of its microscopic origin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Polar Kerr measurements、transport response、devices、conductance plateau。；研究对象：拓扑铁基超导体FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅及其边界介导的超导输运现象，涉及超导、能带拓扑与自发时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在拓扑非平庸的FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅中观测到一种异常电导平台，该平台依赖于连续尖锐边缘、具有长程非局域性、热展宽被强烈抑制，且其温度演化与TRSB能标（T*Kerr）而非超导转变温度Tc相关，表明这是边界介导的超导输运响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在拓扑非平庸的FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅中观测到一种异常电导平台，该平台依赖于连续尖锐边缘、具有长程非局域性、热展宽被强烈抑制，且其温度演化与TRSB能标（T*Kerr）而非超导转变温度Tc相关，表明这是边界介导的超导输运响应。；创新点：首次通过输运实验建立了识别边界介导超导输运的多项实验判据（掺杂选择性、边缘几何依赖性、与TRSB相关性、长程非局域性），并揭示了该异常电导平台与TRSB能标而非超导能标的直接关联。
papers.method_zh: 使用机械剥离的Fe(Te,Se)器件，结合极克尔（Polar Kerr）效应测量（探测TRSB）、边缘主导的接触构型（crystallographically sharp, continuous edges and side-surface-dominant contacts）、以及不同掺杂组分（拓扑非平庸FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅与拓扑平庸FeTe₀.₄₀Se₀.₆₀和Fe₁.₀₂Te₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅）的对比输运测量。

papers.title: Localization pattern of a mobile impurity in the disordered Kitaev chain
papers.abstract: We study a mobile impurity coupled to a Kitaev chain with chemical-potential disorder and ask whether the impurity behavior distinguishes different regimes of the host system. Exact diagonalization calculations for small periodic chains shows that in the deep topological regime the impurity localizes only partially, with a smooth increase of $\mathrm{IPR}_d$, whereas in the deep trivial regime it undergoes a much sharp transition to nearly single-site localization. For open chains at strong interaction, DMRG shows edge-localized impurity density near the Kitaev sweet spot. With increasing chemical potential, the impurity weight spreads into the bulk and eventually becomes almost uniform. We explain the edge preference analytically from the Majorana-dimer structure: a bulk impurity rearranges two neighboring dimers, while an edge impurity affects only one. Disorder competes with this clean edge bias and can pin the impurity in the bulk. Thus, the impurity is sensitive to the regime of the host system, although we do not find a strict one-to-one correspondence between the impurity localization pattern and the host topology. Instead, the disorder-averaged behavior suggests only an indirect correlation between impurity localization and the underlying phase of the chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：使用精确对角化（Exact diagonalization）和DMRG（密度矩阵重正化群）进行数值计算，并辅以解析分析（Majorana-dimer结构）。；研究对象：无序Kitaev链中耦合的移动杂质，具体研究杂质在不同拓扑相（拓扑非平庸区与平庸区）中的局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 杂质局域化模式对宿主Kitaev链的拓扑相敏感，但并非严格一一对应：在深拓扑区杂质仅部分局域化，而在深平庸区则发生尖锐转变至近单点局域化；在强相互作用下，杂质在Kitaev甜点附近呈现边缘局域化，但无序可将其钉扎在体相中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：杂质局域化模式对宿主Kitaev链的拓扑相敏感，但并非严格一一对应：在深拓扑区杂质仅部分局域化，而在深平庸区则发生尖锐转变至近单点局域化；在强相互作用下，杂质在Kitaev甜点附近呈现边缘局域化，但无序可将其钉扎在体相中。；创新点：揭示了移动杂质局域化模式与宿主Kitaev链拓扑相之间的间接关联，而非直接对应，并指出无序竞争可改变杂质边缘偏好。摘要未突出说明与先前杂质探测拓扑相工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 1. 对小周期链使用精确对角化计算逆参与率（IPR_d）；2. 对强相互作用开链使用DMRG计算杂质密度分布；3. 基于Majorana-dimer结构进行解析解释。

papers.title: Peripheral Nitrogen Topology as a Defect-Chemical Switch for Electronic and Magnetic States in Graphene: A First-Principles Study of Pyridinic, Pyridazinic, Pyrrolic, and Pyrazolic Configurations
papers.abstract: Defect and heteroatom engineering offer powerful routes for tuning the electronic and magnetic properties of graphene, yet the role of specific peripheral nitrogen topologies around graphene voids remains insufficiently understood. Here, spin-polarized first-principles calculations were performed to investigate how four heterocyclic -- like peripheral nitrogen configurations -- pyridinic, pyridazinic, pyrrolic, and pyrazolic modify the structural stability, charge redistribution, electronic structure, and magnetic response of graphene containing a central void. Among the four peripheral N configurations, the pyridinic N provides the most favorable structural-energetic balance among the investigated motifs. Bond-length analysis reveals that nitrogen topology strongly controls local lattice reconstruction. Charge-density, charge-density-difference, and Bader analyses demonstrate that the peripheral N atoms act as electron-accumulating centers and reshape the local electronic environment around the vacancy rim. Spin-resolved band structures show that pyridinic, pyridazinic, and pyrrolic configurations retain metallic or near-metallic defect-state character, whereas pyrazolic graphene opens a narrow band gap. Magnetic analysis further reveals that pyrazolic graphene is spin-compensated, with zero net magnetization, unlike the other systems, which possess finite spin-polarized moments. Spin-density and SPDOS analyses indicate that the magnetism originates from N-modulated vacancy-edge states involving both N 2p and neighboring C 2p orbitals. These findings establish peripheral nitrogen topology not merely as a structural defect descriptor, but as a deterministic defect-chemical switch, offering a metal-free route to pattern active spintronic and semiconducting domains directly into the graphene lattice through controlled vacancy-edge nitrogen coordination.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“spin-polarized first-principles calculations”（自旋极化第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是含有中心空位的石墨烯，并系统研究了四种外围氮拓扑构型（吡啶型、哒嗪型、吡咯型、吡唑型）对其电子和磁性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外围氮拓扑构型可作为“缺陷化学开关”，决定石墨烯的电子态和磁态：吡啶型、哒嗪型和吡咯型石墨烯保持金属性或近金属性缺陷态，而吡唑型石墨烯打开窄带隙且自旋补偿（零净磁化），其他构型则具有有限的自旋极化磁矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外围氮拓扑构型可作为“缺陷化学开关”，决定石墨烯的电子态和磁态：吡啶型、哒嗪型和吡咯型石墨烯保持金属性或近金属性缺陷态，而吡唑型石墨烯打开窄带隙且自旋补偿（零净磁化），其他构型则具有有限的自旋极化磁矩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自旋极化第一性原理计算（spin-polarized first-principles calculations），具体包括：键长分析、电荷密度分析、电荷密度差分分析、Bader电荷分析、自旋分辨能带结构、自旋密度分析以及自旋投影态密度（SPDOS）分析。

papers.title: Defect Topology in Colloidal Smectics
papers.abstract: Colloidal smectics -- layered structures formed in dense suspensions of rod-like particles -- often exhibit grain boundaries, across which the layer orientation changes by $90^{\circ}$. Motivated by this feature, we develop a layer-based topological framework that treats orthogonal grain boundaries as constituents of the ground state rather than as exceptional defect structures. Extending the layer-based approach for ordinary smectics, we reduce the smectic structure to layers, half-layers, and domain walls. We classify the topology of defects and their combination rules based on this structure. In two dimensions, point defects are described by semi-directed cycle graphs. Although the disclination charge remains a valid topological invariant, it does not uniquely classify defects, as distinct graphs may share the same charge. In three dimensions, line defects are classified by their transverse graph structure, while point defects exhibit qualitatively different behavior. In particular, we show that the hedgehog disclination charge is not a topological invariant, but instead varies continuously under smooth deformations of the layer structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“topological framework”、“classify the topology”、“theoretical”。；研究对象：胶体层状相（colloidal smectics）中的缺陷拓扑结构，特别是由棒状颗粒致密悬浮液形成的层状结构中出现的90°晶界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维中，向错电荷并非唯一分类缺陷的拓扑不变量；在三维中，hedgehog向错电荷不是拓扑不变量，而是随层结构光滑变形连续变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维中，向错电荷并非唯一分类缺陷的拓扑不变量；在三维中，hedgehog向错电荷不是拓扑不变量，而是随层结构光滑变形连续变化。；创新点：将正交晶界视为基态的组成部分而非例外缺陷结构，并揭示了三维中hedgehog向错电荷的连续可变性，挑战了其作为拓扑不变量的传统认知。
papers.method_zh: 基于层的拓扑框架：将层状结构简化为层、半层和畴壁，利用半有向循环图（semi-directed cycle graphs）对二维点缺陷进行分类，并推广到三维线缺陷和点缺陷的拓扑分类。

papers.title: Hyperfine versus exchange interaction in the spin dynamics of spatially indirect excitons in CsPbI$_{3}$ perovskite nanocrystals
papers.abstract: We study the dynamics of recombination, optical orientation, and optical alignment of excitons in ensembles of CsPbI$_{3}$ nanocrystals (NCs), synthesized in a glass matrix. In large NCs with size exceeding 16 nm, the low-energy photoluminescence is contributed by the emission of indirect in real space excitons formed by spatially separated electrons and holes, which are localized at the NC/glass interface. The recombination dynamics of an ensemble of such excitons extends from tens of nanoseconds to microseconds and exhibits a power-law dependence. Their optical alignment and optical orientation reveal a peculiar spin dynamics caused by excitons influenced by the exchange interaction, varying by orders of magnitude. We develop a theory of the polarized photoluminescence of triplet excitons, taking into account the interplay between the electron-hole exchange interaction, their Zeeman effect, and their hyperfine interaction with the nuclei. This model reveals that for the excitons with the smallest exchange splitting we reach the regime, where the exciton fine structure becomes dominated by the hyperfine interaction with the random nuclear spin fluctuations in the NCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：photoluminescence、recombination dynamics、optical orientation/alignment、theory development）；研究对象：CsPbI₃钙钛矿纳米晶（NCs）中空间间接激子的自旋动力学，特别是电子-空穴交换相互作用与超精细相互作用的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在尺寸超过16 nm的CsPbI₃纳米晶中，低能光致发光来自空间分离的电子和空穴（局域于NC/玻璃界面）形成的间接激子；对于交换分裂最小的激子，其精细结构由纳米晶中随机核自旋涨落导致的超精细相互作用主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在尺寸超过16 nm的CsPbI₃纳米晶中，低能光致发光来自空间分离的电子和空穴（局域于NC/玻璃界面）形成的间接激子；对于交换分裂最小的激子，其精细结构由纳米晶中随机核自旋涨落导致的超精细相互作用主导。；创新点：揭示了在空间间接激子体系中，交换相互作用可变化数个数量级，并首次在CsPbI₃纳米晶中实现了交换分裂极小区域，使激子精细结构进入超精细相互作用主导的新奇自旋动力学 regime。
papers.method_zh: 实验上：光致发光光谱、时间分辨发光动力学（从数十纳秒到微秒）、光学取向与光学对准测量。理论上：建立了三重态激子的偏振光致发光理论模型，考虑了电子-空穴交换相互作用、塞曼效应以及激子与原子核的超精细相互作用。

papers.title: Machine learning metallic glass critical cooling rates through elemental and molecular simulation based featurization
papers.abstract: We have developed a machine learning model for critical cooling rates for metallic glasses based on computational properties. We compare results for features derived from easy-to-compute functions of elemental properties to more complex physically motivated properties using ab initio, machine-learning potentials, and empirical potential molecular dynamics methods. The established approach enables property acquisition across a diverse range of alloys. Analysis of various features for 34 alloys from 20 chemical systems shows that the best model for critical cooling rates was learned from one elemental property-based feature and three simulated features. The elemental property-based feature is an ideal entropy value based on alloy stoichiometry. The simulated features were acquired from estimates of energies above the convex hull, changes in heat capacity, and the fraction of icosahedra-like Voronoi polyhedra. Models were assessed through a demanding cross validation test based on repeatedly leaving out full chemical systems as test sets and had an $R^2$ of 0.78 and a mean average error of 0.76 in units of $[log_{10}(K/s)]$. We demonstrate with Shapley additive explanation analysis that the most impactful features have physically reasonable influence on model predictions. The established methodology can be applied to other high-throughput studies of material properties of diverse compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“machine learning model”、“molecular dynamics simulations”、“computational properties”。；研究对象：金属玻璃的临界冷却速率（critical cooling rates）。具体涉及20个化学体系中的34种合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于元素性质与分子模拟特征构建的机器学习模型，能够以较高精度预测金属玻璃的临界冷却速率，其中最具影响力的特征包括合金化学计量比对应的理想熵值、凸包以上能量估计、热容变化以及二十面体类Voronoi多面体比例。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于元素性质与分子模拟特征构建的机器学习模型，能够以较高精度预测金属玻璃的临界冷却速率，其中最具影响力的特征包括合金化学计量比对应的理想熵值、凸包以上能量估计、热容变化以及二十面体类Voronoi多面体比例。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习建模（特征工程+回归模型），结合第一性原理（ab initio）、机器学习势（machine-learning potentials）和经验势分子动力学（empirical potential molecular dynamics）方法获取模拟特征。模型评估采用留出完整化学体系的交叉验证，并使用Shapley加法解释（SHAP）分析特征重要性。

papers.title: Nonlocal Sensing Drives Hybrid Phase Separation in Brownian Matter
papers.abstract: Matter can organize not only through forces, but also through the information its constituents acquire from their surroundings. Here we use perceptive Brownian particles as a minimal model to isolate nonlocal sensing as an organizing principle for nonequilibrium matter. The particles undergo purely Brownian motion, with no mechanical interactions, self-propulsion, alignment, or auxiliary fields. Their only coupling is informational, through diffusivity regulated by density measured over a finite perception zone. Whereas local sensing, when unstable, produces conventional long-wavelength demixing, nonlocal perception restructures the instability spectrum, introducing finite-wavelength patterning and nonlinear bubbling instabilities. More fundamentally, it reshapes the ordering pathway by assembling a cascade of instabilities: macroscopic demixing creates dense domains, finite-wavelength modes pattern them internally, and nonlinear feedback hollows them into void bubbles. This produces hybrid phase separation, where a macroscopic dense phase coexists with a dilute background while retaining ordered internal microstructure, whose symmetry, anisotropy, and length scales are selected by the perception kernel. These results establish information acquisition as a constitutive principle of nonequilibrium matter, capable of governing both phase stability and the dynamical pathways through which order emerges.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：minimal model（最小模型）、theoretical framework（理论框架）、nonlinear feedback（非线性反馈）。；研究对象：非平衡物质（nonequilibrium matter）中的相分离现象，具体以具有感知能力的布朗粒子（perceptive Brownian particles）为模型，研究非局域感知（nonlocal sensing）作为组织原理的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非局域感知能够重塑相分离的不稳定性谱，引入有限波长图案化和非线性气泡不稳定性，从而驱动一种混合相分离（hybrid phase separation）：宏观致密相与稀薄背景共存，同时内部保留有序的微观结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非局域感知能够重塑相分离的不稳定性谱，引入有限波长图案化和非线性气泡不稳定性，从而驱动一种混合相分离（hybrid phase separation）：宏观致密相与稀薄背景共存，同时内部保留有序的微观结构。；创新点：将信息获取（非局域感知）确立为非平衡物质的一个构成性原理，证明其不仅能调控相稳定性，还能决定有序涌现的动力学路径。这与传统上依赖力或场的组织机制形成对比。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个由感知型布朗粒子组成的理论最小模型。粒子仅进行纯布朗运动，无机械相互作用、自驱动、排列或辅助场，其唯一耦合是通过由有限感知区内测量的密度调节的扩散率（信息耦合）。通过分析不稳定性谱和动力学路径来研究相行为。

papers.title: Spin qubit operations by conveyor-mode shuttling
papers.abstract: Dynamic qubit routing is emerging as a promising architectural path for semiconductor quantum processors. Charge carriers can be rapidly moved around on a chip using traveling-wave potentials known as conveyors, preserving the spin state with high fidelity. Originally developed for spin transport, conveyor-mode shuttling may also offer opportunities for performing qubit operations directly controlled by the motion itself. Here, we demonstrate coherent single- and two-qubit control by conveyor-mode electron shuttling, using two conceptually different approaches. First, conveyor electric-dipole spin resonance (conveyor EDSR) achieves high-fidelity rotations by resonantly shuttling spins through transverse magnetic-field gradients at their mean Larmor frequency. Second, conveyor diabatic gates exploit quantization-axis tilts for tunable bang-bang control. Combining diabatic conveyor transport with exchange activation controlled by the motion directly yields a variety of effective two-qubit interactions selectable via the shuttling speed and distance. These experimental results motivate an architectural paradigm of reconfigurable and transport-driven spin qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、experimental results、demonstration。；研究对象：半导体量子处理器中的自旋量子比特，具体研究通过“传送带模式”（conveyor-mode）电子穿梭实现量子比特操作。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过传送带模式电子穿梭，实现了两种不同原理的相干单量子比特和两量子比特控制：一是传送带电偶极自旋共振（conveyor EDSR），二是传送带绝热门（conveyor diabatic gates），并可通过穿梭速度和距离直接调控两量子比特相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过传送带模式电子穿梭，实现了两种不同原理的相干单量子比特和两量子比特控制：一是传送带电偶极自旋共振（conveyor EDSR），二是传送带绝热门（conveyor diabatic gates），并可通过穿梭速度和距离直接调控两量子比特相互作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用行波势（traveling-wave potentials）即“传送带”驱动电子在芯片上移动，结合横向磁场梯度实现电偶极自旋共振，以及利用量子化轴倾斜实现绝热门控制；两量子比特操作通过直接由运动激活的交换相互作用实现。

papers.title: Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in Two-Dimensional Perovskite Oxides
papers.abstract: Perovskite oxides ABO$_3$ host a rich interplay of charge, spin, lattice, and orbital degrees of freedom, giving rise to diverse quantum phenomena. In low-dimensional ABO$_3$, reduced symmetry can induce exotic quantum effects such as the two-dimensional electron gas and unconventional superconductivity. Using first-principles density functional theory, tight-binding modeling, and symmetry analysis, we show that ultrathin two-dimensional (2D) ABO$_3$ films -- exemplified by SrTiO$_3$ -- naturally break inversion symmetry, producing a spontaneous out-of-plane bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect. This differs from previous studies on in-plane BPV current signals and is more applicable and experimentally detectable. Such an effect is highly tunable via thickness, strain, surface termination, crystallographic orientation, and Moiré twisting. These findings are broadly applicable to a wide range of 2D perovskite and other layer-resolved oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。判断依据：关键词“first-principles density functional theory, tight-binding modeling, and symmetry analysis”。；研究对象：二维钙钛矿氧化物（以 SrTiO₃ 为例）中的体光伏效应（Bulk Photovoltaic Effect, BPV）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超薄二维 ABO₃ 薄膜（如 SrTiO₃）天然打破反演对称性，产生自发面外体光伏效应，且该效应可通过厚度、应变、表面终止、晶向和莫尔扭转高度调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超薄二维 ABO₃ 薄膜（如 SrTiO₃）天然打破反演对称性，产生自发面外体光伏效应，且该效应可通过厚度、应变、表面终止、晶向和莫尔扭转高度调控。；创新点：该工作聚焦于面外（out-of-plane）体光伏效应，区别于以往研究中关注的面内（in-plane）BPV电流信号，且该效应更易于实验探测和应用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）、紧束缚模型（tight-binding modeling）以及对称性分析。

papers.title: Quasi-one-dimensional motion of an active MXene sheet driven by chemo-hydrodynamic waves
papers.abstract: Signal-driven motion is widespread in natural and artificial systems, yet quantitative characterization of how transient chemo-hydrodynamic waves are converted into mechanical driving forces remains limited. Here, we investigate the self-propulsion of a MXene sheet asymmetrically coated with catalase in hydrogen peroxide solution. By combining dual-view particle image velocimetry experiments and numerical simulations reveal that active motion of the sheet is driven by chemo-hydrodynamic waves and exhibits direct-wave motion, the driving force of which is analyzed in terms of the shear stress on the sheet surface caused by chemo-hydrodynamic waves. This work suggests theoretical principles for designing and controlling hydrodynamically driven active motion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。关键词：particle image velocimetry experiments, numerical simulations。；研究对象：一种不对称涂覆过氧化氢酶的MXene片在过氧化氢溶液中的自推进运动，具体为化学-流体动力学波驱动的准一维运动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MXene片的主动运动由瞬态化学-流体动力学波驱动，表现为直接波运动，其驱动力可归因于化学-流体动力学波在片表面产生的剪切应力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MXene片的主动运动由瞬态化学-流体动力学波驱动，表现为直接波运动，其驱动力可归因于化学-流体动力学波在片表面产生的剪切应力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 双视角粒子图像测速（dual-view particle image velocimetry）实验，结合数值模拟。

papers.title: Importance of effective Coulomb interactions for $T_c$ in cuprates
papers.abstract: Cuprate superconductors exhibit the highest observed superconducting $T_c$ at atmospheric pressure. However, the magnitude of $T_c$ varies significantly between different cuprates. At present, it is unclear what properties of the crystal structure affect $T_c$ most strongly, yet such an understanding must underpin any efforts toward high-$T_c$ materials design. To address this issue, we perform a large scale systematic study, employing a combination of data collection, state-of-the-art numerical methods, and statistical analysis. We identify about 40 different cuprate compounds, and we compile detailed data about their $T_c$'s and crystal structures from literature and the available databases. Using a fully automated procedure, for each compound we compute the DFT bandstructure and downfold it to two of the most commonly studied low-energy lattice models, namely the single-band Hubbard and the three-band Emery models. The downfolding is based on the approach of MLWFs and cRPA. Finally, we apply a thorough and unbiased statistical analysis to investigate the correlations between the experimentally measured $T_c$'s and the computed parameters of our theoretical models. Our data indicates that more sophisticated models might be needed to describe all cuprates on the same footing. Nevertheless, we find that $T_c$ scales well with simple functions of model parameters. We confirm a previously observed trend that $t'$ in the single-band model correlates with the experimental $T_c$, and we find that $T_c$ appears to vanish below a finite value of $t'$, in agreement with recent ground-state calculations for the Hubbard model. However, we find that the coupling strength also plays a role: throughout our entire dataset, $T_c$ correlates the most with the Coulomb coupling on the $p$-orbitals in the 3-band model, highlighting the importance of the oxygen sites in the copper-oxide planes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：DFT bandstructure、downfold、MLWFs、cRPA、statistical analysis。；研究对象：铜氧化物高温超导体（cuprates），具体研究约40种不同铜氧化物化合物的晶体结构、理论模型参数与实验超导转变温度（\(T_c\)）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: \(T_c\) 与单带Hubbard模型中的次近邻跃迁参数 \(t'\) 存在正相关，且 \(t'\) 低于某一有限值时 \(T_c\) 消失；同时，在整个数据集中，\(T_c\) 与三带Emery模型中氧 \(p\) 轨道的有效库仑耦合强度相关性最强，表明铜氧平面中的氧位点对超导至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：\(T_c\) 与单带Hubbard模型中的次近邻跃迁参数 \(t'\) 存在正相关，且 \(t'\) 低于某一有限值时 \(T_c\) 消失；同时，在整个数据集中，\(T_c\) 与三带Emery模型中氧 \(p\) 轨道的有效库仑耦合强度相关性最强，表明铜氧平面中的氧位点对超导至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数据收集与文献调研；基于DFT的能带计算；利用最大局域化Wannier函数（MLWFs）和约束随机相位近似（cRPA）将能带降维至单带Hubbard模型和三带Emery模型；对计算出的模型参数与实验 \(T_c\) 进行无偏统计相关性分析。

papers.title: From Landau Equation and Large Deviations to Efficient Simulations of Dynamical Fluctuations
papers.abstract: The (deterministic) Landau equation captures the mean long-term evolution of dynamically hot long-range interacting finite-$N$ systems. Though successful, this kinetic equation fundamentally ignores dynamical fluctuations. Building upon Large Deviation Theory, we present a physically-consistent system of Langevin equations that simultaneously recovers the mean Landau dynamics and accurately captures the corresponding fluctuations among different realizations. We show in particular how these Langevin equations can be derived from Rostoker's principle in the limit of weak two-body deflections. We extensively validate these equations against tailored direct $N$-body simulations, showing an exquisite level of agreement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Landau equation、Large Deviation Theory、Langevin equations、Rostoker's principle）；研究对象：长程相互作用的有限N体系统（dynamically hot long-range interacting finite-N systems）中的动力学涨落现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于大偏差理论构建了一组朗之万方程，该方程既能恢复平均场Landau动力学，又能准确捕捉不同实现之间的动力学涨落，并通过直接N体模拟验证了其高度一致性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于大偏差理论构建了一组朗之万方程，该方程既能恢复平均场Landau动力学，又能准确捕捉不同实现之间的动力学涨落，并通过直接N体模拟验证了其高度一致性。；创新点：首次将大偏差理论与Landau动力学方程结合，构建了能够同时描述平均动力学和涨落的随机微分方程框架，弥补了传统Landau方程忽略动力学涨落的缺陷。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合数值验证：从Rostoker原理出发，在弱两体偏转极限下推导出朗之万方程；通过直接N体模拟（direct N-body simulations）对理论进行定量验证。

papers.title: Floquet-induced anisotropic magnetoresistance and anomalous Hall effect in 2D $d$-wave altermagnets with Rashba spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) combine momentum-dependent spin splitting with zero net magnetization, making them promising for spintronics. Periodic driving enables dynamic symmetry engineering beyond static, material-specific control. We show that Floquet engineering in 2D $d$-wave AMs with out-of-plane Néel order and Rashba spin-orbit coupling unlocks equilibrium-forbidden transport responses. Monochromatic driving produces purely out-of-plane magnetization, yielding longitudinal anisotropic magnetoresistance (AMR) and an anomalous Hall effect, whereas bichromatic driving generates both in-plane and out-of-plane magnetizations and additionally activates transverse AMR via the second harmonic of the secondary beam. Comparable static magnetic fields would require hundreds of tesla, avoided in Floquet driving. These effects persist across linear, circular, and mixed light polarizations and are tunable via light parameters. Our results establish multi-color Floquet engineering for controlling magnetization and symmetry-protected transport in AMs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Floquet engineering”“shows that”“establish”等理论推导与预测性表述，未涉及实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：二维d波交变磁体（altermagnets）中由Floquet工程诱导的各向异性磁电阻（AMR）和反常霍尔效应，具体体系为具有面外奈尔序和Rashba自旋轨道耦合的二维d波交变磁体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过单色光驱动可在二维d波交变磁体中产生纯面外磁化，从而引发纵向各向异性磁电阻和反常霍尔效应；双色光驱动则可同时产生面内和面外磁化，并通过次级光束的二次谐波激活横向各向异性磁电阻。这些效应在多种光偏振下均存在，且可通过光参数调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过单色光驱动可在二维d波交变磁体中产生纯面外磁化，从而引发纵向各向异性磁电阻和反常霍尔效应；双色光驱动则可同时产生面内和面外磁化，并通过次级光束的二次谐波激活横向各向异性磁电阻。这些效应在多种光偏振下均存在，且可通过光参数调控。；创新点：首次在多色Floquet工程框架下，在二维d波交变磁体中实现平衡态下被禁止的各向异性磁电阻和反常霍尔效应，且所需等效静磁场强度可达数百特斯拉量级，避免了实际强磁场的需求。摘要未突出说明与已有Floquet工程或交变磁体研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架：Floquet工程（周期驱动），用于动态调控对称性并诱导平衡态下被禁止的输运响应。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如微扰论、有效哈密顿量推导等）。

papers.title: Strain induced magnetic phase transitions in Fe3GeTe2 monolayer
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetic properties of a monolayer of Fe3GeTe2 as a function of the lattice constant by combining first-principles calculations with atomistic spin dynamics simulations. The calculated magnetic exchange interactions reveal a competition between ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, with the latter being significantly strengthened under compressive strain. Stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert simulations reveal a substantial decrease in the Curie temperature with decreasing lattice constant, and predict a transition of the magnetic ground state from a ferromagnetic configuration to a conical spin-spiral state. We introduce a simple spin-model which explains the stabilization of the spiral phase due to competing exchange interactions. We found multiple magnetic phase transitions involving ferromagnetic, conical spin-spiral, and planar Neel states, depending on both the lattice constant and the temperature. The absence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions is found to significantly reduce the Neel temperature, while leaving the Curie temperature largely unaffected. Our findings reveal the importance of lattice distortions in controlling complex magnetic phases and their evolution with temperature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：结合了第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）与原子自旋动力学模拟（atomistic spin dynamics simulations），并引入了自旋模型（spin-model）进行理论解释。；研究对象：单层Fe₃GeTe₂（Fe₃GeTe₂ monolayer）的磁性质，特别是晶格常数变化（应变）对其磁基态和相变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在压缩应变下，单层Fe₃GeTe₂的磁基态从铁磁态转变为锥形自旋螺旋态（conical spin-spiral state），并且居里温度显著降低。研究还发现了多种依赖于晶格常数和温度的磁相变，包括铁磁态、锥形自旋螺旋态和平面内奈尔态（planar Neel states）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在压缩应变下，单层Fe₃GeTe₂的磁基态从铁磁态转变为锥形自旋螺旋态（conical spin-spiral state），并且居里温度显著降低。研究还发现了多种依赖于晶格常数和温度的磁相变，包括铁磁态、锥形自旋螺旋态和平面内奈尔态（planar Neel states）。；创新点：揭示了晶格畸变（应变）在控制Fe₃GeTe₂单层中复杂磁相（包括铁磁、锥形螺旋和平面奈尔态）及其随温度演化中的关键作用。特别指出，在没有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的情况下，应变仍能驱动这些相变，且Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用主要影响奈尔温度，而对居里温度影响不大。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）用于计算磁交换相互作用（magnetic exchange interactions）；原子自旋动力学模拟（atomistic spin dynamics simulations），具体为随机朗道-利夫希茨-吉尔伯特（Stochastic Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert, sLLG）模拟，用于计算居里温度和预测磁基态；并引入了一个简单的自旋模型（spin-model）来解释螺旋相的稳定性。

papers.title: Topological Hall Effect in Antiferromagnetic Co doped Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$
papers.abstract: Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ is van der Waals (vdW) ferromagnet with a Curie temperature $T_C$ ranging from 350 K to 380 K, followed upon cooling by a ferrimagnetic transition near room temperature. Substituting Fe with Co was previously reported to induce antiferromagnetism (AFM) at a Co fraction dependent Neel temperature $T_N$. In this work, we confirm the overall phase diagram of the Fe$_{3-x}$Co$_x$GaTe$_2$ series as a function of $x$ and temperature via magnetization and electrical transport measurements. For $x \simeq 0.6$ the Hall effect is observed to mimic the magnetization as the AF ground state is suppressed by the external magnetic field via a metamagnetic transition, thus displaying an anomalous Hall response. At low temperatures, we also observe a pronounced topological Hall signal peaking at $μ_0H$ = 4 T, or within the metamagnetic transition region of fields. This observation points to the presence of magnetic field-induced chiral spin textures, such as skyrmions upon approaching magnetization saturation. Magnetic force microscopy (MFM) reveals the emergence of nearly circular magnetic domains, with diameters on the order of 100 to 200 nm, within the antiferromagnetic phase. A detailed analysis of the MFM images indicates that the topological Hall effect is closely linked to the field-induced stabilization of magnetic domain structures, likely exhibiting chiral textures. This observation suggests the possible formation of skyrmions already in the AFM phase, i.e., AFM skyrmions, that evolve into ferromagnetic (FM) ones upon increasing the magnetic field. Consequently, Co-doped Fe$_3$GaTe$_2$ might provide a platform to investigate the transformation of skyrmions, initially coupled antiferromagnetically into ferromagnetic skyrmions, and to explore its impact on the topological and skyrmion Hall effects.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magnetization and electrical transport measurements、Hall effect、Magnetic force microscopy (MFM)。；研究对象：Co掺杂的Fe₃GaTe₂（Fe₃₋ₓCoₓGaTe₂）体系中的反铁磁相、拓扑霍尔效应及可能存在的磁斯格明子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Co掺杂Fe₃GaTe₂的反铁磁相中，观测到显著的拓扑霍尔信号，表明磁场诱导了手性自旋纹理（如斯格明子）的形成；该拓扑霍尔效应与磁场稳定化的磁畴结构密切相关，可能揭示了从反铁磁斯格明子向铁磁斯格明子的演化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Co掺杂Fe₃GaTe₂的反铁磁相中，观测到显著的拓扑霍尔信号，表明磁场诱导了手性自旋纹理（如斯格明子）的形成；该拓扑霍尔效应与磁场稳定化的磁畴结构密切相关，可能揭示了从反铁磁斯格明子向铁磁斯格明子的演化过程。；创新点：在反铁磁相中直接观测到拓扑霍尔效应，并指出该效应与磁场诱导的磁畴结构（可能具有手性）相关，为研究反铁磁斯格明子向铁磁斯格明子的转变及其对拓扑霍尔效应和斯格明子霍尔效应的影响提供了潜在平台。
papers.method_zh: 磁化强度测量、电输运测量（霍尔效应）、磁力显微镜（MFM）。

papers.title: Exotic topological defects and director fields in free-floating spherical ferroelectric nematic liquid crystal shells
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric nematic (NF) liquid crystals exhibit polar symmetry and large polarization, giving rise to phenomena absent in conventional apolar nematics. We investigate NF liquid crystals confined to free-floating spherical shells with tangential boundary conditions, enforcing a total topological defect charge of +2. We conjecture that ferroelectric nematics avoid splayed configurations with half-integer defects, common in apolar nematic shells, instead concentrating the topological charge into escaped azimuthal +1 defects requiring only bend and twist. Indeed, at room temperature in the NF phase, our thin RM734+DIO shells with inner and outer aqueous poly(vinyl alcohol) solutions develop an azimuthal director field around two antipodal +1 bend-twist defects. The non-centrosymmetric nature and the azimuthal director configuration of the shells in the NF phase are confirmed also through second-harmonic generation microscopy. At intermediate temperature the antiferroelectric Nx phase generates a new exotic texture rife in zigzag lines in the shells. In the regular N phase at high temperature, the shells develop the usual four +1/2 disclinations located near the thinnest point. Our study highlights the rich platform offered by spherical shells to study the behavior of exotic liquid crystals subject to topological constraints, possibly opening new paths to apply the highly responsive ferroelectric nematic phase
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观测（“develop an azimuthal director field”、“confirmed through second-harmonic generation microscopy”），并涉及不同温度下的相变观察。；研究对象：铁电向列相（NF）液晶，具体为RM734+DIO混合物，被限制在自由漂浮的球形壳层中，并施加切向边界条件。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁电向列相（NF）中，球形壳层并未形成常规向列相中常见的半整数缺陷，而是将拓扑电荷集中到两个对跖的+1弯曲-扭曲缺陷上，形成方位角指向矢场。此外，在中间温度的反铁电Nx相中，观察到了充满锯齿线的新型奇异织构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁电向列相（NF）中，球形壳层并未形成常规向列相中常见的半整数缺陷，而是将拓扑电荷集中到两个对跖的+1弯曲-扭曲缺陷上，形成方位角指向矢场。此外，在中间温度的反铁电Nx相中，观察到了充满锯齿线的新型奇异织构。；创新点：首次在球形几何约束下研究铁电向列相液晶的拓扑缺陷行为，发现了与常规向列相截然不同的缺陷结构（+1缺陷替代+1/2缺陷），并首次报道了反铁电Nx相在球形壳层中产生的锯齿线织构。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：制备由RM734+DIO液晶和内外水相聚乙烯醇（PVA）溶液构成的薄壳层；使用偏振光显微镜观察指向矢织构；利用二次谐波发生（SHG）显微术确认壳层在NF相中的非中心对称性和方位角指向矢构型。

papers.title: In-plane and out-of-plane magnetic field driven Josephson diode effect in magic-angle twisted four-layer graphene
papers.abstract: The superconducting diode effect offers a powerful probe into the fundamental symmetries of quantum materials. Recent studies on twisted graphene diodes have predominantly focused on bilayer or trilayer systems under out-of-plane magnetic fields. Here, we demonstrate both out-of-plane and in-plane driven Josephson diode effects in a magic-angle twisted four-layer graphene junction, i.e., an even number of layers. We observe the emergence of a diode effect at zero out-of-plane field, tuned by an increasing in-plane magnetic field. This result points to the presence of strong in-plane orbital coupling, which is highly sensitive to the specific layer parity of the structure. Our findings provide experimental insights into the symmetry-breaking mechanisms of even-layer twisted graphene, establishing in-plane magnetic fields as a vital tool for unravelling their microscopic properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、observe、provide experimental insights。；研究对象：魔角扭曲四层石墨烯结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应，特别是面内和面外磁场驱动的超导二极管现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在魔角扭曲四层石墨烯结中，同时观测到了面外和面内磁场驱动的约瑟夫森二极管效应；在零面外磁场下，仅通过增加面内磁场即可调控出二极管效应，表明存在强烈的面内轨道耦合，且该耦合对层数奇偶性高度敏感。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在魔角扭曲四层石墨烯结中，同时观测到了面外和面内磁场驱动的约瑟夫森二极管效应；在零面外磁场下，仅通过增加面内磁场即可调控出二极管效应，表明存在强烈的面内轨道耦合，且该耦合对层数奇偶性高度敏感。；创新点：此前研究主要集中于双层或三层扭曲石墨烯在面外磁场下的二极管效应，本工作首次在偶数层（四层）扭曲石墨烯中同时实现面内和面外磁场驱动的约瑟夫森二极管效应，并揭示了面内轨道耦合在对称性破缺中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 通过构建魔角扭曲四层石墨烯结，在面内和面外磁场下测量其超导二极管效应，分析零面外磁场下二极管效应随面内磁场的变化行为。

papers.title: Thermo-responsive self-oscillating gel: mathematical model and theoretical analysis
papers.abstract: Internally heated LCST thermo-responsive gels can show self-sustained swelling and collapse oscillations through feedback between temperature-induced collapse and collapse-suppressed heating. In this work, a minimal two-variable model is developed by coupling gel swelling dynamics with a lumped thermal balance. The analysis shows that stable large-amplitude oscillations are mainly controlled by global bifurcations of limit cycles, rather than by the local Hopf bifurcation. The Hopf bifurcation is subcritical in the studied parameter range, leading to a broad coexistence region where a stable fixed point and a stable limit cycle are both possible. The oscillatory behavior remains robust for different heating-gate functions, indicating that local linear instability is neither necessary nor sufficient for self-oscillation. Fast-slow analysis further shows that the oscillation period is mainly governed by the cooling rate, while the amplitude is determined by the geometry of the swelling equilibrium manifold. These results clarify the bifurcation mechanism of thermo-responsive gel oscillations and provide guidance for controlling their period, amplitude, and waveform.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mathematical model, theoretical analysis, bifurcation analysis, fast-slow analysis。；研究对象：热响应自振荡凝胶（thermo-responsive self-oscillating gel），具体为具有LCST（低临界溶解温度）行为、通过内部加热实现自持溶胀-塌缩振荡的凝胶体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 稳定的大振幅振荡主要由极限环的全局分岔控制，而非局域Hopf分岔；Hopf分岔在研究的参数范围内是亚临界的，导致稳定不动点与稳定极限环共存的宽区域。振荡周期主要由冷却速率决定，振幅则由溶胀平衡流形的几何形状决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：稳定的大振幅振荡主要由极限环的全局分岔控制，而非局域Hopf分岔；Hopf分岔在研究的参数范围内是亚临界的，导致稳定不动点与稳定极限环共存的宽区域。振荡周期主要由冷却速率决定，振幅则由溶胀平衡流形的几何形状决定。；创新点：揭示了热响应凝胶自振荡的全局分岔机制，指出局域线性不稳定性既非自振荡的必要条件也非充分条件，并阐明了振荡周期与振幅的物理决定因素。
papers.method_zh: 建立了一个最小二变量模型，将凝胶溶胀动力学与集总热平衡耦合。通过分岔分析（全局分岔、亚临界Hopf分岔）、快慢分析以及不同加热门函数的鲁棒性测试进行理论分析。

papers.title: Bose-Einstein Condensation of Three-Dimensional Exciton-Polaritons
papers.abstract: We develop a band-structure-based theory of exciton-polaritons in a three-dimensional inverse-opal photonic crystal doped with semiconductor quantum dots. Starting from a symmetry-selected bright photonic branch near the photonic gap edge, we construct an exciton-photon Hamiltonian and obtain a lower-polariton band with a W-point global minimum and a nearby X-point van-Hove-enhanced density of states. We show that the W valleys determine the equilibrium Bose-Einstein condensation threshold, while the X-point saddle provides a finite excited-state capacity that renormalizes the critical temperature when the W-X offset is thermally accessible. By tuning the exciton resonance and the light-matter coupling, the relative W-X ordering can be reconstructed, leading to a strong variation of the critical temperature. We further formulate a momentum-resolved Boltzmann model for driven-dissipative kinetics. Under non-resonant pumping, reservoir feeding, radiative decay, and inter-sector relaxation can produce either W-dominated condensation, a mixed W-X regime, or an X-dominated nonequilibrium coherent state. Our results establish three-dimensional photonic-crystal polaritons as a platform where condensation is controlled not only by the band minimum but also by valley geometry, van-Hove-enhanced phase space, and relaxation pathways.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：band-structure-based theory、Hamiltonian、Boltzmann model。；研究对象：三维反蛋白石光子晶体中掺杂半导体量子点形成的激子-极化激元体系，具体研究其玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三维光子晶体极化激元的BEC阈值由W点能谷决定，而X点鞍点提供的有限激发态容量会重整化临界温度；通过调节激子共振和光-物质耦合，可重构W-X相对能级顺序，从而显著改变临界温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三维光子晶体极化激元的BEC阈值由W点能谷决定，而X点鞍点提供的有限激发态容量会重整化临界温度；通过调节激子共振和光-物质耦合，可重构W-X相对能级顺序，从而显著改变临界温度。；创新点：揭示了三维光子晶体极化激元中，凝聚不仅受能带最小值控制，还受能谷几何结构、范霍夫增强的相空间以及弛豫路径的共同影响，为调控BEC提供了新自由度。
papers.method_zh: 基于能带结构理论构建激子-光子哈密顿量，得到下极化激元能带；采用动量分辨的玻尔兹曼模型描述驱动-耗散动力学，模拟非共振泵浦下的粒子注入、辐射衰减和能级间弛豫过程。

papers.title: Communication Heterogeneity and Collective Consensus in Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract: Reaching global agreement from purely local interactions is a defining problem of collective intelligence, and most models of it assume that all agents share a single communication protocol. We ask what happens when they do not. Using a Neural Cellular Automaton in which a population of cells must solve the density classification task, agreeing on a global majority that no individual can observe, we introduce ``languages'' as sub-populations that read one another's messages through a translation with a tunable ``linguistic distance''. We find that linguistic distance slows consensus, that it produces mild divergence between groups rather than full fragmentation, and that a collective whose shared rule was trained under diverse protocols is robust to mismatch; a homogeneously trained one is not. The findings hold on both a ring and a two-dimensional grid, and admit a natural reading as Ising relaxation, in which a foreign-language region acts as a boundary defect that leaves the system in a higher-energy, partially ordered state. These patterns are qualitatively consistent with effects reported in human group studies, suggesting that distance between communication protocols is a minimal mechanism sufficient to produce them, without anything language-specific.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用Neural Cellular Automaton（神经细胞自动机）进行数值模拟，并结合Ising模型进行理论类比分析。；研究对象：集体智能系统中的通信异质性（communication heterogeneity）对全局共识达成的影响。具体体系为：一群必须通过局部相互作用解决密度分类任务（density classification task）的神经细胞自动机细胞群体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通信协议之间的“语言距离”（linguistic distance）会减慢共识达成速度，并导致群体间产生温和的分歧而非完全分裂；在多样化协议下训练的集体对通信不匹配具有鲁棒性，而单一协议下训练的集体则不具备这种鲁棒性。该现象可类比为Ising模型中的边界缺陷导致的能量升高、部分有序状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通信协议之间的“语言距离”（linguistic distance）会减慢共识达成速度，并导致群体间产生温和的分歧而非完全分裂；在多样化协议下训练的集体对通信不匹配具有鲁棒性，而单一协议下训练的集体则不具备这种鲁棒性。该现象可类比为Ising模型中的边界缺陷导致的能量升高、部分有序状态。；创新点：首次在神经细胞自动机框架中系统引入通信协议的异质性（即“语言距离”），并发现其与人类群体研究中报告的效应定性一致，表明通信协议间的距离本身（无需语言特异性机制）就足以产生这些集体行为模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用神经细胞自动机（Neural Cellular Automaton）模型，引入“语言”作为子群体，通过可调“语言距离”的翻译机制实现子群体间的消息读取。在环形和一维网格两种拓扑结构上执行密度分类任务，并利用Ising弛豫（Ising relaxation）进行理论解释。

papers.title: Atomistic Mechanisms of Hard Carbon Formation from Polyvinylidene Chloride
papers.abstract: Hard carbons are a class of disordered materials with widespread application in energy storage. Despite decades of research, their atomistic formation mechanisms have remained elusive, due to the difficulty of both in situ experimental characterization and first-principles simulations. Here, we describe the formation mechanism of hard carbon from the thermal decomposition of polyvinylidene chloride (PVDC), using first-principles-quality simulations with a bespoke machine-learned interatomic potential model.
