Our results indicate a two-stage process, consisting of (i) radical-mediated dehydrochlorination, which generates reactive unsaturated carbon sites, and (ii) progressive carbon-carbon cross-linking followed by thermally activated rearrangement into an extended sp$^{2}$-bonded network. We provide an atomistic account of non-hexagonal ring motifs emerging during pyrolysis, supporting the empirically-derived theory that these motifs induce the intrinsic curvature that frustrates graphitic ordering in hard carbons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles-quality simulations、machine-learned interatomic potential model。；研究对象：硬碳（hard carbon）从聚偏二氯乙烯（PVDC）热分解形成的原子尺度机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬碳的形成是一个两阶段过程：先由自由基介导的脱氯化氢反应生成不饱和碳位点，随后发生碳-碳交联并热激活重排为扩展的sp²键合网络。非六元环结构在热解过程中出现，是导致硬碳中石墨化受阻的内在曲率来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬碳的形成是一个两阶段过程：先由自由基介导的脱氯化氢反应生成不饱和碳位点，随后发生碳-碳交联并热激活重排为扩展的sp²键合网络。非六元环结构在热解过程中出现，是导致硬碳中石墨化受阻的内在曲率来源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用定制化的机器学习原子间势模型（machine-learned interatomic potential model）进行第一性原理精度的分子动力学模拟。

papers.title: Moiré-Enhanced Plasmonics in Non-Hermitian Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: We study plasmonic excitations in twisted bilayer graphene within a non-Hermitian framework that incorporates effective gain and loss. Using a non-Hermitian extension of the Bistritzer--MacDonald continuum model together with a biorthogonal Kubo formalism for the optical conductivity, we determine how the moiré electronic structure enters the plasmonic response of the active bilayer. We find that non-Hermiticity modifies the collective spectrum, yielding optical and acoustic plasmon branches, with the acoustic branch exhibiting strong subwavelength confinement. In the parity-time-symmetric configuration, gain--loss engineering can reduce the effective spatial damping and enhance the propagation length within the ideal linear model. The same regime produces strongly localized transverse-magnetic near fields. We argue that the enhancement is not a generic consequence of adding gain to a bilayer, but results from the combined influence of moiré-band reconstruction, biorthogonal optical matrix elements, and non-Hermitian modification of the plasmon pole. We also discuss the limitations imposed by disorder, substrate loss, gain saturation, and stability of the parity-time-symmetric regime. These results identify twisted bilayer graphene as a promising, but experimentally demanding, platform for tunable non-Hermitian plasmonics in moiré quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“We study...”、“Using a non-Hermitian extension...”、“We determine...”等表述，且未提及任何实验数据或具体实验操作，核心是理论建模与计算。；研究对象：非厄米框架下的扭曲双层石墨烯（twisted bilayer graphene）中的等离激元（plasmonic excitations）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米性（引入增益和损耗）会改变扭曲双层石墨烯的等离激元集体激发谱，产生光学支和声学支等离激元，其中声学支具有强亚波长局域特性。在宇称-时间（PT）对称构型下，增益-损耗工程可以在理想线性模型中有效降低空间阻尼并增强等离激元传播长度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米性（引入增益和损耗）会改变扭曲双层石墨烯的等离激元集体激发谱，产生光学支和声学支等离激元，其中声学支具有强亚波长局域特性。在宇称-时间（PT）对称构型下，增益-损耗工程可以在理想线性模型中有效降低空间阻尼并增强等离激元传播长度。；创新点：揭示了扭曲双层石墨烯中等离激元增强并非简单地由添加增益导致，而是摩尔能带重构、双正交光学矩阵元以及非厄米对等离激元极点修正三者共同作用的结果。论文将扭曲双层石墨烯定位为研究摩尔量子材料中可调谐非厄米等离激元学的一个有前景但实验要求高的平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用非厄米扩展的Bistritzer-MacDonald连续模型，并结合用于计算光学电导率的双正交Kubo形式论（biorthogonal Kubo formalism）。

papers.title: Many-body attractions do not stabilize gas-liquid phase separation in aqueous dispersions of charged colloids within the Poisson-Boltzmann framework
papers.abstract: Attractive three-body interactions have been reported for like-charged colloids in low-salt suspensions, based on both finite-element Poisson-Boltzmann calculations and direct experimental measurements, and have been proposed as a mechanism to drive colloidal clustering. However, these Poisson-Boltzmann calculations typically neglect charge regulation and higher-order many-body effects. Here, we construct machine-learned (ML) many-body interaction potentials for charge-regulating colloids, trained on finite-element Poisson-Boltzmann calculations, to accurately capture three-body and higher-order contributions. We find that the three-body contribution to the many-body potential as obtained from Poisson-Boltzmann calculations on isolated colloid triplets is strongly attractive, consistent with previous work, whereas the four-body contribution for an equilateral pyramid configuration of four colloids is repulsive. We then construct ML many-body potentials for charged colloids using finite-element Poisson-Boltzmann calculations on clusters of 13 colloids, and find that the incorporation of higher-body interactions weakens the cohesive nature of the interactions. We identify a parameter regime exhibiting gas-liquid or gas-solid phase separation using the ML potentials in molecular dynamics simulations. However, when we include clusters of 48 colloids in the training data, the cohesion diminishes further, and molecular dynamics simulations using these potentials no longer include broad phase separation in aqueous dispersions of charged colloids. Finally, we compute the potential of mean force of pairs and triplets of colloids using primitive model simulations. We find that the resulting potentials are in good agreement with those obtained from the Poisson-Boltzmann calculations, thereby supporting the validity of the Poisson-Boltzmann approach for determining many-body interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论文章。关键词：Poisson-Boltzmann计算、机器学习势、分子动力学模拟、原始模型模拟。；研究对象：带电胶体在水分散体系中的多体相互作用，特别是气体-液相分离的稳定性问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Poisson-Boltzmann框架下，虽然三体相互作用是吸引的，但更高阶（四体及以上）多体相互作用会削弱这种内聚性；当训练数据包含足够大的胶体团簇（48个胶体）时，多体势不再支持水分散体系中带电胶体的宽范围气-液相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Poisson-Boltzmann框架下，虽然三体相互作用是吸引的，但更高阶（四体及以上）多体相互作用会削弱这种内聚性；当训练数据包含足够大的胶体团簇（48个胶体）时，多体势不再支持水分散体系中带电胶体的宽范围气-液相分离。；创新点：首次系统考虑了电荷调节效应和更高阶（四体及以上）多体相互作用对带电胶体相行为的影响，发现之前被忽略的高阶项会显著削弱甚至消除气-液相分离。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元Poisson-Boltzmann计算，结合机器学习构建多体相互作用势；训练数据来自孤立胶体三重态、13个胶体团簇和48个胶体团簇的Poisson-Boltzmann计算；使用分子动力学模拟检验相分离行为；并用原始模型模拟验证对势和平均力势的准确性。

papers.title: Quantum-Geometry-Induced Superconductivity near a Fractional Chern Insulator
papers.abstract: Recent moiré experiments and numerical studies of interacting Chern bands have revealed fractional Chern insulators, charge-density-wave order, and superconductivity as proximate correlation-driven phases in topological systems. How these phases compete or intertwine, and how quantum geometry shapes their interplay, remain open questions. Here we present an analytic study of competing correlation-driven phases in a partially filled Chern band using a coupled-wire construction and bosonization. The key ingredient is the coexistence of interaction channels that favor, respectively, a fractional Chern insulator (FCI) and a closely related anti-FCI (aFCI) state. The aFCI channel is specific to lattice Chern bands and is enhanced by the quantum geometry of the underlying band structure. We show that when both FCI and aFCI scattering channels are present, their interplay generates an effective coupling that drives a superconducting instability near the FCI phase. The same mechanism can also favor a charge-density-wave phase, depending on microscopic parameters. Using a perturbative renormalization-group analysis, we obtain the phase diagram and identify a superconducting regime adjacent to the FCI phase. We further estimate the superconducting transition temperature and show that it is enhanced by quantum geometry. Our results establish quantum geometry as an organizing principle for the interplay among FCI, aFCI, and superconducting correlations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytic study、coupled-wire construction、bosonization、perturbative renormalization-group analysis。；研究对象：部分填充的Chern能带中由关联驱动的竞争相，具体包括分数量子Chern绝缘体（FCI）、反分数量子Chern绝缘体（aFCI）、电荷密度波（CDW）以及超导态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FCI与aFCI散射通道的共存会通过量子几何效应产生有效耦合，从而在FCI相附近驱动超导不稳定性；量子几何同时增强了超导转变温度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FCI与aFCI散射通道的共存会通过量子几何效应产生有效耦合，从而在FCI相附近驱动超导不稳定性；量子几何同时增强了超导转变温度。；创新点：首次从解析角度揭示了量子几何作为组织原理，调控FCI、aFCI与超导关联之间的竞争与交织关系，并指出aFCI通道是晶格Chern能带所特有且由量子几何增强的。
papers.method_zh: 采用耦合线构造（coupled-wire construction）和玻色化（bosonization）进行解析分析，并结合微扰重整化群（perturbative renormalization-group）方法获得相图。

papers.title: Room-Temperature Noncolinear Ferroelectricity in van der Waals WO$_2$Cl$_2$ with a Wide Bandgap
papers.abstract: Low-dimensional ferroelectrics are attractive for their promising prospects in nanoelectronics. Compared with widely-used ferroelectric perovskites, most low-dimensional ferroelectrics exhibit several inborn weaknesses such as small bandgaps (mostly <2 eV, i.e. semiconductors-like) or faint polarizations (e.g. $<1$ $μ$C/cm$^2$ for sliding ferroelectrics even if their bandgaps can be large). Here we experimentally demonstrate the room-temperature ferroelectricity of van der Waals WO$_2$Cl$_2$ . The well-tested d0 rule inherited from ferroelectric perovskites leads to a large dipole (~3 eÅ) from the off-center displacement of W$^6+$ ion and a wide bandgap of 2.80 eV. Its ferroelectricity is proved by multiple characterizations including second harmonic generation, piezoresponse force microscopy, and ferroelectric hysteresis loops. More interestingly, the exotic noncollinear dipole order is directly observed at the atomic level by integrated differential phase contrast scanning transmission electron microscopy. Our work paves an alternative route for low-dimensional ferroelectrics to pursue excellent ferroelectric performance and distinct physics of polarity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally demonstrate”“multiple characterizations”“directly observed”等关键词。；研究对象：范德华材料WO₂Cl₂中的室温非共线铁电性，以及其宽禁带（2.80 eV）和大偶极矩（~3 eÅ）特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验证实WO₂Cl₂在室温下具有铁电性，其W⁶⁺离子的非中心位移产生大偶极矩和宽禁带，并首次在原子尺度直接观察到非共线偶极序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验证实WO₂Cl₂在室温下具有铁电性，其W⁶⁺离子的非中心位移产生大偶极矩和宽禁带，并首次在原子尺度直接观察到非共线偶极序。；创新点：该工作突破了低维铁电体通常禁带窄（<2 eV）或极化弱（<1 μC/cm²）的局限，利用d⁰规则在范德华材料中实现了宽禁带（2.80 eV）和大极化，并首次在原子尺度直接观测到非共线偶极序。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：二次谐波产生（SHG）、压电力显微镜（PFM）、铁电电滞回线测量，以及积分差分相位衬度扫描透射电子显微镜（iDPC-STEM）用于原子级结构观察。

papers.title: SALMON 2.3: Implementation of divide-and-conquer ground-state initialization for large-scale real-time TDDFT
papers.abstract: In large-scale real-time time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT), preparing the ground-state electronic structure can be more expensive than the subsequent time propagation, limiting simulations of nonequilibrium electron dynamics in realistic systems containing thousands of atoms. This bottleneck is especially important for disordered materials, liquids, nanostructures, and heterogeneous condensed-matter systems, where nonlinear and strong-field phenomena such as high-harmonic generation and light-induced phase transitions require explicit real-time treatment. SALMON is an open-source first-principles code for light-matter interaction simulations based on real-time TDDFT on real-space grids, supporting massively parallel calculations with MPI combined with OpenMP or GPU acceleration. In SALMON 2.3, we implement a divide-and-conquer density functional theory (DC-DFT) scheme and combine it with a postprocessing method that reconstructs spatially extended Kohn-Sham orbitals of the entire system. These reconstructed global orbitals are used directly as initial states for the standard real-time, real-space TDDFT module of SALMON. The resulting workflow connects efficient DC-DFT ground-state preparation to conventional real-time TDDFT. The DC-DFT self-consistent-field procedure exhibits linear scaling with system size, addressing a major bottleneck in large-scale electron-dynamics simulations while retaining the robustness and broad applicability of SALMON's established time-propagation scheme. We describe the computational procedure, parallelization strategy, and input/output design. Weak-scaling tests using Si supercells on Fugaku confirm the linear-scaling behavior. Accuracy tests for a 512-atom amorphous Si system and a bulk H2O liquid system containing 4134 atoms demonstrate that the workflow enables practical large-scale real-time TDDFT simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：real-time TDDFT、divide-and-conquer DFT、open-source code、first-principles simulations。；研究对象：大规模凝聚态体系（如无序材料、液体、纳米结构、异质体系）中的非平衡电子动力学，具体测试体系包括Si超胞、512原子非晶硅体系和4134原子的体相H2O液体。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过实现分治密度泛函理论（DC-DFT）基态初始化方案，解决了大规模实时TDDFT模拟中基态电子结构计算比时间传播更昂贵的瓶颈，使含数千原子的实际体系实时电子动力学模拟成为可能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过实现分治密度泛函理论（DC-DFT）基态初始化方案，解决了大规模实时TDDFT模拟中基态电子结构计算比时间传播更昂贵的瓶颈，使含数千原子的实际体系实时电子动力学模拟成为可能。；创新点：将线性标度的DC-DFT基态制备与SALMON已有的实时TDDFT时间传播方案无缝衔接，在保持鲁棒性和广泛适用性的同时，解决了大规模电子动力学模拟的主要瓶颈。摘要未突出说明与先前版本相比的其他具体创新。
papers.method_zh: 在开源第一性原理代码SALMON 2.3中实现了分治密度泛函理论（DC-DFT）方案，并结合后处理方法重构整个系统的空间扩展Kohn-Sham轨道，将这些全局轨道直接作为标准实时实空间TDDFT模块的初始态。采用MPI+OpenMP或GPU加速的大规模并行计算，在Fugaku超级计算机上进行了弱扩展测试。

papers.title: Asymptotic hydrographs and anomalous dispersion in mass-conserving storage cascades
papers.abstract: Sums of independent exponential random variables lead to the Erlang distribution, providing a direct probabilistic route from exponential waiting times to the integer-shape gamma law. This paper investigates how this classical construction changes when the exponential waiting-time density is replaced by the $q$-exponential density of nonextensive statistics. Our main result is an analytical asymptotic expression for the outflow of a mass-conserving cascade of reservoirs driven by a $q$-exponential waiting-time kernel. In the critical case $q=5/3$, the large-cascade flow rate converges to a stable Lévy density whose time argument is shifted by a Galilean-type transformation. This shifted Lévy law gives the asymptotic hydrograph of the cascade. We also found that for the entire regime $1<q<2$ the macroscopic dynamics are governed by $α$-stable Lévy laws. This proves that anomalous non-Gaussian dispersion can emerge from pure mass-conserving convolutional chains without invoking fractional derivatives.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytical asymptotic expression”“proves”等理论推导术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：质量守恒的储层级联系统（mass-conserving storage cascades），具体研究由q-指数等待时间核驱动的储层级联中的出流（hydrograph）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界q=5/3时，大规模级联的流量收敛到经伽利略型变换时间参数的稳定Lévy分布；对于整个1<q<2区间，宏观动力学由α-稳定Lévy律支配，证明异常非高斯色散可从纯质量守恒卷积链中产生，无需引入分数阶导数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界q=5/3时，大规模级联的流量收敛到经伽利略型变换时间参数的稳定Lévy分布；对于整个1<q<2区间，宏观动力学由α-稳定Lévy律支配，证明异常非高斯色散可从纯质量守恒卷积链中产生，无需引入分数阶导数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析渐近分析方法，将经典指数等待时间的Erlang分布推广到非广延统计的q-指数密度，通过卷积链的渐近行为推导出储层级联的出流表达式。

papers.title: Propagating edge and interfacial states in corrugated graphene: Robustness and configurability
papers.abstract: Periodically strained graphene on patterned substrates provides a versatile route to realizing moiré-like electronic structures through strain engineering. Here, we show that the interplay between a strain-induced pseudomagnetic field and a displacement-field-controlled scalar potential enables the formation of isolated narrow bands and multiple energy gaps near charge neutrality and at higher energies. Some of the low-energy bands exhibit nontrivial topology, carrying valley-opposite Chern numbers. Remarkably, despite a vanishing total Chern number, propagating in-gap edge states emerge in a wide range of nanoribbon geometries that preserve valley symmetry. We elucidate the distinct mechanisms responsible for edge states in the zero-energy and higher-energy gaps and demonstrate that they remain robust against variations in superlattice termination and moderate disorder, despite lacking conventional topological protection. Leveraging these properties, we propose device architectures in which an externally applied staggered potential electrically switches the zero-energy gap and its associated edge channels on and off. Furthermore, split-gate geometries generate topologically protected interfacial states that coexist with the edge modes and can be spatially reconfigured by gate voltages. These results establish strain superlattices as a powerful platform for engineering topological electronic states and electronic transport in graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们展示”、“我们阐明”、“我们提出”等理论推导和模型构建的表述，并涉及能带计算（如Chern数）和器件概念设计，未提及具体实验手段。；研究对象：周期性应变石墨烯（corrugated graphene）中的边缘态和界面态。具体体系为在图案化衬底上受到周期性应变的石墨烯，通过应变工程形成类似摩尔纹的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变石墨烯超晶格中，即使总陈数为零，也能在零能隙和高能隙中产生鲁棒的传播性边缘态；通过外加交错势和分裂栅极，可以实现边缘态和拓扑保护界面态的电学开关与空间重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变石墨烯超晶格中，即使总陈数为零，也能在零能隙和高能隙中产生鲁棒的传播性边缘态；通过外加交错势和分裂栅极，可以实现边缘态和拓扑保护界面态的电学开关与空间重构。；创新点：1. 揭示了在总陈数为零的体系中，通过保持谷对称性，仍可在多种纳米带几何结构中产生鲁棒的传播性边缘态，并阐明了零能隙和高能隙中边缘态的不同产生机制。2. 提出了基于应变超晶格的可配置器件架构，利用外加交错势和分裂栅极实现边缘态和界面态的电学开关与空间重构，展示了应变超晶格作为可编程拓扑电子学平台的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与模型计算。具体包括：利用应变诱导的赝磁场与位移场控制的标量势之间的相互作用来构建模型；通过计算能带结构（孤立窄带、能隙）和拓扑性质（谷陈数）进行分析；采用纳米带几何结构研究边缘态；通过改变超晶格终止和引入中等无序来测试鲁棒性。

papers.title: Mechanically Exfoliated Metallic Delafossite PdCoO2 Nanomembranes: Quantum Transport and Electrical Evaluation Toward Interconnect Applications
papers.abstract: Metallic delafossite oxides have drawn attention for their ultralow resistivity and coherent electronic transport. However, mesoscopic transport studies are hindered by the limited access to high quality nanoscale devices. Here, we report single crystalline PdCoO2 nanomembranes, enabling exploration of quasi two dimensional (2D) transport. Shubnikov de Haas and Aharonov Bohm oscillations under different magnetic field orientations are observed at low temperatures, from which the electron effective mass and electron phase coherence length are extracted. Beyond quantum transport, the electrical performance of PdCoO2 toward interconnect applications is evaluated. A nearly thickness independent room temperature resistivity is observed for flakes down to 40 nm thickness. The nanomembranes exhibit a breakdown current density up to 113 MA cm-2, with excellent thermal stability and electromigration resistance. These results demonstrate that mechanically exfoliated PdCoO2 flakes preserve the high crystalline and electronic quality of bulk crystals in the quasi-2D limit, providing a useful platform for mesoscopic transport studies and interconnect applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了机械剥离、量子输运测量、电学性能评估等实验手段，并给出了具体实验数据（如电阻率、击穿电流密度等）。；研究对象：准二维金属三角氧化物PdCoO₂纳米薄膜的量子输运性质及其在互连应用中的电学性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 机械剥离的PdCoO₂纳米薄膜在准二维极限下保持了与体材料相同的高结晶质量和电子输运性能，观测到Shubnikov-de Haas振荡和Aharonov-Bohm振荡，并展现出高达113 MA cm⁻²的击穿电流密度和优异的抗电迁移能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：机械剥离的PdCoO₂纳米薄膜在准二维极限下保持了与体材料相同的高结晶质量和电子输运性能，观测到Shubnikov-de Haas振荡和Aharonov-Bohm振荡，并展现出高达113 MA cm⁻²的击穿电流密度和优异的抗电迁移能力。；创新点：首次通过机械剥离获得高质量单晶PdCoO₂纳米薄膜，实现了准二维极限下的介观输运研究，并系统评估了其作为互连材料的电学性能（如厚度无关的电阻率、超高击穿电流密度）。
papers.method_zh: 机械剥离法制备单晶PdCoO₂纳米薄膜；低温强磁场下测量不同磁场方向下的Shubnikov-de Haas振荡和Aharonov-Bohm振荡，提取电子有效质量和相位相干长度；室温电阻率随厚度变化测量；击穿电流密度测试及热稳定性、电迁移抗性评估。

papers.title: Quasi-1D Spin Textures: From Chiral Soliton Lattice to Fan State
papers.abstract: In most helimagnets, an applied magnetic field aligns the propagation direction of a helical spin texture with the field, resulting in a conical state and obscuring the unwinding process. Here, we access a complementary regime in the anisotropic chiral magnet Mn$_{1.4}$PtSn, where crystal symmetry constrains the propagation direction of the spin modulation. Using resonant elastic X-ray scattering in a vector magnet, we track the evolution of quasi-one-dimensional spin textures that propagate along a chiral crystallographic axis while the magnetic field is applied perpendicular to this direction. Together with micromagnetic simulations, our measurements reveal a transformation from the zero-field $π$-chiral soliton lattice into a fan-like state. In this state, the propagation direction remains transverse to the applied field, while the spins oscillate about the field direction. During magnetization, the modulation length decreases continuously with the field and approaches the field-polarized state. Simulations indicate that magnetostatic interactions in finite samples play a key role in stabilizing this behavior. Our results provide evidence for a fan-like regime in a chiral magnet and highlight how field orientation can be used to control one-dimensional spin textures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以微磁模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提及“使用矢量磁体中的共振弹性X射线散射”进行实验测量，并“结合微磁模拟”。；研究对象：准一维自旋织构，具体为各向异性手性磁体Mn₁.₄PtSn中的手性孤子晶格和扇状态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁场垂直于自旋调制传播方向时，零场下的π-手性孤子晶格转变为扇状态，其中自旋围绕磁场方向振荡，且调制长度随磁场增加而连续减小，最终趋近于场极化态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁场垂直于自旋调制传播方向时，零场下的π-手性孤子晶格转变为扇状态，其中自旋围绕磁场方向振荡，且调制长度随磁场增加而连续减小，最终趋近于场极化态。；创新点：首次在手性磁体中实验证实了扇状态的存在，并揭示了通过磁场方向控制准一维自旋织构演化的机制。摘要未突出说明与以往研究的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：矢量磁体中的共振弹性X射线散射。计算方法：微磁模拟。

papers.title: Electrically Programmable Correlated Topology and Magnetism in a Moiré Trilayer
papers.abstract: Strong electron-electron interactions underlie a wide range of quantum many-body phenomena, including magnetism, superconductivity, and charge fractionalization. A central goal is to achieve in situ control over lattice geometry, bandwidth, and band topology within a single platform. Here we realize such an electrically programmable quantum many-body system in an alternating twisted trilayer MoTe$_2$, where an out-of-plane displacement field continuously modifies the layer polarization, effective lattice, and topology of the moiré bands. At zero displacement field, the system realizes a triangular lattice hosting a correlated insulator at one hole per moiré unit cell ($ν= -1$). Doping this state produces strongly asymmetric magnetic responses: double-exchange-like ferromagnetism for $|ν| > 1$, and signatures of spin polarons and antiferromagnetism for $|ν| < 1$. At large displacement field, interlayer hybridization reconstructs the electronic structure into a honeycomb lattice with a flat Chern band, supporting integer and fractional Chern insulators. Magneto-optical measurements further reveal the signatures of gap closure and Landau-level formation from a spin-polarized Fermi surface near the crossover between the two regimes. These results establish a unified, electrically tunable platform in which correlated magnetism and topological states emerge from a single controllable band structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体实验实现（“realize such an electrically programmable quantum many-body system”）、测量手段（“magneto-optical measurements”）以及观察到的实验现象（如磁响应、Chern绝缘体等）。；研究对象：交替扭转三层MoTe₂（alternating twisted trilayer MoTe₂）中的关联拓扑与磁性现象，具体涉及三角晶格与蜂窝晶格上的关联绝缘体、铁磁/反铁磁序、整数与分数量子反常霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过垂直位移场可连续调控莫尔能带的层极化、有效晶格几何与拓扑，在零位移场下实现三角晶格上的关联绝缘体及不对称磁响应，在大位移场下重构为蜂窝晶格平带并支持整数与分数量子反常霍尔效应，从而在同一平台中实现关联磁性、拓扑态与能带结构的电学可编程控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过垂直位移场可连续调控莫尔能带的层极化、有效晶格几何与拓扑，在零位移场下实现三角晶格上的关联绝缘体及不对称磁响应，在大位移场下重构为蜂窝晶格平带并支持整数与分数量子反常霍尔效应，从而在同一平台中实现关联磁性、拓扑态与能带结构的电学可编程控制。；创新点：首次在单一莫尔异质结中通过电学位移场实现晶格几何（三角晶格与蜂窝晶格之间）和能带拓扑（普通能带与平带Chern能带之间）的原位连续调控，并在此过程中同时观察到关联绝缘态、不对称磁性以及整数/分数量子反常霍尔效应，将关联磁性、拓扑态与能带工程统一于一个可电学编程的平台。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用交替扭转三层MoTe₂异质结，通过施加垂直位移场调控层间杂化与能带拓扑；利用磁光测量（magneto-optical measurements）观测能隙闭合、朗道能级形成以及自旋极化费米面附近的交叉行为；通过掺杂（改变每个莫尔原胞的空穴数ν）研究磁响应（如双交换型铁磁、自旋极化子、反铁磁等）。

papers.title: Observation and Control of Spontaneous Magnon Emission from Spin Ensembles in 2D Hexagonal Boron Nitride
papers.abstract: Hybrid systems consisting of color centers and magnetic materials provide an appealing solid-state platform for advancing the burgeoning quantum technological revolution. Exploring novel coupling mechanisms between optically active spin defects and quantum degrees of freedom is directly relevant in this context. Here, we report observation and control of spontaneous magnon emission from boron-vacancy centers in 2D hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), an unconventional qubit-magnon dipole coupling channel that dominates in the near-zero temperature limit. The spontaneous magnon emission process starts to be overshadowed by thermal magnon effect as temperature increases, reflecting the crossover from an emission-dominated, effectively cold magnon reservoir to a thermally occupied spin bath where absorption and stimulated processes restore balance. By increasing the spin defect density, we further present that spontaneous magnon emission into a common spin bath could help establish quantum correlations in dense hBN spin ensembles. Our results are quantitatively captured by detailed theoretical modeling, bringing insights into understanding qubit-magnon coupling, correlated spin dynamics, and many-body physics of color centers in the quantum regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observation, control, report, experimental results, theoretical modeling）；研究对象：二维六方氮化硼（hBN）中的硼空位色心自旋系综与磁振子之间的耦合系统，具体为自发磁振子发射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在近零温度极限下，硼空位色心通过一种非传统的量子比特-磁振子偶极耦合通道主导自发磁振子发射；随着温度升高，该过程被热磁振子效应掩盖，并可通过增加自旋缺陷密度在密集hBN自旋系综中建立量子关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在近零温度极限下，硼空位色心通过一种非传统的量子比特-磁振子偶极耦合通道主导自发磁振子发射；随着温度升高，该过程被热磁振子效应掩盖，并可通过增加自旋缺陷密度在密集hBN自旋系综中建立量子关联。；创新点：首次在二维六方氮化硼中观测并控制色心自旋系综的自发磁振子发射，揭示了在近零温极限下占主导的新型量子比特-磁振子耦合通道，并展示了通过调控缺陷密度实现自旋系综间量子关联的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过光学手段观测和控制硼空位色心的自发磁振子发射；理论上通过详细的理论建模定量解释实验结果。

papers.title: Deciphering Noise in tip--sample Interactions: Insights into Nanoscale Dynamics
papers.abstract: Noise sets the fundamental limits of resolution and sensitivity in Dynamic Atomic Force Microscopy (DAFM). While thermal fluctuations are conventionally assumed to be the dominant noise source, this work demonstrates that tip--sample interactions in ambient conditions introduce a non--thermal noise component that significantly exceeds the thermal background. Using a model system of sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) on graphite, we characterize this noise through force spectroscopy, 3D imaging modes, and Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy (KPFM). This interaction--induced noise arises from the stochastic formation and rupture of nanoscopic liquid necks, serving as a direct fingerprint of local wettability and dissipative dynamics. Crucially, we find that this ``noise channel'' provides chemical contrast that is distinct from and complementary to the electrostatic potential mapped by KPFM. By deciphering the physical origin of these fluctuations, we establish that noise is not merely an instrumental artifact but a rich spectroscopic signal, and we propose that Frequency Modulation (FM--DAFM) offers a superior approach to decouple these dissipative effects for high--resolution imaging.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：force spectroscopy, 3D imaging modes, Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy (KPFM)。；研究对象：环境条件下动态原子力显微镜（DAFM）中针尖-样品相互作用产生的非热噪声，以及该噪声作为纳米尺度动力学（如液体颈缩形成与断裂）指纹的物理现象。具体模型体系为石墨上的十二烷基硫酸钠（SDS）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境条件下针尖-样品相互作用会引入一种显著超过热背景的非热噪声成分，该噪声源于纳米尺度液体颈缩的随机形成与断裂，并且能提供与KPFM所测静电势互补的化学对比度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境条件下针尖-样品相互作用会引入一种显著超过热背景的非热噪声成分，该噪声源于纳米尺度液体颈缩的随机形成与断裂，并且能提供与KPFM所测静电势互补的化学对比度。；创新点：揭示了DAFM中的噪声并非仅仅是仪器伪影，而是一种富含光谱信息的信号，能够作为局部润湿性和耗散动力学的直接指纹，并指出调频模式（FM-DAFM）是解耦这些耗散效应以实现高分辨率成像的优越方法。
papers.method_zh: 使用动态原子力显微镜（DAFM）进行力谱测量、三维成像模式以及开尔文探针力显微镜（KPFM）表征。

papers.title: Observation of Berry curvature fluctuations from incipient polar order in an oxide interface
papers.abstract: Diagnosing hidden local orders at buried interfaces remains a central challenge in the design and characterization of quantum materials. Second-order electrical responses, such as the nonlinear Hall effect, probe inversion-symmetry-breaking terms invisible to linear transport, offering a direct window into these nanoscale environments via the quantum geometry of Bloch electrons. Here, we utilize $\text{KTaO}_3$, a complex oxide driven by strong tantalum $5d$ spin-orbit coupling and interfacial inversion symmetry breaking, to demonstrate that second-harmonic resistivities exhibit large, reproducible mesoscopic fluctuations. Remarkably, these fluctuations persist in macroscopically large ($200\,μ\text{m}$) devices and are ubiquitous across all studied surface orientations, even where macroscopic conductivity strictly adheres to underlying crystal symmetries. We propose that these robust, magnetic-field-driven interference patterns arise from local structural symmetry breaking, driven by incipient ferroelectric polarization pinned to the interfacial impurity landscape. This defect-pinned polar mechanism is firmly supported by the signal's suppression above $10\text{ K}$ due to phase decoherence, and a complete loss of mesoscopic memory upon thermal cycling above $40\text{ K}$. By linking quantum geometry to dynamic lattice ordering, our findings establish nonlinear mesoscopic transport as a powerful new characterization tool, capable of revealing local polar tendencies and hidden structural orders in complex materials that remain fundamentally invisible to conventional probes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：second-harmonic resistivities exhibit、macroscopically large devices、thermal cycling。；研究对象：KTaO₃氧化物界面，具体涉及强自旋-轨道耦合的钽5d电子体系、界面反演对称性破缺以及由此产生的非线性霍尔效应和隐藏极性有序。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宏观尺寸（200 μm）的KTaO₃界面器件中，二次谐波电阻率表现出巨大且可复现的介观涨落，该涨落源于由杂质钉扎的初期铁电极化导致的局域结构对称性破缺。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宏观尺寸（200 μm）的KTaO₃界面器件中，二次谐波电阻率表现出巨大且可复现的介观涨落，该涨落源于由杂质钉扎的初期铁电极化导致的局域结构对称性破缺。；创新点：将量子几何（Bloch电子量子几何）与动态晶格有序联系起来，建立了非线性介观输运作为揭示传统探针无法观测的局域极性倾向和隐藏结构有序的新型表征工具。
papers.method_zh: 利用二次谐波电阻率（二阶电输运响应）测量，结合磁场调控、温度依赖实验（10 K以上信号抑制）以及热循环（40 K以上介观记忆消失）进行表征。

papers.title: Persistent structural distortions and absent superconductivity in trilayer nickelate thin films
papers.abstract: A new family of high-temperature superconductors was recently discovered in the $n=2,3$ Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates, where superconductivity emerges concomitant with suppression of parent density waves and structural octahedral rotations under hydrostatic pressure. Intriguingly, compressive strain mimics the structural effects of pressure in the $n=2$ phase, yielding ambient-pressure superconductivity. However, analogous strain-stabilized superconductivity has not been realized in the $n=3$. Here, we use atomically-precise synthesis, transport, picoscale electron microscopy, and synchrotron X-ray diffraction to probe $n=3$ La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$ thin films. Although compressive strain suppresses density wave order, we do not observe superconductivity even under the largest strain state. Importantly, we identify a structural distortion unique to strained $n=3$ thin films that may inhibit superconductivity: persistent, layer-inequivalent octahedral rotations around the $c$-axis. Our results highlight key differences between the $n=3$ and $n=2$ systems, suggesting that ambient-pressure superconductivity in the $n=3$ may require new methods beyond epitaxial strain engineering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：atomically-precise synthesis, transport, picoscale electron microscopy, synchrotron X-ray diffraction。；研究对象：三层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐La₄Ni₃O₁₀薄膜，以及其在压缩应变下的结构畸变与超导电性缺失现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在n=3的La₄Ni₃O₁₀薄膜中，尽管压缩应变抑制了密度波序，但并未实现超导电性；发现了一种独特的、层间不等价的c轴八面体旋转结构畸变，这可能是阻碍超导出现的关键因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在n=3的La₄Ni₃O₁₀薄膜中，尽管压缩应变抑制了密度波序，但并未实现超导电性；发现了一种独特的、层间不等价的c轴八面体旋转结构畸变，这可能是阻碍超导出现的关键因素。；创新点：揭示了n=3与n=2镍酸盐体系在应变工程下的关键差异，指出在n=3体系中仅靠外延应变无法实现常压超导，可能需要新的调控手段。摘要未突出说明与已有理论预测的对比。
papers.method_zh: 原子级精确合成（薄膜生长）、输运测量、皮米级电子显微镜、同步辐射X射线衍射。

papers.title: Quantum Enhancement of Particle-Size Segregation
papers.abstract: Segregated states based on particle size emerge in granular materials from the competition between segregation and diffusive remixing. Here, we show that quantum coherence can enhance segregation beyond this classical limit. We introduce an open quantum cellular automaton for bidisperse mixtures that combines coherent transport and dissipative segregation. The automaton reproduces experimental and continuum-theory segregation dynamics, with segregation degrees collapsing onto a theoretical Péclet-dependent relationship. However, weakly decohering systems exhibit a coherence-driven transport regime that produces more strongly segregated steady states than classical predictions. Across a broad parameter range, the steady-state degree of segregation collapses onto two dimensionless numbers governing the competition between segregation, diffusion, and decoherence. These results identify quantum coherence as a mechanism for enhancing particle-size segregation and establish a framework for studying transport phenomena in open many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：open quantum cellular automaton、theoretical Péclet-dependent relationship、dimensionless numbers governing competition）；研究对象：双分散颗粒混合物中的粒径分离现象，以及量子相干性对该过程的增强作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子相干性可以驱动一种新的输运机制，使稳态分离程度超越经典极限（即仅由分离与扩散竞争决定的上限），且稳态分离度可由两个无量纲数统一描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子相干性可以驱动一种新的输运机制，使稳态分离程度超越经典极限（即仅由分离与扩散竞争决定的上限），且稳态分离度可由两个无量纲数统一描述。；创新点：首次将量子相干性识别为增强粒径分离的物理机制，并建立了描述开放多体系统中输运现象的统一框架。
papers.method_zh: 构建了一个开放量子元胞自动机模型，将相干输运与耗散分离过程相结合，并通过与实验及连续介质理论结果的对比验证模型有效性。

papers.title: Scanning-probe quantum sensing of microwave and static magnetic field response of an on-chip superconducting resonator
papers.abstract: Superconducting resonators are finding increasing applications in designing advanced quantum circuits for ongoing sensing, metrology, and computing technological revolution. A detailed knowledge of microscopic electromagnetic properties of superconducting resonators is directly relevant for their further improvements on circuitry design and device performance. Here, we introduce scanning-probe quantum microscopy to report nanoscale sensing of microwave and static magnetic field environment of an on-chip niobium (Nb) superconducting resonator. Taking advantage of Rabi oscillation measurements, we show that microwave magnetic fields generated by the superconducting resonator mode can be utilized to achieve coherent control of a quantum spin sensor. We further visualize static electromagnetic field response of the Nb resonator, showing magnetic field-induced formation, evolution, and depinning of superconducting vortices. Our results provide insights into future design, testing and evaluation of solid-state superconducting resonators, highlighting the potential of quantum sensors as a local probe to investigate electromagnetic properties of superconducting quantum circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：scanning-probe quantum microscopy、Rabi oscillation measurements、visualize。；研究对象：片上铌（Nb）超导谐振器的微波和静磁场响应，以及超导涡旋的形成、演化和脱钉行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用扫描探针量子显微镜，实现了对片上超导谐振器微波磁场的纳米级传感，并利用该微波磁场对量子自旋传感器进行相干控制；同时可视化了静磁场下超导涡旋的动力学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用扫描探针量子显微镜，实现了对片上超导谐振器微波磁场的纳米级传感，并利用该微波磁场对量子自旋传感器进行相干控制；同时可视化了静磁场下超导涡旋的动力学行为。；创新点：将量子自旋传感器作为局域探针，在纳米尺度上同时表征超导谐振器的微波磁场和静磁场响应，为超导量子电路的微观电磁特性研究提供了新手段。
papers.method_zh: 扫描探针量子显微镜（scanning-probe quantum microscopy），结合Rabi振荡测量（Rabi oscillation measurements）实现对微波磁场的量子传感，以及静磁场下超导涡旋的成像。

papers.title: Silicon Nanostructures for Biosensing: From Field-Effect Transistors to Photonic Resonators, and the Long Road to the Clinic
papers.abstract: Silicon has a unique combination of properties that makes it one of the best material choices for biosensor platforms: it is inexpensive, its native oxide is atomically smooth, its fabrication processes are CMOS-compatible and have been refined for more than three decades, and it can support many transduction mechanisms in biosensor design. Over the past thirty years, researchers and engineers have used silicon nanostructures to produce ion-sensitive transistors, ultrasensitive nanowire field-effect biosensors, refractive-index-based porous silicon films, microring photonic resonators, suspended cantilevers, luminescent quantum dots, and solid-state nanopores. These device families have demonstrated successful sensing capabilities at the single-molecule, single-virus, or sub-femtomolar level under laboratory conditions; however, they have rarely been widely deployed in clinical assays. This gap is mainly caused by several well-characterized bottlenecks: for nanowire BioFETs, device variability and Debye screening; for porous silicon, fouling, pore wetting, and surface stability; for silicon photonics, thermal drift, spectral readout, and packaging; and across all platforms, calibration, reproducibility, and validation in real biofluids. In this review, we trace the development of silicon biosensors from their early stages to their current state, search and organize the literature focusing on the three most mature platforms and a set of emerging directions, summarize and compare the performance and bottlenecks of different platforms, and argue that progress over the next decade will come primarily from integrated readout, interface engineering, and systematic benchmarking rather than from the discovery of new silicon nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review、trace the development、search and organize the literature、summarize and compare。；研究对象：基于硅纳米结构的生物传感器，具体包括场效应晶体管（BioFETs）、多孔硅、硅光子学谐振器、悬臂梁、发光量子点、固态纳米孔等平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硅纳米生物传感器在实验室条件下已实现单分子、单病毒或亚飞摩尔级别的检测灵敏度，但极少被广泛部署于临床检测。主要瓶颈包括器件变异性、德拜屏蔽、污染、热漂移、校准与重现性等问题，未来十年进展将主要来自集成读出、界面工程和系统化基准测试，而非新型硅纳米结构的发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硅纳米生物传感器在实验室条件下已实现单分子、单病毒或亚飞摩尔级别的检测灵敏度，但极少被广泛部署于临床检测。主要瓶颈包括器件变异性、德拜屏蔽、污染、热漂移、校准与重现性等问题，未来十年进展将主要来自集成读出、界面工程和系统化基准测试，而非新型硅纳米结构的发现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 该文为文献综述，系统梳理了三十年来硅纳米生物传感器的发展历程，重点分析了三种最成熟的平台（纳米线BioFETs、多孔硅、硅光子学）及若干新兴方向，比较了各平台的性能与瓶颈。

papers.title: Magnetic Anisotropy and Metamagnetic Transitions in Er3Pt2Sb4.55 with A Distorted Square Net Lattice
papers.abstract: Magnetic materials with square-net sublattices are of great interest due to its potential to realize magnetic frustration. Here we report the crystal growth and structural, magnetic, thermodynamic and electronic transport properties of a new rare-earth-based intermetallic compound, Er3Pt2Sb4.55(5). The new material possesses a distorted square-net framework of Er. Magnetic properties measurements suggest anisotropic behavior, long-range antiferromagnetic ordering and metamagnetic transitions based on a Jeff = 1/2 Er3+ motif. A magnetic structure is proposed based on the observed magnetic and thermodynamic properties. This new material expands the R3Pt2Sb4+x family with distorted square-net lattice of rare-earth elements and offers a new opportunity to study the relationship between magnetic ordering, crystal-electric field effect and crystal structure in rare-earth-based compounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：crystal growth, structural, magnetic, thermodynamic and electronic transport properties, measurements。；研究对象：一种新型稀土基金属间化合物 Er₃Pt₂Sb₄.₅₅，具有扭曲的方形格子（distorted square net lattice）结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该材料表现出各向异性磁行为、长程反铁磁有序以及基于 Jeff = 1/2 Er³⁺ 构型的变磁相变，并提出了相应的磁结构模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该材料表现出各向异性磁行为、长程反铁磁有序以及基于 Jeff = 1/2 Er³⁺ 构型的变磁相变，并提出了相应的磁结构模型。；创新点：该工作扩展了具有稀土元素扭曲方形格子结构的 R₃Pt₂Sb₄₊ₓ 家族，为研究稀土基化合物中磁有序、晶体电场效应与晶体结构之间的关系提供了新的平台。摘要未突出说明与已有同家族材料相比的具体性能差异。
papers.method_zh: 晶体生长、结构表征、磁性测量、热力学性质测量、电子输运性质测量。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic tails in chaotic spin chains with quantum group symmetry
papers.abstract: The interplay between symmetry and thermalization governs the late-time dynamics of local quantum and classical many-body systems at nonzero temperature. Recently, two parallel frontiers have emerged: the search for robust anomalous hydrodynamics -- such as superdiffusion -- in generic, non-integrable models, and the formal effort to generalize the fundamental concept of global symmetry. In this paper, we bridge these frontiers by demonstrating that quantum group symmetry provides a novel mechanism for anomalous hydrodynamics in chaotic systems. We study the dynamics of local operators carrying $U(1)$ charge in non-integrable lattice models that also have quantum group symmetry. One example is transverse spin in the XXZ model with integrability breaking deformations. While such excitations are expected to decay very quickly at high temperature because their charge forbids overlap with conventional hydrodynamic densities, we find that protection by the quantum group symmetry makes these modes long-lived, despite the absence of local quantum group charge density or current. Furthermore, the dynamics is superdiffusive across Hamiltonian, Floquet, and classical realizations, and exhibits unusual finite size effects at very late times. We also revisit transverse spin dynamics in the integrable XXZ model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：demonstrating、study、revisit（理论分析与数值模拟结合，无实验数据）。；研究对象：具有量子群对称性的非可积混沌自旋链中的反常流体动力学，具体以XXZ模型（含可积性破缺微扰）中的横向自旋动力学为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子群对称性为非可积混沌系统中的反常流体动力学（超扩散）提供了新机制：携带U(1)电荷的局域算符虽因电荷禁止与常规流体密度重叠而预期快速衰减，但受量子群对称性保护而成为长寿命模式，且其动力学在哈密顿、Floquet和经典实现中均表现为超扩散，并在极晚时间呈现异常有限尺寸效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子群对称性为非可积混沌系统中的反常流体动力学（超扩散）提供了新机制：携带U(1)电荷的局域算符虽因电荷禁止与常规流体密度重叠而预期快速衰减，但受量子群对称性保护而成为长寿命模式，且其动力学在哈密顿、Floquet和经典实现中均表现为超扩散，并在极晚时间呈现异常有限尺寸效应。；创新点：将量子群对称性这一广义对称性概念与反常流体动力学（超扩散）联系起来，证明其可作为混沌系统中长寿命反常输运的机制，填补了对称性与热化交叉领域的前沿空白。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值模拟相结合：研究非可积晶格模型（如含可积性破缺的XXZ模型）中局域算符的动力学，涵盖哈密顿、Floquet和经典三种实现方式，并重新审视可积XXZ模型中的横向自旋动力学。

papers.title: Displacement-Field-Driven Semimetal-Superconductor Transition in Magic-Angle Twisted Trilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene(MATTG) hosts versatile displacement-field-tuned correlated phenomena. MATTG consists of a dispersive Dirac cone which hybridizes with the flat band from a twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) sector. The hybridization strength increases with the displacement field $D$ and naively one may expect D-driven heavy fermion physics. However, the TBG Hubbard bands have a momentum-selective Mott gap, which is small at the $Γ$ point due to the band topology, and a rigid local moment description as in the familiar Kondo lattice model is invalid. Here we show that the dominant effect of the displacement field is to induce an energy shift of the Dirac cone and self-doping into the TBG sector. We illustrate this picture in a concrete calculation using a slave-particle theory at the filling $ν=\pm 2$. We find that increasing $D$ drives a transition from a semimetal into a superconducting state. We also discuss the enhancement of the superconductivity by $D$ near $ν=\pm2$ and the particle-hole asymmetry of the phase diagram. Our results provide a unified picture for electric-field-tunable superconductivity, Mottness, and heavy-fermion-like behavior in MATTG.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：slave-particle theory、计算、理论框架）；研究对象：魔角三层石墨烯（MATTG）中由位移场调控的半金属-超导转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位移场的主要效应是诱导狄拉克锥的能量移动，导致对扭曲双层石墨烯（TBG）扇区的自掺杂，从而驱动从半金属到超导态的转变；位移场在填充数ν=±2附近可增强超导电性，并导致相图的粒子-空穴不对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位移场的主要效应是诱导狄拉克锥的能量移动，导致对扭曲双层石墨烯（TBG）扇区的自掺杂，从而驱动从半金属到超导态的转变；位移场在填充数ν=±2附近可增强超导电性，并导致相图的粒子-空穴不对称性。；创新点：揭示了魔角三层石墨烯中位移场调控超导电性、莫特绝缘体行为及重费米子行为的统一物理图像，并指出传统重费米子模型中刚性局域磁矩描述在此体系中不适用。
papers.method_zh: 采用奴隶粒子理论（slave-particle theory）在填充数ν=±2下进行具体计算。

papers.title: Partition function zeros of quantum many-body systems: perturbative results
papers.abstract: A systematic method to find the Yang-Lee partition function zeros of quantum many-body systems based on perturbation theory at finite temperatures was recently introduced in arXiv:2504.01880. This method identifies wave-vector and temperature-dependent complex virtual energies obtainable from the thermal electronic Greens function. The collection of virtual energies over all $\vec{k}$ yield the Yang-Lee zeroes. We apply this approach to the one-dimensional Hubbard model for different boundary conditions. We compare the results obtained by this method up to second-order in perturbation theory with the results found by exact diagonalization. We also propose a quantity that could be used for experimental detection of these zeros of a Hubbard ring. An example of the detection method is presented using exact diagonalization of the 8-site Hubbard ring.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：perturbation theory、partition function zeros、Yang-Lee zeros、finite temperatures）；研究对象：量子多体系统的杨-李配分函数零点，具体应用于一维Hubbard模型（不同边界条件）及Hubbard环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于微扰理论的方法（至二阶）可计算量子多体系统的杨-李零点，其结果与精确对角化结果一致；并提出了可用于实验探测Hubbard环中这些零点的物理量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于微扰理论的方法（至二阶）可计算量子多体系统的杨-李零点，其结果与精确对角化结果一致；并提出了可用于实验探测Hubbard环中这些零点的物理量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但方法本身基于arXiv:2504.01880提出的系统化微扰方法，本文将其应用于一维Hubbard模型并比较了不同边界条件及与精确对角化的结果）。
papers.method_zh: 微扰理论（至二阶）、热电子格林函数、精确对角化（8位点Hubbard环）。

papers.title: Tuning ergodicity breaking: Anomalous diffusion under asymptotic power-law forcing
papers.abstract: In non-Markovian systems, distinct dynamical phases arise from the competition between internal memory and external forcing, encompassing thermalization, persistent ergodicity breaking, and runaway energy growth. This study shows that the scaling parameter $η$ governs the emergent phase diagram within a system described by the Generalized Langevin Equation, particularly when subjected to external drives with asymptotic power-law tails. Three universal regimes for diffusive processes are delineated by this parameter: thermalization ($η> 0$), non-ergodic saturation ($η= 0$), and a force-dominated runaway phase ($η< 0$). The fluctuation-dissipation theorem, within this framework, is shown to be independent of external force and determined by the integral of noise density of states. A selective breaking of ergodicity is revealed by this formulation; microscopic fluctuations are decoupled from the drive, yet the relaxation completely encodes it, which in turn controls the kinetic effective temperature. Direct Langevin simulations in the Markovian limit quantitatively confirm this classification, capturing the non-thermal plateau at the critical point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Generalized Langevin Equation、scaling parameter、phase diagram、Langevin simulations）；研究对象：非马尔可夫系统中，在具有渐近幂律尾部的外力驱动下的反常扩散现象，以及由此产生的遍历性破缺与动力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 标度参数η决定了系统的三个普适扩散相：热化相（η>0）、非遍历饱和相（η=0）和力主导的失控相（η<0）。在临界点（η=0）处，系统出现非热平台，且涨落-耗散定理与外力无关，仅由噪声态密度积分决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：标度参数η决定了系统的三个普适扩散相：热化相（η>0）、非遍历饱和相（η=0）和力主导的失控相（η<0）。在临界点（η=0）处，系统出现非热平台，且涨落-耗散定理与外力无关，仅由噪声态密度积分决定。；创新点：揭示了外力渐近幂律尾部的标度参数η如何统一控制遍历性破缺的三种不同动力学相，并指出涨落-耗散定理在该框架下对外力不敏感，从而实现了微观涨落与驱动的选择性解耦。
papers.method_zh: 采用广义朗之万方程（Generalized Langevin Equation）作为理论框架，通过标度分析推导相图，并在马尔可夫极限下进行直接朗之万模拟（Direct Langevin simulations）以定量验证分类。

papers.title: Boosting lattice polarization Mixing the perspectives of geometry optimization and cell-augmentation
papers.abstract: Topologically polarized mechanical metamaterials enjoy a special built-in asymmetry that manifests as a preferred localization of edge states on selected edges. While this property has been shown for a few ideal Maxwell lattices, we currently lack systematic criteria to design families of structural systems exhibiting polarization. Here, we propose a framework to design polarized structural configurations enabled by topology optimization (TO), using both band and mode morphological properties as drivers of the optimization algorithm. Through the lens of TO, we are able to tap into a vast design space, unlocking geometric freedom far beyond what is achievable with canonical lattice architectures. At the same time, we elucidate important criteria that need to be satisfied, beyond the optimization outcome, to ensure robustness of the achieved polarization against perturbations of the edge morphology. These results provide the inspiration to loop back into the realm of ideal lattices in search of new configurations characterized by extreme polarization. The peculiar shape and connectivity of the TO-generated lattice offer a blueprint for identifying a new family of Maxwell trusses based on augmented kagome geometry. We demonstrate the achievement of strong polarization signatures up to a three-count edge state mismatch. For all the cases studied, we show agreement between theory, simulations, and experiments, which include laser vibrometry wave measurements on a waterjet-cut specimen and static tests on a 3D-printed prototype.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论、计算与实验相结合）。判断依据：摘要中同时提及了“拓扑优化（TO）”这一计算方法、“理论、模拟与实验的一致性”，以及具体的实验手段“激光测振波测量”和“3D打印原型静态测试”。；研究对象：拓扑极化机械超材料，特别是通过几何优化和晶胞增强设计出的新型麦克斯韦桁架结构。具体现象为边缘态在特定边缘上的优先局域化（即极化现象）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于拓扑优化的系统框架，能够设计出具有强极化特征的机械超材料，并成功识别出一种基于增强型kagome几何的新家族麦克斯韦桁架，实现了高达三倍边缘态失配的强极化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于拓扑优化的系统框架，能够设计出具有强极化特征的机械超材料，并成功识别出一种基于增强型kagome几何的新家族麦克斯韦桁架，实现了高达三倍边缘态失配的强极化。；创新点：1. 首次将拓扑优化引入极化机械超材料的设计，解锁了远超传统晶格架构的几何自由度。2. 阐明了除优化结果外，确保极化鲁棒性所需满足的关键判据。3. 基于优化结果，逆向识别并定义了一个基于增强型kagome几何的新型麦克斯韦桁架家族，实现了强极化。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用拓扑优化（Topology Optimization, TO）作为设计框架，利用能带和模态的形态学特性作为优化算法的驱动力。通过理论分析、数值模拟（摘要未明确具体模拟方法）以及实验验证（包括对水射流切割样品的激光测振波测量和对3D打印原型的静态测试）相结合。

papers.title: A few remarks on hyperstatistics and some applications
papers.abstract: In a recent paper [arXiv:2604.24783 (2026)], we have proposed a general approach to treat systems with inherent non-Boltzmann-Gibbsian behaviour. Given the extremely high accuracy of our approach, we have adopted the term hyperstatistics. We have applied such a statistical mechanics approach, i.e., hyperstatistics, to the discharge of a capacitor in a RC series circuit, pumping of $^4$He of a closed cycle cryostat, midrapidity data of $p$-Pb collisions at the LHC, as well as for the distribution of accelerations in turbulent systems. Here, we discuss into more details the ground of hyperstatistics. We demonstrate the versatility of hyperstatistics upon applying it to the velocity autocorrelation function in Brownian motion and also regarding its potential to describe brain dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出了一种通用方法”“统计力学方法”，并讨论理论框架（hyperstatistics）的基础和应用。；研究对象：非玻尔兹曼-吉布斯行为的统计力学系统，具体应用包括：RC串联电路中的电容器放电、闭循环低温恒温器中⁴He的泵浦、LHC中p-Pb碰撞的中间快度数据、湍流系统中的加速度分布、布朗运动中的速度自相关函数，以及脑动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并深入讨论了“超统计”（hyperstatistics）这一统计力学框架，展示了其在多种非平衡系统（从电路到湍流、从粒子碰撞到脑动力学）中的广泛适用性和高精度描述能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并深入讨论了“超统计”（hyperstatistics）这一统计力学框架，展示了其在多种非平衡系统（从电路到湍流、从粒子碰撞到脑动力学）中的广泛适用性和高精度描述能力。；创新点：摘要未突出说明相对于已有研究的具体新意，但指出该方法在先前工作中已展现出“极高的精度”，并在此进一步阐述其理论基础和扩展应用范围。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为“超统计”（hyperstatistics），是一种处理非玻尔兹曼-吉布斯行为的统计力学方法。摘要未提及具体实验或计算手段，仅涉及理论推导与数据拟合应用。

papers.title: Non-ergodicity effects in 1D localization
papers.abstract: It is well-known that the dimensionless Landauer resistance ρof an 1D disordered system obeys the log-normal distribution. The average value <ρ> for such distribution is not representative, since it strongly differs from the typical value ρ_{typ} in a specific sample. In fact, this conclusion should be revised due to effects of non-ergodicity. If L is the system size, and $K$ is the number of realizations of a random potential, then a situation for L\to\infty, K\to \infty depends on the order of limiting transitions. If the limit K\to \infty is taken firstly, then the log-normal distribution is valid for all L, if the condition ρ>>1 is fulfilled. If the number of realizations K is restricted, then a situation for L\to \infty is effectively described by the delta-function distribution, and <ρ>\approxρ_{typ}$. Transformation of the log-normal distribution can be observed with the use of experimental technique developed in the context of the universal conductance fluctuations. Non-ergodicity effects are essential for understanding of the difference between the theoretical predictions for the parameters of the log-normal distribution and the results of numerical and physical experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：log-normal distribution、limiting transitions、delta-function distribution、non-ergodicity effects。；研究对象：一维无序系统中的局域化现象，具体为Landauer电阻的统计分布及其非遍历性效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 一维无序系统的Landauer电阻的log-normal分布是否成立取决于系统尺寸L与随机势实现次数K的极限顺序：若先取K→∞，则log-normal分布对所有L有效；若K有限，则L→∞时分布退化为delta函数，平均电阻与典型电阻近似相等。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：一维无序系统的Landauer电阻的log-normal分布是否成立取决于系统尺寸L与随机势实现次数K的极限顺序：若先取K→∞，则log-normal分布对所有L有效；若K有限，则L→∞时分布退化为delta函数，平均电阻与典型电阻近似相等。；创新点：揭示了非遍历性效应导致的理论预测与数值/物理实验结果之间的差异，并指出log-normal分布的有效性依赖于随机势实现次数的有限性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landauer电阻的log-normal分布理论，通过分析不同极限顺序（L→∞与K→∞）下的统计行为，结合通用电导涨落实验技术进行理论推导与讨论。

papers.title: Multi-scale reconstruction of single-ion damage tracks in diamond via nitrogen-vacancy centers
papers.abstract: Understanding particle-induced damage tracks in solid-state materials underpins emerging applications in rare-event detection and quantum defect engineering. Resolving these tracks requires multi-scale readout, from event localization at the millimeter scale to track-morphology reconstruction at the nanoscale. Nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond provide such a platform, combining optical localization with quantum sensing of track morphology. Here, we implant sub-MeV carbon ions into nitrogen-rich diamond and detect individual recoil events via spatially localized NV formation. We develop a simulation framework that explains the observed NV yield and predicts that directional information is retained in the NV distribution after annealing. Machine learning further recovers much of the information lost to defect diffusion and limited NV yield, improving head-tail classification to a level comparable to pre-annealed vacancy tracks. Measurements of NV spin coherence indicate compatibility with nanoscale track reconstruction via NV strain mapping and magnetic gradient-based techniques. These results identify promising pathways toward NV-diamond directional detectors for rare events, while the track-modeling framework has broader implications for paleodetection and quantum material synthesis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验上通过碳离子注入和NV中心光学定位检测单个反冲事件，同时开发了模拟框架和机器学习方法进行理论建模。；研究对象：金刚石中由亚MeV碳离子辐照产生的单离子损伤径迹，利用氮-空位（NV）中心进行多尺度重建。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过NV中心实现了从毫米级事件定位到纳米级径迹形态重建的多尺度读出，并证明退火后NV分布仍保留方向信息，机器学习可恢复因缺陷扩散和有限NV产额损失的信息，使头-尾分类精度接近退火前空位径迹水平。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过NV中心实现了从毫米级事件定位到纳米级径迹形态重建的多尺度读出，并证明退火后NV分布仍保留方向信息，机器学习可恢复因缺陷扩散和有限NV产额损失的信息，使头-尾分类精度接近退火前空位径迹水平。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用亚MeV碳离子注入富氮金刚石，通过空间局域化的NV形成检测单个反冲事件；理论上开发了模拟框架解释NV产额并预测方向信息保留，结合机器学习进行信息恢复；测量NV自旋相干性以评估纳米尺度径迹重建的可行性（如NV应变映射和磁梯度技术）。

papers.title: Hexagonal Boron Nitride Spin Defects for Quantum Photonics: Annealing-Free Generation by Krypton Ion Implantation
papers.abstract: Controlled, reproducible generation of luminescent defect centres in hBN remains a key challenge for scalable quantum-photonic technologies. Here, we report Kr$^{+}$ ion implantation as a tunable, annealing-free, and chemically inert route to room-temperature near-infrared luminescent spin defects in hBN, requiring no pre- or post-implantation annealing. SRIM Monte Carlo simulations were used to optimise the parameters for 40 keV Kr$^{+}$ irradiation of hBN flakes. The implanted samples exhibit a stable near-infrared photoluminescence (PL) band centred at $\sim$830 nm whose intensity increases with implantation fluence over $10^{11}$-$10^{15}$ions/cm$^{2}$. Temperature-dependent PL measurements (20-300 K) reveal a linewidth broadening well described by a $T^{3}$ dependence, consistent with acoustic-phonon-mediated dephasing. Raman spectra show the characteristic $E_{2g}$ mode of pristine hBN at $\sim$1366 cm$^{-1}$ alongside an implantation-induced defect feature at $\sim$1295 cm$^{-1}$, confirming irradiation-induced lattice disorder. Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) measurements reveal a paramagnetic centre with a $g$-factor of 2.003, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations indicate that a spatially separated $V_{\mathrm{N}}$-$C_{\mathrm{B}}$ donor-acceptor pair complex is a viable origin of the observed optical and magnetic signatures. Overall, Kr$^{+}$ implantation offers an effective, annealing-free, and scalable platform for generating stable room-temperature luminescent defects, providing a promising route toward quantum photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算模拟）。判断依据：关键词包括“Kr⁺ ion implantation”、“PL measurements”、“Raman spectra”、“EPR measurements”等实验手段，以及“SRIM Monte Carlo simulations”、“DFT calculations”等计算模拟方法。；研究对象：六方氮化硼（hBN）中的发光自旋缺陷，具体为通过氪离子注入产生的近红外发光缺陷中心。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氪离子注入可在无需任何退火处理的情况下，在hBN中可控、可重复地生成稳定的室温近红外发光自旋缺陷（光致发光峰位于~830 nm），且该缺陷的顺磁中心g因子为2.003，DFT计算表明其可能源于空间分离的VN-CB施主-受主对复合体。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氪离子注入可在无需任何退火处理的情况下，在hBN中可控、可重复地生成稳定的室温近红外发光自旋缺陷（光致发光峰位于~830 nm），且该缺陷的顺磁中心g因子为2.003，DFT计算表明其可能源于空间分离的VN-CB施主-受主对复合体。；创新点：提出了一种无需退火、化学惰性的氪离子注入方法，避免了传统方法中必需的退火步骤，为hBN中发光自旋缺陷的可扩展、可控制备提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：Kr⁺离子注入（40 keV）、光致发光（PL）光谱（20-300 K变温测量）、拉曼光谱、电子顺磁共振（EPR）。计算模拟：SRIM蒙特卡罗模拟（优化注入参数）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（分析缺陷起源）。

papers.title: Substitution-Based Analysis of Structural Novelty for Generative Models of Materials
papers.abstract: There has been rapid progress in generative artificial intelligence (AI) models for inorganic crystal design, which can efficiently generate large numbers of candidate compounds after being trained on databases of known crystals. However, it remains unclear whether they genuinely expand the accessible materials search space beyond conventional strategies such as elemental substitution within known structure types. We address this question by developing a workflow to assess whether AI-generated crystals are duplicates of training structures, reproducible by elemental substitution, or unmatched by either criterion. Applying this workflow to representative generative models reveals that 81-92% of chemically valid and metastable generated crystals are either training duplicates or substitution-derived structures. This tendency is particularly strong in high-symmetry crystal systems, even though many possible structural prototypes remain unexplored. Further analysis of the underlying structural fingerprints shows that low-symmetry structures beyond duplication or substitution can be interpreted as interpolation in training-data-rich regions, while high-symmetry duplicates appear to result from memorisation in training-sparse regions. Our findings highlight a limitation in the current generation of models that exhibit a bias towards known structural prototypes in the high symmetry regions, but enable wider exploration of the low-symmetry structural space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：generative AI models、workflow、structural fingerprints、analysis。；研究对象：生成式人工智能模型生成的无机晶体材料的结构新颖性，具体分析这些生成晶体是否真正拓展了材料搜索空间，还是仅重复或衍生自已知结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 81-92%的化学有效且亚稳态的生成晶体要么是训练集重复结构，要么可通过元素替换从已知结构得到；高对称性晶体系统尤其倾向于重复已知结构原型，而低对称性结构则更多表现为训练数据密集区域的插值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：81-92%的化学有效且亚稳态的生成晶体要么是训练集重复结构，要么可通过元素替换从已知结构得到；高对称性晶体系统尤其倾向于重复已知结构原型，而低对称性结构则更多表现为训练数据密集区域的插值。；创新点：首次系统量化了生成式材料模型在结构新颖性上的局限性，明确区分了“训练重复”、“元素替换衍生”和“真正新颖”三类生成晶体，并揭示了高对称性与低对称性区域不同的生成机制（记忆 vs. 插值）。
papers.method_zh: 开发了一套工作流，用于评估AI生成晶体是否属于训练集重复、是否可通过元素替换得到、或两者均不匹配。应用该工作流对代表性生成模型进行分析，并进一步分析结构指纹（structural fingerprints）以区分不同对称性下的生成行为。

papers.title: Physics-governed executable modelling of triboelectric nanogenerators
papers.abstract: Predictive modelling of triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) remains fragmented across analytical theories, finite-geometry solvers and disconnected simulation workflows. These disparate approaches must be unified into an executable framework to advance quantitative TENG research.Here we introduce a charge-defined modelling framework and implement it as TENG-CLAW, a physics-governed platform for traceable TENG simulation. The framework establishes a self-consistent electrostatic hierarchy in which triboelectric charges, pre-charging charges and compensating electrode charges serve as defining state variables.This hierarchy connects the infinite plate analytical limit for near-uniform fields with finite-geometry numerical formulations required for edge-dominated devices. Built on this basis, TENG-CLAW converts user-defined research requests into physically admissible simulation tasks, so that generated outputs are tied to explicit charge states, boundary conditions, solver routes and reusable artifacts across spatial, temporal, field-level, comparative and reporting workflows. This work establishes a rigorous computational basis for interpreting TENG mechanisms and provides reproducible research infrastructure for simulation and physics-guided device design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“predictive modelling”、“analytical theories”、“finite-geometry solvers”、“simulation workflows”、“numerical formulations”。；研究对象：摩擦纳米发电机（TENGs）的预测性建模与仿真框架。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种以电荷为定义变量的自洽静电场层级模型，将无限平板解析极限与有限几何数值方法统一到一个可执行的仿真框架中，从而为TENG机制解释和可重复研究提供了计算基础。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种以电荷为定义变量的自洽静电场层级模型，将无限平板解析极限与有限几何数值方法统一到一个可执行的仿真框架中，从而为TENG机制解释和可重复研究提供了计算基础。；创新点：将以往碎片化的解析理论、有限几何求解器和分离的仿真工作流统一为一个可执行的、物理驱动的仿真平台，并实现了从用户研究请求到物理可允许仿真任务的自动转换，生成可复用的仿真工件。
papers.method_zh: 建立了“电荷定义建模框架”（charge-defined modelling framework），并实现为名为TENG-CLAW的物理驱动仿真平台。该框架构建了包含摩擦电荷、预充电荷和补偿电极电荷的自洽静电场层级，连接了近均匀场的无限平板解析极限与边缘主导器件的有限几何数值公式。

papers.title: Powder Spreading and Layer Deposition in Metal Powder Bed Fusion
papers.abstract: Powder spreading and layer deposition are fundamental stages of Powder Bed Fusion (PBF) technologies and play a critical role in determining process stability and final component quality. This chapter examines the mechanisms governing powder-bed formation, highlighting the interactions between powder characteristics, process parameters, and machine architecture. Particular attention is devoted to the influence of particle size distribution, morphology, cohesion, flowability, layer thickness, recoater velocity, and environmental conditions on powder-bed quality. The resulting powder-bed is discussed as a process state variable whose characteristics, including packing density, surface coverage, effective layer thickness, and spatial homogeneity, directly affect energy absorption, melt-pool stability, defect formation, and mechanical performance. The chapter also reviews the application of the Discrete Element Method (DEM) for modelling powder spreading phenomena and quantifying powder-bed quality metrics. Finally, the role of powder reuse, lifecycle management, and future developments involving process monitoring, digital twins, and data-driven optimization strategies is discussed, emphasizing the growing importance of powder engineering in advanced metal additive manufacturing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述/章节类文章（非单一实验、计算或理论文章）。判断依据：关键词“examines the mechanisms”、“reviews the application”、“discusses the role”。；研究对象：金属粉末床熔融（PBF）技术中的粉末铺展与层沉积过程，重点关注粉末特性（粒径分布、形貌、内聚力、流动性）、工艺参数（层厚、刮刀速度、环境条件）与粉末床质量（堆积密度、表面覆盖率、空间均匀性）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 粉末铺展与层沉积是决定PBF工艺稳定性与最终部件质量的关键阶段，粉末床本身应被视为一个过程状态变量，其特性直接影响能量吸收、熔池稳定性、缺陷形成及力学性能。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：粉末铺展与层沉积是决定PBF工艺稳定性与最终部件质量的关键阶段，粉末床本身应被视为一个过程状态变量，其特性直接影响能量吸收、熔池稳定性、缺陷形成及力学性能。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但强调了对粉末工程在先进金属增材制造中日益重要性的讨论，包括粉末再利用、生命周期管理、过程监控、数字孪生及数据驱动优化策略等未来发展方向。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用离散元方法（DEM）对粉末铺展现象进行建模，并量化粉末床质量指标；同时涉及对粉末特性、工艺参数及机器架构影响的系统性分析。

papers.title: Large-Area Patternable Solar-Powered Bistable Organic Film for Nonlinear Optical Communication
papers.abstract: Reversible control of crystal symmetry offers a powerful route to programmable optical functionality. However, achieving solid-state bistability between centrosymmetric and non-centrosymmetric crystalline phases remains a formidable challenge; examples of materials that enable stable switching of second-order nonlinear optical (NLO) responses are exceptionally rare. Here we report a solar-powered, symmetry-bistable organic material based on the photoisomerizable molecule (E/Z)-2-(4-(4-bromophenyl)thiazol-2-yl)-3-(4- (dimethylamino)phenyl)acrylonitrile (E/Z-BTDPA). The crystallizable E- and Z-isomers adopt distinct molecular packing arrangements that reversibly toggle between these states, controlling second-order NLO activity. The E-form exhibits strong second-harmonic generation (SHG), whereas the Z-form is SHG-inactive and displays twophoton luminescence. This bistable behavior is retained in flexible thin films, where sunlight-driven photoisomerization enables reversible photoswitching of the second-order electric susceptibility (\c{hi} 2), large-area optical patterning, and real-time NLO communication via waveform generation and text-string transcription at telecommunication wavelengths. This sustainable strategy bypasses rigid inorganic architectures, establishing photoinduced symmetry bistability as a scalable paradigm for all-optical computing and advanced communication networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了材料合成、表征（如SHG、双光子发光）、器件制备（柔性薄膜）及功能演示（光图案化、波形生成）等具体实验内容。；研究对象：一种基于光致异构分子 (E/Z)-2-(4-(4-溴苯基)噻唑-2-基)-3-(4-(二甲氨基)苯基)丙烯腈 (E/Z-BTDPA) 的太阳能驱动的对称性双稳态有机薄膜材料。具体物理现象为：在中心对称与非中心对称晶相之间的可逆切换，及其对二阶非线性光学（NLO）响应的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该有机材料通过光致异构化实现了中心对称（Z型，无二次谐波产生）与非中心对称（E型，强二次谐波产生）晶相之间的可逆、稳定切换，并能在柔性薄膜中保持此双稳态特性，从而利用太阳光实现大面积光学图案化和实时非线性光学通信。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该有机材料通过光致异构化实现了中心对称（Z型，无二次谐波产生）与非中心对称（E型，强二次谐波产生）晶相之间的可逆、稳定切换，并能在柔性薄膜中保持此双稳态特性，从而利用太阳光实现大面积光学图案化和实时非线性光学通信。；创新点：该工作首次报道了一种基于光致异构有机分子的、由太阳能驱动的对称性双稳态材料，实现了在柔性薄膜中稳定切换二阶非线性光学响应，并展示了其在全光计算和先进通信网络中的可扩展应用潜力，绕开了传统刚性无机架构的限制。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段包括：光致异构化（利用太阳光驱动）、二次谐波产生（SHG）测量、双光子发光测量、二阶电极化率（χ²）的开关测试、大面积光学图案化技术，以及在电信波长下进行波形生成和文本字符串转录的通信演示。

papers.title: Reaction-Network-Level Discovery of Ammonia Synthesis Catalysts via Ten-Million-Scale Generative Exploration
papers.abstract: Catalyst discovery for ammonia synthesis is inherently a reaction-network challenge because catalytic performance is governed not by a single adsorbed intermediate, but by a surface's orchestrated compatibility with multiple distinct intermediates across competing dissociative and associative pathways. However, navigating ultra-large chemical spaces under such multi-intermediate constraints remains a formidable bottleneck for conventional screening workflows. Here, we report a reaction-network-level catalyst discovery framework driven by ten-million-scale generative exploration. By coupling adsorbate-specific generative Transformers with high-throughput machine learning potentials, we systematically map the structure-property landscapes of four critical intermediates (N*, NH*, NNH*, and HNNH*). Scale-dependent overlap analysis shows that the full four-intermediate compatibility space remains strongly under-sampled at conventional 105-106 generative scales, emerging exclusively under ten-million-scale exploration. By generating approximately 15 million configurations per adsorbate, followed by structural compression and machine-learning-potential predictions, we identified 279 highly potential target materials. This sparse compatibility space successfully recovers traditional Fe- and Ru-based motifs while uncovering previously unexplored catalyst families. Representative DFT calculations validate pathway-dependent mechanisms: Fe-V emerges as a dissociative-pathway lead by significantly lowering the initial N2 dissociation barrier, whereas Al-Pd-Zr efficiently stabilizes associative intermediates as an associative-pathway lead. These findings establish multi-intermediate reaction-network compatibility as a robust criterion for discovering advanced catalysts from multi-million generative chemical spaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“generative exploration”、“machine learning potentials”、“DFT calculations”。；研究对象：氨合成催化剂。具体研究在多种中间体（N*, NH*, NNH*, HNNH*）约束下的催化剂表面反应网络兼容性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过千万量级的生成式探索，发现传统筛选规模（10^5-10^6）下严重欠采样的四中间体兼容性空间，并从中识别出279种高潜力催化剂材料，包括已知的Fe/Ru基体系以及此前未被探索的催化剂家族（如Fe-V和Al-Pd-Zr）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过千万量级的生成式探索，发现传统筛选规模（10^5-10^6）下严重欠采样的四中间体兼容性空间，并从中识别出279种高潜力催化剂材料，包括已知的Fe/Ru基体系以及此前未被探索的催化剂家族（如Fe-V和Al-Pd-Zr）。；创新点：提出了“反应网络级”的催化剂发现框架，将催化性能的评判标准从单一中间体提升至多中间体（N*, NH*, NNH*, HNNH*）的反应网络兼容性，并证明了在千万量级生成空间中进行探索的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 采用吸附物特异性生成式Transformer模型与高通量机器学习势（ML potentials）相结合的方法。具体流程为：为每种吸附中间体生成约1500万个构型，通过结构压缩和机器学习势预测，最终进行代表性DFT计算验证。

papers.title: A single-electron double quantum dot with Rashba spin-orbit interaction as a working substance for heat machines
papers.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic performance of a quantum Otto machine whose working substance is a single electron confined in a double quantum dot under an external magnetic field and Rashba spin-orbit interaction. The Hamiltonian is controlled by the Zeeman splitting, the interdot tunneling amplitude, and the Rashba coupling, which induces spin-flip tunneling between localized orbital states. Within a quasistatic Otto cycle, we analyze the heat exchanged with the reservoirs, the extracted work, and the efficiency as functions of the Hamiltonian parameters and reservoir temperatures. We show that the Rashba interaction acts as an effective control parameter for switching among heat-engine, refrigerator, heater, and accelerator regimes. A global numerical analysis over the Hamiltonian parameters and reservoir temperatures identifies the optimal operating points for efficiency and work output in the heat-engine regime. The highest efficiencies occur near the maximum temperature gradient explored and approach the Carnot bound, whereas the largest work output appears in a different region of parameter space. The results reveal a clear trade-off between maximum efficiency and maximum extracted work, governed by the spectral deformation induced by the Zeeman splitting, tunneling amplitude, and Rashba coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We investigate”“We analyze”“A global numerical analysis”等表述，未提及实验或计算模拟，属于理论分析工作。；研究对象：以单个电子束缚于双量子点中的系统为工作物质，在外部磁场和Rashba自旋-轨道耦合作用下的量子奥托热机。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Rashba自旋-轨道耦合可作为有效控制参数，实现热机、制冷机、加热器和加速器四种工作模式之间的切换；在热机模式下，最高效率接近卡诺极限，但最大功输出出现在参数空间的不同区域，两者之间存在明确的权衡关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Rashba自旋-轨道耦合可作为有效控制参数，实现热机、制冷机、加热器和加速器四种工作模式之间的切换；在热机模式下，最高效率接近卡诺极限，但最大功输出出现在参数空间的不同区域，两者之间存在明确的权衡关系。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用准静态奥托循环框架，通过分析哈密顿量参数（塞曼分裂、量子点间隧穿振幅、Rashba耦合）和储热器温度对系统与热库交换的热量、提取功及效率的影响，进行全局数值分析。

papers.title: Polar director structure of SmAP$_\text{F}$ phase of bent-core liquid crystals in thin planar cells with bias electric field
papers.abstract: We study the polar director structure in thin planar cells filled with bent-core liquid crystals in the ferroelectric smectic-A phase (SmAP$_\text{F}$). We analyze a continuum phenomenological model proposed in the physics literature and present rigorous proofs of the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium solutions. We further investigate the qualitative properties of nontrivial solutions and examine the effects of a bias electric field, surface anchoring, and cell thickness on the polar director configuration. Our results are consistent with previous experimental and numerical simulations reported in the physics literature. In addition, our analysis reveals new parameter-dependent behaviors supported by our numerical simulations and extends results reported from previous literature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“continuum phenomenological model”、“rigorous proofs”、“numerical simulations”。；研究对象：弯核液晶在铁电近晶A相（SmAPF）中，置于薄平面电池内并施加偏置电场时的极性指向矢结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了平衡解的存在性与唯一性，揭示了偏置电场、表面锚定和电池厚度对极性指向矢构型的影响，并发现了新的参数依赖行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了平衡解的存在性与唯一性，揭示了偏置电场、表面锚定和电池厚度对极性指向矢构型的影响，并发现了新的参数依赖行为。；创新点：提供了平衡解存在性与唯一性的严格数学证明，并通过数值模拟揭示了先前文献未报道的新参数依赖行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用连续介质唯象模型进行理论分析，结合严格的数学证明（存在性与唯一性）以及数值模拟。

papers.title: A phase-field model for microbiologically influenced corrosion
papers.abstract: A phase-field-based reaction-diffusion corrosion model is developed to predict microbially influenced corrosion (MIC) in metal alloys, with a focus on anaerobic conditions and sulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB). The formulation couples microbial sulfate reduction, sulfate transport, electrochemical kinetics, material dissolution, and mechanical effects. Microbial activity is modelled using a Monod-type expression for sulfate consumption, whereas the mechano-chemical coupling is incorporated through an enhanced mobility relationship that captures the influence of mechanical fields on corrosion kinetics. The model is calibrated against experiments and shows strong agreement in predicting pitting kinetics under SRB activity. Sensitivity analyses quantify the competing roles of microbial kinetics, transport, and thermodynamic driving forces in governing corrosion behaviour. The capability of the formulation to capture both MIC-induced pitting and stress-assisted corrosion across multiple length scales is demonstrated through case studies that include microstructure-sensitive simulations and structural-scale coupling with a cathodic protection (CP) model. Results show that finer grain sizes reduce pitting severity but promote faster defect propagation under mechanical loading. At the structural scale, coupling with the CP model enables predictions of defect growth under varying electrochemical conditions and over engineering-relevant length scales, as exemplified with the analysis of an offshore wind turbine monopile. CP delays pitting and suppresses crack propagation, although its effectiveness diminishes as sacrificial anodes degrade. The framework provides a predictive and computationally efficient tool for assessing MIC-induced damage over extended times, with potential applications in the integrity and life assessment of metallic structures operating in aggressive microbial environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：phase-field model, reaction-diffusion corrosion model, sensitivity analyses, case studies）；研究对象：微生物影响下的金属合金腐蚀（MIC），特别是厌氧条件下硫酸盐还原菌（SRB）引起的点蚀和应力辅助腐蚀。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该相场模型能够准确预测SRB活性下的点蚀动力学，并揭示了晶粒尺寸对腐蚀行为的影响：更细的晶粒尺寸能减轻点蚀严重程度，但在机械载荷下会促进缺陷的更快扩展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该相场模型能够准确预测SRB活性下的点蚀动力学，并揭示了晶粒尺寸对腐蚀行为的影响：更细的晶粒尺寸能减轻点蚀严重程度，但在机械载荷下会促进缺陷的更快扩展。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作的主要新意在于开发了一个统一的相场框架，该框架首次将微生物活性（SRB）、电化学动力学、材料溶解、力学效应以及阴极保护耦合在一个模型中，能够跨多个长度尺度（从微观结构到工程结构）预测MIC损伤。
papers.method_zh: 基于相场的反应-扩散腐蚀模型。具体包括：使用Monod型表达式模拟微生物硫酸盐消耗；通过增强的迁移率关系实现力-化学耦合；模型通过实验数据进行校准；并通过微观结构敏感模拟和与阴极保护（CP）模型耦合的结构尺度案例研究进行验证。

papers.title: Integrated Whispering-Gallery Microlaser-Waveguide Platform for On-Chip Electrical Excitation of InGaAs Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: We report the fabrication and characterization of an integrated quantum photonic device consisting of an electrically driven whispering-gallery-mode micropillar laser evanescently coupled to a ridge waveguide, both incorporating InGaAs quantum dots (QDs). The lasing characteristics of microlasers are systematically investigated as a function of the pillar-waveguide gap distance. Coherent emission from the whispering-gallery-mode microlaser coupled into the waveguide enables on-chip optical excitation of QDs embedded in an electrically contacted micropillar at the end of the waveguide. Under continuous-wave on-chip excitation, we observe single-photon emission with $g^{(2)}(0) = (3.49 \pm 0.01) \%$ for a QD integrated in the outcoupling micropillar which can be spectrally tuned-by the quantum confined Stark effect. These results constitute an important step toward low-footprint, deterministic, and scalable single-photon sources for QD-based integrated quantum photonic circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：fabrication, characterization, measured, observed。；研究对象：集成量子光子器件，具体为电驱动回音壁模式微柱激光器与脊形波导耦合系统，内含InGaAs量子点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了电驱动微柱激光器与波导的片上集成，通过波导耦合的相干光激发波导末端微柱中的量子点，观测到单光子发射，其二阶关联函数g^(2)(0) = (3.49 ± 0.01)%，且可通过量子限制斯塔克效应进行光谱调谐。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了电驱动微柱激光器与波导的片上集成，通过波导耦合的相干光激发波导末端微柱中的量子点，观测到单光子发射，其二阶关联函数g^(2)(0) = (3.49 ± 0.01)%，且可通过量子限制斯塔克效应进行光谱调谐。；创新点：实现了基于量子点的电驱动微激光器与波导的片上集成，并利用该平台实现片上电激发量子点单光子源，为低占用面积、确定性和可扩展的单光子源提供了重要进展。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备了电驱动回音壁模式微柱激光器与脊形波导的集成器件，系统测量了微柱-波导间隙距离对激光特性的影响，并利用连续波片上激发观测量子点的单光子发射及斯塔克调谐。

papers.title: Multi-Level Resistive Synapses for On-Chip Neural Networks: A Physics-Based Design of a Memristive Crossbar Fabric with Quasi-Continuous Conductance States
papers.abstract: Building on resistive communication, this paper presents a physics-based design of an on-chip neural network with multi-level memristive synapses supporting a dense spectrum of conductance states. Derived from ionic transport physics, we develop a state-variable model and quantify storable sub-levels under thermal noise, drift, and quantized conductance. We assemble these devices into a 1T1R crossbar fabric, derive the linear algebra of analog vector-matrix multiplication (VMM) under wire resistance, and design a differential synapse for signed weights. A multilayer pipeline executes inference, backpropagation, and weight updates physically in the analog domain. We derive the in-situ outer-product learning rule, its discretization onto the conductance lattice, and the resulting quantization noise. We provide energy, area, capacity, and inter-tile models, showing this substrate is ideally suited for large language models (LLMs). Our design eliminates weight movement, surpassing binary ReRAM and traditional CMOS. We detail the material stack (HfO_2-based), the FEOL/BEOL CMOS foundry-integration flow, a self-contained SPICE model, the complete memristive-FPGA neuromorphic system, and an in-memory self-attention engine with current-mode translinear softmax. Finally, a ternary BitNet datapath shows projected per-token efficiency orders of magnitude better than advanced CPUs or GPUs. The result is a self-contained hardware-native blueprint for a high-density, analog, in-memory neural processor.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论设计+器件建模+系统架构）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“physics-based design”（物理设计）、“state-variable model”（状态变量模型）、“SPICE model”（电路仿真模型）以及“assembled into a 1T1R crossbar fabric”（组装成1T1R交叉阵列）等关键词，涵盖了从底层物理模型到顶层系统集成的完整设计流程。；研究对象：基于忆阻器的多级电阻突触器件及其构成的片上神经网络系统。具体材料体系为HfO₂基忆阻器，物理现象涉及离子输运、热噪声、漂移和量子化电导。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过基于离子输运物理的状态变量模型，设计出支持准连续电导态的多级忆阻突触，并将其集成到1T1R交叉阵列中，实现了无需权重移动的模拟域片上神经网络，其能效在大型语言模型（LLM）推理任务上远超先进CPU/GPU。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过基于离子输运物理的状态变量模型，设计出支持准连续电导态的多级忆阻突触，并将其集成到1T1R交叉阵列中，实现了无需权重移动的模拟域片上神经网络，其能效在大型语言模型（LLM）推理任务上远超先进CPU/GPU。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统二进制ReRAM或CMOS方案相比的具体创新点，但可归纳为：1）提出了一个从底层物理（离子输运、噪声、量子化）到顶层系统（LLM推理、自注意力引擎）的完整、自洽的硬件原生蓝图；2）设计了支持准连续电导态的忆阻突触，并量化了其存储容量；3）实现了片上模拟域的原位学习（外积规则），消除了权重数据在存储与计算单元间的移动。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于离子输运物理的状态变量模型。设计方法：1T1R交叉阵列结构、差分突触（用于符号权重）、模拟向量-矩阵乘法（VMM）线性代数推导、原位外积学习规则及其离散化。系统架构：多层流水线（推理、反向传播、权重更新）、忆阻-FPGA神经形态系统、电流模式跨导线性Softmax、三元BitNet数据通路。仿真与集成：自洽SPICE模型、FEOL/BEOL CMOS代工厂集成流程。

papers.title: Effusivity-Controlled Interfacial Thermal Transport Revealed by Nanoscale Optical Thermometry
papers.abstract: Quantitative imaging of heat transport with high spatial and temporal resolution is essential for understanding thermal processes in heterogeneous systems, yet direct measurements of transient temperature fields at material interfaces remain challenging. Here, we employ time resolved thermal optical diffraction tomography (thermal ODT), a label free nanoscale optical thermometry technique that reconstructs spatio-temporal evolution of three dimensional temperature fields from thermally induced refractive index changes. We show that thermal diffusion along an interface is controlled by their thermal effusivity contrast. We also derive an effective interfacial diffusivity that accurately describes the lateral propagation of thermal fields and validate the model through finite-element simulations across a broad range of liquid-glass interfaces. Surprisingly, liquids with lower bulk thermal diffusivities exhibit faster interfacial thermal spreading due to their lower effusivities. The measured diffusivities agree quantitatively with theoretical predictions over diverse material combinations. By combining volumetric thermal imaging with a general framework for interfacial heat transport, our work establishes thermal ODT as a powerful platform for investigating nanoscale thermodynamics and engineering heat flow in heterogeneous environments.
