papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：time resolved thermal optical diffraction tomography、nanoscale optical thermometry、finite-element simulations）；研究对象：界面热输运现象，具体为液体-玻璃界面处的热扩散行为，以及热扩散率（effusivity）对比对界面热传输的控制作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 界面热扩散受材料间热扩散率（effusivity）对比控制；具有较低体热扩散率的液体反而因较低的热扩散率而表现出更快的界面热传播。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：界面热扩散受材料间热扩散率（effusivity）对比控制；具有较低体热扩散率的液体反而因较低的热扩散率而表现出更快的界面热传播。；创新点：首次通过纳米级光学测温直接观测并定量描述了热扩散率对比对界面热传输的控制，并推导出有效界面扩散率模型，揭示了体热扩散率与界面热传播速度之间的反直觉关系。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨热光学衍射层析成像（thermal ODT），一种无标记纳米级光学测温技术，通过热致折射率变化重建三维温度场的时空演化；并结合有限元模拟进行模型验证。

papers.title: Hierarchy of mixed symmetry protected topological states in extended cluster states under subsystem decoherence
papers.abstract: We study the effect of subsystem decoherence to an extended cluster state which is a symmetry protected topological (SPT) phase. The model includes many subsystem $Z_2$ symmetries. We report that subsystem decoherence induces local charge fluctuations, leading to a mixed SPT state in the unaffected subsystems. If we start from the extended cluster state, hierarchical mixed-state SPT phases emerge in response to step-by-step subsystem decoherences. These mixed-state SPT phases keep strong symmetries the symmetry of which is protecting symmetries for the initial cluster SPT. Moreover, these SPTs can be characterized by Rényi-2 string orders. Then, as the subsystems are progressively decohered, the hierarchy of mixed-state SPT phases terminates in a $Z_2$ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) state on the final remaining subsystem, where a long-range entangled state appears, namely a glassy Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) state. Our work demonstrates that decoherence is not merely a destructive process, but can induce and organize series of nontrivial mixed-states. This reveals a systematic route from mixed-state SPT order to SWSSB with the glassy GHZ-type long-range entanglement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“study the effect”、“report”、“demonstrate”，未提及实验或计算手段，属于理论分析。；研究对象：扩展团簇态（extended cluster state）中的对称保护拓扑（SPT）相，以及子系统退相干（subsystem decoherence）对该相的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 子系统退相干并非纯粹的破坏过程，而是可以诱导出一系列非平庸的混合态SPT相，并最终在剩余子系统中形成具有长程纠缠的玻璃态GHZ态，实现从混合态SPT序到强-弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）的系统性转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：子系统退相干并非纯粹的破坏过程，而是可以诱导出一系列非平庸的混合态SPT相，并最终在剩余子系统中形成具有长程纠缠的玻璃态GHZ态，实现从混合态SPT序到强-弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）的系统性转变。；创新点：揭示了退相干可以诱导并组织出一系列层级化的混合态SPT相，并建立了从混合态SPT序到SWSSB及玻璃态GHZ长程纠缠的系统路径。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体包括：利用子系统Z₂对称性框架，研究逐步施加子系统退相干对扩展团簇态的影响；通过Rényi-2弦序（Rényi-2 string orders）表征混合态SPT相；分析强对称性（strong symmetries）的保护作用。

papers.title: A Classical Elliptic Regularity Approach to Almost Harmonic Maps and Related Systems
papers.abstract: We establish interior regularity results for a broad class of two-dimensional nonlinear elliptic systems. Our approach isolates the core integrability mechanism within a unified abstract framework built around a Campanato-type discrete iteration scheme coupled with a Caccioppoli-type estimate. Specifically, we show that within any class of admissible pairs $(\boldsymbol{u}, \boldsymbol{f})$ that is stable under rescaling and satisfies a discrete oscillation-decay axiom, the map $\boldsymbol{u}$ is automatically locally Hölder continuous. Furthermore, the resulting Hölder exponent is explicit and optimally attains the classical Morrey--Campanato threshold dictated by the Lebesgue integrability of the source term $\boldsymbol{f}$. This purely analytic framework systematically avoids the $\mathcal{H}^1$--$\mathrm{BMO}$ duality, Wente's inequality, moving frames, and conformal uniformization techniques that underpin existing regularity theories. We apply this principle to derive regularity results in regimes lying strictly beyond the reach of existing gauge-theoretic methods. As a foundational example, we provide a new direct proof of local Hölder continuity for almost harmonic maps $-Δ\boldsymbol{u} = |\nabla \boldsymbol{u}|^2 \boldsymbol{u} + \boldsymbol{f}$ into $\mathbb{S}^n$ with $L^q$-integrable tension fields. We then extend the analysis to systems of the form $-Δ\boldsymbol{u} = Ω\cdot \nabla \boldsymbol{u} + \boldsymbol{f}$, replacing geometric antisymmetry assumption on the connection form $Ω\in L^2$ with the purely analytic condition $\mathrm{div} Ω\in L^q$ for some $q>1$...
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“建立内部正则性结果”、“统一抽象框架”、“Campanato型离散迭代方案”等纯数学分析工具，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：二维非线性椭圆系统，特别是几乎调和映射（almost harmonic maps）及相关系统，如 $-Δ\boldsymbol{u} = |\nabla \boldsymbol{u}|^2 \boldsymbol{u} + \boldsymbol{f}$（映射到 $\mathbb{S}^n$）和 $-Δ\boldsymbol{u} = Ω\cdot \nabla \boldsymbol{u} + \boldsymbol{f}$ 等。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于一大类二维非线性椭圆系统，只要满足重标度稳定性及离散振荡衰减公理，映射 $\boldsymbol{u}$ 自动具有局部 Hölder 连续性，且 Hölder 指数达到由源项 $\boldsymbol{f}$ 的 Lebesgue 可积性决定的经典 Morrey–Campanato 阈值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于一大类二维非线性椭圆系统，只要满足重标度稳定性及离散振荡衰减公理，映射 $\boldsymbol{u}$ 自动具有局部 Hölder 连续性，且 Hölder 指数达到由源项 $\boldsymbol{f}$ 的 Lebesgue 可积性决定的经典 Morrey–Campanato 阈值。；创新点：该工作完全绕过了现有规范理论方法（如几何反对称性假设）的限制，将正则性分析推广到传统方法无法处理的参数区域。例如，对连接形式 $Ω\in L^2$ 的系统，仅需 $\mathrm{div} Ω\in L^q$（$q>1$）这一纯分析条件即可建立正则性，而无需几何反对称性假设。
papers.method_zh: 采用纯解析框架：基于 Campanato 型离散迭代方案与 Caccioppoli 型估计，建立统一的抽象正则性理论。该方法系统性地避免了 $\mathcal{H}^1$–BMO 对偶、Wente 不等式、活动标架及共形均匀化等传统技术。

papers.title: Kinetics of multistate DNA polymerases
papers.abstract: In the present paper, we apply the iterative mathematical method previously developed for the kinetics of template-directed multistate copolymerization to the kinetics of DNA replication by polymerases having multiple structural states. In particular, we study a two-state kinetic model for the T7 DNA polymerase. We obtain the mean velocity for the growth of the copy along the template, the error probability of DNA replication by the polymerase, and the local probabilities of base-pair formation along the template sequence. Furthermore, we show that the iterative method is more than a million times faster than usual numerical simulation methods. Results are also obtained in the approximation of homogenization of template heterogeneities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“iterative mathematical method”、“kinetic model”、“obtain the mean velocity”、“error probability”。；研究对象：多状态DNA聚合酶的动力学过程，具体以T7 DNA聚合酶的两态动力学模型为研究对象，研究其沿模板进行DNA复制的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过迭代数学方法，获得了多状态DNA聚合酶沿模板生长的平均速度、复制错误概率以及沿模板序列的碱基对形成局部概率；该方法比常规数值模拟方法快一百万倍以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过迭代数学方法，获得了多状态DNA聚合酶沿模板生长的平均速度、复制错误概率以及沿模板序列的碱基对形成局部概率；该方法比常规数值模拟方法快一百万倍以上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用先前为模板指导的多态共聚动力学开发的迭代数学方法，对多结构状态的DNA聚合酶复制动力学进行分析，并在模板异质性均匀化近似下获得结果。

papers.title: Kinetics of template-directed multistate copolymerization
papers.abstract: We consider processes of template-directed multistate copolymerization by molecular machines such as polymerases or ribosomes, having multiple states of conformation or activation. We show that the kinetic equations of these processes can be exactly solved for the mean growth velocity, the sequence probabilities of the grown copy, and the local probabilities and fractions of monomeric units in the copy. Asymptotically, in the long-time limit, the kinetic equations are solved with a matrix factorization ansatz in terms of a backward iteration, forming an iterated matrix function system, and a complementary forward iteration, both running along the template sequence. The iterative method is very significantly faster than usual computational methods, as demonstrated with a numerical example.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“kinetic equations”、“exactly solved”、“matrix factorization ansatz”、“iterative method”。；研究对象：模板指导的多态共聚反应动力学，具体涉及分子机器（如聚合酶或核糖体）在具有多种构象或激活状态下的共聚过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模板指导的多态共聚反应的动力学方程可以精确求解，得到平均生长速度、复制链的序列概率以及复制链中单体单元的局域概率和分数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模板指导的多态共聚反应的动力学方程可以精确求解，得到平均生长速度、复制链的序列概率以及复制链中单体单元的局域概率和分数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用矩阵分解假设（matrix factorization ansatz），通过沿模板序列进行的反向迭代（构成迭代矩阵函数系统）和互补的正向迭代来求解动力学方程，并利用数值示例验证了该迭代方法比常规计算方法快得多。

papers.title: Data-driven geometric phase in biological locomotion
papers.abstract: Geometric phase quantifies net locomotion in dissipative media via gauge theory, but linking this theoretical quantity to noisy, sparse, and weakly periodic biological shape data is challenging. We develop a theory-guided, data-driven Koopman autoencoder to recover the limit cycle embedded in imperfect cyclic data and extract shape gaits and geometric phase from sperm and nematode data. We introduce a geometric phase sensitivity function that quantifies responses to shape perturbations and reveals mechanical information using only gauge-theoretic structure, without assuming mechanical laws.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：gauge theory、theory-guided、data-driven、Koopman autoencoder）；研究对象：生物运动中的几何相位，具体以精子（sperm）和线虫（nematode）的形态数据为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过数据驱动的Koopman自编码器，可从噪声、稀疏且弱周期性的生物形态数据中恢复极限环，提取形态步态和几何相位；并引入几何相位敏感函数，仅利用规范理论结构即可量化形态扰动对运动的影响，无需假设力学定律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过数据驱动的Koopman自编码器，可从噪声、稀疏且弱周期性的生物形态数据中恢复极限环，提取形态步态和几何相位；并引入几何相位敏感函数，仅利用规范理论结构即可量化形态扰动对运动的影响，无需假设力学定律。；创新点：将规范理论中的几何相位概念与数据驱动方法结合，从实际生物运动数据中提取几何相位，并引入无需力学定律的几何相位敏感函数来揭示机械信息。
papers.method_zh: 理论指导的数据驱动方法：Koopman自编码器（Koopman autoencoder），用于从不完美周期数据中提取极限环和几何相位；并定义了几何相位敏感函数。

papers.title: SVGym (SciVerseGym): An Environment for Reinforcement Learning and Bayesian Optimization in Crystal Discovery
papers.abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials now enable efficient atomistic evaluation for interactive materials discovery, yet closed-loop crystal search methods remain fragmented across bespoke pipelines for editing, relaxation, scoring, constraints, and bookkeeping. We introduce SciVerseGym, a Gymnasium-compatible environment for sequential crystal discovery that frames crystal design as a Markov decision process. Agents observe an atomistic structure, apply chemically meaningful edits, and receive feedback from a configurable evaluator. SciVerseGym supports local and global actions, including elemental substitution, lattice perturbation, atomic displacement, vacancy creation, and atom insertion, along with configurable chemical spaces, structure pools, atomistic and graph-based observations, custom rewards, optional relaxation, and stability or phonon-related diagnostics. Each step applies an edit, evaluates the candidate using a machine-learned interatomic potential or any ASE-compatible calculator, and returns the standard (obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info) tuple. By decoupling agent logic from materials infrastructure, SciVerseGym provides an open, reproducible, and extensible testbed for reinforcement learning, Bayesian optimization, evolutionary search, and language-agent workflows in closed-loop crystal discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/Bin-Cao/SciVerseGym.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：machine-learned interatomic potentials、reinforcement learning、Bayesian optimization、closed-loop crystal discovery。；研究对象：晶体材料的发现与设计过程，具体为将晶体设计建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并提供一个用于强化学习、贝叶斯优化等算法的测试环境。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献是提出了一个名为SciVerseGym的开放、可复现、可扩展的晶体发现环境。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现，主要贡献是提出了一个名为SciVerseGym的开放、可复现、可扩展的晶体发现环境。；创新点：将原本分散在定制化流程中的晶体搜索方法（编辑、弛豫、评分、约束、记录）统一到一个标准化的、与智能体逻辑解耦的测试环境中，为强化学习、贝叶斯优化、进化搜索和语言智能体工作流在闭环晶体发现中的应用提供了通用平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用Gymnasium兼容的环境框架，将晶体设计转化为序列决策问题。支持局部和全局原子编辑操作（元素替换、晶格扰动、原子位移、空位创建、原子插入），使用机器学习原子间势或任何ASE兼容的计算器进行候选结构评估，并支持可配置的化学空间、结构池、观测方式、奖励函数、结构弛豫及稳定性/声子诊断。

papers.title: Structural and physical properties of gyromorphs and disordered stealthy hyperuniform media
papers.abstract: Disordered stealthy hyperuniform materials combine liquid-like statistical isotropy with crystal-like homogeneity, suppressed density fluctuations at large length scales, bounded holes, and an isotropic structure factor that vanishes for a finite range of wavevectors. This combination yields unusual physical properties, including optical transparency, effective delocalization, ultrafast spreadability, optimal conductivity, and complete isotropic photonic bandgaps. Gyromorphs, point patterns whose structure factor includes rings of Bragg-like peaks arranged with discrete $G$-fold rotational symmetry, were recently introduced as counterexamples: disordered media that can somehow achieve the same physical properties, in some cases with higher performance, without stealthiness or hyperuniformity. In this paper, we resolve the puzzle of how gyromorphs fit consistently with the stealthy hyperuniform studies. We first show that gyromorphs are actually hyperuniform and, in the large-$G$ limit where they become nearly isotropic, belong to the weakest form of hyperuniformity, known as Class III. Thus, gyromorphs should have comparatively degraded physical properties compared to stealthy hyperuniform media, which belong to the strongest form of hyperuniformity, known as Class I. We verify this expectation using the rigorous spectral Green's matrix method for the calculation of the density of states (DOS) and Purcell factors in large arrays of electric dipoles. We find that gyromorphs display size-dependent pseudogaps richly populated by localized states rather than smooth band gaps like those found for highly stealthy hyperuniform materials or in deterministic structures such as Vogel spiral and triangular lattices. Furthermore, we predict similar disorder-induced degradation relative to stealthy hyperuniformity with regard to transparency, spreadability and diffusion properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：spectral Green’s matrix method、计算 density of states、理论分析 hyperuniformity 分类）；研究对象：无序超均匀材料（disordered stealthy hyperuniform media）与 gyromorphs（具有离散旋转对称性布拉格峰环的点图案）的结构与物理性质对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Gyromorphs 实际上属于最弱形式的超均匀性（Class III），而非之前认为的非超均匀体系；因此其物理性能（如光子带隙、透明度、扩散性）相对于最强超均匀性（Class I）的 stealthy hyperuniform 材料存在退化，表现为尺寸依赖的赝能隙和局域态，而非平滑带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Gyromorphs 实际上属于最弱形式的超均匀性（Class III），而非之前认为的非超均匀体系；因此其物理性能（如光子带隙、透明度、扩散性）相对于最强超均匀性（Class I）的 stealthy hyperuniform 材料存在退化，表现为尺寸依赖的赝能隙和局域态，而非平滑带隙。；创新点：解决了 gyromorphs 与 stealthy hyperuniform 研究之间看似矛盾的谜题，首次明确 gyromorphs 属于 Class III 超均匀性，并系统预测了其物理性能相对于 Class I 材料的退化。
papers.method_zh: 使用严格的谱格林矩阵方法（spectral Green’s matrix method）计算大尺度电偶极子阵列的态密度（DOS）和 Purcell 因子；通过结构因子分析超均匀性分类。

papers.title: Glass-based physical models for tissue mechanics
papers.abstract: Techniques from glass art and fabrication provide a controllable physical platform for studying tissue mechanics in simple organisms. Here, we use glass-based physical models to investigate tissue deformation in the marine organism Trichoplax adhaerens. Previous studies have shown that the epithelial tissues in T. adhaerens undergo large deformations and form fracture holes under mechanical loading, exhibiting a ductile-to-brittle transition at fast loading rates. To model these behaviors in a tunable and experimentally accessible system, glass is shaped into tissue-like monolayers in a glass studio, heated to its specific process temperature, and subjected to controlled stretching. Rapid cooling arrests the deformed configurations, providing snapshots of tissue-like strain states under load. Under lateral and radial stretching, we quantify changes in the area and eccentricity of individual "cells" in the glass models, and found that eccentricity increases after stretching. We further use tensegrity-based models to quantify deformations in the cellular geometry of the glass tissues, enabling direct comparison between experiments and simulations. The model captures the principal experimental deformation patterns, but underestimates the magnitude of the observed eccentricity changes. Our results demonstrate that glass-based physical models provide an experimentally accessible platform for studying tissue-scale deformation and mechanical behavior, while supporting interdisciplinary approaches that connect methods in the arts and sciences.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：glass-based physical models、experimentally accessible platform、controlled stretching、quantify changes）；研究对象：海洋生物Trichoplax adhaerens的上皮组织在力学加载下的变形行为，以及用玻璃物理模型模拟该组织的力学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻璃基物理模型能够复现Trichoplax adhaerens组织在拉伸下的主要变形模式（如细胞偏心率的增加），但模型低估了实验观察到的偏心率变化幅度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻璃基物理模型能够复现Trichoplax adhaerens组织在拉伸下的主要变形模式（如细胞偏心率的增加），但模型低估了实验观察到的偏心率变化幅度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 在玻璃工作室将玻璃塑造成组织状单层膜，加热至特定工艺温度后进行受控拉伸，通过快速冷却冻结变形构型；使用张拉整体（tensegrity）模型量化玻璃组织中单个“细胞”的几何变形（面积和偏心率），并与实验变形模式进行直接比较。

papers.title: Crust glass formation reveals the neutron star birth properties in IGR J17480-2446
papers.abstract: IGR J17480-2446 is a low-mass X-ray binary, harboring an exceptional accreting pulsar (a neutron star) with an unusual spin frequency of 11 Hz and a very slow post-outburst crust cooling. The former may imply that it is observed at an early stage of recycling, while the latter was shown to indicate the presence in the outer crust of a low thermal conductivity layer, possibly made of glass. Here we argue that the glass layer formation is a natural result of accretion induced failure of pristine cold crystal crust. This allows us to determine the mass of the accreted material as $ΔM \approx 2.4\times 10^{-6}~M_\odot$, confirming very early accretion stage for this neutron star. An analysis of spin and thermal state reveals a peculiar set of neutron star birth properties which is commonly associated with `recycled' neutron stars, i.e.\ those that have been experiencing prolonged periods of accretion from a companion. We speculate that such birth properties may represent the outcome of neutron star formation in an electron-capture supernova.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“argue”、“analysis”、“speculate”等理论推理和推测性词汇，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：中子星IGR J17480-2446的壳层玻璃形成机制及其与中子星诞生性质的关系。具体物理现象包括：吸积脉冲星的自旋频率（11 Hz）、爆发后壳层缓慢冷却、以及外壳中低热导率玻璃层的形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 玻璃层的形成是吸积导致原始冷晶壳层破坏的自然结果，由此确定该中子星吸积物质质量约为2.4×10⁻⁶ M☉，证实其处于极早期吸积阶段；其自旋与热态揭示的诞生性质与“再循环”中子星（即长期吸积的中子星）相似，可能源于电子俘获超新星。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：玻璃层的形成是吸积导致原始冷晶壳层破坏的自然结果，由此确定该中子星吸积物质质量约为2.4×10⁻⁶ M☉，证实其处于极早期吸积阶段；其自旋与热态揭示的诞生性质与“再循环”中子星（即长期吸积的中子星）相似，可能源于电子俘获超新星。；创新点：首次将IGR J17480-2446的异常缓慢壳层冷却归因于吸积导致的晶壳玻璃化，并利用该机制定量约束吸积质量，从而确认其极早期吸积阶段；提出其诞生性质可能与电子俘获超新星相关。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于吸积诱导的原始晶壳破坏模型，结合观测到的自旋频率（11 Hz）和壳层冷却数据，推导吸积物质质量；通过自旋与热态分析推断中子星诞生性质。

papers.title: On Potentials and Complementary Potentials in One-Dimensional Nonlocal Integral Formulations
papers.abstract: The present research presents potentials and complementary potentials used in the one-dimensional nonlocal integral formulations. The pure stress and the pure strain nonlocal formulations were considered. While the potential used in the strain driven formulation is well known, the complementary potential has not yet been presented in the literature. The same applies to the stress driven formulation. The equivalent formulations are obtained by resorting to the Legendre transformation, and their equivalence is proved. It is also shown that these results can be used to postulate a novel potential, i.e. a kind of mixed stress-strain potential, which is, however, as ill-conditioned as the pure strain-driven formulation. Finally, an example is given that practically confirms that the stress-driven formulations resulting from the potential and the complementary potential are equivalent.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：nonlocal integral formulations、Legendre transformation、potential、complementary potential。；研究对象：一维非局部积分公式中的势与互补势，具体涉及纯应力驱动和纯应变驱动的非局部公式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次提出了一维非局部积分公式中应变驱动和应力驱动公式的互补势，并通过勒让德变换证明了其等价性；同时指出一种混合应力-应变势虽然可被提出，但会像纯应变驱动公式一样病态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次提出了一维非局部积分公式中应变驱动和应力驱动公式的互补势，并通过勒让德变换证明了其等价性；同时指出一种混合应力-应变势虽然可被提出，但会像纯应变驱动公式一样病态。；创新点：首次在文献中给出非局部积分公式中应变驱动和应力驱动公式的互补势，并证明其与原有势的等价性；此外提出一种混合应力-应变势，但指出其病态性。
papers.method_zh: 采用勒让德变换（Legendre transformation）推导等价公式，并通过数学证明和实例验证势与互补势的等价性。

papers.title: Machine Learning Optimal Quantum Error Correction Thresholds
papers.abstract: As quantum computers remain susceptible to noise, QEC is essential for preserving logical information during computations. However, the performance of QEC codes breaks down beyond certain noise thresholds, revealing fundamental limits on their ability to protect quantum information. These limits can be characterized using information-theoretic measures such as the coherent information, which quantifies the maximum rate at which logical information can be reliably transmitted through a noisy quantum channel. In this work, we establish a direct connection between the CI and the binary cross-entropy loss used when training neural network decoders. Specifically, we show that the CI constitutes a sharp lower bound on the achievable loss for decoders that track logical operators across noisy channels. To this end, we develop a transformer-based neural network model based on maximum likelihood decoding. We train this network to estimate the CI and evaluate its performance on the surface code under three noise models: code capacity, phenomenological, and circuit-level noise. Our results demonstrate that the network accurately predicts CI and yields threshold estimates that closely match known theoretical limits. When used as a decoder, the network significantly outperforms the minimum weight perfect matching decoder in terms of logical error rate. We also introduce a novel soft post-selection scheme that independently treats uncertainty in both logical operators and relies on confidence-based filtering of the network's output. We prove that such post-selection strategies, based on the MLD cosets, are optimal, and demonstrate their scalability in terms of both logical error rate and abort probability. These findings establish transformer-based architectures as powerful tools for QEC and provide the first numerical evidence supporting the optimality and scalability of MLD-based post-selection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：information-theoretic measures、neural network decoders、transformer-based neural network model、numerical evidence。；研究对象：量子纠错（QEC）中的噪声阈值，具体以表面码（surface code）为测试体系，研究在三种噪声模型（code capacity、phenomenological、circuit-level noise）下的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了相干信息（coherent information, CI）与神经网络解码器训练中使用的二元交叉熵损失之间的直接联系，证明CI是解码器可实现损失的一个严格下界；基于最大似然解码（MLD）的变压器网络能准确预测CI，并给出与已知理论极限高度吻合的阈值估计，在逻辑错误率上显著优于最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）解码器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了相干信息（coherent information, CI）与神经网络解码器训练中使用的二元交叉熵损失之间的直接联系，证明CI是解码器可实现损失的一个严格下界；基于最大似然解码（MLD）的变压器网络能准确预测CI，并给出与已知理论极限高度吻合的阈值估计，在逻辑错误率上显著优于最小权重完美匹配（MWPM）解码器。；创新点：首次将相干信息与神经网络解码器的损失函数直接关联，并提供了基于MLD的后选择策略在最优性和可扩展性上的首个数值证据；展示了transformer架构在量子纠错中的强大能力。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（建立CI与交叉熵损失的下界关系）；数值模拟（训练基于transformer的神经网络模型，用于估计CI并作为解码器）；引入一种新颖的软后选择（soft post-selection）方案，基于MLD陪集进行置信度过滤，并证明其最优性与可扩展性。

papers.title: Electromagnetic Characterization of Magnetic Bar: Case of Square Cross-Section Shape
papers.abstract: This paper presents a complete two-dimensional theoretical model for the electromagnetic behavior of square-section solid magnetic bars under sinusoidal loading. Through the application of Maxwell's equations within a Cartesian coordinate system and the integration of complex permeability, exact mathematical expressions are derived for mutual impedance, internal magnetic fields, flux, and core losses. Hyperbolic functions are utilized to separate the variables, enabling the accurate representation of edge flux accumulation and the 2D skin effect. In addition to mathematically decoupling eddy current and hysteresis losses, this formulation yields a new apparent permeability parameter. This parameter establishes a fast, reliable method for magnetic steel characterization that bypasses the extensive processing times associated with Finite Element Analysis (FEA). Numerical results over 1 Hz-1 MHz show the apparent relative permeability decreasing from 500 to 300 and a characteristic resistance peak near 700 kHz, marking the transition from volumetric to surface-dominated loss regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical model、Maxwell's equations、mathematical expressions、numerical results。；研究对象：具有方形截面的实心磁性棒（square-section solid magnetic bars）在正弦激励下的电磁行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出方形截面磁性棒的互阻抗、内部磁场、磁通和铁芯损耗的精确数学表达式，并发现表观相对磁导率在1 Hz–1 MHz范围内从500降至300，且在约700 kHz处出现特征电阻峰值，标志着损耗从体相主导转变为表面主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出方形截面磁性棒的互阻抗、内部磁场、磁通和铁芯损耗的精确数学表达式，并发现表观相对磁导率在1 Hz–1 MHz范围内从500降至300，且在约700 kHz处出现特征电阻峰值，标志着损耗从体相主导转变为表面主导。；创新点：提出了一种绕过有限元分析（FEA）的快速、可靠的磁性钢表征方法，通过新定义的表观磁导率参数实现。摘要未突出说明与已有理论模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于笛卡尔坐标系下的麦克斯韦方程组，结合复磁导率（complex permeability），利用双曲函数分离变量，推导出解析表达式。通过数学方法将涡流损耗和磁滞损耗解耦，并定义了一个新的表观磁导率参数。

papers.title: Accurate identification and measurement of the precipitate area by two-stage deep neural networks in novel chromium-based alloys
papers.abstract: The performance of advanced materials for extreme environments is underpinned by their microstructure, including the size and distribution of reinforcing phases. Chromium-based superalloys are a recently proposed alternative to conventional face-centred-cubic superalloys for high-temperature applications, such as Concentrated Solar Power, and their development requires efficient measurement of precipitate volume fraction and size distribution from electron microscopy images. Traditional fixed-threshold image processing is sensitive to background noise, generalises poorly across materials, and requires substantial manual measurement effort. To address these bottlenecks, this study proposes DT-SegNet, an end-to-end two-stage deep learning scheme based on YOLOv5 and SegFormer for object detection and segmentation in electron microscopy images. The approach combines the training efficiency of convolutional neural networks at the detection stage with the segmentation accuracy of a Vision Transformer. Numerical experiments show that DT-SegNet substantially outperforms state-of-the-art segmentation tools offered by Weka and ilastik across metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The model provides a useful tool for alloy-development microstructure examinations and helps address the large datasets associated with high-throughput alloy development.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：electron microscopy images、numerical experiments、deep learning scheme）；研究对象：新型铬基高温合金（chromium-based superalloys）中析出相（precipitate）的面积识别与测量，具体关注析出相的体积分数和尺寸分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为DT-SegNet的两阶段深度学习方案（基于YOLOv5和SegFormer），在电子显微镜图像中对析出相进行目标检测与分割，其准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数均显著优于Weka和ilastik等现有分割工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为DT-SegNet的两阶段深度学习方案（基于YOLOv5和SegFormer），在电子显微镜图像中对析出相进行目标检测与分割，其准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数均显著优于Weka和ilastik等现有分割工具。；创新点：将卷积神经网络的训练效率与视觉Transformer的分割精度相结合，构建了针对电子显微镜图像中析出相识别与测量的专用两阶段深度学习方案，解决了传统固定阈值图像处理方法对背景噪声敏感、泛化能力差且需要大量人工测量的问题。
papers.method_zh: 采用端到端的两阶段深度学习框架：第一阶段使用卷积神经网络YOLOv5进行目标检测，第二阶段使用视觉Transformer SegFormer进行图像分割。通过数值实验对比了该方法与Weka、ilastik等工具的性能。

papers.title: Transient Information Partition in Coherent Exciton-Phonon-Photon Dynamics
papers.abstract: We study transient information partition in a coherent exciton-phonon-photon system using subsystem-resolved quantum mutual information (QMI). By employing a model with excitonic, phononic, and photonic degrees of freedom, we analyze the dynamics in the $J$-$ν$ plane, where $J$ characterizes excitonic delocalization and $ν$ denotes the exciton-phonon coupling strength. By comparing time-averaged QMI maps with the absorbed photon number, we show that optical activity alone does not determine the character of the light-induced transient state. The exciton-centered information partition identifies a broad crossover between polariton-like and polaron-like transient responses, depending on whether excitonic information is mainly shared with the photon or phonon subsystem. In contrast, the phonon-centered partition reveals a sharper boundary-adjacent redistribution ridge near the boundary between the zero- and one-exciton ground-state sectors. This ridge is absent from both the ground-state sector map and the photon-absorption map, indicating that it is neither a static sector boundary nor an enhancement of optical absorption. A variational strength-function analysis connects the ridge to a region-II-like finite-energy polaronic excitation whose dominant spectral weight lies near the one-phonon energy, and thus the ridge represents a hidden transient correlation structure in which a limited amount of phonon-related information is preferentially shared with the photon subsystem before being predominantly allocated to exciton-phonon dressing. These results show that QMI-based information partition provides a correlation-based framework for characterizing coherent light-induced transient states in which optical and material degrees of freedom jointly participate quantum mechanically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：subsystem-resolved quantum mutual information (QMI)、model、variational strength-function analysis。；研究对象：激子-声子-光子相干系统中的瞬态信息分配，具体研究激子离域化参数J与激子-声子耦合强度ν构成的参数平面上的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于量子互信息的信息分配揭示了光致瞬态态中一种隐藏的瞬态关联结构（ridge），该结构既非基态扇区边界也非光吸收增强，而是与有限能量极化子激发相关，其中有限声子信息优先与光子子系统共享，随后主要分配给激子-声子 dressing。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于量子互信息的信息分配揭示了光致瞬态态中一种隐藏的瞬态关联结构（ridge），该结构既非基态扇区边界也非光吸收增强，而是与有限能量极化子激发相关，其中有限声子信息优先与光子子系统共享，随后主要分配给激子-声子 dressing。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用子系统分辨的量子互信息（QMI）分析激子-声子-光子模型；通过比较时间平均QMI图与吸收光子数进行对比；使用变分强度函数分析（variational strength-function analysis）识别关联结构的起源。

papers.title: Effect of rewiring for a sandpile model on a directed network
papers.abstract: Several studies have considered sandpile dynamics not over regular grids, but over networks. In this case, avalanches redistribute grains not between neighboring sites in a geometrical sense, but between connected sites, in a topological sense. However, depending on how nodes are connected, grains may never leave the system, preventing energy release. In this work, we study the simplest case, the BTW model in one and two dimensions, rewiring the nodes so that at every rewiring step, the energy release is always possible, and study avalanche statistics as a function of rewiring. In the 1D case, a transition is observed in the Gini coefficient of the load distribution per node at about 85% the number of possible rewirings, a transition which is not evident with other measures, such as the size distribution of avalanches or the mean distance between nodes in the network. In the 2D case, energy release follows a power law even when the grid is fully rewired, while the Gini coefficient, unlike the 1D case, decreases at a steady rate, with a smoother transition. The effect of network size N is studied, finding that there is a transition for the Gini coefficient at the thermodynamic limit N \to \infty for both the 1D and 2D cases, transition which is also observed in the betweenness centrality, but not in other topological measures. Finally, the dependence of the results with the load per rewiring iteration, and the avalanche threshold is studied.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：sandpile model（沙堆模型）、rewiring（重连）、avalanche statistics（雪崩统计）、Gini coefficient（基尼系数）。；研究对象：在一维和二维有向网络上运行的BTW沙堆模型，研究网络重连对雪崩动力学和能量释放的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一维情况下，节点负载分布的基尼系数在约85%可能重连数处出现相变，而雪崩尺寸分布等其它测量未显示该转变；在二维情况下，即使完全重连，能量释放仍遵循幂律，基尼系数以更平滑的方式稳定下降。两种维度下，热力学极限（N→∞）时基尼系数均存在相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一维情况下，节点负载分布的基尼系数在约85%可能重连数处出现相变，而雪崩尺寸分布等其它测量未显示该转变；在二维情况下，即使完全重连，能量释放仍遵循幂律，基尼系数以更平滑的方式稳定下降。两种维度下，热力学极限（N→∞）时基尼系数均存在相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用BTW沙堆模型，在一维和二维规则网格基础上进行有向网络重连（rewiring），确保每次重连后能量释放始终可能。通过数值模拟统计雪崩尺寸分布、节点间平均距离、基尼系数、介数中心性等拓扑与动力学量，并研究系统尺寸N、每次重连负载量及雪崩阈值的影响。

papers.title: Distance from home matters: Investigation of a basic movement strategy
papers.abstract: Discovering the fundamental dynamical rules that generate the main statistical features of human mobility is essential for understanding the mechanisms underlying such processes. A prominent example is the exploration and preferential return model and its generalizations, which successfully reproduce several empirical findings. Here, we exploit another observation: the endpoint distances of a trip from the trajectory's starting point are strongly correlated. We consider a movement process in which each user performs a sequence of trips to satisfy a set of demands, given a spatial distribution of suppliers on a two-dimensional lattice. In each trip, destinations are chosen with a probability that depends on the ratio of the initial and final distances from the user's origin (home). We show that even a single agent with uniformly distributed demands and suppliers qualitatively reproduces key empirical statistics, such as the power-law distribution of traveled distances. The results are also robust to introducing interactions between agents via queues and incorporating more realistic demand and supplier distributions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：movement process、probability、model、simulation）；研究对象：人类移动行为的基本动力学规则，具体为个体在二维格点上基于“家”位置进行行程选择的过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅考虑单个智能体，在需求与供应商均匀分布的条件下，仅依据行程起点与终点到“家”的距离比值来选择目的地，即可定性复现人类移动的关键统计特征（如行程距离的幂律分布）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅考虑单个智能体，在需求与供应商均匀分布的条件下，仅依据行程起点与终点到“家”的距离比值来选择目的地，即可定性复现人类移动的关键统计特征（如行程距离的幂律分布）。；创新点：提出并验证了“行程端点距家距离的强相关性”作为基本运动策略，而非依赖传统的探索与优先返回机制。
papers.method_zh: 构建基于二维格点的随机运动模型，其中每次行程的目的地选择概率由起点和终点到“家”的距离比值决定；通过数值模拟分析单智能体行为，并进一步引入队列交互及非均匀需求/供应商分布检验鲁棒性。

papers.title: The impedance of a charged flat-plate electric double-layer capacitor
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Finite Element Method simulations（有限元模拟）、modified Poisson–Nernst–Planck equations（修正的泊松-能斯特-普朗克方程）、等效电路分析。；研究对象：平板电极双电层电容器的阻抗特性，具体研究偏置电压（U_bias≠0）和阴阳离子扩散系数差异（D_-≠D_+）对阻抗谱的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现阻抗谱中倾斜线的出现源于双极性盐扩散，并否定了此前关于该斜线宽度代表双电层电阻、斜率代表扩散与充电时间尺度比值的两种观点；提出了两种等效电路模型，建立了Warburg预因子与体电解质化学电容、双电层微分电荷效率等物理量的定量关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现阻抗谱中倾斜线的出现源于双极性盐扩散，并否定了此前关于该斜线宽度代表双电层电阻、斜率代表扩散与充电时间尺度比值的两种观点；提出了两种等效电路模型，建立了Warburg预因子与体电解质化学电容、双电层微分电荷效率等物理量的定量关系。；创新点：否定了此前文献中关于斜线宽度和斜率的两种错误解释；针对D_-≠D_+和U_bias≠0两种情形分别提出Warburg短/开元件的等效电路，并给出Warburg预因子与双极性扩散系数、体化学电容、双电层微分电荷效率的定量关系；解释了斜线宽度在大偏压下饱和、在高离子堆积分数下消失以及闭系统中总电容受离子数量限制的物理原因。
papers.method_zh: 采用有限元方法模拟修正的泊松-能斯特-普朗克方程，计算阻抗谱；通过Nyquist图分析频率响应，结合浓度扰动分析确认物理机制；基于阻抗数据提出等效电路模型（Warburg短元件和Warburg开元件）进行定量分析。

papers.title: Revisiting Theoretical Modeling of Seebeck Coefficient of Semiconductors
papers.abstract: We revisit the closed-form models of Seebeck coefficient, and identify the thermodynamic flaws in those extensively-used methodologies, essentially including the confusion of electrochemical potential and electrical potential within the definition, arbitrarily neglecting the dependence on conduction band bottom and Fermi level when calculating distribution function spatial gradient, and the improper heat flux presentation. Here, an alternative methodology is presented, which derives the Seebeck coefficient model based on the drift-diffusion equation with the Soret effect in the open circuit condition. The reversible model that eliminates the electron velocity and relaxation terms in the formulation is recovered for the band term in the near-equilibrium case, and it can give the lower bound of Seebeck coefficient in theory, while the phonon-drag term is of the identical form to the Boltzmann transport equation(BTE)-based one. A case study is performed for highly-n-doped Silicon, where the reversible, ballistic(based on Landauer formulation) and BTE models are compared with each other and with the experimental data. The reversible model gives the fairly-good predictions for the experiments. Given its theoretical-soundness, simple form and low computation cost, the reversible model can serve as a concise alternative for evaluating thermoelectric properties in both the reversible and near-equilibrium cases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“revisit the closed-form models”、“derive the Seebeck coefficient model”、“present an alternative methodology”，属于理论建模与推导。；研究对象：半导体材料的Seebeck系数（热电输运现象）。具体案例为高掺杂n型硅（highly-n-doped Silicon）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 现有广泛使用的Seebeck系数封闭形式模型存在热力学缺陷（如混淆电化学势与电势、忽略导带底和费米能级对分布函数空间梯度的影响等）。作者提出的基于漂移-扩散方程与Soret效应的可逆模型在近平衡条件下能给出Seebeck系数的理论下界，且与实验数据吻合良好。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：现有广泛使用的Seebeck系数封闭形式模型存在热力学缺陷（如混淆电化学势与电势、忽略导带底和费米能级对分布函数空间梯度的影响等）。作者提出的基于漂移-扩散方程与Soret效应的可逆模型在近平衡条件下能给出Seebeck系数的理论下界，且与实验数据吻合良好。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可归纳为：指出了现有Seebeck系数建模中的热力学不一致性，并提供了一个在理论上更自洽、形式简单且计算成本低的可逆模型，作为评估热电性质的简洁替代方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：基于漂移-扩散方程（drift-diffusion equation）并引入Soret效应（热扩散效应），在开路条件下推导Seebeck系数模型。案例对比中使用了可逆模型、弹道模型（基于Landauer公式）和玻尔兹曼输运方程（BTE）模型，并与实验数据进行比较。

papers.title: Prethermal cooling with many-body quantum quenches
papers.abstract: Many-body quantum quenches are typically associated with heating. In this work, we show that quantum quenches that perform positive work on the system can still lead to effective cooling of low-energy degrees of freedom if the quench energy is deposited in long-lived high-energy excitations. We discuss this explicitly for a quench of the hopping term t in the strong-coupling (U >> t) fermionic Hubbard model at half filling, where the quench induces a very long-lived non-equilibrium doublon density. The associated prethermal state persists for a time exponentially large in (U/t)^2. During this time window, we find an effective prethermal temperature that is reduced by the square of the ratio of final to initial hopping amplitude with respect to the initial temperature. This manifests as an effective fluctuation-dissipation relation that holds for doublon-number conserving operators. In a practical implementation the Hubbard system acts as a refrigerant to cool a target system provided the coupling conserves doublon number. Our protocol can be thought of as a quantum quench many-body generalization of adiabatic demagnetization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“我们证明”、“我们讨论”、“我们发现”等理论推导和概念阐述的表述，未提及任何实验或计算模拟细节。；研究对象：强关联费米子体系中的量子淬火动力学，具体为半满填充下强耦合（U >> t）费米子哈伯德模型中的非平衡态冷却现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在量子淬火中，即使对系统做正功（注入能量），只要该能量被储存在长寿命的高能激发（如双占据子）中，就可以实现对低能自由度的有效冷却。该预热态的温度相对于初始温度，降低了最终与初始跃迁振幅之比的平方。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在量子淬火中，即使对系统做正功（注入能量），只要该能量被储存在长寿命的高能激发（如双占据子）中，就可以实现对低能自由度的有效冷却。该预热态的温度相对于初始温度，降低了最终与初始跃迁振幅之比的平方。；创新点：提出了一个将量子淬火（通常与加热相关）用于冷却的新范式，并将其类比为多体系统中的“绝热去磁”过程。该方案利用预热态的长时间存在性，为通过耦合一个“制冷剂”（哈伯德系统）来冷却目标系统提供了理论依据。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析。具体框架包括：对强耦合费米子哈伯德模型（U >> t）中跃迁项t进行量子淬火；利用预热态（prethermal state）的概念，分析双占据子（doublon）的长寿命非平衡密度；推导并应用了针对双占据数守恒算符的有效涨落-耗散关系。

papers.title: Semi-Analytical Pricing for General Default Intensity Models
papers.abstract: Using the path-integral formalism, we develop an accurate and easy-to-compute semi-analytical approximation for a general class of {default intensity} models. We illustrate the accuracy of the method by presenting results for the Black-Karasinski model for which the proposed approximation provides remarkably accurate results, even in regimes of high volatility and multi-year time horizons. The accuracy and the computational efficiency of the proposed approximation makes it a viable alternative to fully numerical schemes for a variety of applications in econometrics and derivatives pricing, including the computation of XVA for credit products. As a practical example, we consider the pricing of a quanto Credit Default Swap (CDS) under stochastic intensity of default and an FX devaluation model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：路径积分形式（path-integral formalism）、半解析近似（semi-analytical approximation）、数值结果展示。；研究对象：违约强度模型（default intensity models）中的定价问题，具体涉及Black-Karasinski模型以及随机违约强度下的信用违约互换（CDS）定价。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于路径积分形式的半解析近似方法，能在高波动率和多年时间尺度下对Black-Karasinski模型给出非常精确的结果，可作为全数值方案的可行替代。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于路径积分形式的半解析近似方法，能在高波动率和多年时间尺度下对Black-Karasinski模型给出非常精确的结果，可作为全数值方案的可行替代。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有方法的对比，但指出该方法兼具高精度和计算效率，适用于计量经济学和衍生品定价（如XVA计算）中的多种场景。
papers.method_zh: 路径积分形式（path-integral formalism）推导半解析近似；通过Black-Karasinski模型验证精度；以quanto信用违约互换（CDS）在随机违约强度和外汇贬值模型下的定价作为实际应用示例。

papers.title: Instabilities of the continuous superradiant laser
papers.abstract: We investigate the intensity stability of the superradiant laser. Our study focuses on the architecture where a continuous beam of atoms in an electronically excited state crosses the mode of a high-finesse Fabry-Perot cavity, which has been proposed as a new architecture of an active optical clock. We show that such superradiant laser can become unstable and develop chaotic behavior. We derive an analytical criterion for this instability and find that it may only occur when the lifetime of photons in the cavity is significantly shorter than the lifetime of atoms. This criterion allows for refining the necessary parameters to run a superradiant laser as a frequency reference in the optical domain. In particular, we point-out the consequences of the instability on intensity fluctuations and laser linewidth. On the other hand, we also point out that the superradiant laser, when in the unstable regime, can become an interesting playground for studying chaos. At the mean-field level, there is a direct mapping to the Bénard instability associated with fluid turbulence; however quantum fluctuations associated with photon out-coupling and atom re-filling substantially modify the expected behaviors. Finally, we point-out the existence of a regular self-pulsing regime at large atom numbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、derive analytical criterion、mean-field level、mapping to Bénard instability）；研究对象：连续超辐射激光器（continuous superradiant laser）的强度稳定性，具体为高精细度法布里-珀罗腔中连续激发态原子束与腔模相互作用的架构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该超辐射激光器可能失稳并发展出混沌行为，失稳仅发生在腔内光子寿命显著短于原子寿命时；在原子数较大时存在规则的自脉冲（self-pulsing）状态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该超辐射激光器可能失稳并发展出混沌行为，失稳仅发生在腔内光子寿命显著短于原子寿命时；在原子数较大时存在规则的自脉冲（self-pulsing）状态。；创新点：首次给出了连续超辐射激光器失稳的解析判据，并指出失稳对强度涨落和激光线宽的影响；揭示了该体系在失稳区域可作为研究混沌的新平台，且平均场与量子涨落效应存在显著差异。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导失稳判据；平均场理论映射到流体湍流中的Bénard不稳定性；考虑光子出射和原子补充相关的量子涨落对行为的修正。

papers.title: Revisiting creeping viscoelastic cross-slot flow: Global linear stability and structural sensitivity analyses
papers.abstract: The viscoelastic instability of cross-slot flow was first observed experimentally almost half a century ago and reproduced numerically two decades ago, yet its physical origin remains unresolved. We revisit this problem for two-dimensional creeping flow of Oldroyd-B fluid by combining direct numerical simulations, global stability analysis, structural sensitivity analysis, and energy-budget analysis. Our simulations reproduce the canonical pitchfork bifurcation, and the stability analysis consistently predicts the threshold and perturbation growth rates. The leading eigenmode consists of a chiral velocity--stress perturbation that tilts and rotates the birefringent strand generated by the extensional flow. Structural sensitivity and energy-budget analyses identify narrow high-extension-rate ridges within the extensional flow as both the spatial core and energetic source of the instability. In these ridges, the stress-based wavemaker co-localizes with large positive disturbance polymeric stress power density, indicating localized transfer of stored elastic energy to the disturbance flow. Analyses of cross-slot variants with rounded corners and with a centered cylinder further reveal that neither sharp corners nor a free central stagnation point is the essential destabilizing ingredient; rather, the instability originates from elastic-energy release in extension-dominated regions characteristic of cross-slot flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。判断依据：结合了直接数值模拟、全局稳定性分析、结构敏感性分析和能量收支分析。；研究对象：粘弹性流体在十字槽（cross-slot）流动中的不稳定性现象，具体针对二维Oldroyd-B流体的蠕变流动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 十字槽流动中粘弹性不稳定性的物理起源并非来自尖锐拐角或中心自由驻点，而是源于流动中拉伸主导区域（高拉伸率脊）内的弹性储能释放。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：十字槽流动中粘弹性不稳定性的物理起源并非来自尖锐拐角或中心自由驻点，而是源于流动中拉伸主导区域（高拉伸率脊）内的弹性储能释放。；创新点：首次通过结构敏感性和能量收支分析，明确将不稳定性定位于流动中狭窄的高拉伸率脊区域，并证明该区域是扰动弹性应力的“波发生器”和能量来源，从而澄清了此前关于失稳起源（如是否依赖尖锐拐角或驻点）的争议。
papers.method_zh: 采用了直接数值模拟（DNS）重现分岔现象；全局线性稳定性分析预测失稳阈值和扰动增长率；结构敏感性分析（wavemaker分析）定位不稳定性空间核心；能量收支分析识别扰动能量来源。

papers.title: Mirror-Symmetry-Enforced Photonic Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Altermagnets host momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, a symmetry-enforced band phenomenon whose photonic analogues have so far been realized only in square lattices governed by fourfold rotation. Here we introduce a photonic altermagnet on a hexagonal lattice whose helicity splitting is governed by mirror rather than rotational symmetry. Elliptical chiral elements of alternating handedness, placed at the vertices of a regular hexagon, leave the two opposite-chirality sublattices connected only by chirality reversal combined with a mirror reflection. Full-wave simulations reveal mirror-related splitting of the two opposite-helicity branches in the band structure and isofrequency contours, with the channels exchanged when the ellipse orientation is reversed. Using a finite photonic crystal slab, we show that such splitting separates a linearly polarized beam into handedness-resolved channels, thus enabling beam splitting and direction-selective helicity filtering with target-helicity output fractions above 0.85 and output paths continuously tunable through the ellipse rotation angle. These results extend photonic altermagnetism to a previously unexplored lattice-symmetry class and establish mirror-symmetric chiral textures as building blocks for altermagnetism-inspired on-chip chiral photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析+全波模拟+有限结构演示）。判断依据：摘要提及“全波模拟揭示”、“使用有限光子晶体平板演示”。；研究对象：基于六角晶格的光学交变磁体（photonic altermagnet），具体为在正六边形顶点放置交替手性椭圆手性元的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在六角晶格中，通过镜面对称性而非旋转对称性实现了光子交变磁体的螺旋度分裂，并利用该分裂实现了光束分离和方向选择性螺旋度滤波，目标螺旋度输出分数超过0.85。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在六角晶格中，通过镜面对称性而非旋转对称性实现了光子交变磁体的螺旋度分裂，并利用该分裂实现了光束分离和方向选择性螺旋度滤波，目标螺旋度输出分数超过0.85。；创新点：将光子交变磁体从之前仅基于四重旋转对称性的正方晶格，拓展到基于镜面对称性的六角晶格这一此前未探索的晶格对称性类别，并建立了镜面对称手性纹理作为交变磁体启发的片上手性光子学构建模块。
papers.method_zh: 全波模拟（full-wave simulations）计算能带结构和等频轮廓；使用有限光子晶体平板进行光束分离和螺旋度滤波的演示。

papers.title: Controlling the phase behaviour of ultraconfined water via bilayer graphene stacking
papers.abstract: Water confined within nanoscale capillaries exhibits phase behaviour and transport properties that differ substantially from bulk, and these effects are commonly interpreted as consequences of geometric confinement and reduced dimensionality. Here we show that confinement topology alone is insufficient to predict the behaviour of nanoconfined water. Using machine learning interatomic potentials with first-principles accuracy, we compute the density-temperature phase diagram of water confined within bilayer graphene nanocapillaries and compare AA and AB stacking arrangements, which differ only by a lateral shift of 1.4 Å. Despite this minimal structural change, AA stacking can stabilise different ice polymorphs, can increase the melting temperature by more than 100 K, can enhance proton transfer, and alters the onset of superionic behaviour relative to AB stacking. We trace these effects to stacking-induced changes in the hydrogen-bond network associated with modifications to the lateral free energy landscape and neighbouring O-O separations. Our results demonstrate that even subtle atomistic variations in the confining walls can qualitatively reshape the physical and chemical behaviour of nanoconfined water, with implications for the interpretation and control of fluids under angstrom-scale confinement.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials、first-principles accuracy、density-temperature phase diagram。；研究对象：双层石墨烯纳米毛细管中限域水的相行为，具体比较AA堆叠与AB堆叠两种构型对水冰多晶型、熔点、质子传输及超离子行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 仅1.4 Å的横向堆叠差异（AA vs AB）即可显著改变限域水的相图：AA堆叠可稳定不同冰多晶型、使熔点升高超过100 K、增强质子传输并改变超离子行为起始点，表明限域壁的原子级变化能定性重塑纳米限域水的物理化学行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：仅1.4 Å的横向堆叠差异（AA vs AB）即可显著改变限域水的相图：AA堆叠可稳定不同冰多晶型、使熔点升高超过100 K、增强质子传输并改变超离子行为起始点，表明限域壁的原子级变化能定性重塑纳米限域水的物理化学行为。；创新点：揭示限域拓扑结构本身不足以预测纳米限域水的行为，强调限域壁的原子级堆叠排列（而非仅几何尺寸）对氢键网络及相行为的决定性影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用具有第一性原理精度的机器学习原子间势（machine learning interatomic potentials）计算双层石墨烯纳米毛细管中水的密度-温度相图。

papers.title: Quantum work statistics and coherence effects in quenched bosonic Josephson junctions
papers.abstract: We investigate the non-equilibrium work statistics originating from a sudden quench in a bosonic Josephson junction. In particular, by employing the Holstein-Primakoff approximation, the work statistics are analytically characterized in the weak-interaction regime, where the dynamics map onto a time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillator. For a junction initialized in the ground state of the pre-quench Hamiltonian, we demonstrate that the work statistics are governed by a negative binomial distribution, as occurs in fully-connected models driven across a critical point. Furthermore, we also consider initial superposition states containing quantum coherences in the energy basis. To characterize the corresponding work distributions, we employ Kirkwood-Dirac quasiprobabilities (KDQ). Even in the simplest case, when the junction is initialized in a superposition of the ground and second excited states, the KDQ distribution of work exhibits negative or complex values, reflecting non-classical features. Moreover, the coherence content of the initial state can be optimized to enhance the extractable work extracted from the quench, beyond classical bounds. Finally, we propose an experimental interferometric protocol to directly measure the characteristic function of the work distribution in experimentally accessible settings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“analytically characterized”、“employing the Holstein-Primakoff approximation”、“propose an experimental interferometric protocol”（提出实验方案，但核心为理论分析）。；研究对象：玻色约瑟夫森结（bosonic Josephson junction）在突然淬火（sudden quench）下的非平衡功统计与量子相干效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱相互作用区，淬火后的功统计由负二项分布描述；当初始态包含能量基矢的量子相干时，功分布由Kirkwood-Dirac准概率描述，会出现负值或复数值，且初始态的相干性可被优化以提取超过经典极限的功。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱相互作用区，淬火后的功统计由负二项分布描述；当初始态包含能量基矢的量子相干时，功分布由Kirkwood-Dirac准概率描述，会出现负值或复数值，且初始态的相干性可被优化以提取超过经典极限的功。；创新点：首次将负二项分布与玻色约瑟夫森结的淬火功统计联系起来，并引入KDQ准概率揭示量子相干对功分布的非经典影响，同时展示了通过优化相干性增强可提取功的可能性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Holstein-Primakoff近似将系统映射为含时量子谐振子，解析求解弱相互作用区的功统计；利用Kirkwood-Dirac准概率（KDQ）表征含相干初始态的功分布；提出干涉测量协议以直接测量功分布的特征函数。

papers.title: An FFT-based solver with general boundary conditions for stationary diffusion problems based on Chebyshev collocation
papers.abstract: An efficient and robust FFT-based solver is proposed for diffusion-type problems with general Neumann and Dirichlet boundary conditions, based on a Chebyshev collocation framework. The method combines Chebyshev polynomial approximations with FFT-based operators to provide a matrix-free implementation of the discrete differential operator at the Chebyshev-Gauss-Lobatto points. The linear system of equations resulting from the Chebyshev discretization is solved using LGMRES. To overcome convergence problems on fine grids, a hierarchical refinement strategy based on modal prolongation is proposed, enabling the solution of very large 3D problems. The methodology is applicable to homogeneous and heterogeneous domains, as well as to linear and nonlinear constitutive equations. The accuracy of the proposed method is analyzed by solving the Poisson equation in homogeneous 1D and 3D domains with general boundary conditions, using manufactured analytical solutions as references. Convergence to the analytical solution is achieved in a few iterations, with smaller errors than those obtained using DCT/DST approaches. Discretizations of up to $256^3$ are achieved thanks to the hierarchical refinement strategy. In the case of heterogeneous domains, the accuracy and efficiency obtained are similar to those of a standard periodic FFT approach. It is found that the computational complexity of the method preserves the FFT scaling, of order $n\log n$, in all the cases studied.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：FFT-based solver、Chebyshev collocation、matrix-free implementation、LGMRES。；研究对象：扩散型问题（包括泊松方程等），适用于均匀和非均匀介质、线性和非线性本构方程，未指定具体物理材料或体系，属于数值方法研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于切比雪夫配点法和FFT的求解器，能够高效处理一般Neumann和Dirichlet边界条件下的扩散问题，计算复杂度保持O(n log n)，在均匀和非均匀域中均能达到高精度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于切比雪夫配点法和FFT的求解器，能够高效处理一般Neumann和Dirichlet边界条件下的扩散问题，计算复杂度保持O(n log n)，在均匀和非均匀域中均能达到高精度。；创新点：提出了一种结合切比雪夫配点与FFT的通用边界条件求解框架，并引入模态延拓分层细化策略，使得三维问题可达到256³网格规模，同时保持FFT的O(n log n)计算复杂度。
papers.method_zh: 采用切比雪夫多项式近似与FFT算子结合，在切比雪夫-高斯-洛巴托点上实现无矩阵离散微分算子；线性系统使用LGMRES求解；为克服细网格收敛问题，提出基于模态延拓的分层细化策略；通过制造解析解验证精度，并与DCT/DST方法对比。

papers.title: Atomistic Language Models Understand and Generate Materials
papers.abstract: Atomistic structure and natural language have long been modeled separately, with language models either calling atomistic models as tools or being fine-tuned on lossy textual encodings that discard atomistic information. We introduce Atomistic Language Models (ALMs) to pursue native multimodality, in which a single language backbone understands atomistic structures, generates materials from natural language, and optimizes crystal structures as instructed by text. By unifying a pretrained atomistic encoder, large language model, and denoising diffusion model through purely continuous projectors and staged training, ALMs achieve state-of-the-art results on crystal structure prediction and de novo generation. ALMs are enabled by a continuous bridge that maps language model embeddings directly into the steering space of atomistic diffusion, and are assisted by Text-to-Crystal Feynman-Kac (T2C-FK), a particle-based sampler that scores partial denoising trajectories to enforce stoichiometric targets at inference time. To evaluate the ability of ALMs to optimize and generate materials from natural-language prompts and 3D atom-coordinate inputs, we introduce ALM Bench, the first benchmark for text-conditioned crystal generation and optimization. Code, training data, and model weights will be released soon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Atomistic Language Models、pretrained atomistic encoder、large language model、denoising diffusion model、staged training。；研究对象：晶体结构预测与从头生成，具体为从自然语言提示和3D原子坐标输入出发，优化和生成材料（晶体结构）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将预训练原子编码器、大语言模型和去噪扩散模型通过连续投影器和分阶段训练统一起来，Atomistic Language Models（ALMs）在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务上取得了最先进的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将预训练原子编码器、大语言模型和去噪扩散模型通过连续投影器和分阶段训练统一起来，Atomistic Language Models（ALMs）在晶体结构预测和从头生成任务上取得了最先进的结果。；创新点：首次实现单一语言骨干原生多模态理解原子结构、从自然语言生成材料、并根据文本指令优化晶体结构；引入连续桥接机制替代有损文本编码；提出首个文本条件晶体生成与优化基准ALM Bench。
papers.method_zh: 采用多模态融合框架：1）预训练原子编码器处理原子结构；2）大语言模型作为语言骨干；3）去噪扩散模型用于生成晶体结构；4）连续投影器将语言模型嵌入直接映射到原子扩散的引导空间；5）Text-to-Crystal Feynman-Kac（T2C-FK）粒子采样器在推理时对部分去噪轨迹进行评分以强制执行化学计量目标。

papers.title: AI-accelerated metallized $σ$-bonding screening for superconductor discovery
papers.abstract: The computational discovery of phonon-mediated superconductors is hindered by the prohibitive cost of density functional perturbation theory (DFPT). Here, guided by the metallized $σ$-bonding picture, we introduce the $σ$-bonding density of states ($σ$DOS) as an efficient physical descriptor to identify high-transition-temperature ($T_{\mathrm{c}}$) superconductors from density functional theory (DFT)-level electronic structure without explicit DFPT calculations. The evaluation of $σ$DOS can be further accelerated by a deep-learning DFT Hamiltonian method, enabling efficient large-scale screening for superconductors. Screening 2 million materials, we identify B$_{13}$Se as an ambient-pressure superconductor candidate with predicted $T_{\mathrm{c}} > 40$~K, together with a family of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ B$_{13}X$ candidates, supporting the effectiveness of this discovery strategy. By bridging physics priors with AI acceleration, this study delivers an efficient and generalizable route for computational materials discovery in the AI era.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：computational discovery、DFT、deep-learning DFT Hamiltonian method、screening）；研究对象：基于金属化σ键图像的高温超导体候选材料，具体包括B₁₃Se及B₁₃X家族化合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出σ键态密度（σDOS）作为高效物理描述符，无需显式DFPT计算即可从DFT电子结构中识别高转变温度（Tc）超导体；通过筛选200万种材料，发现环境压力下Tc > 40 K的超导体候选材料B₁₃Se。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出σ键态密度（σDOS）作为高效物理描述符，无需显式DFPT计算即可从DFT电子结构中识别高转变温度（Tc）超导体；通过筛选200万种材料，发现环境压力下Tc > 40 K的超导体候选材料B₁₃Se。；创新点：将物理先验（金属化σ键图像）与人工智能加速相结合，提出无需DFPT计算的高效超导体筛选策略，并实现百万级材料的高通量计算筛选。
papers.method_zh: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）电子结构分析、σDOS描述符构建、深度学习辅助的DFT哈密顿量方法（deep-learning DFT Hamiltonian method）进行大规模材料筛选。

papers.title: Entanglement-entropy analysis of critical and topological quantum phases in a frustrated spin-1/2 Heisenberg ladder
papers.abstract: We investigate the ground-state phase diagram of a frustrated spin-1/2 Heisenberg ladder in the transverse magnetic field with an anisotropic inter-rung exchange coupling $α$. This bond-anisotropic parameter continuously interpolates among the Ising-like limit $α=0$, the isotropic point $α=1$, and the XY-dominated regime $α\gg 1$. Using density-matrix renormalization group calculations within a matrix-product-state framework, we analyze bipartite entanglement, magnetization, and spin correlations to characterize the emergent quantum phases. We identify six distinct ground-state phases, including rung-singlet, Haldane-like, Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid, canted Ising-ordered, XY-polarized, and ordered ferromagnetic states. While magnetization and local correlations provide a first insight into phase classifications, the finite-size scaling of the entanglement measures offers a more sensitive and unified diagnostics of both gapped and gapless regimes. In the gapless regime, we extract the central charge $c \simeq 1$, confirming Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid behavior, while at the transition between the canted Ising and ferromagnetic phases, we observe $c \simeq 1/2$, consistent with the Ising universality. Finally, we find that both the Haldane-like behavior and the extended critical Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid regime are strongly confined to the vicinity of the isotropic point $α= 1$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density-matrix renormalization group calculations, matrix-product-state framework。；研究对象：受挫自旋-1/2海森堡梯子模型，在横向磁场中具有各向异性梯级间交换耦合（参数α），涵盖从Ising极限到XY主导的多种耦合情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度，识别出六个不同的基态相（包括rung-singlet、Haldane-like、Tomonaga-Luttinger液体、canted Ising有序、XY极化及有序铁磁态），并在无能隙区域提取出中心荷c≃1（Tomonaga-Luttinger液体行为），在canted Ising与铁磁相变处观察到c≃1/2（Ising普适类）。Haldane-like行为和扩展的临界Tomonaga-Luttinger液体区域强烈局限于各向同性点α=1附近。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度，识别出六个不同的基态相（包括rung-singlet、Haldane-like、Tomonaga-Luttinger液体、canted Ising有序、XY极化及有序铁磁态），并在无能隙区域提取出中心荷c≃1（Tomonaga-Luttinger液体行为），在canted Ising与铁磁相变处观察到c≃1/2（Ising普适类）。Haldane-like行为和扩展的临界Tomonaga-Luttinger液体区域强烈局限于各向同性点α=1附近。；创新点：利用纠缠熵的有限尺寸标量作为更灵敏的统一诊断工具，同时刻画有能隙和无能隙区域，并精确提取了不同量子相变点的中心荷，揭示了各向异性参数α对相图结构的强约束作用。摘要未突出说明与先前工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于矩阵乘积态的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算，分析二分纠缠熵、磁化强度和自旋关联函数。

papers.title: Synchronization in the quantum regime
papers.abstract: Can synchronization -- the widespread spontaneous emergence of coordinated dynamics in classical nonlinear systems -- also occur in the quantum regime? This question has recently sparked intense research into collective behavior and temporal self-organization in quantum systems. Typical quantum features such as the linearity of time evolution and the presence of quantum noise seem to hinder the appearance of synchrony at the microscopic level. At the same time, quantum coherence and quantum correlations may provide novel mechanisms for enhancing synchronization beyond its classical counterpart. We here survey recent theoretical and experimental advances in quantum synchronization, ranging from the characterization of synchronous oscillations and genuinely nonclassical forms of synchrony to many-body synchronization on quantum networks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有实验进展综述）。判断依据：关键词“survey recent theoretical and experimental advances”。；研究对象：量子系统中的同步现象，包括量子振荡、非经典同步形式以及量子网络上的多体同步。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 量子系统中的同步可能受到量子线性演化和量子噪声的抑制，但量子相干性和量子关联也可能提供超越经典同步的新机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：量子系统中的同步可能受到量子线性演化和量子噪声的抑制，但量子相干性和量子关联也可能提供超越经典同步的新机制。；创新点：系统梳理了从经典同步到量子同步的过渡，并特别关注了“真正非经典形式的同步”以及多体量子网络中的同步行为。
papers.method_zh: 综述性分析，涵盖理论框架（如量子主方程、量子轨迹方法）和实验平台（如超导量子比特、离子阱、光机械系统等），但摘要未具体列出单一方法。

papers.title: Bounds on the Topological Charge of Photonic Systems
papers.abstract: Topology has become a central concept in understanding physical phenomena, leading to important advances in condensed matter and photonics. Recent work has established a universal upper bound on the energy gap of Chern insulators in electronic systems, revealing a fundamental connection between topology, quantum geometry, and optical absorption. Here, we generalize this framework to photonic systems, deriving rigorous upper bounds on gap Chern numbers without requiring explicit topological analysis. Our approach enables the estimation of the topological charge of band gaps in both dispersive and nondispersive regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“deriving rigorous upper bounds”“generalize this framework”，属于理论推导和框架推广。；研究对象：光子系统的拓扑性质，具体为光子带隙的拓扑电荷（Chern数）上界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在光子系统中，无需进行显式的拓扑分析，即可推导出带隙Chern数的严格上界，从而估计光子带隙的拓扑电荷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在光子系统中，无需进行显式的拓扑分析，即可推导出带隙Chern数的严格上界，从而估计光子带隙的拓扑电荷。；创新点：将原本适用于电子系统的拓扑电荷与能隙之间的普适上界关系首次推广至光子体系，并建立了无需显式拓扑分析即可估计拓扑电荷的方法。
papers.method_zh: 基于电子系统中Chern绝缘体能隙上界的已有理论框架，将其推广至光子体系，在色散和非色散两种情形下分别推导拓扑电荷的约束条件。

papers.title: Generalized Mpemba effect in diffusion-controlled spin-dependent delayed fluorescence
papers.abstract: The Mpemba effect is commonly associated with anomalous thermal relaxation, in which a system prepared at a higher temperature reaches equilibrium faster than one prepared at a lower temperature. In modern formulations, however, its defining feature is broader: a state initially farther from equilibrium can relax faster than a closer one, or, equivalently, relaxation trajectories can cross. Here, we show that magnetic-field-dependent delayed fluorescence in triplet-fusion systems realizes a generalized Mpemba effect driven by external control of spin-selective kinetics. Using a diffusion-controlled geminate-recombination extension of the Johnson--Merrifield model, we demonstrate that delayed-fluorescence trajectories obtained at different magnetic fields cross when geminate fusion is effective. We further derive a compact kinetic criterion for such crossing in terms of the competition between intermediate-time decay rates and long-time power-law amplitudes. This criterion captures the interplay between effective fast and slow relaxation contributions. Within this kinetic framework, the final state is independent of the external control parameter and is defined as the fully relaxed state in which no separated triplet population remains. The generalized Mpemba effect therefore arises from the redistribution of transient relaxation pathways associated with geminate recombination, whereas bulk diffusion-controlled processes contribute only to the final relaxation. These results link anomalous relaxation in spin-dependent photokinetics to modern formulations of the generalized Mpemba effect and show how trajectory crossing can emerge in systems governed by diffusion-controlled geminate recombination and non-Markovian kinetics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Johnson--Merrifield模型”、“推导了动力学判据”、“理论框架”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：三线态融合（triplet-fusion）体系中磁场依赖的延迟荧光（delayed fluorescence），以及其中由自旋选择性动力学驱动的广义Mpemba效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扩散控制的成对复合（geminate recombination）三线态融合体系中，不同磁场下的延迟荧光弛豫轨迹会发生交叉，从而实现了广义Mpemba效应：初始远离平衡态的系统反而更快弛豫到平衡态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扩散控制的成对复合（geminate recombination）三线态融合体系中，不同磁场下的延迟荧光弛豫轨迹会发生交叉，从而实现了广义Mpemba效应：初始远离平衡态的系统反而更快弛豫到平衡态。；创新点：将广义Mpemba效应的现代定义（弛豫轨迹交叉）首次应用于自旋依赖的光动力学体系，揭示了成对复合过程对瞬态弛豫路径的重新分配是产生该异常弛豫的关键，而体扩散过程仅贡献最终弛豫。
papers.method_zh: 采用Johnson--Merrifield模型的扩散控制成对复合扩展版本，通过分析中间时间衰减率与长时间幂律振幅之间的竞争，推导出轨迹交叉的紧凑动力学判据。

papers.title: Cavity-Mediated Long-Range Cooperative Coupling between Localized Plasmons and Molecular Excitons
papers.abstract: Strong coupling between molecules and electromagnetic fields has emerged as a powerful strategy to modify the physical and chemical properties of molecules, enabled by the formation of hybridized energy levels through strong light-matter interactions. Rather than purely photonic or plasmonic modes, hybrid cavity fields that integrate plasmonic and photonic contributions provide versatile platforms with distinct advantages for tailoring light-matter interactions. Here, we present hybrid modes formed through the coupling between localized surface plasmon resonances of Au nanoparticles and Fabry-Perot microcavity modes. Furthermore, by using this hybrid platform, we demonstrate that the cavity field can give rise to cooperative coherent coupling between the spatially separated plasmonic nanoparticles and the molecules by mediating long-range dipole-dipole interactions. As we show, this cavity-mediated coupling also enhances the plasmon-exciton mixing, as compared to their direct interaction. This configuration opens new avenues for tailoring light-matter interactions at the nanoscale by supporting novel hybrid plexcitonic states that incorporate contributions from plasmons, excitons, and extended cavity fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：demonstrate、present、show，涉及混合腔场构建与耦合效应测量）；研究对象：Au纳米颗粒的局域表面等离激元共振与法布里-珀罗微腔模式耦合形成的混合腔场，以及该腔场介导的等离激元与分子激子之间的长程协同耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合腔场能够通过介导长程偶极-偶极相互作用，实现空间分离的等离激元纳米颗粒与分子之间的协同相干耦合，并且这种腔介导的耦合相比直接相互作用增强了等离激元-激子混合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合腔场能够通过介导长程偶极-偶极相互作用，实现空间分离的等离激元纳米颗粒与分子之间的协同相干耦合，并且这种腔介导的耦合相比直接相互作用增强了等离激元-激子混合。；创新点：利用同时包含等离激元和光子贡献的混合腔场，实现了对空间分离的等离激元与分子激子之间长程协同耦合的调控，并增强了等离激元-激子混合。
papers.method_zh: 构建Au纳米颗粒局域表面等离激元共振与法布里-珀罗微腔模式的混合腔场，通过实验观测腔场介导的长程偶极-偶极相互作用，并比较直接与间接耦合下的等离激元-激子混合程度。

papers.title: Parametric correlations in non-Hermitian quantum chaos: random matrix approach
papers.abstract: Motivated by the surge of interest in statistics of non-Hermitian random matrices as a framework for description of universal characteristics of dissipative chaotic quantum many-body systems, we address the problem of characterizing the parametric correlations of spectral densities. Considering parameter-dependent ensemble of complex Ginibre matrices we derive an explicit, closed-form expression for the parametric number covariance in the systems of symmetry class $\mathbf{A}$ for eigenvalues in a circular domain containing on average a finite number of eigenvalues in the spectral bulk. This behavior is expected to be universal, as further supported by numerical evidence for the real Ginibre ensemble, non-Hermitian Bernoulli Wigner matrices and bi-unitarily invariant ensembles. We also discuss a relation between parametric correlations of spectral densities and the distribution of the so-called eigenvector non-orthogonality factor, which attracted considerable interest in recent years.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：random matrix approach（随机矩阵方法）、derivation（推导）、closed-form expression（闭式表达式）。；研究对象：非厄米量子混沌系统中的谱密度参数关联，具体针对耗散混沌量子多体系统的普适特性，以及非厄米随机矩阵的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出了对称类A（complex Ginibre矩阵）在包含平均有限个本征值的圆域内，谱密度的参数数协方差（parametric number covariance）的显式闭式表达式，并数值验证了该行为在实Ginibre系综、非厄米Bernoulli Wigner矩阵及双酉不变系综中的普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出了对称类A（complex Ginibre矩阵）在包含平均有限个本征值的圆域内，谱密度的参数数协方差（parametric number covariance）的显式闭式表达式，并数值验证了该行为在实Ginibre系综、非厄米Bernoulli Wigner矩阵及双酉不变系综中的普适性。；创新点：首次给出了非厄米随机矩阵谱密度参数关联的闭式解析表达式，并建立了其与本征向量非正交性因子分布之间的联系。摘要未突出说明与已有非厄米混沌理论的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟相结合。理论框架为随机矩阵理论，具体针对参数依赖的复Ginibre矩阵系综进行解析推导；数值验证涉及实Ginibre系综、非厄米Bernoulli Wigner矩阵及双酉不变系综的模拟。

papers.title: Complexity Inequalities for Quantum Subsystems
papers.abstract: Motivated by the role of the holographic entropy cone in constraining the entanglement structure of states with classical gravitational duals, we investigate combinations of subsystem complexities associated with reduced density matrices in multipartite quantum systems. Focusing on subsystems composed of three disjoint regions, we introduce two quantities: a tripartite complexity, inspired by the tripartite information, and a complexity gap, designed to characterize emergent complexity in the full quantum state beyond that of its constituents. We study the sign structure of these quantities in three selected approaches to subsystem complexity. In holography, we employ the complexity=volume proposal in AdS spacetimes; for Gaussian many-body states, we use Fisher-Rao subsystem complexity; and we further develop a Krylov-space inspired, effective framework for reduced density matrices, which we test in few-qubit systems and coherent-state dynamics. Across all three approaches, we find that the tripartite complexity is not sign-definite in general. By contrast, the complexity gap exhibits a definite sign in every example we analyze, although the sign itself depends on the underlying notion of subsystem complexity. Our results suggest that the complexity gap could be a natural candidate building block for a prospective hierarchy of subsystem complexity inequalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：motivated by、investigate、study、proposal、framework。；研究对象：多体量子系统中约化密度矩阵的子系统复杂度，特别是由三个不相交区域组成的子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 三体复杂度在三种不同方法中均不具符号确定性；而复杂度间隙在所有分析示例中均呈现确定符号，但符号本身依赖于子系统复杂度的具体定义，提示复杂度间隙可能成为构建子系统复杂度不等式层级结构的自然候选。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：三体复杂度在三种不同方法中均不具符号确定性；而复杂度间隙在所有分析示例中均呈现确定符号，但符号本身依赖于子系统复杂度的具体定义，提示复杂度间隙可能成为构建子系统复杂度不等式层级结构的自然候选。；创新点：首次系统比较了三种不同框架下的子系统复杂度，并引入复杂度间隙这一新概念，用于刻画全量子态相对于其组成部分的涌现复杂度特征。
papers.method_zh: 1）全息对偶：采用AdS时空中的复杂度=体积（complexity=volume）方案；2）高斯多体态：使用Fisher-Rao子系统复杂度；3）Krylov空间启发的约化密度矩阵有效框架，并在少量子比特系统和相干态动力学中测试。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Test-Time Discovery of Quantum-Chemical Approximation Algorithms
papers.abstract: Quantum chemistry simulations underpin modern materials discovery, yet their impact is limited by steep computational cost and dependence on fixed approximation schemes. Foundation models, such as machine-learned interatomic potentials, have accelerated parts of this workflow, but their reliance on large-scale pretraining restricts adaptability at the frontier of chemical space, where methodological innovation and sparse data are the norm. Agentic AI systems can automate existing simulation pipelines, yet they remain constrained by the predefined tools and algorithms they orchestrate. In response, we introduce LADeQ, an LLM-guided workflow that discovers, implements, and benchmarks candidate approximation algorithms at test-time within existing quantum chemistry codes. Rather than selecting from a predefined repertoire, LADeQ constructs candidate approximation schemes on demand, drawing on techniques from disciplines such as spatial statistics, circuit simulation, and kernel methods that have had little prior presence in electronic-structure theory. Because it builds on an out-of-the-box language model, LADeQ requires no task-specific pretraining or curated data, and the resulting implementations are transparent and inspectable, with explicitly traceable approximation errors that enable principled control of accuracy--efficiency trade-offs. We show that LADeQ accelerates coupled cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) and configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD) calculations while keeping correlation-energy errors within user-specified tolerances, demonstrating autonomous, objective-driven discovery of approximation algorithms inside existing electronic-structure solvers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：关键词为“LLM-guided workflow”、“quantum chemistry codes”、“approximation algorithms”、“electronic-structure solvers”，属于算法开发与计算模拟研究。；研究对象：量子化学模拟中的电子结构计算，具体针对耦合簇（CCSD）和组态相互作用（CISD）方法中的近似算法发现与加速。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为LADeQ的LLM引导工作流，能够在测试时自主发现、实现并测试量子化学近似算法，在保持相关能误差在用户指定容差内的前提下，显著加速CCSD和CISD计算。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为LADeQ的LLM引导工作流，能够在测试时自主发现、实现并测试量子化学近似算法，在保持相关能误差在用户指定容差内的前提下，显著加速CCSD和CISD计算。；创新点：LADeQ不依赖预定义的算法库，而是按需构造候选近似方案，且生成的实现透明可审查，具有显式可追踪的近似误差，从而实现对精度-效率权衡的原则性控制。摘要未突出说明与传统机器学习势或自动化模拟管线相比的具体性能提升幅度。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于现成语言模型（LLM）的智能体工作流LADeQ，该工作流在现有量子化学代码内部，动态构建近似方案，借鉴空间统计、电路仿真和核方法等领域的已有技术，无需任务特定预训练或精心整理的数据集。

papers.title: The Sustainability Paradox of Biodegradable Packaging: A Life Cycle Perspective on Chitosan-Based Food Packaging
papers.abstract: Chitosan-based nanomaterials are being increasingly explored as sustainable alternatives to petroleum-derived food packaging, yet their environmental performance across the full life cycle remains insufficiently understood. This review critically evaluates these systems from a life cycle perspective and examines how material origin, processing pathways, functional performance, and end-of-life behavior collectively influence sustainability outcomes. Beginning with chitin extraction from crustacean waste, key processing steps, including demineralization, deproteinization, and nanoparticle synthesis, are assessed in terms of chemical intensity, energy demand, and associated emissions. Manufacturing routes, including solvent-based and green synthesis approaches, are compared with those of conventional plastics to identify relative environmental burdens. The use phase is analyzed with respect to antimicrobial functionality, shelf life extension, and potential reductions in food waste. End-of-life pathways, including biodegradation and composting, are evaluated alongside uncertainties related to degradation behavior and nanoparticle fate. By synthesizing these stagewise interactions, this review highlights critical trade-offs that are often overlooked in sustainability narratives and examines whether chitosan-based nanomaterials provide net environmental benefits in food packaging applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“review critically evaluates”“synthesizes these stagewise interactions”等关键词，属于对已有研究的综合评述，而非原创实验或计算工作。；研究对象：壳聚糖基纳米材料用于食品包装，具体涉及从甲壳类废弃物中提取甲壳素、经脱矿、脱蛋白及纳米颗粒合成等步骤制备的包装材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 壳聚糖基纳米包装在全生命周期中（从原料提取、加工、使用到废弃）存在显著的环境权衡：其生物降解性和减少食物浪费的潜力可能被高能耗、高化学强度的加工过程以及纳米颗粒在降解中的不确定性所抵消，因此是否真正优于传统石油基塑料尚不明确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：壳聚糖基纳米包装在全生命周期中（从原料提取、加工、使用到废弃）存在显著的环境权衡：其生物降解性和减少食物浪费的潜力可能被高能耗、高化学强度的加工过程以及纳米颗粒在降解中的不确定性所抵消，因此是否真正优于传统石油基塑料尚不明确。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该综述通过整合各阶段相互作用，揭示了可持续性叙事中常被忽视的关键权衡，并系统评估了壳聚糖基纳米材料在食品包装中是否提供净环境效益。
papers.method_zh: 采用生命周期评价（Life Cycle Assessment, LCA）框架，系统比较不同加工路径（溶剂法与绿色合成法）的化学强度、能耗与排放，分析使用阶段的抗菌功能与保质期延长效果，并评估降解与堆肥等末端处理路径。

papers.title: Constituency Optimisation Through Hamiltonian Representation Of Mandates (COTHROM): Algorithmic Redistricting of Irish Election Boundaries
papers.abstract: Electoral redistricting in Ireland's Proportional Representation Single Transferable Vote (PR-STV) system faces the challenge of selecting an optimally representative set of electoral boundaries from an enormous set of possible configurations, and where ``representative'' is a delicate balance of constitutional objectives that are often in tension with one another. We present the first computational framework for Irish electoral redistricting that systematically optimises across multiple constitutional requirements while making trade-offs explicit and quantifiable. The electoral redistricting problem is parsed using statistical physics, where constitutional objectives are considered as terms in a Potts Hamiltonian. Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods and simulated annealing are employed to minimise this objective function, systematically exploring this configuration space, with coupling constants as proxies for objective weightings. Multi Criterion Decision Analysis (MCDA) and Pareto Optimality is then utilised to remedy the ambiguity in choosing a certain objective weighting combination over others. With respect to proportional representation and compactness objectives evaluated in County Cork, COTHROM consistently improves on the existing legal constituency boundaries for a range of objective weightings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：统计物理、Potts哈密顿量、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛、模拟退火、多准则决策分析。；研究对象：爱尔兰选举边界重划问题。具体而言，是在爱尔兰比例代表制单一可转移投票（PR-STV）体系下，如何从海量可能的配置中，选出最优代表选民意愿的选区边界集合。这是一个将物理概念应用于社会系统的跨学科研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将宪法目标（如比例代表性和选区紧凑性）编码为Potts哈密顿量中的项，并利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和模拟退火进行优化，所提出的COTHROM算法能够在科克郡的测试中，针对一系列目标权重组合，持续优于现有的法定选区边界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将宪法目标（如比例代表性和选区紧凑性）编码为Potts哈密顿量中的项，并利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛和模拟退火进行优化，所提出的COTHROM算法能够在科克郡的测试中，针对一系列目标权重组合，持续优于现有的法定选区边界。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容推断，主要创新在于首次为爱尔兰选举重划问题提供了一个系统的计算框架，该框架能够量化并权衡多个相互冲突的宪法目标，并利用统计物理方法进行全局优化。
papers.method_zh: 1. **理论框架**：将选区重划问题映射为统计物理中的Potts模型，其中每个宪法目标（如比例代表性、紧凑性）被视为哈密顿量中的一项，其权重由耦合常数表示。2. **计算方法**：采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法和模拟退火算法，在巨大的配置空间中搜索，以最小化由Potts哈密顿量定义的目标函数。3. **决策分析**：利用多准则决策分析（MCDA）和帕累托最优性，来解决不同目标权重组合选择上的模糊性问题。

papers.title: Mixed memories in Hopfield networks
papers.abstract: We consider the class of Hopfield models of associative memory with activation function $F$ and state space $\{-1,1\}^N$, where each vertex of the cube describes a configuration of $N$ binary neurons. $M$ randomly chosen configurations, called patterns, are stored using an energy function designed to make them local minima. If they are, which is known to depend on how $M$ scales with $N$, then they can be retrieved using a dynamics that decreases the energy. However, storing the patterns in the energy function also creates unintended local minima, and thus false memories. Although this has been known since the earliest work on the subject, it has only been supported by numerical simulations and non-rigorous calculations, except in elementary cases. Our results are twofold. For a generic function $F$, we explicitly construct a set of configurations, called mixed memories, whose properties are intended to characterise the local minima of the energy function. For three prominent models, namely the classical, the dense and the modern Hopfield models, obtained for quadratic, polynomial and exponential functions $F$ respectively, we give conditions on the growth rate of $M$ which guarantee that, as $N$ diverges, mixed memories are fixed points of the retrieval dynamics and thus exact minima of the energy. We conjecture that in this regime, all local minima are mixed memories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“construct”、“give conditions”、“conjecture”等理论推导和猜想性表述，未涉及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：Hopfield神经网络模型中的关联记忆（associative memory）系统，具体研究其能量函数产生的局部极小值（local minima），即“混合记忆”（mixed memories）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于三类典型的Hopfield模型（经典、密集、现代），在模式数量M随神经元数N增长的特定条件下，混合记忆是检索动力学的固定点，即能量函数的精确极小值；并猜想在该条件下所有局部极小值均为混合记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于三类典型的Hopfield模型（经典、密集、现代），在模式数量M随神经元数N增长的特定条件下，混合记忆是检索动力学的固定点，即能量函数的精确极小值；并猜想在该条件下所有局部极小值均为混合记忆。；创新点：首次对一般激活函数F的Hopfield模型，显式构造了混合记忆构型，并严格给出了三类重要模型中混合记忆成为能量极小值的条件，此前该现象仅由数值模拟和非严格计算支持。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过构造一组称为“混合记忆”的构型，并针对激活函数F分别为二次、多项式、指数函数的三种Hopfield模型（经典、密集、现代），给出M随N增长率的条件，证明在N→∞时混合记忆成为能量函数的精确极小值。

papers.title: On the Renormalization Group Flow of Active Flocks
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study the statistical field-theoretic renormalization of active flocks via the MSRDJ action formulation for stochastic systems, focusing on the Toner-Tu theory of `Malthusian flocks', or polar-ordered, momentum non-conserving active fluids where relaxation times for density fluctuations are so short that they can be eliminated as a hydrodynamic variable.
