Working in the limit of isotropic diffusion in two spatial dimensions, we compute the renormalization of the couplings and their anomalous dimensions to all orders, facilitated by the Ward identities associated with the non-linear realization of a diagonal rotation/ shift symmetry, and a non-local field-dependent redundancy specific to the MSRDJ representation of this model. We find a range of behavior depending on the parameters of the theory. If $κ$ is the diffusion coefficient and $Δ$ is the variance of the noise, we find a line of fixed points and a marginal vertex instability at $Δ/κ= 2π$. This instability separates Gaussian, and symmetry-protected strongly interacting gapless phases, realizing non-equilibrium critical behavior beyond standard Wilson--Fisher criticality, and implies the persistence of long range order when $Δ/κ$ is below the critical value. We revisit and contextualize various claims and counter-claims in the literature in light of our findings, and discuss extensions of our analysis to flocks with anisotropic diffusion, and where density fluctuations are reintroduced.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：statistical field-theoretic renormalization、MSRDJ action formulation、Ward identities。；研究对象：活性群体（active flocks）的统计场论重正化，具体针对Toner-Tu理论中的“马尔萨斯群体”（Malthusian flocks），即极性有序、动量不守恒的活性流体，且密度涨落弛豫时间极短可被消去作为流体力学变量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维各向同性扩散极限下，发现一条固定点线和一个位于Δ/κ=2π处的边缘顶点不稳定性。该不稳定性将高斯相与对称性保护的强相互作用无能隙相分开，实现超越标准Wilson-Fisher临界性的非平衡临界行为，并表明当Δ/κ低于临界值时长程有序持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维各向同性扩散极限下，发现一条固定点线和一个位于Δ/κ=2π处的边缘顶点不稳定性。该不稳定性将高斯相与对称性保护的强相互作用无能隙相分开，实现超越标准Wilson-Fisher临界性的非平衡临界行为，并表明当Δ/κ低于临界值时长程有序持续存在。；创新点：首次在二维各向同性扩散的马尔萨斯群体模型中，通过全阶重正化群分析揭示了Δ/κ=2π处的边缘顶点不稳定性及其对长程有序和临界行为的决定性影响，并对文献中相关争议进行了重新审视和语境化。
papers.method_zh: 采用随机系统的MSRDJ作用量形式，结合与对角旋转/平移对称性的非线性实现相关的Ward恒等式，以及该模型MSRDJ表示特有的非局域场依赖冗余，对所有阶的耦合重正化及其反常维度进行了计算。

papers.title: Controllable Quantum Spin Hall Phases in Bi$_2$Te$_3$-Family van der Waals Heterobilayers
papers.abstract: The tunability and control of topological edge/surface states are crucial for the development of new device applications. In this work, by combining first-principles calculations and Wannier-based tight-binding methods, we show the emergence of quantum spin Hall phases in van der Waals heterostructures formed by stacking two trivial quintuple layers from the Bi$_2$Te$_3$ family. We demonstrate the tunability of the edge states under interlayer strain and external electric field effects, suggesting the possibility of switching topological edge states on/off by external control. Additionally, the quantum spin Hall edge channels remain robust against interlayer twist, highlighting their stability against external perturbations. Our results provide a new way to create and manipulate two-dimensional topological phases in systems based on Bi$_2$Te$_3$ family, which can be valuable for practical applications, such as topological field effect transistors and spintronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：first-principles calculations、Wannier-based tight-binding methods。；研究对象：由Bi₂Te₃家族中两个平凡（trivial）五原子层堆叠而成的范德华异质双层结构，以及其中出现的量子自旋霍尔相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在由两个平凡五原子层堆叠的Bi₂Te₃家族范德华异质双层中，出现了量子自旋霍尔相，且其边缘态可通过层间应变和外电场实现开关调控，同时边缘通道对层间扭转保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在由两个平凡五原子层堆叠的Bi₂Te₃家族范德华异质双层中，出现了量子自旋霍尔相，且其边缘态可通过层间应变和外电场实现开关调控，同时边缘通道对层间扭转保持鲁棒性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）结合基于Wannier函数的紧束缚方法（Wannier-based tight-binding methods）。

papers.title: Magnetic configurations and excitations in high-$T_{c}$ multilayer nickelates
papers.abstract: We investigate the magnetic ground states and transverse spin excitations of bilayer and trilayer nickelates within a multi-orbital itinerant framework. For the bilayer system, although Hartree-Fock calculations slightly favor a double-stripe order, the calculated excitation spectrum of the single-stripe state, characterized by an anisotropic low-energy cone at $Q_{\text{BL}}$ and isotropic high-energy excitations near $Γ$, exhibits good qualitative agreement with recent RIXS and neutron scattering experiments. We further identify mirror-even optical interlayer modes at $Q_{\text{BL}}$ whose energies match the mirror-odd modes at $Γ$. For the trilayer system, both mirror-odd and mirror-even spin-density-wave states can be stabilized near $Q_{\text{TL}}$, with the mirror-odd state lower in energy in the parameter regime studied. The mirror-odd state hosts an additional nearly gapless mode dominated by the middle layer, while the mirror-even state contains only one acoustic branch together with two gapped optical modes. Comparison with available RIXS data favors the mirror-odd spin-density-wave scenario. Our results show that magnetic excitations provide a sensitive probe of the magnetic order and support a common itinerant origin of magnetism in multilayer nickelates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：multi-orbital itinerant framework、Hartree-Fock calculations、计算激发谱。；研究对象：多层镍氧化物超导体（bilayer and trilayer nickelates）的磁基态和横向自旋激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层镍酸盐中，单条纹磁序的激发谱与RIXS和中子散射实验定性一致；在三层镍酸盐中，镜面奇宇称自旋密度波态与现有RIXS数据更吻合，表明磁激发是探测磁序的灵敏探针，支持多层镍酸盐中磁性具有共同巡游起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层镍酸盐中，单条纹磁序的激发谱与RIXS和中子散射实验定性一致；在三层镍酸盐中，镜面奇宇称自旋密度波态与现有RIXS数据更吻合，表明磁激发是探测磁序的灵敏探针，支持多层镍酸盐中磁性具有共同巡游起源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于多轨道巡游电子框架，采用Hartree-Fock计算确定磁基态，并计算横向自旋激发谱。

papers.title: Transfer-matrix functions for algebraically decaying interactions in variational infinite matrix product states
papers.abstract: Variational infinite matrix product state (iMPS) calculations usually make Hamiltonians with algebraically decaying interactions compatible with standard MPO algorithms by first replacing the target Hamiltonian with a finite-pole sum-of-exponentials surrogate, thereby introducing a Hamiltonian-representation residual. We formulate the fixed-$D$ variational energy without introducing such a surrogate. For a fixed finite-$D$ MPS, the algebraic tail can be summed directly through the connected transfer matrix: the tail $e^{\mathrm{i} Qr}/r^α$ is represented by the matrix function $F_{α,Q}(\widetilde{T}_A)$, with $F_{α,Q}(z)=\operatorname{Li}_α(e^{\mathrm{i} Q}\,z)/z$. We evaluate the resulting matrix-function action using a Krylov method and obtain stable gradients by combining a Fréchet adjoint with implicit fixed-point differentiation. Benchmarks on long-range free fermions and the inverse-square Heisenberg family, including the Haldane--Shastry point, validate the transfer-matrix-function formulation. A long-range Ising-chain calculation illustrates a practical consequence of avoiding a finite-pole Hamiltonian representation. At a fixed, independently known critical field, finite-pole surrogate Hamiltonians can bias a critical diagnostic away from criticality, whereas the matrix-function calculation retains the expected critical signatures of the target algebraic Hamiltonian.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：variational infinite matrix product state (iMPS)、transfer matrix、Krylov method、fixed-point differentiation。；研究对象：具有代数衰减相互作用（algebraically decaying interactions）的量子多体系统，具体包括长程自由费米子、逆平方海森堡族（包括Haldane–Shastry点）以及长程伊辛链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需引入有限极点指数和替代哈密顿量（finite-pole sum-of-exponentials surrogate）的方法，直接通过转移矩阵函数计算固定维数无限矩阵乘积态（iMPS）的变分能量，避免了因哈密顿量表示残差导致的临界诊断偏差。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需引入有限极点指数和替代哈密顿量（finite-pole sum-of-exponentials surrogate）的方法，直接通过转移矩阵函数计算固定维数无限矩阵乘积态（iMPS）的变分能量，避免了因哈密顿量表示残差导致的临界诊断偏差。；创新点：首次在iMPS框架下直接处理代数衰减相互作用而不引入有限极点近似，从而避免了替代哈密顿量对临界行为诊断的干扰。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于转移矩阵函数 \(F_{\alpha,Q}(\widetilde{T}_A) = \operatorname{Li}_\alpha(e^{i Q} z)/z\) 直接求和代数尾项；数值方法：使用Krylov方法评估矩阵函数作用，结合Fréchet伴随与隐式不动点微分获得稳定梯度。

papers.title: Smooth time-dependent control of dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates
papers.abstract: We consider protocols for control of dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates where the critical role is played by the long-range anisotropic interatomic magnetic dipole-dipole interaction. The phase diagram of such a condensate has been explored theoretically and experimentally with certain values of the interatomic scattering length corresponding to superfluid and supersolid phases, where supersolidity appears as a modulation in the ground state density. Preparation of this modulated ground state is challenging, since excitations appear as a result of a finite-time evolution required to produce qualitative changes in the wavefunction density. To solve this problem we consider the time-dependent control of a dipolar Bose-Einstein condensate using shortcuts to adiabaticity techniques, concentrating on design of the time-dependent scattering length, a parameter of the system easily tunable by contemporary experiments. The first technique is the variational approach based on the Euler-Lagrange equations for a separable ansatz describing the evolution of the superfluid state. Secondly, we study the transition from superfluid to supersolid using a direct optimization protocol. We discuss the fidelity of the developed protocols in terms of the evolution time.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“variational approach based on the Euler-Lagrange equations”和“direct optimization protocol”，未涉及实验数据或大规模数值计算。；研究对象：偶极玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（dipolar Bose-Einstein condensates）的超流态到超固态的相变过程，以及该过程中基态密度调制的制备。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计随时间可调的散射长度（利用“捷径到绝热”技术），可以在有限时间内高效制备偶极BEC的超固态调制基态，并抑制激发产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计随时间可调的散射长度（利用“捷径到绝热”技术），可以在有限时间内高效制备偶极BEC的超固态调制基态，并抑制激发产生。；创新点：将“捷径到绝热”（shortcuts to adiabaticity）技术应用于偶极BEC的超流-超固态相变控制，通过优化散射长度的时间演化来克服有限时间演化导致的激发问题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 1. 基于可分离波函数假设的变分法（Euler-Lagrange方程）；2. 直接优化协议（direct optimization protocol）。两者均用于设计时间依赖的散射长度控制方案。

papers.title: A Defect-Free Model of Amorphous Silicon with Pristine Electronic Structure
papers.abstract: Amorphous silicon (a-Si) is understood to be the canonical continuous random network material, ideally defined by fully fourfold coordination. Here, we show that a defect-free ('ideal') model of a-Si from machine-learning-driven molecular-dynamics simulations [L. A. M. Rosset et al., Nat. Commun. 16, 2360 (2025)], subsequently evaluated with hybrid-level density-functional theory computations, can accurately reproduce the experimentally observed electronic bandgap. We compare this model with one resulting from the Wooten-Winer-Weaire (WWW) bond-switching approach and with other recent approximants to ideal a-Si. More broadly, our work provides a platform for studies of band tails, optical properties, and transport in a-Si.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词包括“machine-learning-driven molecular-dynamics simulations”、“hybrid-level density-functional theory computations”。；研究对象：非晶硅（amorphous silicon, a-Si），具体为无缺陷（理想）连续随机网络模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习分子动力学模拟构建的无缺陷非晶硅模型，经杂化密度泛函理论计算后，能够准确复现实验观测到的电子带隙。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习分子动力学模拟构建的无缺陷非晶硅模型，经杂化密度泛函理论计算后，能够准确复现实验观测到的电子带隙。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习驱动的分子动力学模拟（用于构建模型），以及杂化密度泛函理论计算（用于评估电子结构）。

papers.title: Correlated Mott semi-metal in the topological heavy fermion model
papers.abstract: The topological heavy-fermion model provides a minimal framework for describing the coexistence of localized moments and itinerant Dirac electrons in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG). Several analytical and numerical methods have been applied to this model; however, whether they provide a realistic description of MATBG remains incompletely understood. In this work, we develop an Hubbard operator approach that incorporates non-local correlations beyond the single-site limit. We benchmark the approximate calculations against numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations of a lattice-regularized model. We show that commonly used local approximations, such as Hubbard-I, fail to capture the coupling between localized and itinerant degrees of freedom, leading to incorrect spectral properties in the local-moment regime. In contrast, the Hubbard operator method provides a controlled description of both correlation functions and spectral features over a regime of parameters, in good agreement with exact numerical methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Hubbard operator approach、determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations、lattice-regularized model）；研究对象：拓扑重费米子模型中的关联Mott半金属态，具体针对魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（MATBG）中局域磁矩与巡游狄拉克电子的共存体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 常用的局域近似（如Hubbard-I）无法正确描述局域与巡游自由度之间的耦合，导致局域磁矩区间的谱性质错误；而Hubbard算符方法能提供与精确数值方法一致的关联函数和谱特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：常用的局域近似（如Hubbard-I）无法正确描述局域与巡游自由度之间的耦合，导致局域磁矩区间的谱性质错误；而Hubbard算符方法能提供与精确数值方法一致的关联函数和谱特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 发展了超越单站点极限的Hubbard算符方法（包含非局域关联），并通过格点正则化模型与精确的行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）模拟进行基准对比。

papers.title: Polymer-polymer interdiffusion: effects of entanglements and a polymeric source
papers.abstract: Many industrial applications and biological scenarios involve the interdiffusion of two polymeric species. Motivated by biological subcellular source-driven processes, we study polymer-polymer interdiffusion problems in the absence or the presence of a polymeric source, for both unentangled and entangled scenarios. Utilizing a two-fluid formalism, we arrive at scaling relations, self-similar reductions, and analytical solutions, which are confirmed with one- and two-dimensional numerical simulations. The introduction of a source term breaks the self-similar structure, modifying the boundary conditions and the domain of integration. Nevertheless, we show that the front characteristics of the diffusing droplet exhibit similar spatial structures as in the absence of a source. Our results allow deeper understanding of polymer-polymer interdiffusion and nonlinear transport, especially in the presence of a source.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：scaling relations, self-similar reductions, analytical solutions, two-fluid formalism, numerical simulations）；研究对象：聚合物-聚合物互扩散过程，特别关注高分子链缠结效应以及存在聚合物源（polymeric source）的情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入源项会破坏自相似结构并改变边界条件与积分域，但扩散液滴的前沿特征在有无源项时仍表现出相似的空间结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入源项会破坏自相似结构并改变边界条件与积分域，但扩散液滴的前沿特征在有无源项时仍表现出相似的空间结构。；创新点：首次系统研究了存在聚合物源（受生物亚细胞源驱动过程启发）时，缠结与非缠结聚合物体系的互扩散问题，揭示了源项对自相似性及边界条件的影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用双流体（two-fluid）形式化理论框架，推导标度关系、自相似约化及解析解，并通过一维和二维数值模拟进行验证。

papers.title: Scaling, fractal dynamics, and critical exponents in the equilibrium phase transition
papers.abstract: Statistical methods are essential for understanding thermodynamic systems with many degrees of freedom. For systems in equilibrium, a very useful method is that of correlation functions, which establish a correlation between a field phi(x), which depends on the spatial position x, and the same field evaluated at another position, phi(x0). Fisher [Journal of Mathematical Physics 5, 944322 (1964)] introduced the autocorrelation function for fluctuations of the order parameter, which has been an important mathematical tool for understanding second-order phase transitions in equilibrium. However, his analysis is restricted to a Euclidean space of dimension d, and an exponent eta is introduced to correct the spatial behavior of the correlation function at T = Tc. In a recent work, Lima et al. [Phys. Rev. E 110, L062107 (2024)] demonstrated that a modern fractional differential analysis is necessary for a complete description of the correlation function at Tc. In this study, we highlight the deep connection among scaling behavior, critical exponents, and fractal geometry. Our results provide a unified geometric interpretation of critical exponents and fractal dimensions, broadly applicable to thermodynamic phase transitions. However, the approach does not apply to topological phase transitions, which lack local order parameters and the associated scale-invariant fractal geometry. We verify its predictions for several cornerstone thermodynamic models: the Ising, Potts, XY, and Heisenberg systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“统计方法”“相关函数”“分数阶微分分析”“临界指数”“分形几何”等理论分析工具，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：平衡态热力学系统中的二级相变，具体包括伊辛模型、Potts模型、XY模型和海森堡模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了标度行为、临界指数与分形几何之间的深层联系，为临界指数和分形维数提供了统一的几何解释，该解释广泛适用于热力学相变，但不适用于拓扑相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了标度行为、临界指数与分形几何之间的深层联系，为临界指数和分形维数提供了统一的几何解释，该解释广泛适用于热力学相变，但不适用于拓扑相变。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用分数阶微分分析（modern fractional differential analysis）对临界温度（T = Tc）下的序参量涨落自相关函数进行完整描述，并结合标度理论和分形几何进行统一分析。

papers.title: Space-time duality approach to (inhomogeneous) integrable quenches
papers.abstract: Characterising the universal aspects of non-equilibrium quantum many-body dynamics is one of the key goals of this century's physics research. Progress, however, is hindered by the lack of general theoretical frameworks for studying interacting quantum matter far from equilibrium. A recent breakthrough has been the realization that several key non-equilibrium quantities, such as the rate of growth of entanglement or the fluctuations of conserved charges within finite subsystems, can be related to equilibrium properties through a space-time duality that effectively exchanges the roles of space and time. This observation effectively enables the study of non-equilibrium phenomena using tools and concepts borrowed from equilibrium statistical mechanics and thermodynamics. A first proof of principle of this framework, dubbed space-time duality approach (SDA), was provided by interacting integrable systems, where thermodynamic properties can often be characterized exactly, while dynamical quantities typically remain beyond analytical reach. Subsequent developments, however, revealed that the SDA suffered from an intrinsic ambiguity, restricting its applicability to homogeneous quenches and to charge fluctuations arising from symmetric initial states. Here we resolve this ambiguity from first principles and derive closed-form predictions for entanglement growth and charge fluctuations after general quantum quenches. We benchmark our results against the exact analytical solution of the Rule 54 quantum cellular automaton and extensive TEBD simulations of the XXZ chain. Moreover we show that, when specialised to the entanglement entropy, our framework naturally reproduces the predictions of the quasiparticle picture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“从第一性原理解决歧义”“推导出封闭形式的预测”，并涉及与精确解析解和数值模拟（TEBD）的对比验证，属于理论框架构建与验证。；研究对象：非平衡量子多体动力学中的可积淬火过程（包括均匀和非均匀淬火），具体涉及纠缠增长和守恒荷涨落等非平衡量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 解决了时空对偶方法（SDA）在可积淬火中存在的内在歧义，首次从第一性原理推导出一般量子淬火后纠缠增长和电荷涨落的封闭形式预测，并证明该框架在纠缠熵上自然复现准粒子图像的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：解决了时空对偶方法（SDA）在可积淬火中存在的内在歧义，首次从第一性原理推导出一般量子淬火后纠缠增长和电荷涨落的封闭形式预测，并证明该框架在纠缠熵上自然复现准粒子图像的结果。；创新点：从第一性原理解决了SDA方法在非均匀淬火和非对称初始态电荷涨落计算中的内在歧义，将其适用范围从均匀淬火和对称初始态推广到一般量子淬火。
papers.method_zh: 时空对偶方法（SDA），结合精确可解模型（Rule 54量子元胞自动机）的解析解和XXZ链的TEBD（时间演化块消去）数值模拟进行基准测试。

papers.title: Polaronic hybridization of atoms, dimers and trimers in a Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: The Bose polaron problem of an impurity immersed in a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) has been predicted to feature strong correlations arising from bound states of multiple bosons with the impurity. While direct experimental evidence has so far remained elusive, here we observe clear signatures of three-body correlations in Bose polarons. We perform radiofrequency spectroscopy on $^{40}$K impurities in a BEC of $^{23}$Na and identify polaronic hybrid states that can be understood as superpositions of the bare atom, a NaK dimer and a Na$_2$K trimer, coupled through coherent particle exchange with the condensate. We show that the main spectroscopic features are captured by a simple three-level model without free parameters. Our work shows how a condensate environment can coherently hybridize bound states of different composition and mass, reminiscent of quark-flavor mixing described by the Cabibbo-Kobayashi-Maskawa (CKM) matrix in particle physics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“we observe”、“perform radiofrequency spectroscopy”、“experimental evidence”。；研究对象：玻色极化子（Bose polaron）体系，具体为浸入钠（²³Na）玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）中的钾（⁴⁰K）杂质原子，以及由此形成的原子、二聚体（NaK）和三聚体（Na₂K）的极化杂化态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验观测到玻色极化子中由多体束缚态（二聚体、三聚体）与凝聚体相干粒子交换耦合形成的极化杂化态，这些态可理解为裸原子、NaK二聚体和Na₂K三聚体的量子叠加。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验观测到玻色极化子中由多体束缚态（二聚体、三聚体）与凝聚体相干粒子交换耦合形成的极化杂化态，这些态可理解为裸原子、NaK二聚体和Na₂K三聚体的量子叠加。；创新点：首次在实验上清晰观测到玻色极化子中由三体关联（三聚体）引起的强关联效应，并揭示了凝聚体环境如何像粒子物理中的CKM矩阵混合夸克味一样，相干地杂化不同组成和质量的束缚态。
papers.method_zh: 对BEC中的⁴⁰K杂质进行射频（radiofrequency）光谱学测量，并用一个无自由参数的三能级模型拟合主要光谱特征。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect Enhances Pairing Correlations in Moiré Hubbard Systems
papers.abstract: We show that the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE) can enhance pairing correlations in moiré Hubbard systems through a channel-selective mechanism: skin-induced localization amplifies the boundary density of states, strengthening local pairing tendencies within an intermediate ``golden window'' of non-reciprocity $γ\in[0.5,1.2]\,t$. Using exact diagonalization of the non-Hermitian Hubbard model on triangular lattices with open boundaries, we map the $(U,γ)$ phase diagram. The double occupancy $D(γ)$ exhibits non-monotonic behavior -- rising by up to 21\% then declining -- reflecting a competition between NHSE-enhanced boundary pairing and over-localization. A decomposition of the pairing susceptibility $χ_{\mathrm{SC}}$ on the $3\times3$ cluster reveals that the NHSE acts \emph{channel-selectively}: it enhances on-site pairing ($+21\%$) while simultaneously suppressing competing antiferromagnetic correlations (22\% reduction), so that the total pairing susceptibility, dominated by the on-site channel, grows by $+98\%$ on that cluster. These trends are corroborated by an independent non-Hermitian DMRG calculation and establish an enhancement of finite-cluster pairing correlations rather than trivial density redistribution. We do not claim long-range superconducting order. A BCS scaling estimate converts the same pairing-response signal into a dome-shaped $T_c(γ)$ fingerprint, suggesting an experimentally distinguishable response in coherent-drive versus reservoir-dominated moiré devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：exact diagonalization、non-Hermitian DMRG计算、BCS scaling estimate。；研究对象：莫尔哈伯德体系（moiré Hubbard systems）中的非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）与配对关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非厄米趋肤效应通过通道选择性机制增强莫尔哈伯德体系中的配对关联：在非互易强度γ∈[0.5,1.2]t的“黄金窗口”内，趋肤诱导的局域化放大边界态密度，使局域配对倾向增强；同时竞争性的反铁磁关联被抑制，导致总配对磁化率在有限团簇上增长高达98%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非厄米趋肤效应通过通道选择性机制增强莫尔哈伯德体系中的配对关联：在非互易强度γ∈[0.5,1.2]t的“黄金窗口”内，趋肤诱导的局域化放大边界态密度，使局域配对倾向增强；同时竞争性的反铁磁关联被抑制，导致总配对磁化率在有限团簇上增长高达98%。；创新点：揭示了非厄米趋肤效应对配对关联的通道选择性增强机制（增强局域配对+21%，同时抑制反铁磁关联22%），并指出该效应并非简单的密度重分布，而是有限团簇上配对关联的真实增强。摘要未突出说明与已有非厄米超导研究的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用开放边界三角晶格上的非厄米哈伯德模型精确对角化，绘制(U,γ)相图；在3×3团簇上分解配对磁化率χ_SC；并使用独立的非厄米DMRG计算进行验证。

papers.title: Superconductivity and non-Fermi liquid metals in a charge-1/3 anyon fluid
papers.abstract: We revisit the charge-1/3 anyon fluid obtained by doping the $ν= 2/3$ Jain fractional Chern insulator (FCI). In the standard composite fermion description, the doped anyons fractionalize into three translation-related flavors of secondary composite fermions, whose gauge-mediated interactions drive a robust inter-flavor pairing instability. In our previous work, we analyzed a flavor-asymmetric paired state and obtained a charge-ordered Fermi liquid. Inspired by a recent paper, we consider an alternative flavor-symmetric paired state and show that it is an SC* state: a charge-$2e$ condensate that coexists with residual $\mathbb{Z}_2$ topological order. The weak and strong pairing regimes share the same intrinsic topological order but differ in chiral central charge, giving $c_- = 7/2$ and $c_- = 2$. We further show how other proposed effective field theories fit within the same composite fermion description, and argue that across the doping driven FCI-to-superconductor transition, localized anyons evolve into Bogoliubov quasiparticles rather than vortices. At low doping, we identify an approximate SU(3)-symmetric regime in which the system instead realizes a non-Fermi liquid $\mathbb{Z}_3$ Orthogonal Metal with three charge-1/3 fermion pockets and no sharp electron quasiparticle. Finally, we comment on the energetics of various possible ground states and discuss implications for experiments in moire materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：理论框架、有效场论、配对不稳定性分析。；研究对象：电荷为1/3的任意子流体，具体是通过掺杂ν=2/3 Jain分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）得到的系统。该研究探讨了该系统中的超导态和非费米液体金属态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电荷1/3任意子流体中，通过考虑一种新的味道对称的配对态，发现了一个SC*态：一种与残余Z₂拓扑序共存的电荷-2e凝聚体。此外，在低掺杂区域，系统会实现一种非费米液体的Z₃正交金属态，具有三个电荷1/3的费米口袋且没有尖锐的电子准粒子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电荷1/3任意子流体中，通过考虑一种新的味道对称的配对态，发现了一个SC*态：一种与残余Z₂拓扑序共存的电荷-2e凝聚体。此外，在低掺杂区域，系统会实现一种非费米液体的Z₃正交金属态，具有三个电荷1/3的费米口袋且没有尖锐的电子准粒子。；创新点：该工作提出了一个不同于以往工作的味道对称配对态，并证明其对应一个SC*态。同时，它统一了多种已有的有效场论描述，并阐明了从FCI到超导体的掺杂驱动转变中，局域任意子演化为Bogoliubov准粒子而非涡旋的物理图像。此外，还识别了一个新的非费米液体相（Z₃正交金属）。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用复合费米子理论框架。具体地，将掺杂的任意子分解为三种与平移相关的次级复合费米子，并分析由规范场介导的相互作用所驱动的配对不稳定性。通过比较不同配对态（味道不对称与味道对称）的性质，以及分析弱配对和强配对区域的不同手征中心荷（c_- = 7/2 和 c_- = 2），来构建相图。

papers.title: Mixed Floquet Lattice model for gapless topology
papers.abstract: We investigate the realization of a time-reversal-broken Weyl semimetal in Floquet synthetic dimensions generated by two incommensurate drives, in the spirit of topological frequency conversion in driven synthetic lattices PRX 7, 041008 (2017). The system is described by a one-dimensional lattice model in a mixed $(1~\mathrm{real}+2~\mathrm{synthetic})$-dimensional setting, where the driving phases act as synthetic momenta and generate Weyl points in the mixed Floquet band structure. Using the topology associated with these band degeneracies, we analyze the energy transfer between the two drives. We find that the mixed Floquet lattice captures the Weyl-semimetal topology only in a momentum-resolved sense: for fixed real momentum $k_x$, the power transfer measures the $k_x$-resolved Chern number and detects the separation of the Weyl nodes. However, the full real-space response is qualitatively different. The total power transfer does not reproduce the static Weyl-semimetal phase diagram, but instead follows an effective Rice-Mele-type pumping structure. Thus, in contrast to fully gapped topological insulators, gapless semimetallic phases do not straightforwardly translate to Floquet synthetic dimensions. Our results reveal a distinct dynamical phase structure of driven Weyl systems and establish mixed Floquet lattices as a platform for exploring non-equilibrium gapless topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We investigate”“We analyze”“Our results reveal”等理论分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：由两个不可公度驱动产生的Floquet合成维度中的时间反演对称破缺Weyl半金属，具体为混合（1实空间+2合成维度）一维晶格模型中的拓扑频率转换现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 混合Floquet晶格仅在动量分辨意义上捕捉Weyl半金属拓扑（功率转移测量k_x分辨陈数并检测Weyl节点分离），但全实空间响应不重现静态Weyl半金属相图，而是遵循有效Rice-Mele型泵浦结构，表明无能隙半金属相不能直接移植到Floquet合成维度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：混合Floquet晶格仅在动量分辨意义上捕捉Weyl半金属拓扑（功率转移测量k_x分辨陈数并检测Weyl节点分离），但全实空间响应不重现静态Weyl半金属相图，而是遵循有效Rice-Mele型泵浦结构，表明无能隙半金属相不能直接移植到Floquet合成维度。；创新点：揭示了驱动Weyl系统具有与静态Weyl半金属不同的动力学相结构，并建立混合Floquet晶格作为探索非平衡无能隙拓扑的平台。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于不可公度双驱动构建Floquet合成维度，采用混合（1实空间+2合成维度）晶格模型，通过驱动相位作为合成动量生成Weyl点，利用能带简并拓扑分析两驱动间的能量转移。

papers.title: Charge imprinting biases topology of correlated insulator in hBN-aligned rhombohedral multilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene aligned with hexagonal boron nitride (RMG-hBN) hosts correlated Chern phases, but the microscopic role of hBN stacking remains unclear, especially when the active carriers are displaced away from the moiré interface. Using Hartree-Fock calculations over layer numbers, twist angles, displacement fields, fillings, and hBN alignments, we show that correlated insulators are most robust at small twist angles and intermediate layer number ($N\simeq 6$), where bandwidth suppression is balanced by layer delocalization of the wavefunctions of the active carriers. Under moiré-distant conditions at filling $ν=1$, the topology of the insulating state is strongly biased by charge imprinting: the hBN alignment shapes the occupied valence-band charge texture near the interface via moiré potential, which acts through long-range Coulomb interactions as a remote electrostatic template for doped conduction electrons. Depending on the alignment, this template favors either triangular charge localization associated with trivial insulators or honeycomb-like charge networks compatible with Chern insulators. Our results identify valence-band charge textures as a microscopic route by which a remote moiré interface controls correlated topology in multilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：使用Hartree-Fock计算，涉及层数、扭转角、位移场、填充和hBN对齐等参数的系统计算。；研究对象：与六方氮化硼（hBN）对齐的菱面体多层石墨烯（RMG-hBN）中的关联Chern相，特别是hBN堆叠对关联绝缘体拓扑性质的微观影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离莫尔界面的条件下（填充ν=1），hBN对齐通过电荷印记效应强烈偏置绝缘态的拓扑性质：hBN的莫尔势塑造了界面附近价带电荷纹理，该纹理通过长程库仑相互作用作为远程静电模板，决定掺杂导带电子是形成三角晶格局域化（平庸绝缘体）还是蜂窝状电荷网络（Chern绝缘体）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离莫尔界面的条件下（填充ν=1），hBN对齐通过电荷印记效应强烈偏置绝缘态的拓扑性质：hBN的莫尔势塑造了界面附近价带电荷纹理，该纹理通过长程库仑相互作用作为远程静电模板，决定掺杂导带电子是形成三角晶格局域化（平庸绝缘体）还是蜂窝状电荷网络（Chern绝缘体）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: Hartree-Fock计算，系统扫描层数（N）、扭转角、位移场、填充数（ν）和hBN对齐方式。

papers.title: Breaking symmetry to create a parallel-plate varactor dielectric with unparalleled microwave performance
papers.abstract: Voltage-tunable capacitors (varactors) are key to microwave circuits. Tunable dielectric varactors outperform competing technologies in almost every relevant metric but usually suffer from high dielectric loss. In contrast, Ruddlesden-Popper (RPs) dielectric thin films have remarkably low microwave loss. Unfortunately, their crystallographic symmetry has until recently dictated an in-plane device structure, precluding the favorable out-of-plane parallel-plate varactor design for minimized size and maximized electric field in the tunable dielectric. Guided by theory, we report RPs akin to the widely studied tunable microwave dielectric BaxSr1-xTiO3. Assembling these same atoms into the first RP phase with broken out-of-plane symmetry, we achieve a low-loss, out-of-plane tunable dielectric thin film. The highest performing film, (ATiO3)nAO film with A = Ba0.45Sr0.55 and n = 8, unlocks a tenfold improvement in the figure of merit for out-of-plane tunable dielectrics at 10 GHz, paving the way for a new generation of tunable monolithic microwave integrated circuits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report”“achieve”“unlocks”等实验性动词，并描述了薄膜制备与性能测试结果。；研究对象：Ruddlesden-Popper（RP）相介电薄膜，具体为(ATiO₃)ₙAO（A = Ba₀.₄₅Sr₀.₅₅，n = 8）体系，研究其作为可调介电材料在微波频段的性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过打破RP相的晶体对称性，实现了低损耗、面外方向可调的介电薄膜，在10 GHz下将面外可调介电材料的品质因数提升了十倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过打破RP相的晶体对称性，实现了低损耗、面外方向可调的介电薄膜，在10 GHz下将面外可调介电材料的品质因数提升了十倍。；创新点：首次将RP相介电薄膜从传统的面内器件结构转变为面外平行板电容器结构，从而同时实现低微波损耗与高电场可调性，克服了传统可调介电材料损耗高的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 理论指导下的材料设计（基于对称性分析），制备RP相薄膜（具体生长方法摘要未明确说明），并在10 GHz下测量其介电调谐性能与损耗。

papers.title: Effective masses, Burstein-Moss shift, and bandgap renormalization in degenerate Al-doped ZnO from broadband ellipsometry and Hall measurements
papers.abstract: A comprehensive methodology is developed to extract electron and hole effective masses in degenerate semiconductors through a simultaneous global fit of carrier concentration dependence of bandgap and plasma energy, explicitly incorporating band nonparabolicity. Broadband spectroscopic ellipsometry combined with Hall effect analyses enables accurate determination of the bandgap, plasma energy and carrier concentrations. The dielectric function of sputtered Al-doped ZnO thin films are modeled in the fundamental absorption region using an Elliott based model with overlapping excitonic transitions and Urbach tails, while free carrier absorption is described by a modified sernelius formula. Wide carrier concentrations are achieved via controlled deposition and post-annealing, revealing changes in electron effective masses and deviations from parabolic dispersion. Two nonparabolic models are compared, Pisarkiewicz, assuming spherically symmetric band with a step-function approximation of the Fermi-Dirac distribution and Nilsson, incorporating thermal and impurity effects. The latter is shown to capture accurately band nonparabolicity, yielding effective masses and nonparabolicity parameter consistent with bandgap evolution. This approach quantitatively separates Burstein-Moss shift and bandgap renormalization, reproducing carrier dependent bandgap shifts across a wide concentration range. Neglecting valence band contributions introduces systematic bias. Bandgap renormalization is further evaluated using plasmon pole and random phase approximations, underscoring the importance of many-body screening. This framework also enables determination of the Mott critical concentration and the fundamental absorption edge onset. Collectively, these results establish a reliable methodology for extracting band-structure parameters and bandgap shifts, extendable to other transparent conducting oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论建模）。关键词：broadband spectroscopic ellipsometry, Hall effect measurements, global fit, nonparabolic models。；研究对象：Al掺杂ZnO（AZO）薄膜，具体研究其简并半导体中的电子和空穴有效质量、Burstein-Moss位移、带隙重整化效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过同时拟合带隙和等离子体能量随载流子浓度的变化，并明确考虑能带非抛物性，可准确提取简并半导体的有效质量与非抛物性参数；该方法能定量分离Burstein-Moss位移与带隙重整化，并揭示价带贡献不可忽略。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过同时拟合带隙和等离子体能量随载流子浓度的变化，并明确考虑能带非抛物性，可准确提取简并半导体的有效质量与非抛物性参数；该方法能定量分离Burstein-Moss位移与带隙重整化，并揭示价带贡献不可忽略。；创新点：建立了同时拟合带隙与等离子体能量以提取有效质量的全局方法，并系统比较了两种非抛物性模型，证明Nilsson模型能更准确描述能带非抛物性；定量分离了Burstein-Moss位移与带隙重整化，并指出忽略价带贡献会引入系统性偏差。
papers.method_zh: 宽带光谱椭偏仪（broadband spectroscopic ellipsometry）结合霍尔效应（Hall effect）测量；介电函数在基本吸收区采用基于Elliott模型的激子跃迁与Urbach尾拟合，自由载流子吸收采用修正的Sernelius公式；非抛物性模型比较了Pisarkiewicz模型（球形对称带+费米-狄拉克阶梯近似）与Nilsson模型（包含热效应与杂质效应）；带隙重整化采用等离子体极点近似（plasmon pole approximation）和随机相位近似（random phase approximation）评估。

papers.title: Diagnosing the origin of quantum oscillation beating in graphene
papers.abstract: Magnetic quantum oscillations are usually periodic in inverse magnetic field, and their amplitude can show beating when two nearby frequencies interfere. In graphene-based hexagonal systems, such beating can arise from strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields, unequal valley populations, valley-dependent energy shifts, spin-orbit coupling-induced band splitting, or Kekulé distortions. Here, we show that the carrier density and magnetic field dependence of the beating nodes can distinguish these mechanisms. Starting from Onsager's quantization relation, we derive scaling relations for the critical carrier density $N_c$ for the beating nodes as a function of critical magnetic field $B_c$. A pseudomagnetic field gives $N_c\propto B_c^2$, whereas a density-independent valley imbalance gives $N_c\propto B_c$. A constant Dirac-band energy splitting by Zeeman-like spin-orbit coupling also gives quadratic field scaling, but with a different node sequence: $N_{c,j}\propto(2j+1)B_{c,j}^2$ for a pseudomagnetic field and $N_{c,j}\propto(2j+1)^2B_{c,j}^2$ for energy splitting, where $j$ labels the beating node indices. These results provide quantitative constraints on different microscopic origins of valley- and spin-dependent band splittings in graphene-based systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we derive scaling relations”“we show”等理论推导和模型分析表述，未提及实验或计算模拟手段。；研究对象：石墨烯中磁量子振荡拍频现象的起源诊断，具体涉及应变诱导的赝磁场、不等谷布居、谷依赖能移、自旋-轨道耦合导致的能带劈裂以及Kekulé畸变等机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过推导拍频节点处临界载流子密度 \(N_c\) 与临界磁场 \(B_c\) 之间的标度关系，可以区分不同微观机制：赝磁场给出 \(N_c \propto B_c^2\)，而密度无关的谷不平衡给出 \(N_c \propto B_c\)；此外，赝磁场与类塞曼自旋-轨道耦合的能劈裂虽都给出二次方标度，但节点序列的指数不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过推导拍频节点处临界载流子密度 \(N_c\) 与临界磁场 \(B_c\) 之间的标度关系，可以区分不同微观机制：赝磁场给出 \(N_c \propto B_c^2\)，而密度无关的谷不平衡给出 \(N_c \propto B_c\)；此外，赝磁场与类塞曼自旋-轨道耦合的能劈裂虽都给出二次方标度，但节点序列的指数不同。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于Onsager量子化关系，推导了拍频节点处临界载流子密度与临界磁场的标度关系，并对比了不同机制下的节点序列规律。

papers.title: Tunable Flat Bands and magnetism in Triangulene-based Superatomic Graphene
papers.abstract: Superatomic graphene platforms host a rich portfolio of flat-band-driven exotic quantum properties, yet their experimental realization remains challenging. Here, we report the bottom-up on-surface synthesis of superatomic graphene using phosphorus-doped triangulene as building blocks. Scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy measurements resolve the well-defined honeycomb lattice of as-fabricated superatomic graphene and demonstrate the characteristic Dirac band and flat band electronic structures. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the flat bands originate from the in-plane p$_x,_y$-like frontier orbitals of the phosphorus-doped triangulene units, leading to intrinsic half-metallic behavior. Furthermore, oxygen functionalization of the molecular precursor enables deterministic modulation of the electronic structure and magnetic ordering. This work establishes a general platform for designing correlated quantum materials with tunable flat band properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：bottom-up on-surface synthesis、scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy、density functional theory calculations，属于实验与计算结合类型）；研究对象：基于磷掺杂三角烯（phosphorus-doped triangulene）构筑的超原子石墨烯（superatomic graphene）及其平带电子结构和磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功在表面上合成了超原子石墨烯，观察到狄拉克带和平带电子结构；平带源于磷掺杂三角烯单元的面内p_x,y型前沿轨道，导致本征半金属行为；氧功能化可调控电子结构和磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功在表面上合成了超原子石墨烯，观察到狄拉克带和平带电子结构；平带源于磷掺杂三角烯单元的面内p_x,y型前沿轨道，导致本征半金属行为；氧功能化可调控电子结构和磁有序。；创新点：首次利用磷掺杂三角烯作为构筑块实现超原子石墨烯的表面上合成，并展示了平带的可调性及氧功能化对磁性的调控。摘要未突出说明与已有超原子石墨烯实验工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 自下而上的表面合成（bottom-up on-surface synthesis）、扫描隧道显微镜（STM）和扫描隧道谱（STS）、密度泛函理论（DFT）计算。

papers.title: Thermal reconstruction as a method of substrate preparation for highly crystalline superconducting TiN resonators
papers.abstract: High quality crystalline growth of a thin film on sapphire requires sufficient substrate preparation, often achieved via the use of aggressive chemical cleaning. Direct thermal reconstruction of the sapphire substrate via a CO$_2$ laser beam may allow for an alternative way to prepare the substrate for epitaxy without the use of any chemical processing. Within this work, we demonstrate that thermal annealing of sapphire into its ($\sqrt{31}$$\times$$\sqrt{31}$)$R$$\pm$9° reconstruction is a valid alternative preparation technique for sapphire substrates. TiN films grown via plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy upon these substrates exhibit greater crystallinity than those grown on chemically cleaned sapphire substrates. Superconducting resonators fabricated from these films exhibit similar performance, with many possessing internal quality factors at single photon levels greater than 10$^6$ for both substrate preparation methods.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验过程（thermal annealing、film growth、fabrication）和性能测试（internal quality factors）。；研究对象：在蓝宝石（sapphire）衬底上通过热重构方法制备的高结晶性超导氮化钛（TiN）薄膜及其谐振器。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过CO₂激光热退火使蓝宝石衬底形成(√31×√31)R±9°重构表面，可作为无需化学处理的替代衬底制备方法。在此衬底上生长的TiN薄膜结晶性优于化学清洗衬底上生长的薄膜，且制成的超导谐振器在单光子水平内禀品质因数均超过10⁶，性能相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过CO₂激光热退火使蓝宝石衬底形成(√31×√31)R±9°重构表面，可作为无需化学处理的替代衬底制备方法。在此衬底上生长的TiN薄膜结晶性优于化学清洗衬底上生长的薄膜，且制成的超导谐振器在单光子水平内禀品质因数均超过10⁶，性能相当。；创新点：提出并验证了利用CO₂激光直接热重构蓝宝石衬底（无需任何化学清洗）作为外延生长衬底制备的新方法，并证明该方法可提升TiN薄膜结晶性且不降低超导谐振器性能。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：CO₂激光热退火实现蓝宝石表面重构、等离子体辅助分子束外延（plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy）生长TiN薄膜、超导谐振器制备及内禀品质因数测量。

papers.title: Fractional excitations in Kitaev quasi-one-dimensional chain
papers.abstract: The Kitaev honeycomb model has attracted significant interest due to its quantum spin liquid ground state, fractionalized Majorana excitations, and topological properties. Motivated by these features, we introduce a quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev-like spin chain derived from a truncated honeycomb geometry. The resulting Majorana band structure contains both dispersive and flat bands, with a gap closing at a critical anisotropy that separates trivial and chiral topological phases. Under open boundary conditions, the topological regime hosts zero-energy edge modes protected by chiral symmetry, placing the system in the BDI symmetry class with a quantized winding number. In the excited spectrum, localized plaquette modes emerge near zero energy and can be tuned by introducing domains of negative plaquettes. The dynamical spin correlation function reveals broad continua associated with fractionalized excitations, together with characteristic low-energy spectral weight from edge Majorana modes. These features distinguish the present system from conventional Heisenberg spin chains and provide experimentally relevant fingerprints of chiral topological order. Our model thus establishes a conceptual bridge between the two-dimensional Kitaev spin liquid and Kitaev's one-dimensional quantum wire.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入模型”“Majorana能带结构”“拓扑相”“动力学自旋关联函数”等理论分析关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：准一维Kitaev自旋链，该模型由截断的蜂窝状几何结构导出，研究其分数化激发、拓扑相及边缘态等物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该准一维Kitaev链在拓扑相中存在受手征对称性保护的无能隙边缘模，属于BDI对称性类，具有量子化的绕数；激发谱中零能附近出现可调谐的局域plaquette模，且动力学自旋关联函数呈现与分数化激发相关的宽连续谱及边缘Majorana模的低能谱权重。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该准一维Kitaev链在拓扑相中存在受手征对称性保护的无能隙边缘模，属于BDI对称性类，具有量子化的绕数；激发谱中零能附近出现可调谐的局域plaquette模，且动力学自旋关联函数呈现与分数化激发相关的宽连续谱及边缘Majorana模的低能谱权重。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与分析：从截断的蜂窝状几何结构构造准一维Kitaev自旋链模型，通过Majorana费米子表示分析能带结构（含色散带与平带），研究临界各向异性处的能隙闭合，利用开放边界条件识别边缘态，计算动力学自旋关联函数以揭示分数化激发特征。

papers.title: All-In-All-Out Pyrochlore Iridates as Noncollinear Spin-Orbit Coupled Counterparts of Altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnetically ordered states that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting in the absence of net magnetization and spin-orbit coupling (SOC). Related spin-splitting patterns, however, can also emerge in noncollinear magnetic systems with large SOC. Here we show, via a microscopic model, that the all-in-all-out (AIAO) state in pyrochlore iridates constitutes a noncollinear counterpart of a $d$-wave altermagnet stabilized by strong SOC. Starting from a microscopic $j_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1/2$ tight-binding model on the pyrochlore lattice, we demonstrate that electronic interactions favor the AIAO phase and analyze its symmetry properties. We show that the AIAO order parameter transforms as an $A_{2g}^{-}$ octupolar magnetic moment, breaking time-reversal symmetry while preserving inversion and zero net magnetization. Using group-theory analysis and mean-field calculations, we demonstrate that this symmetry enforces both a spin-polarized momentum-dependent lifting of band degeneracies that is similar to that of a collinear $d$-wave cubic altermagnet, but also a band splitting at zero-momentum. We show that the latter feature is captured by a low-energy model similar to the Luttinger-Kohn model for cubic semiconductors. Our results identify pyrochlore iridates as a platform for noncollinear counterparts of altermagnetism and provide a general symmetry framework for spin-split phenomena in spin-orbit coupled materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“via a microscopic model”、“group-theory analysis and mean-field calculations”、“low-energy model”等关键词，未涉及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：烧绿石铱氧化物（pyrochlore iridates）中的全入全出（all-in-all-out, AIAO）磁有序态，作为非共线自旋-轨道耦合对应物与交变磁体（altermagnets）的对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AIAO态在强自旋-轨道耦合下构成d波交变磁体的非共线对应物，其对称性导致动量依赖的自旋极化能带劈裂，并在零动量处也产生能带劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AIAO态在强自旋-轨道耦合下构成d波交变磁体的非共线对应物，其对称性导致动量依赖的自旋极化能带劈裂，并在零动量处也产生能带劈裂。；创新点：首次将烧绿石铱氧化物的AIAO态识别为交变磁体的非共线对应物，并建立了一个普适的对称性框架，用于理解自旋-轨道耦合材料中的自旋劈裂现象。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观\(j_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2\)紧束缚模型，结合群论分析和平均场计算，并引入类似Luttinger-Kohn模型的低能有效模型描述零动量劈裂。

papers.title: Multi-particle gates on driven one-dimensional paths: probing deep traps
papers.abstract: We study single-file transport of driven overdamped colloidal particles on a periodic path with deep potential wells. In the small trap limit (i.e., trap size smaller than particle size), the particle current transitions from zero to finite as the number of particles on the path exceeds a critical number $n_c$. Beyond this threshold, $n_c$ particles cluster behind the trap, demonstrating collective correlated motion. The remaining `extra' particles circulate, giving a finite current. We study this phenomenon numerically using overdamped Brownian dynamics simulations, and present an experimental realization of this behaviour for micron-scale colloidal particles driven in an optical vortex. Using our experimental observations, we present results characterizing potential wells as deep as several hundred $k_BT$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“numerically using overdamped Brownian dynamics simulations”和“experimental realization”。；研究对象：驱动过阻尼胶体粒子在具有深势阱的周期性路径上的单列输运现象，特别是深陷阱（deep traps）对粒子流的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当周期性路径上的粒子数超过临界值 \( n_c \) 时，粒子流从零变为有限；\( n_c \) 个粒子在陷阱后聚集形成集体关联运动，而“额外”粒子则循环流动产生电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当周期性路径上的粒子数超过临界值 \( n_c \) 时，粒子流从零变为有限；\( n_c \) 个粒子在陷阱后聚集形成集体关联运动，而“额外”粒子则循环流动产生电流。；创新点：首次在实验上实现了对深势阱（数百 \( k_BT \)）中驱动胶体粒子单列输运的定量表征，并揭示了小陷阱极限下粒子数阈值导致的零电流到有限电流的转变机制。
papers.method_zh: 过阻尼布朗动力学数值模拟；实验上使用光学涡旋（optical vortex）驱动微米级胶体粒子，并利用实验观测表征深达数百 \( k_BT \) 的势阱。

papers.title: Arrival times of an atomic Bose-Einstein condensate
papers.abstract: The times of flight of an atomic Bose-Einstein condensate are theoretically investigated in the experimentally unexplored regime corresponding to detection close to the trap of the condensate. In this regime, there is no consensus on how to calculate the distribution of times of arrival onto the detector. For non-interacting particles, distinct theoretical predictions have been made in the past. This work analyses how these predictions are modified for an interacting Bose-Einstein condensate. For this purpose, a time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equation is solved analytically and numerically.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：theoretically investigated、analytically and numerically、time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equation）；研究对象：原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensate）在探测器靠近陷阱时的到达时间分布。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于存在相互作用的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，过去针对无相互作用粒子提出的不同到达时间理论预测会被修正，且可通过解析和数值求解含时Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行分析。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于存在相互作用的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，过去针对无相互作用粒子提出的不同到达时间理论预测会被修正，且可通过解析和数值求解含时Gross-Pitaevskii方程进行分析。；创新点：首次在实验尚未探索的“探测器靠近陷阱”区域，系统研究相互作用对玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体到达时间分布的影响，并比较了此前无相互作用粒子理论预测的修正情况。
papers.method_zh: 解析与数值求解含时Gross-Pitaevskii方程（time-dependent Gross-Pitaevskii equation）。

papers.title: Spin transport in a normal meta-altermagnetic superconducting nanowire junction
papers.abstract: Spin triplet superconductors are considered a promising platform for dissipationless spin transport, where spin currents are carried by spin triplet Cooper pairs. In this paper, we propose that the spin triplet superconductivity and spin supercurrent can be engineered in an altermagnetic superconducting nanowire, where a one-dimensional nanowire is placed on the surface of an s-wave superconductor and in proximity to the altermagnet. Using the nonequilibrium Green's function method, we demonstrate a nonzero equal spin Andreev reflection coefficient at the normal metal-altermagnetic superconducting nanowire interface, thereby verifying the injection of spin triplet Cooper pairs. Furthermore, we systematically investigate the spin transport properties in this hybrid system under a spin bias. Our results demonstrate that these properties can be effectively tuned by the chemical potential and spin bias orientation. Our proposal provides a pathway toward realizing dissipationless spin transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“非平衡格林函数方法”（nonequilibrium Green‘s function method）进行理论计算和模拟。；研究对象：正常金属-交变磁体超导纳米线结（normal metal-altermagnetic superconducting nanowire junction）。具体体系为一维纳米线置于s波超导体表面，并与交变磁体（altermagnet）邻近。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正常金属与交变磁体超导纳米线的界面处存在非零的等自旋安德烈夫反射系数，证实了自旋三重态库珀对的注入；并且该混合体系的自旋输运性质可通过化学势和自旋偏压方向进行有效调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正常金属与交变磁体超导纳米线的界面处存在非零的等自旋安德烈夫反射系数，证实了自旋三重态库珀对的注入；并且该混合体系的自旋输运性质可通过化学势和自旋偏压方向进行有效调控。；创新点：提出在交变磁体超导纳米线中工程化自旋三重态超导和自旋超流的方案，为在常规s波超导体/交变磁体混合体系中实现无耗散自旋输运提供了新路径。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡格林函数方法（nonequilibrium Green‘s function method）。

papers.title: Exciton Transport in Disordered Perovskite Nanocrystal Solids
papers.abstract: Solution-processed thin films of colloidal lead halide perovskite (LHP) nanocrystals (NCs) show great potential for the implementation into optoelectronic devices such as light-emitting diodes (LEDs), lasers, and solar cells. However, these hybrid LHP NC solids exhibit non-negligible size and shape polydispersity, which introduces both structural and energetic disorder. Here, we resolve the exciton dynamics in space, time, and energy to elucidate the impact of different forms of disorder (structural and energetic) on exciton transport. We show that the disorder depends sensitively on the length of the alkylamine ligand used in the synthesis. While shorter alkyl chain lengths lead to high polydispersity, longer alkyl chains lead to more monodispersed and smaller particles where quantum confinement becomes more pronounced and, consequently, lead to increased energetic disorder. Strikingly, we find that exciton transport is less efficient in NC solids with long alkyl chain ligands, despite having a significantly more monodisperse ensemble. This demonstrates that energetic disorder, rather than structural disorder, is the dominant factor for predicting exciton transport within these materials. These findings reveal the critical role of ligand engineering in designing high-performance optoelectronic devices based on hybrid LHP NCs, providing new insights into energy transport dynamics in disordered systems and highlighting the versatility of these materials for advanced photonic and optoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“resolve the exciton dynamics in space, time, and energy”，并描述了对不同配体长度样品的比较研究，属于实验观测与表征。；研究对象：胶体铅卤钙钛矿纳米晶体（LHP NCs）固体薄膜中的激子输运行为，重点关注结构无序（尺寸/形状多分散性）和能量无序（量子限域效应导致的能级分布）对输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在钙钛矿纳米晶体固体中，能量无序（energetic disorder）而非结构无序（structural disorder）是决定激子输运效率的主导因素。使用长链烷基胺配体虽能获得更单分散的纳米晶体，但由于量子限域增强导致能量无序增加，反而使激子输运效率降低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在钙钛矿纳米晶体固体中，能量无序（energetic disorder）而非结构无序（structural disorder）是决定激子输运效率的主导因素。使用长链烷基胺配体虽能获得更单分散的纳米晶体，但由于量子限域增强导致能量无序增加，反而使激子输运效率降低。；创新点：揭示了配体工程在调控钙钛矿纳米晶体固体中能量无序与结构无序的竞争关系中的关键作用，并首次明确指出能量无序是限制激子输运的主要因素，而非通常认为的结构多分散性。
papers.method_zh: 通过空间、时间和能量分辨的激子动力学测量，系统研究了不同烷基胺配体链长（短链 vs 长链）合成的纳米晶体固体中的激子输运行为。

papers.title: Anomalous magneto-optical response at $\mathrm{RuO_2 / WSe_2}$ van der Waals interface
papers.abstract: Ruthenium dioxide ($\mathrm{RuO_2}$) has been proposed as an altermagnetic candidate, although its magnetic ground state remains controversial. Here, we probe weak interfacial magnetic states at the surface of (001)-oriented $\mathrm{RuO_2}$ films using the magnetic proximity effect (MPE) in a van der Waals heterostructure consisting of monolayer tungsten diselenide ($\mathrm{WSe_2}$) atop $\mathrm{RuO_2}$. Temperature-dependent magneto-optical spectroscopy reveals an anomalous excitonic energy shift and a deviation from conventional Varshni behavior below 55 K that are absent in an encapsulated $\mathrm{WSe_2}$ control sample. The anomalous shift reverses sign upon field cooling with opposite magnetic field polarity, indicating a magnetic origin. Polarization-resolved measurements further show a nearly field-independent and fluctuating valley splitting in $\mathrm{WSe_2 / RuO_2}$ in strong contrast to the conventional linear Zeeman splitting observed in the control bare $\mathrm{WSe_2}$ sample. These results suggest that the valley states are governed predominantly by interfacial exchange fields associated with weak surface magnetic states in $\mathrm{RuO_2}$, which do not produce a conventional linear Zeeman response within the applied magnetic field range. Importantly, this approach enables direct optical probing of emergent surface magnetism without introducing an additional ferromagnetic layer, positioning MPE-based optical probing as a tool for investigating weak surface magnetism and offering new possibilities for studying magnetic materials with controversial magnetic states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：magneto-optical spectroscopy（磁光光谱）、polarization-resolved measurements（偏振分辨测量）、field cooling（场冷）。；研究对象：RuO₂(001)薄膜与单层WSe₂构成的范德华异质结界面，以及该界面处RuO₂的弱表面磁性态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在RuO₂/WSe₂异质结中，温度依赖的磁光光谱在55 K以下出现反常激子能量偏移和偏离常规Varshni行为，且该偏移在场冷时随磁场极性反转而改变符号，表明其起源于RuO₂表面的弱磁性态。同时，WSe₂/RuO₂中的谷劈裂近乎与磁场无关且存在涨落，与裸WSe₂中常规线性塞曼劈裂形成鲜明对比，说明谷态主要受RuO₂表面交换场调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在RuO₂/WSe₂异质结中，温度依赖的磁光光谱在55 K以下出现反常激子能量偏移和偏离常规Varshni行为，且该偏移在场冷时随磁场极性反转而改变符号，表明其起源于RuO₂表面的弱磁性态。同时，WSe₂/RuO₂中的谷劈裂近乎与磁场无关且存在涨落，与裸WSe₂中常规线性塞曼劈裂形成鲜明对比，说明谷态主要受RuO₂表面交换场调控。；创新点：通过磁邻近效应（MPE）在无需额外铁磁层的情况下，利用光学手段直接探测RuO₂的弱表面磁性态，为研究具有争议性磁基态的材料提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 磁光光谱（magneto-optical spectroscopy）、偏振分辨测量（polarization-resolved measurements）、场冷（field cooling）实验，以及封装WSe₂对照样品。

papers.title: Activity driven buckling and pattern formation in shells of oriented solids
papers.abstract: We investigate shells of active oriented solid, materials in which orientationally ordered active particles are embedded in a deformable elastic surface. Focusing on cylindrical geometries, we show that active stresses drive a new class of buckling instabilities and nonlinear patterns absent in passive shells. Linear stability analysis reveals that the unstable buckling mode is selected by the nematic orientation and activity sign, leading to axial, circumferential, and helical deformations. Remarkably, circumferential modes become unstable at arbitrarily small activity due to the absence of stretching costs. The results of the linear stability analysis are corroborated by full nonlinear simulations, which further uncover steady diamond shaped patterns and persistent dynamical states including oscillations, traveling domain walls, and propagating waves. Our results establish fundamental buckling modes and emergent patterns in shells of active oriented solid materials, with potential relevance to active biological tissues and engineered responsive materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含计算模拟）。关键词：linear stability analysis（线性稳定性分析）、full nonlinear simulations（全非线性模拟）。；研究对象：活性取向固体构成的壳结构（shells of active oriented solid materials），具体为嵌入可变形弹性表面的取向有序活性粒子体系，重点研究圆柱形几何构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性应力驱动了被动壳中不存在的全新屈曲失稳类型和非线性图案，包括轴向、周向和螺旋形变形；周向模式在任意小活性下即可失稳，且非线性模拟揭示了稳态菱形图案及振荡、传播波等动态态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性应力驱动了被动壳中不存在的全新屈曲失稳类型和非线性图案，包括轴向、周向和螺旋形变形；周向模式在任意小活性下即可失稳，且非线性模拟揭示了稳态菱形图案及振荡、传播波等动态态。；创新点：首次系统建立了活性取向固体壳中的基本屈曲模式与涌现图案，揭示了活性应力可克服被动壳中拉伸成本从而在极低活性下触发周向失稳，并发现了被动系统中不存在的动态态（如振荡、传播畴壁、行波）。
papers.method_zh: 线性稳定性分析（确定失稳模式与向列取向、活性符号的关系）结合全非线性数值模拟（揭示非线性图案与动态行为）。

papers.title: Effects of nonlocal interactions on s- and d-wave superconducting correlations in the extended Hubbard model
papers.abstract: We investigate the influence of nonlocal interactions on superconducting correlations within the extended Hubbard model. In addition to the on-site Coulomb interaction and nearest-neighbor hopping, we include next-nearest-neighbor hopping together with several physically relevant nonlocal terms, namely nearest-neighbor Coulomb interaction, correlated hopping, exchange interaction, and pair hopping. Using Lanczos exact diagonalization on a $4\times4$ cluster, supported by projector quantum Monte Carlo simulations for selected parameter regimes, we analyze pairing correlations in both the s- and d-wave channels. We demonstrate that nonlocal interactions exert a highly nontrivial and symmetry-dependent influence on superconducting correlations. While the on-site repulsion in cooperation with next-nearest-neighbor hopping enhances d-wave pairing tendencies, correlated hopping and nearest-neighbor Coulomb interaction strongly promote s-wave correlations, whereas exchange and pair-hopping interactions can efficiently suppress superconductivity beyond relatively small critical strengths. When all nonlocal interactions are considered simultaneously, the resulting phase diagrams reveal a complex interplay and competition between different pairing symmetries. Our results highlight the crucial role of extended interactions in shaping the pairing landscape of strongly correlated systems and demonstrate that a comprehensive treatment beyond the minimal Hubbard model is essential for a realistic description of unconventional superconductivity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Lanczos exact diagonalization、projector quantum Monte Carlo simulations）；研究对象：扩展Hubbard模型中的超导关联，具体研究s波和d波配对通道在非局域相互作用下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非局域相互作用对超导关联具有高度非平凡且依赖于对称性的影响：在位排斥与次近邻跳跃协同增强d波配对倾向，而关联跳跃和最近邻库仑相互作用则强烈促进s波关联；交换和配对跳跃相互作用在超过临界强度后能有效抑制超导电性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非局域相互作用对超导关联具有高度非平凡且依赖于对称性的影响：在位排斥与次近邻跳跃协同增强d波配对倾向，而关联跳跃和最近邻库仑相互作用则强烈促进s波关联；交换和配对跳跃相互作用在超过临界强度后能有效抑制超导电性。；创新点：系统研究了多种非局域相互作用（最近邻库仑相互作用、关联跳跃、交换相互作用、配对跳跃）同时存在时对s波和d波超导关联的复杂竞争与相图，揭示了超越最小Hubbard模型对描述非常规超导电性的必要性。
papers.method_zh: 采用Lanczos精确对角化方法在4×4团簇上进行计算，并辅以投影量子蒙特卡洛模拟对特定参数区域进行验证。

papers.title: Majorana modes in helical altermagnet without net magnetism and spin-orbit coupling
papers.abstract: We propose a scheme to realize topological superconductor and Majorana bound states (MBSs) in a one-dimensional metal nanowire on the surface of a helical altermagnet and in proximity to an s-wave superconductor, removing the requirement of conventional spin-orbit coupling and net magnetism. Through gauge transformation, we demonstrate that the helical frame naturally induces spin-momentum locking while the altermagnetism breaks time-reversal symmetry. The topological superconducting phase is well tuned by chemical potential, altermagnet strength, and helical frequency. Besides, our transport calculation results reveal quantized conductance signatures: a 2e2/h zero-bias peak at nanowire ends and a 4e2/h tunneling conductance at the domain wall of nanowires with opposite chirality, detected via metal lead and scanning tunneling microscopy, respectively. Our research offers new perspectives on finding MBSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：propose a scheme、gauge transformation、transport calculation results。；研究对象：一维金属纳米线置于螺旋交变磁体表面并与s波超导体邻近的体系，用于实现拓扑超导和马约拉纳束缚态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无需传统自旋-轨道耦合和净磁性的条件下，通过螺旋交变磁体诱导的自旋-动量锁定和交变磁性破缺时间反演对称性，可实现拓扑超导相和马约拉纳束缚态，并在输运计算中观察到量子化的电导特征（纳米线末端的2e²/h零偏压峰和手性相反纳米线畴壁处的4e²/h隧穿电导）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无需传统自旋-轨道耦合和净磁性的条件下，通过螺旋交变磁体诱导的自旋-动量锁定和交变磁性破缺时间反演对称性，可实现拓扑超导相和马约拉纳束缚态，并在输运计算中观察到量子化的电导特征（纳米线末端的2e²/h零偏压峰和手性相反纳米线畴壁处的4e²/h隧穿电导）。；创新点：提出在无净磁性和自旋-轨道耦合的条件下，利用螺旋交变磁体实现马约拉纳束缚态的新方案。
papers.method_zh: 通过规范变换分析螺旋框架下的自旋-动量锁定机制；通过调节化学势、交变磁体强度和螺旋频率调控拓扑超导相；采用输运计算（金属引线和扫描隧道显微镜探测）得到电导特征。

papers.title: On representation of macroscopic crack in periodic fine-scale discrete mechanical models
papers.abstract: In multiscale modeling of heterogeneous softening materials, boundary conditions (BC) in the fine-scale model strongly influence the strain localization pattern and the macroscopic response. For rectilinear models (e.g., squares or cubes), standard Periodic BCs produce artificially ductile behavior with excessive energy dissipation when the localization band inclination does not match the periodicity directions. Recently proposed Tessellation and Percolation-path-aligned BCs promise to address this by adapting the periodicity frame to align with the evolving localization bands. Alternatively, spherical/circular models provide an orientation independent response by design. Unfortunately, the standard Periodic BCs do not allow development of proper localization band crossing spherical model's boundaries. A recently proposed modification addresses this by adding a displacement jump to the spherical periodic BCs. This study evaluates the applicability of these novel BCs to a mesoscale discrete particle model of concrete. Two-dimensional square and circular models under uniaxial tension with different loading directions are analyzed, with the selected approaches extended to three-dimensional cube models. Results show that Percolation-path-aligned BCs exhibit major shortcomings: they can lead to multiple localization bands due to uneven straining of the two boundary sections and their weakly constrained section can be prone to spurious strain localization. In contrast, Tessellation BCs consistently yield a well-defined localization band, whose length is determined solely by the model geometry, making it straightforward to account for in post-processing. Periodic boundary conditions augmented with a displacement jump applied to a circular model sometimes incorrect produce crack patterns similar to those under the standard Periodic BCs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“多尺度建模”、“边界条件”、“离散粒子模型”等计算模拟关键词，并通过对不同边界条件的数值结果进行分析和比较。；研究对象：论文研究的具体对象是细观尺度的离散力学模型，具体为混凝土的二维和三维离散粒子模型。核心物理现象是材料在单轴拉伸下的应变局部化（裂纹）模式及其对宏观力学响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，在模拟非均匀软化材料的裂纹时，新近提出的“渗流路径对齐边界条件”存在重大缺陷，可能导致多条局部化带或虚假应变局部化；而“镶嵌边界条件”能稳定产生单一、明确的局部化带，其长度仅由模型几何决定，便于后处理。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，在模拟非均匀软化材料的裂纹时，新近提出的“渗流路径对齐边界条件”存在重大缺陷，可能导致多条局部化带或虚假应变局部化；而“镶嵌边界条件”能稳定产生单一、明确的局部化带，其长度仅由模型几何决定，便于后处理。；创新点：摘要未突出说明该工作相对于已有研究的核心创新点，但可以推断其创新在于系统性地评估并揭示了“渗流路径对齐边界条件”和“镶嵌边界条件”等新型边界条件在模拟混凝土等非均匀材料裂纹时的适用性与局限性，特别是指出了前者可能导致非物理的裂纹模式。
papers.method_zh: 采用了多尺度建模中的细观离散粒子模型（具体为混凝土模型）。通过对比分析二维正方形、圆形模型以及三维立方体模型在单轴拉伸下的响应，系统评估了多种边界条件的表现，包括：标准周期性边界条件、镶嵌边界条件、渗流路径对齐边界条件、以及带有位移跳跃的球形周期性边界条件。

papers.title: Independent Control of Transport and Order in a Ratcheted Colloidal Suspension
papers.abstract: We study directed transport in a two-dimensional suspension of repulsively interacting colloids driven by a stochastic asymmetric piecewise-linear flashing ratchet using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. The driving frequency and the ratchet asymmetry offer two independent ways of controlling the particle current, but they affect the suspension differently. At fixed asymmetry, the current shows a resonance with ratcheting frequency that is set by the collective relaxation dynamics of the interacting particles. The resulting increase in transport is accompanied by defect-mediated structural changes, showing density-dependent hexatic and solid-like states, with larger currents generally associated with weaker ordering. By contrast, at fixed frequency, changing the ratchet asymmetry mainly alters the strength of the directed bias and can significantly enhance the current while leaving the hexatic order largely unchanged. Near the equilibrium hexatic-melting regime, this makes it possible to generate substantial directed currents without strongly disrupting sixfold orientational order. These results show that frequency tuning couples transport to structural reorganization, whereas asymmetry tuning primarily controls transport leaving the structure largely unaltered, providing distinct and complementary routes for manipulating transport and order in driven colloidal suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“large-scale molecular dynamics simulations”（大规模分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：二维排斥相互作用胶体悬浮液在随机非对称分段线性闪烁棘轮驱动下的定向输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节棘轮驱动频率和不对称性，可以独立控制胶体悬浮液的定向输运电流与六角取向序：频率调谐会耦合输运与结构重组，而不对称性调谐则主要改变输运而不显著影响结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节棘轮驱动频率和不对称性，可以独立控制胶体悬浮液的定向输运电流与六角取向序：频率调谐会耦合输运与结构重组，而不对称性调谐则主要改变输运而不显著影响结构。；创新点：揭示了频率调谐与不对称性调谐两种互补的调控路径，前者通过集体弛豫动力学共振增强输运并伴随缺陷介导的结构变化，后者则能在保持六角序基本不变的情况下显著增强定向电流，从而在近平衡六角熔化区域实现不破坏取向序的强定向输运。
papers.method_zh: 大规模分子动力学模拟（large-scale molecular dynamics simulations），模拟二维排斥相互作用胶体在随机非对称分段线性闪烁棘轮（stochastic asymmetric piecewise-linear flashing ratchet）驱动下的动力学行为。

papers.title: Truncated Wigner dynamics of biclique quantum spin glasses
papers.abstract: Quantum spin glasses are often considered testbeds for studying quantum optimization algorithms and as such have been the subject of various quantum advantage claims. Here we investigate the near adiabatic dynamics of biclique quantum spin glasses within the (discrete) truncated Wigner approximation (TWA). Benchmarks on small systems show that TWA recovers sample-to-sample fluctuations of the Edwards-Anderson order parameter, over a wide range of annealing times, with increasing fidelity when the system size increases. We extract critical exponents from the Binder cumulant in line with theoretical expectations, reproducing recent quantum experiments. The computational cost of the method is minimal and it can easily be applied to tens of thousands of qubits.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：truncated Wigner approximation (TWA)、critical exponents、computational cost。；研究对象：双团簇量子自旋玻璃（biclique quantum spin glasses）的近绝热动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双团簇量子自旋玻璃中，离散截断维格纳近似（TWA）能够以极低计算成本高保真度地再现系统尺寸增大时的样本间涨落，并提取出与理论预期一致的临界指数，重现了近期量子实验的结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双团簇量子自旋玻璃中，离散截断维格纳近似（TWA）能够以极低计算成本高保真度地再现系统尺寸增大时的样本间涨落，并提取出与理论预期一致的临界指数，重现了近期量子实验的结果。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用离散截断维格纳近似（TWA）进行数值模拟，通过计算Edwards-Anderson序参量的样本间涨落以及Binder累积量提取临界指数，并在小系统上进行了基准测试。

papers.title: Anomalous Transverse Response in Nodal line Semimetal Mn$_{3}$SnC
papers.abstract: The interplay of topological surface states and magnetism gives rise to unconventional transport behaviors such as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE). Antiperovskites such as Mn$3$SnC, which are nodal-line semimetals and exhibit concurrent antiferromagnetic (AFM) and ferromagnetic (FM) ordering, provide a fertile ground for anomalous transport phenomena. Here, we report that the anomalous transport (AHE and ANE) in this compound is predominantly governed by the intrinsic Berry-curvature effect. We establish a unified relationship between the AHE and ANE using Mott's relation. Electron scattering by both AFM and FM magnons is manifested in the anomalous Nernst signal. The ratio of the anomalous Nernst conductivity to the anomalous Hall conductivity, $|α^A{xy}|/σ^A_{xy}$, constitutes a sizable fraction of $k_B/e$, indicating a strong Berry-curvature contribution to the ANE.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：report、measurements、anomalous transport (AHE and ANE)、Mott's relation。；研究对象：反钙钛矿结构节线半金属 Mn₃SnC，具体研究其同时存在反铁磁和铁磁有序时的反常横向输运现象（反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Mn₃SnC 中的反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应主要由内禀贝里曲率效应主导，且两者之间满足 Mott 关系；反常能斯特电导率与反常霍尔电导率的比值达到 kB/e 量级，表明贝里曲率对反常能斯特效应有显著贡献。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Mn₃SnC 中的反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应主要由内禀贝里曲率效应主导，且两者之间满足 Mott 关系；反常能斯特电导率与反常霍尔电导率的比值达到 kB/e 量级，表明贝里曲率对反常能斯特效应有显著贡献。；创新点：首次在同时具有反铁磁和铁磁有序的节线半金属 Mn₃SnC 中，建立了反常霍尔效应与反常能斯特效应之间的定量统一关系（基于 Mott 关系），并揭示了贝里曲率对反常能斯特效应的主导作用。
papers.method_zh: 通过测量反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应的输运数据，利用 Mott 关系建立两者之间的统一关系，并分析反铁磁和铁磁磁子对反常能斯特信号的散射贡献。

papers.title: Large spin splitting at ferromagnetic surfaces of bulk antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: We use density functional theory and model Hamiltonians to reveal large spin splitting of bands localized at low-symmetry, ferromagnetic surfaces of bulk antiferromagnets (AFMs). There is great interest in finding new material platforms combining the robustness and ultrafast dynamics of AFMs with large, functional spin splitting which is often restricted to ferromagnets. Here, we show that a subset of AFM surfaces which have symmetry-allowed magnetization can host large spin splitting via bulk degeneracy lifting of sublattice-resolved exchange splittings. Using model Hamiltonians, we show that the spin splitting is maximized for two ferromagnetic surface motifs: terminations with single uncompensated magnetic sublattices, and two-sublattice surfaces whose sublattices are magnetically and electronically compensated in the bulk, but acquire distinct crystal field environments via surface truncation. The latter case can yield FM-like spin splitting magnitudes while also having vanishingly small uncompensated magnetization. In contrast, when surface magnetization arises from relativistic canting on symmetry-connected sublattices, the spin splitting is expected to be small. We confirm these predictions with first-principles calculations of $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$ and $\mathrm{FeF_2}$, finding splittings from $\sim10\mathrm{meV}$-$\sim1\mathrm{eV}$ depending on the surface in question. Our findings point to intrinsic surface symmetry breaking as a route to large, functional spin splitting in an expanded range of AFM materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合文章。判断依据：使用密度泛函理论（DFT）和模型哈密顿量（model Hamiltonians）进行计算与理论分析。；研究对象：块体反铁磁体（AFMs）中具有低对称性铁磁表面的体系，具体材料为Cr₂O₃和FeF₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在块体反铁磁体的特定铁磁表面上，通过表面截断打破体相简并，可以产生从约10 meV到约1 eV的大自旋劈裂，其幅度可与铁磁体相当，且在某些情况下净磁化极小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在块体反铁磁体的特定铁磁表面上，通过表面截断打破体相简并，可以产生从约10 meV到约1 eV的大自旋劈裂，其幅度可与铁磁体相当，且在某些情况下净磁化极小。；创新点：提出利用反铁磁体表面的固有对称性破缺（而非依赖相对论性自旋倾斜）来实现大自旋劈裂的新机制，从而将反铁磁体的鲁棒性和超快动力学与铁磁体般的大功能自旋劈裂相结合。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）第一性原理计算，以及模型哈密顿量（model Hamiltonians）分析。

papers.title: Transient triplet blockade in Andreev junction
papers.abstract: We study the time-dependent triplet configuration, appearing under nonequilibrium conditions in a nanoscopic junction with two quantum dots coupled in series between superconductor and normal metallic lead. We show that in the situation, when both quantum dots are singly occupied by identical spin electrons, the on-dot electron pairing is suppressed what substantially affects the subgap charge transport. We investigate processes in which such configuration can be temporarily encountered, either due to the initial conditions or by imposing the external magnetic field. Our analytical and numerical calculations provide estimations for the temporal scales, characterizing evolution of the triplet configuration which could be manifested in the time-resolved tunneling measurements. Such nonequilibrium features of the triplet configuration might be relevant to operations on superconducting qubits, in their conventional and/or topological realizations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值计算）。关键词：analytical and numerical calculations、study、investigate。；研究对象：由两个量子点串联在超导体与正常金属引线之间构成的纳米结，在非平衡条件下出现的瞬态三重态构型及其对亚隙电荷输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个量子点均被相同自旋的电子单占据时，点内电子配对被抑制，从而显著影响亚隙电荷输运；这种三重态构型可通过初始条件或外加磁场暂时出现，其时间演化尺度可在时间分辨隧穿测量中显现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个量子点均被相同自旋的电子单占据时，点内电子配对被抑制，从而显著影响亚隙电荷输运；这种三重态构型可通过初始条件或外加磁场暂时出现，其时间演化尺度可在时间分辨隧穿测量中显现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 解析分析与数值计算相结合，用于估算三重态构型演化的时间尺度。

papers.title: Norms, overlaps and Yangian descendants for the Haldane--Shastry spin chain
papers.abstract: The Haldane-Shastry spin chain is a prototypical integrable model with long-range interactions, notable for hosting quasiparticles with fractional statistics and serving as a discrete analogue of a conformal field theory. Its remarkable simplicity is closely tied to a full Yangian spin symmetry. While the highest-weight states for this symmetry are known explicitly, a systematic treatment of the descendant states, needed for the computation of various physical quantities, has remained incomplete. In this work, we provide a detailed construction of these descendants in terms of the algebraic Bethe ansatz following recent work of Ferrando et al. In the limit of extreme twist, it includes the Gelfand-Tsetlin basis. As an application, we derive product and determinant formulae for norms and overlaps of these states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：integrable model（可积模型）、algebraic Bethe ansatz（代数贝特假设）、Yangian symmetry（杨氏对称性）。；研究对象：Haldane-Shastry自旋链，一种具有长程相互作用和分数统计准粒子的可积模型，被视为共形场论的离散类比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统构建了Haldane-Shastry自旋链中Yangian对称性的后代态（descendant states），并推导了这些态的内积和重叠的乘积公式与行列式公式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统构建了Haldane-Shastry自旋链中Yangian对称性的后代态（descendant states），并推导了这些态的内积和重叠的乘积公式与行列式公式。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用代数贝特假设（algebraic Bethe ansatz）框架，结合近期Ferrando等人的工作，在极端扭曲极限下包含Gelfand-Tsetlin基，进行后代态的显式构造。

papers.title: Electric-field-driven magnetic switching and tightly bound interlayer excitons in bilayer CrSBr
papers.abstract: Electric field control of magnetic order in two-dimensional (2D) van der Waals magnets is a central goal for low-power spin-based technologies. In the ambient-stable antiferromagnet CrSBr, strong magnetic anisotropy and robust exciton-spin coupling provide a favorable platform, yet deterministic electric field control of its magnetic phases has not been achieved. Here we demonstrate electric-field-driven reversible switching between antiferromagnetic and ferromagnetic states in dual-gated bilayer CrSBr without intentional carrier doping. In parallel, photoluminescence measurements resolve a tightly bound interlayer exciton with an intrinsic dipole moment of only ~1 e angstrom. The electric field dependence of the magnetic phase transition reveals two coexisting mechanisms: a linear magnetoelectric effect in the antiferromagnetic state and an electric-field-modulated interlayer exchange coupling. Their interplay accounts for the asymmetric evolution of the critical magnetic field. Our results establish bilayer CrSBr as a promising 2D material for electrically controlled spin-optoelectronic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“demonstrate”（演示）、“photoluminescence measurements”（光致发光测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：双层CrSBr（一种环境稳定的反铁磁二维范德华材料）中的电场驱动磁态切换和层间激子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无刻意载流子掺杂的双栅极双层CrSBr中，实现了电场驱动的反铁磁与铁磁态之间的可逆切换，并观测到具有约1 e·Å本征偶极矩的强束缚层间激子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无刻意载流子掺杂的双栅极双层CrSBr中，实现了电场驱动的反铁磁与铁磁态之间的可逆切换，并观测到具有约1 e·Å本征偶极矩的强束缚层间激子。；创新点：首次在双层CrSBr中实现了无需载流子掺杂的、电场驱动的确定性磁态可逆切换，并解析了其背后的两种共存物理机制（线性磁电效应与电场调制交换耦合）。
papers.method_zh: 双栅极器件结构施加垂直电场；光致发光（PL）测量；通过电场依赖的磁相变分析，揭示了线性磁电效应和电场调制的层间交换耦合两种共存机制。

papers.title: Direct Observation of Channelised Supercurrents in a Kagome Superconductor
papers.abstract: Superconductors are many-body quantum states in which current flows without dissipation. Theory predicts that supercurrents follow a relatively simple spatial pattern in both conventional and unconventional superconductors. Recent studies into the AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, K, Rb) family of Kagome superconductors indicate that CsV3Sb5 has unconventional transport properties that cannot be accounted for with these simple theories, including reports of intrinsic Josephson junctions, higher order Cooper pairing and the zero field diode effect. Attempts to interpret these findings have focused on the interplay of superconductivity with the unconventional charge density wave (CDW) order in these materials, with which superconductivity competes. A current roadblock to understanding how these kagome superconductors give rise to their intriguing properties is the lack of spatially resolved information about transport. Here we show, using a recently developed superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) microscope, that flakes of CsV3Sb5-xSnx host a network of narrow supercurrent channels. These supercurrent channels emerge at the critical temperature and remain stable for all temperatures and currents. Their non-linear behaviour is consistent with a network of Josephson junctions linked by narrow supercurrent filaments, which naturally leads to the observed transport anomalies. Intriguingly, these observations are much weaker in undoped samples, which suggests links to the physics of charge density waves, disorder, and electronic correlations, all of which are greatly influenced by the doping strength. These results establish new frontiers for the local investigation of charge transport and competing orders in strongly correlated electron systems, and shine a new light on the anomalous transport properties of the AV3Sb5 kagome superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：Direct Observation、SQUID microscope、flakes、transport anomalies。；研究对象：Kagome超导体CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ（掺杂锡的铯钒锑）中的超电流空间分布与输运异常。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ薄片中直接观测到由窄超电流通道构成的网络，这些通道在临界温度出现后保持稳定，其非线性行为与约瑟夫森结网络一致，从而解释了该材料中反常的输运特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ薄片中直接观测到由窄超电流通道构成的网络，这些通道在临界温度出现后保持稳定，其非线性行为与约瑟夫森结网络一致，从而解释了该材料中反常的输运特性。；创新点：首次提供了Kagome超导体中超电流空间分布的直接实验图像，揭示了窄超电流通道网络的存在，并将该微观结构与宏观输运异常（如本征约瑟夫森结、零场二极管效应）联系起来。摘要未突出说明与理论预测的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 使用最近发展的超导量子干涉仪（SQUID）显微镜对CsV₃Sb₅₋ₓSnₓ薄片进行空间分辨的超电流成像。

papers.title: Hartree-Fock Limit for Energies in Solids
papers.abstract: This study establishes a route to the Hartree--Fock (HF) limit for molecules and solids within the linearized augmented plane wave (LAPW) framework. We remove current limitations of the standard LAPW approach to nonlocal exchange by constructing radial basis functions and core orbitals consistently with the HF Hamiltonian. The presented method yields total energies of molecules and solids with a precision of a few $μ$Ha, and we use it to provide reference data for 14 semiconductors and insulators. For the systems considered in this study, the standard approach based on (semi)local potentials for constructing radial basis functions and core orbitals remains highly precise for practical relative energies, including molecular and solid-state formation energies and Si self-interstitial defect formation energies. More broadly, the results provide stringent all-electron benchmarks for basis-set and pseudopotential assessment, improve error control in hybrid-functional calculations within LAPW, and open the way to X-ray spectroscopy simulations within LAPW based directly on hybrid-functional core orbitals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Hartree-Fock limit、linearized augmented plane wave (LAPW) framework、all-electron benchmarks。；研究对象：固体（包括分子和固体）中的总能量计算，具体测试了14种半导体和绝缘体，以及Si自间隙缺陷形成能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在LAPW框架内，通过一致地构造径向基函数和芯态轨道，可以消除标准LAPW方法处理非局域交换时的局限性，使分子和固体的总能量精度达到几个μHa。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在LAPW框架内，通过一致地构造径向基函数和芯态轨道，可以消除标准LAPW方法处理非局域交换时的局限性，使分子和固体的总能量精度达到几个μHa。；创新点：首次在LAPW框架内实现了对分子和固体总能量达到μHa精度的HF极限计算，并提供了14种半导体和绝缘体的参考数据。摘要未突出说明该方法与现有全电子或赝势方法在具体算法上的差异细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性化缀加平面波（LAPW）框架，建立了一条达到Hartree-Fock（HF）极限的路径。具体做法是：使径向基函数和芯态轨道与HF哈密顿量自洽一致，从而克服标准LAPW方法在处理非局域交换时的限制。

papers.title: Terahertz frequency upconversion by coherently driving charge dynamics in the InSb/CdTe heterostructure
papers.abstract: We investigate terahertz (THz) harmonic generation in the InSb/CdTe heterostructure, demonstrating, for the first time, efficient in-plane magnetic field-induced second-harmonic generation (SHG). We also achieve significant third-harmonic generation (THG), rivalling Dirac materials such as graphene and Cd3As2. Our theoretical analysis identifies the primary SHG mechanism as the orbital-Zeeman correction to Drude conductivity, while the dominant THG contribution also shows Drude-like behavior. The results provide a general route to efficient THz harmonic generation in high mobility materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We investigate...demonstrating...”（实验观测）以及“Our theoretical analysis identifies...”（理论分析）。；研究对象：InSb/CdTe异质结中的太赫兹（THz）谐波产生现象，具体包括面内磁场诱导的二次谐波产生（SHG）和三次谐波产生（THG）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在InSb/CdTe异质结中实现高效的面内磁场诱导太赫兹二次谐波产生，并获得了与石墨烯、Cd₃As₂等狄拉克材料相媲美的显著三次谐波产生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在InSb/CdTe异质结中实现高效的面内磁场诱导太赫兹二次谐波产生，并获得了与石墨烯、Cd₃As₂等狄拉克材料相媲美的显著三次谐波产生。；创新点：首次在InSb/CdTe异质结中实现磁场诱导的太赫兹二次谐波产生，并揭示其物理机制为轨道-塞曼修正，同时证明该体系在三次谐波产生效率上可与狄拉克材料竞争，为高迁移率材料中的高效太赫兹谐波产生提供通用路径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用太赫兹谐波产生技术；理论上通过分析Drude电导率中的轨道-塞曼修正（orbital-Zeeman correction）来解释二次谐波机制，并指出三次谐波也呈现类Drude行为。

papers.title: E. coli bacterium near corrugated surfaces: near-suface swimming, escape, and hydrodynamic trapping
papers.abstract: Bacteria often swim in complex environments where surfaces are ubiquitous and rarely flat. Surface topography and curvature can strongly affect bacterial motility, with important consequences for surface exploration, adhesion, and biofilm formation.
